# RedOx Engine — Полный документ по системе рендеринга (весь код + описание) — v3 (финал, vsm_screen_shadows=ON)

> Срез: 2026-08-30 (финал) | vsm_screen_shadows теперь `true` по умолчанию (1 Vogel-луч + темпораль) | 44 шейдера + 75 Rust

## Изменения финала
- `renderer/mod.rs:1472` `vsm_screen_shadows: false → true` + комменты `default ON`
- `pbr.wgsl` теперь семплирует `t_vsm_shadow` (1 fetch) вместо 16-лучевого `vsm_shadow()`
- Все фиксы paste-1 сохранены (gtao bent `-tan_v`, `gtao_disabled` uniform, `gtao_upsample` guard, `vsm_smrt` скобки, `vg_resolve` 23 бинда, `vsm_clipmap` CACHED)

### `shaders/bloom.wgsl` | **Строк:** 76

```wgsl
//! Dual-filter bloom — 6-mip downsample / upsample fullscreen passes.
//!
//! `fs_downsample_threshold` extracts bright HDR into the first mip.
//! `fs_downsample` continues the chain without re-thresholding.
//! `fs_upsample` applies a 9-tap tent filter (caller blends ADD into the
//! already-downsampled finer mip).

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_source: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_linear: sampler;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn sample_box5(uv: vec2<f32>, texel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    var c = textureSample(t_source, s_linear, uv).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, uv + vec2<f32>( texel.x,  0.0)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, uv + vec2<f32>(-texel.x,  0.0)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, uv + vec2<f32>( 0.0,  texel.y)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, uv + vec2<f32>( 0.0, -texel.y)).rgb;
    return c * 0.2;
}

fn apply_threshold(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if (any(c != c) || any(abs(c) > vec3<f32>(65504.0))) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let safe_c = max(c, vec3<f32>(0.0));
    let lum = dot(safe_c, vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    let knee = max(lum - 1.0, 0.0);
    return safe_c * (knee / max(lum, 1.0e-4));
}

@fragment
fn fs_downsample_threshold(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let texel = 1.0 / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_source));
    let c = apply_threshold(sample_box5(in.uv, texel));
    return vec4<f32>(c, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_downsample(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let texel = 1.0 / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_source));
    let c = sample_box5(in.uv, texel);
    return vec4<f32>(c, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_upsample(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    // 9-tap tent filter (weights sum to 16).
    let texel = 1.0 / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_source));
    let o = texel;
    var c = textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv).rgb * 4.0;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-o.x,  0.0)).rgb * 2.0;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>( o.x,  0.0)).rgb * 2.0;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>( 0.0, -o.y)).rgb * 2.0;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>( 0.0,  o.y)).rgb * 2.0;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-o.x, -o.y)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>( o.x, -o.y)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-o.x,  o.y)).rgb;
    c = c + textureSample(t_source, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>( o.x,  o.y)).rgb;
    c = c * (1.0 / 16.0) * 1.15;
    return vec4<f32>(c, 1.0);
}

```

### `shaders/bloom_composite.wgsl` | **Строк:** 26

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var t_base: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_bloom: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var s_linear: sampler;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let base = textureSample(t_base, s_linear, in.uv);
    let bloom = textureSample(t_bloom, s_linear, in.uv);
    return vec4<f32>(base.rgb + bloom.rgb * 0.4, base.a);
}
```

### `shaders/brdf_lut.wgsl` | **Строк:** 74

```wgsl
const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

@group(0) @binding(0) var output_lut: texture_storage_2d<rgba16float, write>;

fn radical_inverse_vdc(bits_in: u32) -> f32 {
    var bits = (bits_in << 16u) | (bits_in >> 16u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x55555555u) << 1u) | ((bits & 0xAAAAAAAAu) >> 1u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x33333333u) << 2u) | ((bits & 0xCCCCCCCCu) >> 2u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x0F0F0F0Fu) << 4u) | ((bits & 0xF0F0F0F0u) >> 4u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x00FF00FFu) << 8u) | ((bits & 0xFF00FF00u) >> 8u);
    return f32(bits) * 2.3283064365386963e-10;
}
fn hammersley(i: u32, n: u32) -> vec2<f32> {
    return vec2<f32>(f32(i) / f32(n), radical_inverse_vdc(i));
}
fn importance_sample_ggx(xi: vec2<f32>, n: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let a  = roughness * roughness;
    let phi       = 2.0 * PI * xi.x;
    let cos_theta = sqrt((1.0 - xi.y) / (1.0 + (a * a - 1.0) * xi.y));
    let sin_theta = sqrt(1.0 - cos_theta * cos_theta);
    let h = vec3<f32>(cos(phi) * sin_theta, sin(phi) * sin_theta, cos_theta);
    var up = vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    if (abs(n.y) > 0.999) { up = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
    let right = normalize(cross(up, n));
    up = cross(n, right);
    return normalize(right * h.x + up * h.y + n * h.z);
}
fn geometry_schlick_ggx_ibl(n_dot_v: f32, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let k = (roughness * roughness) / 2.0;
    return n_dot_v / (n_dot_v * (1.0 - k) + k);
}
fn geometry_smith_ibl(n_dot_v: f32, n_dot_l: f32, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    return geometry_schlick_ggx_ibl(n_dot_v, roughness)
         * geometry_schlick_ggx_ibl(n_dot_l, roughness);
}

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn brdf_lut(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    let size = textureDimensions(output_lut);
    if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; }

    let n_dot_v   = max(f32(id.x) / f32(size.x), 0.001);
    let roughness = max(f32(id.y) / f32(size.y), 0.001);

    var v: vec3<f32>;
    v.x = sqrt(1.0 - n_dot_v * n_dot_v);
    v.y = 0.0;
    v.z = n_dot_v;

    var a = 0.0;
    var b = 0.0;
    let n = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let sample_count = 1024u;

    for (var i = 0u; i < sample_count; i++) {
        let xi    = hammersley(i, sample_count);
        let h     = importance_sample_ggx(xi, n, roughness);
        let l     = normalize(2.0 * dot(v, h) * h - v);
        let n_dot_l = max(l.z, 0.0);
        let n_dot_h = max(h.z, 0.0);
        let v_dot_h = max(dot(v, h), 0.0);
        if (n_dot_l > 0.0) {
            let g     = geometry_smith_ibl(n_dot_v, n_dot_l, roughness);
            // Guard against division by zero
            let g_vis = (g * v_dot_h) / max(n_dot_h * n_dot_v, 0.0001);
            let fc    = pow(1.0 - v_dot_h, 5.0);
            a += (1.0 - fc) * g_vis;
            b += fc * g_vis;
        }
    }
    textureStore(output_lut, id.xy,
        vec4<f32>(a / f32(sample_count), b / f32(sample_count), 0.0, 1.0));
}

```

### `shaders/cluster_cull_lights.wgsl` | **Строк:** 150

```wgsl
// GPU clustered light assignment — one invocation per cluster.
// Cluster AABBs (depth bands) are built on CPU and uploaded to `cluster_bounds`.
// Depth metric is view-space Z (planar), matching fragment shaders.

struct ClusterBounds {
    min_depth: f32,
    max_depth: f32,
}

struct ClusterMetadata {
    offset: u32,
    count: u32,
}

struct ClusterInfo {
    clusters_x: u32,
    clusters_y: u32,
    depth_slices: u32,
    screen_width: u32,
    screen_height: u32,
    near: f32,
    far: f32,
    depth_scale: f32,
    total_clusters: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
    _pad1: u32,
    _pad2: u32,
};

struct PointLight {
    position: vec4<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    shadow_matrices: array<mat4x4<f32>, 6>,
    intensity: f32,
    radius: f32,
    shadow_tile_base: u32,
    _pad: f32,
}

struct CullParams {
    cam_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    num_lights: u32,
    max_lights_per_cluster: u32,
    indices_capacity: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
}

const MAX_LOCAL_LIGHTS: u32 = 256u;

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> cluster_info: ClusterInfo;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> cull_params: CullParams;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> cluster_bounds: array<ClusterBounds>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read> point_lights: array<PointLight>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<storage, read_write> cluster_metadata: array<ClusterMetadata>;
@group(0) @binding(5) var<storage, read_write> light_indices: array<u32>;
@group(0) @binding(6) var<storage, read_write> global_light_offset: atomic<u32>;

fn sphere_intersects_cluster(
    light_pos: vec3<f32>,
    light_radius: f32,
    cluster_idx: u32,
) -> bool {
    let bounds = cluster_bounds[cluster_idx];

    // Perspective: clip.w == view-space depth along -Z (planar), not euclidean.
    let clip = cull_params.view_proj * vec4<f32>(light_pos, 1.0);
    let light_view_z = clip.w;

    if (light_view_z <= 0.0 && light_view_z + light_radius <= 0.0) {
        return false;
    }

    let sphere_near = max(light_view_z - light_radius, 0.0);
    let sphere_far = light_view_z + light_radius;
    if (!(sphere_near <= bounds.max_depth && sphere_far >= bounds.min_depth)) {
        return false;
    }

    // Behind / straddling near plane: skip bogus NDC (matches CPU cull).
    if (clip.w <= 0.0) {
        return false;
    }
    let w = clip.w;
    let ndc = clip.xyz / w;

    let tile_x = cluster_idx % cluster_info.clusters_x;
    let tile_y = (cluster_idx / cluster_info.clusters_x) % cluster_info.clusters_y;
    let tile_min_x = (f32(tile_x) / f32(cluster_info.clusters_x)) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let tile_max_x = (f32(tile_x + 1u) / f32(cluster_info.clusters_x)) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let tile_max_y = 1.0 - (f32(tile_y) / f32(cluster_info.clusters_y)) * 2.0;
    let tile_min_y = 1.0 - (f32(tile_y + 1u) / f32(cluster_info.clusters_y)) * 2.0;

    // Row-wise scale (matches clustering.rs): m[col].row components.
    let scale_x = max(
        max(abs(cull_params.view_proj[0].x), abs(cull_params.view_proj[1].x)),
        abs(cull_params.view_proj[2].x),
    );
    let scale_y = max(
        max(abs(cull_params.view_proj[0].y), abs(cull_params.view_proj[1].y)),
        abs(cull_params.view_proj[2].y),
    );
    let r_ndc_x = light_radius * scale_x / w;
    let r_ndc_y = light_radius * scale_y / w;
    if (ndc.x + r_ndc_x < tile_min_x || ndc.x - r_ndc_x > tile_max_x) {
        return false;
    }
    if (ndc.y + r_ndc_y < tile_min_y || ndc.y - r_ndc_y > tile_max_y) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

@compute @workgroup_size(64, 1, 1)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    let cluster_idx = gid.x;
    if (cluster_idx >= cluster_info.total_clusters) {
        return;
    }

    var count = 0u;
    var local: array<u32, MAX_LOCAL_LIGHTS>;

    let num_lights = cull_params.num_lights;
    let cap = cull_params.max_lights_per_cluster;
    for (var li = 0u; li < num_lights; li = li + 1u) {
        let light = point_lights[li];
        if (sphere_intersects_cluster(light.position.xyz, light.radius, cluster_idx)) {
            if (count < cap) {
                local[count] = li;
                count = count + 1u;
            }
        }
    }

    var write_count = count;
    let offset = atomicAdd(&global_light_offset, write_count);
    // Clamp against compacted index buffer capacity (may be < worst-case).
    let cap_idx = cull_params.indices_capacity;
    if (offset >= cap_idx) {
        write_count = 0u;
    } else if (offset + write_count > cap_idx) {
        write_count = cap_idx - offset;
    }
    cluster_metadata[cluster_idx] = ClusterMetadata(offset, write_count);
    for (var i = 0u; i < write_count; i = i + 1u) {
        light_indices[offset + i] = local[i];
    }
}

```

### `shaders/ddgi_trace.wgsl` | **Строк:** 108

```wgsl
// Compute DDGI probe fill: 8 octahedral rays per probe vs scene AABBs.

struct TraceParams {
    sun_dir: vec4<f32>,
    sun_rad: vec4<f32>,
    origin: vec4<f32>,
    spacing: f32,
    dims_x: u32,
    dims_y: u32,
    dims_z: u32,
    box_count: u32,
    enabled: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
    _pad1: u32,
};

struct SceneBox {
    bmin: vec4<f32>,
    bmax: vec4<f32>,
};

struct DdgiProbeGpu {
    samples: array<vec4<f32>, 8>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> params: TraceParams;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> boxes: array<SceneBox>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read_write> probes: array<DdgiProbeGpu>;

fn sign_nz(x: f32) -> f32 {
    return select(-1.0, 1.0, x >= 0.0);
}

fn oct_decode(index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let x = f32(index % 2u);
    let y = f32(index / 2u);
    let u = (x + 0.5) / 2.0;
    let v = (y + 0.5) / 4.0;
    var f = vec3<f32>(u * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, v * 2.0 - 1.0);
    f.y = 1.0 - abs(f.x) - abs(f.z);
    if (f.y < 0.0) {
        let ox = f.x;
        f.x = (1.0 - abs(f.z)) * sign_nz(ox);
        f.z = (1.0 - abs(ox)) * sign_nz(f.z);
    }
    return normalize(f);
}

fn ray_aabb(orig: vec3<f32>, dir: vec3<f32>, bmin: vec3<f32>, bmax: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
    let inv = 1.0 / dir;
    let t0 = (bmin - orig) * inv;
    let t1 = (bmax - orig) * inv;
    let tmin = max(max(min(t0.x, t1.x), min(t0.y, t1.y)), min(t0.z, t1.z));
    let tmax = min(min(max(t0.x, t1.x), max(t0.y, t1.y)), max(t0.z, t1.z));
    return tmax >= max(tmin, 0.02) && tmin < 48.0;
}

fn ray_blocked(orig: vec3<f32>, dir: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
    let n = min(params.box_count, arrayLength(&boxes));
    for (var i = 0u; i < n; i++) {
        let b = boxes[i];
        if (ray_aabb(orig, dir, b.bmin.xyz, b.bmax.xyz)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

@compute @workgroup_size(64, 1, 1)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    let probe_count = params.dims_x * params.dims_y * params.dims_z;
    let idx = gid.x;
    if (idx >= probe_count || params.enabled == 0u) {
        return;
    }
    let dx = params.dims_x;
    let dy = params.dims_y;
    let x = idx % dx;
    let y = (idx / dx) % dy;
    let z = idx / (dx * dy);
    let pos = params.origin.xyz + vec3<f32>(f32(x), f32(y), f32(z)) * params.spacing;

    let sun = normalize(params.sun_dir.xyz);
    let sun_rad = params.sun_rad.xyz;
    let sky = vec3<f32>(0.22, 0.28, 0.38);
    let ground = vec3<f32>(0.10, 0.09, 0.07);
    let height_term = abs(sin(pos.y * 0.12));

    var out_probe: DdgiProbeGpu;
    var validity = 1.0;
    for (var s = 0u; s < 8u; s++) {
        let dir = oct_decode(s);
        let blocked = ray_blocked(pos + dir * 0.05, dir);
        let hemi = dir.y * 0.5 + 0.5;
        var ambient = mix(sky, ground, 1.0 - hemi) * (0.55 + height_term * 0.15);
        var direct = sun_rad * max(dot(dir, sun), 0.0);
        if (blocked) {
            direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
            ambient = ambient * 0.35;
            validity = 0.65;
        }
        let irr = ambient + direct;
        let w = select(0.0, validity, s == 0u);
        out_probe.samples[s] = vec4<f32>(irr, w);
    }
    probes[idx] = out_probe;
}

```

### `shaders/equirect_to_cube.wgsl` | **Строк:** 34

```wgsl
const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

@group(0) @binding(0) var input_equirect:  texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var samp:            sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var output_cubemap:  texture_storage_2d_array<rgba16float, write>;

fn get_cube_dir(id: vec3<u32>, size: vec2<u32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let uv        = (vec2<f32>(id.xy) + 0.5) / vec2<f32>(size);
    let tex_coords = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    var dir: vec3<f32>;
    let face = id.z;
    if      (face == 0u) { dir = vec3<f32>( 1.0, -tex_coords.y, -tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 1u) { dir = vec3<f32>(-1.0, -tex_coords.y,  tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 2u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x,  1.0,  tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 3u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -1.0, -tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 4u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y,  1.0); }
    else                 { dir = vec3<f32>(-tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y, -1.0); }
    return normalize(dir);
}

fn sample_equirect(v: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let phi   = atan2(v.z, v.x);
    let theta = asin(v.y);
    return vec2<f32>(phi / (2.0 * PI) + 0.5, theta / PI + 0.5);
}

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn equirect_to_cubemap(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    let size = textureDimensions(output_cubemap).xy;
    if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; }
    let color = textureSampleLevel(input_equirect, samp, sample_equirect(get_cube_dir(id, size)), 0.0);
    textureStore(output_cubemap, id.xy, i32(id.z), color);
}

```

### `shaders/forward.wgsl` | **Строк:** 99

```wgsl
// ---- Uniforms ----

struct CameraUniform {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

struct LightUniform {
    dir_color:      vec4<f32>,
    dir_direction:  vec4<f32>,
    ambient:        vec4<f32>,
    point_lights_pos:   array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    point_lights_color: array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    num_point_lights:   u32,
    pad0:               u32,
    pad1:               u32,
    pad2:               u32,
};

struct ModelUniform {
    model: mat4x4<f32>,
    // Inverse-transpose of model (upper-left 3x3) - matches pbr.wgsl Model.
    normal_matrix: mat3x3<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: CameraUniform;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> light_u: LightUniform;
@group(2) @binding(0) var<storage, read> models: array<ModelUniform>;
@group(3) @binding(0) var t_diffuse: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(3) @binding(1) var s_diffuse: sampler;

// ---- Vertex stage ----

struct VertexInput {
    @location(0) position: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) normal:   vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) uv:       vec2<f32>,
    @location(3) tangent:  vec3<f32>,
    @builtin(instance_index) instance_index: u32,
};

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) world_normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) uv:           vec2<f32>,
    @location(2) world_pos:    vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) instance_color: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(in: VertexInput) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let model_data = models[in.instance_index];
    let world_pos = model_data.model * vec4<f32>(in.position, 1.0);
    out.clip_position = camera.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.world_normal = normalize((model_data.model * vec4<f32>(in.normal, 0.0)).xyz);
    out.uv = in.uv;
    out.world_pos = world_pos.xyz;
    out.instance_color = model_data.color;
    return out;
}

// ---- Fragment stage ----

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let tex_color = textureSample(t_diffuse, s_diffuse, in.uv);
    let n = normalize(in.world_normal);

    var total_diffuse = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    // Directional light
    let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
    let diff_dir = max(dot(n, l_dir), 0.0);
    total_diffuse += light_u.dir_color.xyz * diff_dir;

    // Point lights
    for (var i = 0u; i < light_u.num_point_lights; i = i + 1u) {
        let p_pos = light_u.point_lights_pos[i].xyz;
        let p_intensity = light_u.point_lights_pos[i].w;
        let p_color = light_u.point_lights_color[i].xyz;
        let p_radius = light_u.point_lights_color[i].w;

        let l_vec = p_pos - in.world_pos;
        let dist = length(l_vec);
        let l_p = normalize(l_vec);

        let diff_p = max(dot(n, l_p), 0.0);
        
        // Simple attenuation
        let attenuation = p_intensity * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, p_radius, dist));
        total_diffuse += p_color * diff_p * attenuation;
    }

    let final_color = (light_u.ambient.xyz + total_diffuse) * tex_color.xyz * in.instance_color.xyz;
    return vec4<f32>(final_color, tex_color.a * in.instance_color.a);
}

```

### `shaders/gtao.wgsl` | **Строк:** 147

```wgsl
// Ground-Truth AO (slice integration) + bent normals (world space).
// Output: RGB = bent normal, A = scalar visibility [0,1].

struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_noise: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var s_gtao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<uniform> camera: Camera;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const SLICES: u32 = 3u;
const STEPS: u32 = 4u;
const RADIUS_M: f32 = 0.55;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var o: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    o.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    o.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
}

fn view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let view_z = max(linear_depth * FAR, 1e-4);
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0);
    let inv_m00 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[0][0], 1e-6);
    let inv_m11 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[1][1], 1e-6);
    return vec3<f32>(ndc.x * inv_m00 * view_z, ndc.y * inv_m11 * view_z, -view_z);
}

fn project_view_to_uv(view_pos: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let clip = camera.proj * vec4<f32>(view_pos, 1.0);
    let ndc = clip.xy / max(abs(clip.w), 1e-5);
    return vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let px = vec2<i32>(clamp(in.uv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
    let nd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, px, 0);
    let n_world = normalize(nd.rgb);
    let depth = nd.a;
    if (depth >= 0.999 || depth <= 1e-5) {
        return vec4<f32>(n_world, 1.0);
    }

    let view_pos = view_pos_from_uv_depth(in.uv, depth);
    let n_view = normalize((camera.view * vec4<f32>(n_world, 0.0)).xyz);

    let noise_px = vec2<i32>(i32(in.clip_pos.x) & 3, i32(in.clip_pos.y) & 3);
    let noise = textureLoad(t_noise, noise_px, 0).x;

    let texel = 1.0 / dims;
    let radius_uv = clamp(RADIUS_M / max(depth * FAR, 0.5), texel.x * 2.0, 0.08);

    // GTAO horizon integration (XeGTAO / Filament style) + bent normal.
    // Radius in UV: clamp to avoid sampling beyond half-res blur kernel.
    var vis_sum = 0.0;
    var bent_view = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var bent_w = 0.0;

    for (var s = 0u; s < SLICES; s++) {
        let slice_a = (f32(s) + noise) * 6.28318530718 / f32(SLICES);
        let dir2 = vec2<f32>(cos(slice_a), sin(slice_a));
        var h_cos_pos = -1.0;
        var h_cos_neg = -1.0;
        var dir_accum = vec3<f32>(0.0);
        var dir_w = 0.0;

        for (var st = 1u; st <= STEPS; st++) {
            let t = f32(st) / f32(STEPS);
            let off = dir2 * radius_uv * t;
            let suv = in.uv + off;
            if (suv.x < 0.0 || suv.x > 1.0 || suv.y < 0.0 || suv.y > 1.0) {
                continue;
            }
            let spx = vec2<i32>(clamp(suv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
            let sd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, spx, 0).a;
            if (sd >= 0.999) {
                continue;
            }
            let s_view = view_pos_from_uv_depth(suv, sd);
            let v = s_view - view_pos;
            let proj = dot(v, n_view);
            let tan_v = v - n_view * proj;
            let len_t = length(tan_v);
            if (len_t < 1e-5) {
                continue;
            }
            let slice_t = vec3<f32>(dir2.x, dir2.y, 0.0);
            let sign_d = sign(dot(normalize(tan_v), slice_t));
            let h = proj / max(len_t, 1e-4);
            let h_cos = h / sqrt(h * h + 1.0);
            // Horizon angle tracking per side.
            if (sign_d > 0.0) {
                h_cos_pos = max(h_cos_pos, h_cos);
            } else {
                h_cos_neg = max(h_cos_neg, h_cos);
            }
            // Bent direction: weight by UNoccluded direction (opposite to occluder).
            // tan_v points TOWARD the occluder; negate to tilt bent normal into
            // the open hemisphere. Horizon factor (1-h_cos) is larger for blocked samples.
            let falloff = 1.0 - t * 0.5;
            let w = max(0.0, 1.0 - h_cos) * falloff;
            dir_accum = dir_accum + normalize(tan_v) * w * -1.0;
            dir_w += w;
        }

        // Visibility per side: map h_cos∈[-1,1] to visibility. When no hit (h_cos==-1)
        // treat as fully visible (1.0) instead of 0.25+0.75*(-1)= -0.5.
        let v_pos = select(1.0, 0.25 + 0.75 * clamp(h_cos_pos, -1.0, 1.0), h_cos_pos > -0.99);
        let v_neg = select(1.0, 0.25 + 0.75 * clamp(h_cos_neg, -1.0, 1.0), h_cos_neg > -0.99);
        vis_sum += v_pos + v_neg;
        if (dir_w > 0.0) {
            bent_view = bent_view + dir_accum / dir_w;
            bent_w += 1.0;
        }
    }

    let ao = clamp(vis_sum / max(f32(SLICES) * 2.0, 1.0), 0.05, 1.0);
    var bent_world = n_world;
    if (bent_w > 0.0) {
        // Blend accumulated unoccluded directions with geometric view normal
        // to avoid flipping. Weights tuned so flat surfaces keep n_view.
        let bv = normalize(bent_view / bent_w * 0.6 + n_view * 1.4);
        bent_world = normalize((camera.inv_view * vec4<f32>(bv, 0.0)).xyz);
    }
    return vec4<f32>(bent_world, ao);
}
```

### `shaders/gtao_blur.wgsl` | **Строк:** 51

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var t_gtao: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_gtao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const DEPTH_SIGMA: f32 = 0.35;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var o: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    o.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    o.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
}

fn w_bilateral(c: vec4<f32>, s: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    let dw = exp(-abs(c.a - s.a) * FAR / DEPTH_SIGMA);
    let nw = max(dot(normalize(c.rgb), normalize(s.rgb)), 0.0);
    return dw * mix(0.2, 1.0, nw * nw);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let ts = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_gtao));
    let tsz = 1.0 / ts;
    let nds = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let cnd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, vec2<i32>(in.uv * nds), 0);

    var acc = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var y = -3; y <= 3; y++) {
        for (var x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
            let uv = in.uv + vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * tsz;
            let snd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, vec2<i32>(clamp(uv * nds, vec2<f32>(0.0), nds - 1.0)), 0);
            let g = textureSample(t_gtao, s_gtao, uv);
            let w = w_bilateral(cnd, snd) * exp(-0.12 * f32(x * x + y * y));
            acc += g * w;
            wsum += w;
        }
    }
    let out = acc / max(wsum, 1e-5);
    return vec4<f32>(normalize(out.rgb), out.a);
}
```

### `shaders/gtao_upsample.wgsl` | **Строк:** 54

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var t_gtao_half: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_gtao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const DEPTH_SIGMA: f32 = 0.25;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var o: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    o.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    o.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
}

fn w_bilateral(c: vec4<f32>, s: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    let dw = exp(-abs(c.a - s.a) * FAR / DEPTH_SIGMA);
    let nw = max(dot(normalize(c.rgb), normalize(s.rgb)), 0.0);
    return dw * mix(0.2, 1.0, nw * nw);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let full = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let cnd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, vec2<i32>(in.uv * full), 0);
    var acc = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let fpx = vec2<i32>(in.uv * full) + vec2<i32>(x, y);
            let snd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, fpx, 0);
            let huv = (vec2<f32>(fpx) + 0.5) / full;
            let g = textureSample(t_gtao_half, s_gtao, huv);
            let w = w_bilateral(cnd, snd);
            acc += g * w;
            wsum += w;
        }
    }
    // Guard against zero weight on silhouettes (sky vs geometry) — normalize(0) → NaN.
    if (wsum < 1e-4) {
        let g = textureSample(t_gtao_half, s_gtao, in.uv);
        return vec4<f32>(normalize(g.rgb), g.a);
    }
    let out = acc / max(wsum, 1e-5);
    return vec4<f32>(normalize(out.rgb), out.a);
}
```

```wgsl
// Copy depth buffer (non-storage) into Hi-Z mip 0 (r32float storage).

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_depth: texture_depth_2d;
@group(0) @binding(1) var hiz_out: texture_storage_2d<r32float, write>;

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    let dims = textureDimensions(t_depth);
    if (gid.x >= dims.x || gid.y >= dims.y) {
        return;
    }
    let coord = vec2<i32>(i32(gid.x), i32(gid.y));
    let d = textureLoad(t_depth, coord, 0);
    textureStore(hiz_out, coord, vec4<f32>(d, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
}
```

### `shaders/hiz_downsample.wgsl` | **Строк:** 31

```wgsl
// Hi-Z downsample: mip i → mip i+1 via 2×2 max depth reduction.

struct DownsampleParams {
    src_size: vec2<u32>,
    _pad: vec2<u32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_src: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var hiz_out: texture_storage_2d<r32float, write>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> params: DownsampleParams;

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    let dst_dims = textureDimensions(hiz_out);
    if (gid.x >= dst_dims.x || gid.y >= dst_dims.y) {
        return;
    }

    let src_coord = gid.xy * 2u;
    var max_d = 0.0;
    for (var oy = 0u; oy < 2u; oy++) {
        for (var ox = 0u; ox < 2u; ox++) {
            let sc = src_coord + vec2<u32>(ox, oy);
            if (sc.x < params.src_size.x && sc.y < params.src_size.y) {
                max_d = max(max_d, textureLoad(t_src, vec2<i32>(sc), 0).x);
            }
        }
    }
    textureStore(hiz_out, vec2<i32>(gid.xy), vec4<f32>(max_d, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
}
```

### `shaders/irradiance_convolution.wgsl` | **Строк:** 48

```wgsl
const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

@group(0) @binding(0) var environment_map:    texture_cube<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var samp:               sampler;
@group(1) @binding(0) var output_irradiance:  texture_storage_2d_array<rgba16float, write>;

fn get_cube_dir(id: vec3<u32>, size: vec2<u32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let uv        = (vec2<f32>(id.xy) + 0.5) / vec2<f32>(size);
    let tex_coords = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    var dir: vec3<f32>;
    let face = id.z;
    if      (face == 0u) { dir = vec3<f32>( 1.0, -tex_coords.y, -tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 1u) { dir = vec3<f32>(-1.0, -tex_coords.y,  tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 2u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x,  1.0,  tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 3u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -1.0, -tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 4u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y,  1.0); }
    else                 { dir = vec3<f32>(-tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y, -1.0); }
    return normalize(dir);
}

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn irradiance_convolution(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    let size = textureDimensions(output_irradiance).xy;
    if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; }

    let normal = get_cube_dir(id, size);
    var irradiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    var up = vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    if (abs(normal.y) > 0.999) { up = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
    let right = normalize(cross(up, normal));
    up = cross(normal, right);

    let sample_delta = 0.025;
    var nr_samples = 0.0;
    for (var phi = 0.0; phi < 2.0 * PI; phi += sample_delta) {
        for (var theta = 0.0; theta < 0.5 * PI; theta += sample_delta) {
            let ts  = vec3<f32>(sin(theta) * cos(phi), sin(theta) * sin(phi), cos(theta));
            let ws  = ts.x * right + ts.y * up + ts.z * normal;
            irradiance += textureSampleLevel(environment_map, samp, ws, 0.0).rgb
                          * cos(theta) * sin(theta);
            nr_samples += 1.0;
        }
    }
    irradiance = PI * irradiance / nr_samples;
    textureStore(output_irradiance, id.xy, i32(id.z), vec4<f32>(irradiance, 1.0));
}

```

### `shaders/msaa_resolve.wgsl` | **Строк:** 68

```wgsl
struct MsaaResolveUniform {
    sample_count : u32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_msaa : texture_multisampled_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> msaa_u : MsaaResolveUniform;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos : vec4<f32>,
    @location(0)       uv       : vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv       = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn luma_weight(rgb: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let luma = dot(rgb, vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + luma);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let dims = textureDimensions(t_msaa);
    let coord = vec2<i32>(
        i32(in.uv.x * f32(dims.x)),
        i32(in.uv.y * f32(dims.y)),
    );

    var accum = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var weight_sum = 0.0;

    // textureLoad requires a constant sample index on multisampled textures.
    {
        let rgb = textureLoad(t_msaa, coord, 0).rgb;
        let w = luma_weight(rgb);
        accum += rgb * w;
        weight_sum += w;
    }
    if (msaa_u.sample_count > 1u) {
        let rgb = textureLoad(t_msaa, coord, 1).rgb;
        let w = luma_weight(rgb);
        accum += rgb * w;
        weight_sum += w;
    }
    if (msaa_u.sample_count > 2u) {
        let rgb = textureLoad(t_msaa, coord, 2).rgb;
        let w = luma_weight(rgb);
        accum += rgb * w;
        weight_sum += w;
    }
    if (msaa_u.sample_count > 3u) {
        let rgb = textureLoad(t_msaa, coord, 3).rgb;
        let w = luma_weight(rgb);
        accum += rgb * w;
        weight_sum += w;
    }

    let resolved = accum / max(weight_sum, 1e-6);
    return vec4<f32>(resolved, 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/normal.wgsl` | **Строк:** 48

```wgsl
struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

struct Model {
    model: mat4x4<f32>,
    normal_matrix: mat3x3<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> models: array<Model>;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) world_normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(1) world_pos: vec3<f32>,
};

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;

@vertex
fn vs_main(in: CompressedVertIn, @builtin(instance_index) instance_idx: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let mdl = models[instance_idx];
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, mdl.bounds_min.xyz, mdl.bounds_extent.xyz);
    let world_pos = mdl.model * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    out.clip_pos = camera.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.world_pos = world_pos.xyz;
    let nm = mdl.normal_matrix;
    out.world_normal = normalize(nm * oct_decode(in.normal_oct));
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    // Positive view-space distance along the projection ray (clip.w ≈ |view_z|
    // for RH perspective). Prefer this over radial length() so SSAO samples
    // share a plane-aligned depth metric.
    let clip = camera.view_proj * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0);
    let view_z = max(abs(clip.w), 1e-5);
    let linear_depth = clamp(view_z / FAR, 0.0, 1.0);
    return vec4<f32>(normalize(in.world_normal), linear_depth);
}
```

```wgsl
// Instanced billboard quads — vertex_index 0..3, instance_index → particle.

struct GpuParticle {
    position: vec4<f32>,
    velocity: vec4<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    life: f32,
    size: f32,
    _pad: vec2<f32>,
}

struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
}

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> particles: array<GpuParticle>;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) color: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) @interpolate(flat) write_reactive: f32,
}

@vertex
fn vs_main(
    @builtin(vertex_index) vid: u32,
    @builtin(instance_index) iid: u32,
) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let p = particles[iid];
    let center = p.position.xyz;

    // Camera-facing basis from view matrix (column-major).
    let right = normalize(vec3<f32>(camera.view[0].x, camera.view[1].x, camera.view[2].x));
    let up = normalize(vec3<f32>(camera.view[0].y, camera.view[1].y, camera.view[2].y));

    var corner = vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0);
    if (vid == 1u) {
        corner = vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0);
    } else if (vid == 2u) {
        corner = vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0);
    } else if (vid == 3u) {
        corner = vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0);
    }
    let half = max(p.size, 1e-4);
    let world = center + right * (corner.x * half) + up * (corner.y * half);

    out.clip = camera.view_proj * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
    let life_a = clamp(p.life, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.color = vec4<f32>(p.color.rgb, p.color.a * life_a);
    out.write_reactive = 1.0;
    return out;
}

struct FsOut {
    @location(0) hdr: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) reactive: f32,
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> FsOut {
    var out: FsOut;
    out.hdr = in.color;
    out.reactive = in.write_reactive;
    return out;
}
```

### `shaders/particle_sim.wgsl` | **Строк:** 81

```wgsl
// GPU particle integration + compaction (ping-pong storage).
// MVP: CPU may upload state first; this pass can re-sim on GPU when enabled.

struct GpuParticle {
    position: vec4<f32>,
    velocity: vec4<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    life: f32,
    size: f32,
    _pad: vec2<f32>,
}

struct SimParams {
    // Matches `ParticleSimUniforms`: dt at 0, gravity packed immediately after.
    delta_time: f32,
    gravity_x: f32,
    gravity_y: f32,
    gravity_z: f32,
    capacity: u32,
    alive_count: u32,
    _pad: vec2<u32>,
}

struct DrawIndirect {
    vertex_count: u32,
    instance_count: atomic<u32>,
    first_vertex: u32,
    first_instance: u32,
}

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> params: SimParams;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> particles_in: array<GpuParticle>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read_write> particles_out: array<GpuParticle>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> alive_counter: atomic<u32>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<storage, read_write> draw_args: DrawIndirect;

@compute @workgroup_size(256)
fn cs_main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    let idx = gid.x;
    if (idx >= params.capacity) {
        return;
    }

    var p = particles_in[idx];
    let dt = params.delta_time;

    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life > 0.0) {
        let g = vec3<f32>(params.gravity_x, params.gravity_y, params.gravity_z);
        let vel = p.velocity.xyz + g * dt;
        let pos = p.position.xyz + vel * dt;
        p.velocity = vec4<f32>(vel, p.velocity.w);
        p.position = vec4<f32>(pos, p.position.w);
        let slot = atomicAdd(&alive_counter, 1u);
        if (slot < params.capacity) {
            particles_out[slot] = p;
        }
    }
}

// Separate entry: reset counters before the integrate pass.
@compute @workgroup_size(1)
fn cs_reset(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    if (gid.x == 0u) {
        atomicStore(&alive_counter, 0u);
        atomicStore(&draw_args.instance_count, 0u);
        draw_args.vertex_count = 4u;
        draw_args.first_vertex = 0u;
        draw_args.first_instance = 0u;
    }
}

// Copy alive count into indirect args after integrate.
@compute @workgroup_size(1)
fn cs_finalize(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    if (gid.x == 0u) {
        let alive = atomicLoad(&alive_counter);
        atomicStore(&draw_args.instance_count, alive);
    }
}
```

```wgsl
struct VertexOutput {
```
