```wgsl
    @location(1) world_normal: vec3<f32>,
    @location(2) world_tangent: vec3<f32>,
    @location(3) uv:           vec2<f32>,
    @location(4) instance_color: vec4<f32>,
    @location(5) shadow_pos:     vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(in: CompressedVertIn, @builtin(instance_index) instance_idx: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let mdl = models[instance_idx];
    let bounds_min = mdl.bounds_min.xyz;
    let bounds_extent = mdl.bounds_extent.xyz;
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, bounds_min, bounds_extent);
    let model = mdl.model;
    let world_pos = model * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    out.clip_pos = camera.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.world_pos = world_pos.xyz;
    let nm = mdl.normal_matrix;
    let n = normalize(nm * oct_decode(in.normal_oct));
    var t = normalize(nm * oct_decode(in.tangent_oct));
    t = normalize(t - n * dot(n, t));
    out.world_normal = n;
    out.world_tangent = t * decode_tangent_sign(in.pos_q);
    out.uv = in.uv;
    out.instance_color = mdl.color;
    out.shadow_pos = light_u.shadow_view_proj * world_pos;
    return out;
}

const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

/// Drop NaN/Inf and clamp HDR before bloom/TAA (a few 1e4+ pixels flood the screen).
fn sanitize_hdr(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if (any(c != c) || any(abs(c) > vec3<f32>(65504.0))) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    // Practical scene peak well below fp16 max — stops bloom from turning
    // one over-bright speck into a full-frame white/cyan flash.
    return clamp(c, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(64.0));
}

fn oct_encode(n: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    var v = n / max(abs(n.x) + abs(n.y) + abs(n.z), 1.0e-6);
    if (v.y < 0.0) {
        let ox = v.x;
        v.x = (1.0 - abs(v.z)) * select(-1.0, 1.0, ox >= 0.0);
        v.z = (1.0 - abs(ox)) * select(-1.0, 1.0, v.z >= 0.0);
    }
    return clamp(v.xz * 0.5 + 0.5, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0));
}

fn ddgi_sample_at(probe: DdgiProbeGpu, idx: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
    // Naga rejects dynamic indexing into uniform/struct arrays — unroll.
    switch idx {
        case 0u: { return probe.samples[0].xyz; }
        case 1u: { return probe.samples[1].xyz; }
        case 2u: { return probe.samples[2].xyz; }
        case 3u: { return probe.samples[3].xyz; }
        case 4u: { return probe.samples[4].xyz; }
        case 5u: { return probe.samples[5].xyz; }
        case 6u: { return probe.samples[6].xyz; }
        default: { return probe.samples[7].xyz; }
    }
}

fn ddgi_probe_oct(probe: DdgiProbeGpu, n: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    // 2×4 octahedral atlas bilinear sample.
    let uv = oct_encode(n);
    let fx = uv.x * 2.0 - 0.5;
    let fy = uv.y * 4.0 - 0.5;
    let x0 = u32(clamp(floor(fx), 0.0, 1.0));
    let y0 = u32(clamp(floor(fy), 0.0, 3.0));
    let x1 = min(x0 + 1u, 1u);
    let y1 = min(y0 + 1u, 3u);
    let tx = fract(fx);
    let ty = fract(fy);
    let s00 = ddgi_sample_at(probe, y0 * 2u + x0);
    let s10 = ddgi_sample_at(probe, y0 * 2u + x1);
    let s01 = ddgi_sample_at(probe, y1 * 2u + x0);
    let s11 = ddgi_sample_at(probe, y1 * 2u + x1);
    return mix(mix(s00, s10, tx), mix(s01, s11, tx), ty);
}

fn ddgi_probe_index(x: i32, y: i32, z: i32) -> u32 {
    return u32(z) * ddgi_grid.dims_x * ddgi_grid.dims_y
        + u32(y) * ddgi_grid.dims_x
        + u32(x);
}

fn ddgi_sample_irradiance(world_pos: vec3<f32>, n: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if (ddgi_grid.enabled == 0u) {
        return vec3(0.0);
    }
    let dims = vec3<i32>(
        i32(ddgi_grid.dims_x),
        i32(ddgi_grid.dims_y),
        i32(ddgi_grid.dims_z),
    );
    if (any(dims <= vec3<i32>(0)) || ddgi_grid.spacing <= 0.0) {
        return vec3(0.0);
    }
    let local = (world_pos - ddgi_grid.origin.xyz) / ddgi_grid.spacing;
    let base = floor(local);
    let frac = local - base;
    var accum = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var dz = 0; dz < 2; dz = dz + 1) {
        for (var dy = 0; dy < 2; dy = dy + 1) {
            for (var dx = 0; dx < 2; dx = dx + 1) {
                let ix = i32(base.x) + dx;
                let iy = i32(base.y) + dy;
                let iz = i32(base.z) + dz;
                if (ix < 0 || iy < 0 || iz < 0 || ix >= dims.x || iy >= dims.y || iz >= dims.z) {
                    continue;
                }
                let probe = ddgi_probes[ddgi_probe_index(ix, iy, iz)];
                let validity = probe.samples[0].w;
                let wx = select(frac.x, 1.0 - frac.x, dx == 0);
                let wy = select(frac.y, 1.0 - frac.y, dy == 0);
                let wz = select(frac.z, 1.0 - frac.z, dz == 0);
                let w = wx * wy * wz * validity;
                accum = accum + ddgi_probe_oct(probe, n) * w;
                wsum = wsum + w;
            }
        }
    }
    if (wsum > 1.0e-5) {
        return accum / wsum;
    }
    return vec3(0.0);
}

const SDF_CONE_APERTURE: f32 = 0.3;
const SDF_MAX_CONE_STEPS: u32 = 64u;
const SDF_ATLAS_EXTENT: f32 = 128.0;

fn sdf_load_atlas(coord: vec3<i32>) -> f32 {
    let c = clamp(coord, vec3<i32>(0), vec3<i32>(i32(SDF_ATLAS_EXTENT) - 1));
    // R32Float is non-filterable — use textureLoad (NonFiltering sampler on binding 28).
    return textureLoad(t_sdf_bricks, c, 0).r;
}

fn sdf_sample_page(page: SdfBrickPageGpu, p: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let span = page.world_max.xyz - page.world_min.xyz;
    let local = (p - page.world_min.xyz) / max(span, vec3<f32>(1.0e-6));
    if (any(local < vec3<f32>(0.0)) || any(local > vec3<f32>(1.0))) {
        return 1.0e9;
    }
    let res = page.atlas_origin_res.w;
    let origin = page.atlas_origin_res.xyz;
    let grid = origin + local * res - vec3<f32>(0.5);
    let base = floor(grid);
    let f = grid - base;
    let b = vec3<i32>(base);
    var accum = 0.0;
    for (var z = 0; z < 2; z = z + 1) {
        for (var y = 0; y < 2; y = y + 1) {
            for (var x = 0; x < 2; x = x + 1) {
                let w = select(f.x, 1.0 - f.x, x == 0)
                    * select(f.y, 1.0 - f.y, y == 0)
                    * select(f.z, 1.0 - f.z, z == 0);
                accum = accum + sdf_load_atlas(b + vec3<i32>(x, y, z)) * w;
            }
        }
    }
    return accum;
}

fn sdf_aabb(p: vec3<f32>, bmin: vec3<f32>, bmax: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let c = (bmin + bmax) * 0.5;
    let h = (bmax - bmin) * 0.5;
    let q = abs(p - c) - h;
    return length(max(q, vec3<f32>(0.0))) + min(max(q.x, max(q.y, q.z)), 0.0);
}

fn sdf_sample_world(p: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let count = sdf_scene.atlas_dims.x;
    if (count == 0u) {
        return 1.0e9;
    }
    var best = 1.0e9;
    for (var i = 0u; i < count; i = i + 1u) {
        let page = sdf_scene.pages[i];
        let d_box = sdf_aabb(p, page.world_min.xyz, page.world_max.xyz);
        if (d_box <= 0.0) {
            best = min(best, sdf_sample_page(page, p));
        } else {
            // Conservative step toward this brick so traces cannot skip pages.
            best = min(best, d_box);
        }
    }
    return best;
}

fn sdf_trace_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    if (sdf_scene.atlas_dims.x == 0u) {
        return vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0e9);
    }
    let texel = sdf_scene.world_bounds_max_texel.w;
    // Keep bias modest — stacked 2×texel normal + light push caused peter-panning.
    let bias = 0.75 * texel;
    let origin = world_pos + normal * bias;
    let dir = normalize(light_dir);
    let max_dist = length(sdf_scene.world_bounds_max_texel.xyz - sdf_scene.world_bounds_min.xyz);
    let half_tan = tan(0.5 * SDF_CONE_APERTURE);
    let t_min = max(0.5 * texel, 1.0e-4);
    var visibility = 1.0;
    var contact_dist = max_dist;
    var min_sd = 1.0e9;
    var t = t_min;
    for (var step = 0u; step < SDF_MAX_CONE_STEPS; step = step + 1u) {
        if (t >= max_dist) {
            break;
        }
        let p = origin + dir * t;
        let sd = sdf_sample_world(p);
        min_sd = min(min_sd, sd);
        let r = half_tan * t;
        let occ = select(
            clamp((r - sd) / max(r, 1.0e-6), 0.0, 1.0),
            select(1.0, 0.0, sd <= 0.0),
            r > 1.0e-6,
        );
        let dt = select(
            clamp(abs(sd), t_min, max(r, t_min)),
            t_min,
            sd > 0.0,
        );
        let cov = min(dt / max(r, t_min), 1.0);
        let prev_vis = visibility;
        visibility = visibility * (1.0 - occ * cov);
        if (visibility < prev_vis && contact_dist > t) {
            contact_dist = t;
        }
        if (visibility < 1.0e-3) {
            break;
        }
        t = t + dt;
    }
    if (contact_dist >= max_dist) {
        contact_dist = max(min_sd, 0.0);
    }
    return vec2<f32>(clamp(visibility, 0.0, 1.0), contact_dist);
}

fn fetch_shadow(shadow_coords: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    // Perspective divide
    let sc = shadow_coords.xyz / shadow_coords.w;
    // NDC (-1 to 1) to texture (0 to 1), flip Y
    let proj_coords = vec3<f32>(
        sc.x * 0.5 + 0.5,
        sc.y * -0.5 + 0.5,
        sc.z
    );
    
    if (proj_coords.z > 1.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    var visibility = 0.0;
    let size = 1.0 / 2048.0; // Shadow map resolution
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * size;
            visibility += textureSampleCompare(
                t_shadow, s_shadow, 
                proj_coords.xy + offset, 
                proj_coords.z - 0.005 // bias
            );
        }
    }
    return visibility / 9.0;
}

fn get_cascade_index(view_z: f32) -> u32 {
    var idx: u32 = 3u;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 4u; i = i + 1u) {
        if (view_z < shadow_u.csm_splits[i]) {
            idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    return idx;
}

fn cube_face_index(dir: vec3<f32>) -> u32 {
    let ad = abs(dir);
    if (ad.x >= ad.y && ad.x >= ad.z) {
        return select(1u, 0u, dir.x >= 0.0); // NegX : PosX
    }
    if (ad.y >= ad.x && ad.y >= ad.z) {
        return select(3u, 2u, dir.y >= 0.0); // NegY : PosY
    }
    return select(5u, 4u, dir.z >= 0.0);     // NegZ : PosZ
}

fn select_face_matrix(mats: array<mat4x4<f32>, 6>, face: u32) -> mat4x4<f32> {
    // Naga/WGSL validation can be strict about dynamically indexing arrays of matrices.
    // Use a switch with constant indices for maximum compatibility.
    switch (face) {
        case 0u: { return mats[0]; }
        case 1u: { return mats[1]; }
        case 2u: { return mats[2]; }
        case 3u: { return mats[3]; }
        case 4u: { return mats[4]; }
        default: { return mats[5]; }
    }
}

fn get_point_light_shadow(light: PointLight, world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    // Lights without an atlas run (saturated or cast_shadows=false) are lit.
    if (light.shadow_tile_base == 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let dir = world_pos - light.position.xyz;
    let face = cube_face_index(dir);
    let shadow_matrix = select_face_matrix(light.shadow_matrices, face);

    // Normal bias to fight acne.
    let bias_world_pos = world_pos + normal * 0.02;
    let clip = shadow_matrix * vec4<f32>(bias_world_pos, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let local_uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);

    if (local_uv.x < 0.0 || local_uv.x > 1.0 || local_uv.y < 0.0 || local_uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    // ── Tile mapping: tile grid is TILES_PER_AXIS × TILES_PER_AXIS (16×16) ──
    let tpa = 16.0; // TILES_PER_AXIS as f32
    let tile_index = light.shadow_tile_base + face;
    let col = f32(tile_index % 16u);
    let row = floor(f32(tile_index) / tpa);
    let inv_tpa = 1.0 / tpa;

    // 5×5 PCF — matches directional `csm_sample` look (monolithic, no grain).
    let texel_atlas = inv_tpa / 512.0; // TILE_PX = 512
    let tile_origin = vec2<f32>(col, row) * inv_tpa;
    var visibility = 0.0;
    for (var y = -2; y <= 2; y = y + 1) {
        for (var x = -2; x <= 2; x = x + 1) {
            // local_uv [0,1] → atlas UV inside this tile, then offset.
            var sample_uv = tile_origin + local_uv * inv_tpa
                + vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel_atlas;
            sample_uv = clamp(
                sample_uv,
                tile_origin + texel_atlas,
                tile_origin + inv_tpa - texel_atlas,
            );
            // Level-variant: this fn runs under non-uniform control flow
            // (per-light loop), implicit derivatives are invalid.
            visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
                t_local_shadow_atlas, s_shadow,
                sample_uv,
                ndc.z - 0.002,
            );
        }
    }
    return visibility / 25.0;
}

fn csm_sample(cascade_idx: u32, uv: vec2<f32>, depth: f32) -> f32 {
    // 5×5 PCF — hides cascade texel stairs at distant umbrae.
    var visibility = 0.0;
    let texel_size = 1.0 / shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size;
    for (var y = -2; y <= 2; y = y + 1) {
        for (var x = -2; x <= 2; x = x + 1) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel_size;
            visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
                t_csm, s_csm, uv + offset, i32(cascade_idx), depth,
            );
        }
    }
    return visibility / 25.0;
}

fn shadow_sample_dither(clip_xy: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_blue_noise));
    let noise = textureSample(t_blue_noise, s_blue_noise, clip_xy / dims).r;
    return fract(noise + f32(shader_debug.frame_index % 16u) * 0.61803398875);
}

/// Percentage-closer soft shadows: blocker search → penumbra estimate →
/// variable-radius PCF. `light_angle` is the source angular radius (radians).
/// `dither` ∈ [0,1) rotates the Fibonacci disk (blue-noise + temporal).
fn pcss_csm(world_pos: vec3<f32>, view_z: f32, normal: vec3<f32>, light_angle: f32, dither: f32) -> f32 {
    let cascade_idx = get_cascade_index(view_z);
    let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(normal, l_dir), 0.0);
    let biased = world_pos + normal * (0.001 + (1.0 - n_dot_l) * 0.0035);
    let mat = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx];
    let clip = mat * vec4<f32>(biased, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
    if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let texel = 1.0 / shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size;

    // ── Blocker search (9 texel loads in a 4-texel radius) ──
    // Comparison samplers cannot return raw depth; use textureLoad instead.
    var blocker_sum = 0.0;
    var blocker_count = 0.0;
    let search_radius = texel * 4.0;
    let atlas_res = vec2<f32>(shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size);
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * search_radius;
            let coord = vec2<i32>((uv + offset) * atlas_res);
            let d = textureLoad(t_csm, coord, i32(cascade_idx), 0);
            // Bias so flat receivers do not count themselves as blockers (shadow acne zebra).
            let blocker_bias = 0.0008;
            if (d < (ndc.z - blocker_bias)) {
                blocker_sum += d;
                blocker_count += 1.0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (blocker_count < 0.5) {
        return 1.0; // fully lit region — skip PCF entirely.
    }
    let blocker_ndc = blocker_sum / blocker_count;

    // ── Penumbra estimate ──
    // Convert depths to linear view distance for a physically-scaled penumbra.
    let receiver_d = linearize_depth01(ndc.z);
    let blocker_d = linearize_depth01(blocker_ndc);
    let block_dist = max(receiver_d - blocker_d, 0.0);
    let penumbra_world = (block_dist * light_angle) / max(blocker_d, 1e-3);
    // World→NDC scale ≈ 2*tan(fov/2)/res is unknown here; approximate via the
    // cascade's own world-texel size: penumbra_texels = penumbra_world * res/(2R)
    // where R = ortho half-extent ≈ split*aspect… use the pragmatic clamp below.
    var filter_radius = penumbra_world * shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size * 0.02;
    filter_radius = clamp(filter_radius, texel, texel * 12.0);

    // ── Variable-radius PCF with blue-noise rotation (kills 1/16 banding) ──
    var visibility = 0.0;
    let golden = 2.39996323;
    let rot_angle = dither * 6.28318530718;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 16u; i = i + 1u) {
        let fi = f32(i);
        let angle = fi * golden + rot_angle;
        let r = sqrt(fi / 16.0) * filter_radius;
        let offset = vec2<f32>(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * r;
        visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
            t_csm, s_csm, uv + offset, i32(cascade_idx), ndc.z - 0.0003,
        );
    }
    return visibility / 16.0;
}

fn linearize_depth01(d: f32) -> f32 {
    let denom = shadow_u.soft_far - d * (shadow_u.soft_far - shadow_u.soft_near);
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-6) { return shadow_u.soft_far; }
    return shadow_u.soft_near * shadow_u.soft_far / denom;
}

fn sample_vsm_shadow(screen_uv: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return textureSample(t_vsm_shadow, s_vsm_shadow, screen_uv).r;
}

fn multi_bounce_gtao(raw_ao: f32, albedo: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    // Jimenez GTAO multi-bounce polynomial (GDC 2016) tinted by albedo luminance.
    // Filament reference: filament/shaders/src/ambient_occlusion.fs
    let a = 2.0404 * raw_ao - 0.3324;
    let b = -4.7951 * raw_ao + 0.6417;
    let c = 2.7552 * raw_ao + 0.5869;
    let bounce = ((raw_ao * a + b) * raw_ao + c) * raw_ao;
    let lum = dot(albedo, vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    let albedo_term = clamp(lum, 0.0, 1.0);
    return mix(raw_ao, max(raw_ao, bounce), albedo_term);
}

fn sample_directional_csm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, view_z: f32, normal: vec3<f32>, dither: f32) -> f32 {
    let cascade_idx = get_cascade_index(view_z);

    let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(normal, l_dir), 0.0);
    let bias = 0.001 + (1.0 - n_dot_l) * 0.0035;
    let shadow_pos = world_pos + normal * bias;

    let mat = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx];
    let clip = mat * vec4<f32>(shadow_pos, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);

    if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    var shadow: f32;
    if (light_u.soft_shadows == 1u) {
        shadow = pcss_csm(world_pos, view_z, normal, 0.016, dither);
    } else {
        shadow = csm_sample(cascade_idx, uv, ndc.z - 0.0002);
    }

    let idx_usize = i32(cascade_idx);
    if (cascade_idx + 1u < 4u && idx_usize >= 0) {
        let next_split = shadow_u.csm_splits[cascade_idx];
        let prev_split = select(0.0, shadow_u.csm_splits[cascade_idx - 1u], cascade_idx > 0u);
        let band = (next_split - prev_split) * 0.1;
        if (view_z > next_split - band) {
            let mat2 = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx + 1u];
            let clip2 = mat2 * vec4<f32>(shadow_pos, 1.0);
            let ndc2 = clip2.xyz / clip2.w;
            let uv2 = vec2<f32>(ndc2.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc2.y * 0.5);
            if (!(uv2.x < 0.0 || uv2.x > 1.0 || uv2.y < 0.0 || uv2.y > 1.0 || ndc2.z < 0.0 || ndc2.z > 1.0)) {
                let s2 = csm_sample(cascade_idx + 1u, uv2, ndc2.z - 0.001);
                let t = (view_z - (next_split - band)) / max(band, 1e-4);
                shadow = mix(shadow, s2, clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0));
            }
        }
    }
    return shadow;
}

fn get_csm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, view_z: f32, normal: vec3<f32>, dither: f32) -> f32 {
    if (light_u.soft_shadows == 2u) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    return sample_directional_csm_shadow(world_pos, view_z, normal, dither);
}

fn apply_geometric_specular_aa(normal: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    // Decima / Toksvig-style: both screen-space normal derivatives (not max-only).
    let dndx = dpdx(normal);
    let dndy = dpdy(normal);
    let variance = 0.5 * (dot(dndx, dndx) + dot(dndy, dndy));
    let kernel_roughness = clamp(variance, 0.0, 0.25);
    return sqrt(roughness * roughness + kernel_roughness);
}

fn distribution_ggx(n: vec3<f32>, h: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let a = roughness * roughness;
    let a2 = a * a;
    let n_dot_h = max(dot(n, h), 0.0);
    let n_dot_h2 = n_dot_h * n_dot_h;
    let nom = a2;
    let denom = (n_dot_h2 * (a2 - 1.0) + 1.0);
    return nom / (PI * denom * denom);
}

fn geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_v: f32, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let r = (roughness + 1.0);
    let k = (r * r) / 8.0;
    return n_dot_v / (n_dot_v * (1.0 - k) + k);
}

fn geometry_smith(n: vec3<f32>, v: vec3<f32>, l: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 0.0);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
    let ggx2 = geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_v, roughness);
    let ggx1 = geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_l, roughness);
    return ggx1 * ggx2;
}

fn fresnel_schlick(cos_theta: f32, f0: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return f0 + (1.0 - f0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - cos_theta, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
}

fn fresnel_schlick_roughness(cos_theta: f32, f0: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    return f0 + (max(vec3<f32>(1.0 - roughness), f0) - f0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - cos_theta, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
}

/// Cook-Torrance BRDF × n·l for one Substrate / base lobe.
fn eval_brdf_lobe(
    n: vec3<f32>,
    v: vec3<f32>,
    l: vec3<f32>,
    albedo: vec3<f32>,
    metallic: f32,
    roughness: f32,
) -> vec3<f32> {
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
    let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 0.0);
    if (n_dot_l <= 0.0 || n_dot_v <= 0.0) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let vl = v + l;
    let vl_sq = dot(vl, vl);
    if (vl_sq < 1.0e-8) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let h = vl * inverseSqrt(vl_sq);
    let r = apply_geometric_specular_aa(n, clamp(roughness, 0.05, 1.0));
    let f0 = mix(vec3<f32>(0.04), albedo, metallic);
    let ndf = distribution_ggx(n, h, r);
    let g = geometry_smith(n, v, l, r);
    let f = fresnel_schlick(max(dot(h, v), 0.0), f0);
    let specular = (ndf * g * f) / max(4.0 * n_dot_v * n_dot_l, 0.0001);
    let kd = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - f) * (1.0 - metallic);
    return (kd * albedo / PI + specular) * n_dot_l;
}

/// Soft fabric sheen (Charlie-like) — weight from `material.sheen`.
fn eval_sheen_lobe(n: vec3<f32>, v: vec3<f32>, l: vec3<f32>, sheen_w: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    if (sheen_w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let vl = v + l;
    let vl_sq = dot(vl, vl);
    if (vl_sq < 1.0e-8) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let h = vl * inverseSqrt(vl_sq);
    let n_dot_h = max(dot(n, h), 0.0);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
    let sin2 = max(1.0 - n_dot_h * n_dot_h, 0.0);
    // Soft inverted-Gaussian lobe toward grazing normals.
    let d = pow(sin2, 2.5);
    return vec3<f32>(sheen_w) * d * n_dot_l;
}

/// Weighted Substrate multi-lobe evaluation (base + up to two layers + sheen).
fn eval_substrate_lit(
    n: vec3<f32>,
    v: vec3<f32>,
    l: vec3<f32>,
    albedo: vec3<f32>,
    metallic: f32,
    roughness: f32,
) -> vec3<f32> {
    let w0 = material.layer0_params.y;
    let w1 = material.layer1_params.y;
    let w_base = max(1.0 - w0 - w1, 0.0);
    var out = w_base * eval_brdf_lobe(n, v, l, albedo, metallic, roughness);
    if (w0 > 1.0e-4) {
        out = out + w0 * eval_brdf_lobe(
            n, v, l,
            material.layer0_color.xyz,
            material.layer0_color.w,
            material.layer0_params.x,
        );
    }
    if (w1 > 1.0e-4) {
        out = out + w1 * eval_brdf_lobe(
            n, v, l,
            material.layer1_color.xyz,
            material.layer1_color.w,
            material.layer1_params.x,
        );
    }
    out = out + eval_sheen_lobe(n, v, l, material.sheen);
    return out;
}

// Clustered Forward Rendering helper functions
fn linearize_depth(ndc_depth: f32, near: f32, far: f32) -> f32 {
    let z_ndc = ndc_depth * 2.0 - 1.0; // Convert from [0, 1] to [-1, 1]
    return (2.0 * near * far) / ((far + near) - z_ndc * (far - near));
}

fn get_depth_slice(linear_depth: f32, cluster_info: ClusterInfo) -> u32 {
    let z_norm = log(linear_depth / cluster_info.near) / cluster_info.depth_scale;
    return min(u32(max(z_norm, 0.0)), cluster_info.depth_slices - 1u);
}

fn get_cluster_index(screen_pos: vec2<f32>, cluster_info: ClusterInfo) -> u32 {
    let cluster_x = u32(screen_pos.x / 16.0); // CLUSTER_SIZE_X = 16
    let cluster_y = u32(screen_pos.y / 16.0); // CLUSTER_SIZE_Y = 16
    
    if (cluster_x >= cluster_info.clusters_x || cluster_y >= cluster_info.clusters_y) {
        return 0xFFFFFFFFu; // Invalid index
    }
    
    return cluster_x + cluster_y * cluster_info.clusters_x;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    var albedo = material.base_color.rgb * in.instance_color.rgb;
    var alpha = material.base_color.a * in.instance_color.a;
    if ((material.flags & 1u) != 0u) {
        let tex = textureSample(t_albedo, s_mat, in.uv);
        albedo *= tex.rgb;
        alpha *= tex.a;
    }

    // Stochastic alpha-to-coverage with blue noise + golden-ratio temporal offset.
    let use_alpha_test = (material.flags & 16u) != 0u;
    if (use_alpha_test || alpha < 0.999) {
        let screen_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_blue_noise));
        let noise = textureSample(t_blue_noise, s_blue_noise, screen_uv).r;
        let dither = fract(noise + f32(shader_debug.frame_index % 16u) * 0.61803398875);
        if (alpha < dither) {
            discard;
        }
    }
    
    var n = in.world_normal;
    let n_len_sq = dot(n, n);
    if (n_len_sq > 1.0e-12) {
        n = n * inverseSqrt(n_len_sq);
    } else {
        n = vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    }
    var toksvig_delta = 0.0;
    if ((material.flags & 2u) != 0u) {
        let t = normalize(in.world_tangent);
        let b = cross(n, t);
        let tbn = mat3x3<f32>(t, b, n);
        let normal_sample = textureSample(t_normal, s_mat, in.uv);
        let normal_map = normal_sample.xyz * 2.0 - 1.0;
        // Alpha of Toksvig-baked normal mips stores roughness delta in [0,1]
        // mapped to [0, 0.5] (see resource/toksvig.rs).
        toksvig_delta = normal_sample.a * 0.5;
        n = normalize(tbn * normal_map);
    }

    // Geometric normal of the visible face. If the interpolated/CPU normal
    // points into the mesh, lighting looks sun-side-dark / shade-side-bright.
    // `normalize(cross(0))` is NaN and poisons the whole HDR buffer via bloom/TAA.
    let d_cross = cross(dpdx(in.world_pos), dpdy(in.world_pos));
    let d_len_sq = dot(d_cross, d_cross);
    if (d_len_sq > 1.0e-8) {
        var n_geo = d_cross * inverseSqrt(d_len_sq);
        let to_cam = camera.camera_pos.xyz - in.world_pos;
        if (dot(n_geo, to_cam) < 0.0) {
            n_geo = -n_geo;
        }
        // Only flip when clearly inverted — soft threshold avoids diagonal
        // triangulation seams (dpdx/dpdy jumps across the quad split).
        if (dot(n, n_geo) < -0.55) {
            n = -n;
        }
    }

    var metallic = material.metallic;
    var roughness = material.roughness;
    if ((material.flags & 4u) != 0u) {
        let mr = textureSample(t_mr, s_mat, in.uv);
        metallic *= mr.b;
        roughness *= mr.g;
    }
    roughness = clamp(roughness + toksvig_delta, 0.05, 1.0);
    let spec_roughness = apply_geometric_specular_aa(n, roughness);

    let v = normalize(camera.camera_pos.xyz - in.world_pos);
    let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 0.0);
    let f0 = mix(vec3<f32>(0.04), albedo, metallic);

    // --- DEBUG VISUALIZATION OVERLAY ---
    if (shader_debug.debug_viz_mode == 1u) {
        let cluster_x = u32(in.clip_pos.x / 16.0);
        let cluster_y = u32(in.clip_pos.y / 16.0);
        let view_pos = camera.view * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0);
        let view_z = max(-view_pos.z, cluster_info.near);
        let cluster_z = get_depth_slice(view_z, cluster_info);
        let cluster_idx_flat = cluster_x + cluster_y * cluster_info.clusters_x + cluster_z * cluster_info.clusters_x * cluster_info.clusters_y;
        let color_val = f32(cluster_idx_flat % 128u) / 127.0;
        return vec4<f32>(color_val, color_val * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
    } else if (shader_debug.debug_viz_mode == 2u) {
        // ShadowValue debug: combined directional visibility.
        let view_z = -(camera.view * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0)).z;
        let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
        var s = 1.0;
        if (light_u.soft_shadows == 2u) {
            if (light_u.vsm_screen_shadows != 0u) {
                let screen_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_vsm_shadow));
                s = sample_vsm_shadow(screen_uv);
            } else {
                s = vsm_shadow(in.world_pos, n, l_dir);
            }
        } else {
            s = get_csm_shadow(in.world_pos, view_z, n, shadow_sample_dither(in.clip_pos.xy));
        }
        return vec4<f32>(s, s, s, 1.0);
    } else if (shader_debug.debug_viz_mode == 3u) {
        // ShadowSources: each darkening pipeline as its own colour.
        //   Magenta = GTAO
        //   Cyan    = CSM / PCSS (hard directional map)
        //   Lime    = VSM screen shadow
        //   Yellow  = SDF cone trace
        let screen_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_gtao));
        let ao = textureSample(t_gtao, s_gtao, screen_uv).a;
        let ao_dark = clamp(1.0 - ao, 0.0, 1.0);

        let view_z = -(camera.view * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0)).z;
        let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);

        // Force CSM sample (skip VSM branch inside get_csm_shadow).
        let cascade_idx = get_cascade_index(view_z);
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l_dir), 0.0);
        let bias = 0.002 + (1.0 - n_dot_l) * 0.008;
        let shadow_pos = in.world_pos + n * bias;
        let mat = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx];
        let clip = mat * vec4<f32>(shadow_pos, 1.0);
        let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        let csm_uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
        var csm_vis = 1.0;
        if (!(csm_uv.x < 0.0 || csm_uv.x > 1.0 || csm_uv.y < 0.0 || csm_uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0)) {
            csm_vis = csm_sample(cascade_idx, csm_uv, ndc.z - 0.0005);
        }
        let csm_dark = clamp(1.0 - csm_vis, 0.0, 1.0);

        var vsm_dark = 0.0;
        if (light_u.soft_shadows == 2u) {
            var vsm_vis: f32;
            if (light_u.vsm_screen_shadows != 0u) {
                let vsm_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_vsm_shadow));
                vsm_vis = sample_vsm_shadow(vsm_uv);
            } else {
                vsm_vis = vsm_shadow(in.world_pos, n, l_dir);
            }
            vsm_dark = clamp(1.0 - vsm_vis, 0.0, 1.0);
        }

        let sdf_result = sdf_trace_shadow(in.world_pos, l_dir, n);
        let sdf_dark = clamp(1.0 - sdf_result.x, 0.0, 1.0);

        let base = albedo * 0.18;
        let colored =
            base
            + vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.15, 0.85) * ao_dark   // magenta — SSAO
            + vec3<f32>(0.15, 0.95, 1.0) * csm_dark  // cyan    — CSM
            + vec3<f32>(0.45, 1.0, 0.2) * vsm_dark   // lime    — VSM
            + vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.92, 0.15) * sdf_dark; // yellow  — SDF
        return vec4<f32>(colored, 1.0);
    }

    // Directional shadow factor (filled in directional light block).
    var shadow = 1.0;
    var lo = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    // --- Directional Light — VSM-only (CSM deleted per user request) ---
    {
        let l = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
        let radiance = light_u.dir_color.rgb * light_u.dir_color.w;
        var dir_shadow: f32;
        if (light_u.vsm_screen_shadows != 0u) {
            // Screen-space VSM: fallback to CSM when outside clipmap (distant landscape).
            let lk = vsm_lookup(in.world_pos);
            if (lk.valid < 0.5) {
                let view_z = -(camera.view * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0)).z;
                dir_shadow = sample_directional_csm_shadow(in.world_pos, view_z, n, shadow_sample_dither(in.clip_pos.xy));
            } else {
                let screen_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_vsm_shadow));
                dir_shadow = sample_vsm_shadow(screen_uv);
            }
        } else {
            dir_shadow = vsm_shadow(in.world_pos, n, l);
        }
        let sdf_result = sdf_trace_shadow(
            in.world_pos,
            l,
            n,
        );
        let blend = smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, sdf_result.y);
        shadow = mix(sdf_result.x, dir_shadow, blend);
        lo += eval_substrate_lit(n, v, l, albedo, metallic, roughness) * radiance * shadow;
    }

    // --- Point Lights (Clustered Forward Rendering) ---
    if (light_u.point_light_path == 0u) {
    let cluster_x = u32(in.clip_pos.x / 16.0);
    let cluster_y = u32(in.clip_pos.y / 16.0);
    
    // View-space Z (planar depth) — NOT euclidean distance (which draws circles on the floor).
    let view_pos = camera.view * vec4<f32>(in.world_pos, 1.0);
    let view_z = max(-view_pos.z, cluster_info.near);
    let cluster_z = get_depth_slice(view_z, cluster_info);
    
    // Get cluster index in the grid
    if (cluster_x < cluster_info.clusters_x && cluster_y < cluster_info.clusters_y && cluster_z < cluster_info.depth_slices) {
        let cluster_idx = cluster_x + cluster_y * cluster_info.clusters_x + cluster_z * cluster_info.clusters_x * cluster_info.clusters_y;
        
        // Get light list for this cluster
        let cluster_meta = cluster_metadata[cluster_idx];
        let light_count = arrayLength(&point_lights);
        let index_count = arrayLength(&cluster_light_indices);
        let n_cluster = min(cluster_meta.count, 256u);

        for (var i = 0u; i < n_cluster; i = i + 1u) {
            let idx_pos = cluster_meta.offset + i;
            if (idx_pos >= index_count) { break; }
            let light_idx = cluster_light_indices[idx_pos];
            if (light_idx >= light_count) { continue; }
            let light = point_lights[light_idx];
            
            let p_pos = light.position.xyz;
            let p_color = light.color.rgb;
            let p_intensity = light.intensity;
            let p_radius = light.radius;

            let to_light = p_pos - in.world_pos;
            let dist_sq = dot(to_light, to_light);
            let l = normalize(to_light);
            // Inverse-square with smooth Frostbite window — no hard rings.
            let d = sqrt(dist_sq);
            let inv_dist_sq = 1.0 / max(dist_sq, 0.01);
            let x = d / max(p_radius, 0.001);
            let x2 = x * x;
            let window = clamp(1.0 - x2 * x2, 0.0, 1.0);
            let attenuation = inv_dist_sq * window * window;
            let radiance = p_color * p_intensity;
            let p_shadow = get_point_light_shadow(light, in.world_pos, n);
            lo += eval_substrate_lit(n, v, l, albedo, metallic, roughness)
                * radiance * attenuation * p_shadow;
        }
    }
    }

    // GTAO (bent normal + AO) — sample before IBL so diffuse uses bent_n.
    let screen_uv = in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_gtao));
    let gtao = textureSample(t_gtao, s_gtao, screen_uv);
    // Use explicit uniform flag (shader_debug.gtao_enabled) — heuristic
    // gtao.a>=0.999 fails on flat open surfaces where AO naturally =1.
    let gtao_disabled = shader_debug.gtao_enabled == 0u;
    let bent_n = select(normalize(gtao.rgb), n, gtao_disabled);
    let raw_ao = select(gtao.a, 1.0, gtao_disabled);
    let ao = multi_bounce_gtao(raw_ao, albedo);
    // --- Ambient IBL ---
    let kS_ibl = fresnel_schlick_roughness(n_dot_v, f0, spec_roughness);
    let kD_ibl = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - kS_ibl) * (1.0 - metallic);

    var irradiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var prefiltered_color = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var env_brdf = vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0);
    let r = reflect(-v, n);
    if (shader_debug.ibl_enabled != 0u) {
        irradiance = textureSample(t_irradiance, s_ibl, bent_n).rgb;
        prefiltered_color = textureSampleLevel(t_prefiltered, s_ibl, r, spec_roughness * 4.0).rgb;
        env_brdf = textureSample(t_brdf_lut, s_ibl, vec2<f32>(n_dot_v, spec_roughness)).rg;
    }
    let diffuse_ibl = irradiance * albedo;
    let specular_ibl = prefiltered_color * (kS_ibl * env_brdf.x + env_brdf.y);

    // Substrate layer IBL (weighted diffuse-ish contribution).
    var substrate_ibl = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    let w0 = material.layer0_params.y;
    let w1 = material.layer1_params.y;
    if (w0 > 1.0e-4 && shader_debug.ibl_enabled != 0u) {
        let a0 = material.layer0_color.xyz;
        let m0 = material.layer0_color.w;
        let r0 = clamp(material.layer0_params.x, 0.05, 1.0);
        let f0_0 = mix(vec3<f32>(0.04), a0, m0);
        let ks0 = fresnel_schlick_roughness(n_dot_v, f0_0, r0);
        let kd0 = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - ks0) * (1.0 - m0);
        let pre0 = textureSampleLevel(t_prefiltered, s_ibl, r, r0 * 4.0).rgb;
        let brdf0 = textureSample(t_brdf_lut, s_ibl, vec2<f32>(n_dot_v, r0)).rg;
        substrate_ibl = substrate_ibl + w0 * (kd0 * irradiance * a0 + pre0 * (ks0 * brdf0.x + brdf0.y));
    }
    if (w1 > 1.0e-4 && shader_debug.ibl_enabled != 0u) {
        let a1 = material.layer1_color.xyz;
        let m1 = material.layer1_color.w;
        let r1 = clamp(material.layer1_params.x, 0.05, 1.0);
        let f0_1 = mix(vec3<f32>(0.04), a1, m1);
        let ks1 = fresnel_schlick_roughness(n_dot_v, f0_1, r1);
        let kd1 = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - ks1) * (1.0 - m1);
        let pre1 = textureSampleLevel(t_prefiltered, s_ibl, r, r1 * 4.0).rgb;
        let brdf1 = textureSample(t_brdf_lut, s_ibl, vec2<f32>(n_dot_v, r1)).rg;
        substrate_ibl = substrate_ibl + w1 * (kd1 * irradiance * a1 + pre1 * (ks1 * brdf1.x + brdf1.y));
    }
    let w_base = max(1.0 - w0 - w1, 0.0);

    // Ambient factor from light uniform
    let ambient_factor = light_u.ambient.w;

    // Combine IBL with uniform ambient + DDGI diffuse bounce (bent normal).
    let ddgi = ddgi_sample_irradiance(in.world_pos, bent_n);
    let ambient = (w_base * (kD_ibl * diffuse_ibl + specular_ibl) + substrate_ibl) * ambient_factor * ao
        + light_u.ambient.xyz * albedo * ao
        + ddgi * albedo * ao;
    let color = ambient + lo + material.emissive.rgb;
    return vec4<f32>(sanitize_hdr(color), material.base_color.a * in.instance_color.a);
}

// ── Virtual Shadow Maps: clipmap lookup + SMRT soft sampling ────────────
// Canonical source: shaders/vsm_smrt.wgsl (WGSL has no includes; this block
// is mirrored verbatim — keep both copies in sync).
// ── BEGIN VSM_SMRT BLOCK (mirrored into pbr.wgsl verbatim) ──────────────

/// Page-table VALID bit (mirror of `shadow::page_table::PAGE_VALID_BIT`).
const VSM_PAGE_VALID: u32 = 0x80000000u;
/// Page-table physical-index mask (mirror of `PAGE_PHYS_MASK`).
const VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK: u32 = 0x3FFFFFFFu;

/// GPU mirror of one clipmap level (`shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmLevelGpu`).
struct VsmLevelGpu {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    world_half_extent: f32,
    page_table_offset: u32,
    pages_per_side: u32,
    texel_world: f32,
}

/// GPU mirror of `shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo`.
struct VsmGpuInfo {
    level_count: u32,
    page_px: u32,
    phys_page_count: u32,
    phys_pages_per_side: u32,
    // SMRT params (mirror of SmrtUniform / shadow::smrt::SmrtConfig).
    ray_count: u32,
    samples_per_ray: u32,
    source_angle: f32,
    source_radius: f32,
    max_trace_dist: f32,
    _pad0: vec3<f32>,
    levels: array<VsmLevelGpu, 8>,
    /// Concatenated page tables: `level * 256 + y * 16 + x`.
    page_tables: array<u32, 2048>,
}

/// Interleaved gradient noise (Jimenez 2014) for per-pixel ray rotation.
fn vsm_ign(p: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2<f32>(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
}

/// Result of resolving a world position against the clipmap page tables.
struct VsmLookup {
    /// 1.0 when a valid page was found covering the position.
    valid: f32,
    /// Physical page index (== texture array layer).
    layer: i32,
    /// Pixel inside the page (integer, for raw loads).
    pixel: vec2<i32>,
    /// Sub-texel page coordinate for bilinear PCF.
    pixel_f: vec2<f32>,
    /// NDC depth of the query point in the owning level.
    receiver_z: f32,
    /// World units per unit of NDC depth at this level ((far − near)).
    z_world_per_ndc: f32,
    /// World units per shadow texel at this level.
    texel_world: f32,
};

/// Finds the finest clipmap level whose window covers `pos` AND whose page
/// table entry is valid. Coarser levels are tried in order.
fn vsm_lookup(pos: vec3<f32>) -> VsmLookup {
    var out: VsmLookup;
    out.valid = 0.0;
    out.layer = 0;
    out.pixel = vec2<i32>(0);
    out.pixel_f = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    out.receiver_z = 0.0;
    out.z_world_per_ndc = 1.0;
    out.texel_world = 1.0;

    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    for (var lv = 0u; lv < count; lv++) {
        let cm = vsm_info.levels[lv];
        let clip = cm.view_proj * vec4<f32>(pos, 1.0);
        if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
            continue;
        }
        let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
        if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }
        if (ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }

        let pps = f32(cm.pages_per_side);
        let page = min(vec2<u32>(uv * pps), vec2<u32>(cm.pages_per_side - 1u));
        let entry =
            vsm_info.page_tables[cm.page_table_offset + page.y * cm.pages_per_side + page.x];
        if ((entry & VSM_PAGE_VALID) == 0u) {
            continue; // page not resident; try the coarser level
        }

        let phys = entry & VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK;
        let page_uv = fract(uv * pps);
        // Inset 1 texel: matches page_view_proj overlap, skips clear-border.
        let ppx = f32(vsm_info.page_px);
        let lo = 1.0;
        let hi = ppx - 2.0;
        let pf = lo + clamp(page_uv, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0)) * (hi - lo);

        out.valid = 1.0;
        out.layer = i32(phys);
        out.pixel_f = pf;
        out.pixel = vec2<i32>(i32(pf.x), i32(pf.y));
        out.receiver_z = ndc.z;
        // Level ortho spans near=−2h .. far=+2h ⇒ NDC depth unit = 4h world.
        out.z_world_per_ndc = cm.world_half_extent * 4.0;
        out.texel_world = (cm.world_half_extent * 2.0)
            / (pps * f32(vsm_info.page_px));
        return out;
    }
    return out;
}

fn vsm_tap_lit(lk: VsmLookup, pix: vec2<i32>, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let lo = 1;
    let hi = i32(vsm_info.page_px) - 2;
    if (pix.x < lo || pix.y < lo || pix.x > hi || pix.y > hi) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, pix, lk.layer, 0).r;
    if (stored > 0.999) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let occluded = stored < lk.receiver_z - bias_ndc
        && (lk.receiver_z - stored) > min_diff;
    return select(1.0, 0.0, occluded);
}

fn vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let f = lk.pixel_f;
    let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(f.x)), i32(floor(f.y)));
    let a = fract(f);
    let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    return mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y);
}

/// Tiered PCF: 4 taps near contact, 9 weighted taps mid-range, full 3×3 far.
fn vsm_pcf_lit(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, spread: f32) -> f32 {
    let min_diff = (1.25 * lk.texel_world) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
    if (spread <= 1.5) {
        return vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    }
    if (spread <= 2.5) {
        var acc = vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(-1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, -1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        return acc / 5.0;
    }
    let sp = max(spread, 1.0);
    var acc = 0.0;
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            let w = f32(2 - abs(dx)) * f32(2 - abs(dy));
            let pf = lk.pixel_f + vec2<f32>(f32(dx), f32(dy)) * sp;
            let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(pf.x)), i32(floor(pf.y)));
            let a = fract(pf);
            let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            acc += mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y) * w;
            wsum += w;
        }
    }
    return acc / max(wsum, 1.0);
}

/// SMRT-style soft shadow for the directional light.
///
/// Traces `ray_count` rays from the shading point toward the light disc
/// (angular radius `source_angle`), marching `samples_per_ray` steps each.
/// Steps use a quadratic curve: dense near the receiver (contact) and
/// still reaching the far occluder so the umbra tip can soften.
///
/// Returns visibility in [0, 1]. Positions not covered by any resident page
/// return 1.0 (lit) so the virtualized area acts purely as an optimization.
fn vsm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    if (count == 0u) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let f = normalize(light_dir); // direction toward the light
    let up = select(vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), abs(f.y) < 0.99);
    let tangent = normalize(cross(up, f));
    let bitangent = cross(f, tangent);

    let ray_count = clamp(vsm_info.ray_count, 1u, 16u);
    let samples_per_ray = clamp(vsm_info.samples_per_ray, 1u, 16u);
    let tan_source = tan(max(vsm_info.source_angle, 1e-5));

    let jitter = vsm_ign(world_pos.xy + world_pos.zz * 7.31);

    // Receiver offset along the geometric normal only. Any push toward the
    // light slides the umbra off the caster base (peter-panning).
    let lk0 = vsm_lookup(world_pos);
    var origin = world_pos;
    if (lk0.valid > 0.5) {
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
        let push = lk0.texel_world * mix(0.6, 1.5, n_dot_l);
        origin = world_pos + normalize(normal) * push;
    }

    var sum = 0.0;

    for (var r = 0u; r < ray_count; r++) {
        let u1 = (f32(r) + 0.5 + jitter * 0.5) / f32(ray_count);
        let theta = fract(u1 * 2.39996323 + jitter) * 6.28318530718;
        let radius = tan_source * sqrt(u1);
        let dir = normalize(
            f + (tangent * cos(theta) + bitangent * sin(theta)) * radius,
        );

        var transmittance = 1.0;
        for (var s = 1u; s <= samples_per_ray; s++) {
            if (transmittance < 0.01) {
                break;
            }
            let u = f32(s) / f32(samples_per_ray);
            let dist = max(vsm_info.max_trace_dist * u * u * u * u, lk0.texel_world * 1.5);
            let sp = origin + dir * dist;

            let lk = vsm_lookup(sp);
            if (lk.valid < 0.5) {
                break;
            }

            let slope = sqrt(max(1.0 - abs(dot(normal, f)), 0.0));
            let contact = clamp(1.0 - dist / max(lk.texel_world * 16.0, 1e-4), 0.0, 1.0);
            let face_on = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
            let bias_ndc = lk.texel_world * (0.45 + 0.60 * slope + 1.0 * face_on)
                * mix(1.0, 0.45, contact) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
            let spread = clamp(dist * tan_source / max(lk.texel_world, 1e-4), 1.0, 8.0);

            let lit = vsm_pcf_lit(lk, bias_ndc, spread);
            let occ = 1.0 - lit;
            if (occ > 0.01) {
                let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, lk.pixel, lk.layer, 0).r;
                let depth_diff = max((lk.receiver_z - stored) * lk.z_world_per_ndc, 0.0);
                let penumbra = max(vsm_info.source_angle * dist, lk.texel_world);
                let soft = clamp(1.0 - depth_diff / penumbra, 0.0, 1.0);
                transmittance *= mix(1.0, soft, occ);
            }
        }
        sum += transmittance;
    }
    return clamp(sum / f32(ray_count), 0.0, 1.0);
}

// ── END VSM_SMRT BLOCK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

```

### `shaders/prefilter_convolution.wgsl` | **Строк:** 72

```wgsl
const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

@group(0) @binding(0) var environment_map:     texture_cube<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var samp:                sampler;
@group(1) @binding(0) var output_prefiltered:  texture_storage_2d_array<rgba16float, write>;

struct PrefilterUniforms { roughness: f32 };
@group(2) @binding(0) var<uniform> prefilter_u: PrefilterUniforms;

fn get_cube_dir(id: vec3<u32>, size: vec2<u32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let uv        = (vec2<f32>(id.xy) + 0.5) / vec2<f32>(size);
    let tex_coords = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;
    var dir: vec3<f32>;
    let face = id.z;
    if      (face == 0u) { dir = vec3<f32>( 1.0, -tex_coords.y, -tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 1u) { dir = vec3<f32>(-1.0, -tex_coords.y,  tex_coords.x); }
    else if (face == 2u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x,  1.0,  tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 3u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -1.0, -tex_coords.y); }
    else if (face == 4u) { dir = vec3<f32>( tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y,  1.0); }
    else                 { dir = vec3<f32>(-tex_coords.x, -tex_coords.y, -1.0); }
    return normalize(dir);
}
fn radical_inverse_vdc(bits_in: u32) -> f32 {
    var bits = (bits_in << 16u) | (bits_in >> 16u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x55555555u) << 1u) | ((bits & 0xAAAAAAAAu) >> 1u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x33333333u) << 2u) | ((bits & 0xCCCCCCCCu) >> 2u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x0F0F0F0Fu) << 4u) | ((bits & 0xF0F0F0F0u) >> 4u);
    bits = ((bits & 0x00FF00FFu) << 8u) | ((bits & 0xFF00FF00u) >> 8u);
    return f32(bits) * 2.3283064365386963e-10;
}
fn hammersley(i: u32, n: u32) -> vec2<f32> {
    return vec2<f32>(f32(i) / f32(n), radical_inverse_vdc(i));
}
fn importance_sample_ggx(xi: vec2<f32>, n: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let a  = roughness * roughness;
    let phi       = 2.0 * PI * xi.x;
    let cos_theta = sqrt((1.0 - xi.y) / (1.0 + (a * a - 1.0) * xi.y));
    let sin_theta = sqrt(1.0 - cos_theta * cos_theta);
    let h = vec3<f32>(cos(phi) * sin_theta, sin(phi) * sin_theta, cos_theta);
    var up = vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
    if (abs(n.y) > 0.999) { up = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
    let right = normalize(cross(up, n));
    up = cross(n, right);
    return normalize(right * h.x + up * h.y + n * h.z);
}

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn prefilter_convolution(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
    let size = textureDimensions(output_prefiltered).xy;
    if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; }

    let n = get_cube_dir(id, size);
    let v = n;

    let sample_count = 1024u;
    var total_weight    = 0.0;
    var prefiltered_color = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    for (var i = 0u; i < sample_count; i++) {
        let xi    = hammersley(i, sample_count);
        let h     = importance_sample_ggx(xi, n, prefilter_u.roughness);
        let l     = normalize(2.0 * dot(v, h) * h - v);
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
        if (n_dot_l > 0.0) {
            prefiltered_color += textureSampleLevel(environment_map, samp, l, 0.0).rgb * n_dot_l;
            total_weight      += n_dot_l;
        }
    }
    prefiltered_color /= max(total_weight, 0.0001);
    textureStore(output_prefiltered, id.xy, i32(id.z), vec4<f32>(prefiltered_color, 1.0));
}
```

### `shaders/scatter_light.wgsl` | **Строк:** 90

```wgsl
//! ScatterLight — RedOx stochastic per-pixel point-light path (K=8 samples).
//!
//! Reads point lights from a storage buffer and accumulates K randomly
//! selected lights per pixel. Reservoir sampling / shadow rays — follow-up.

struct PointLight {
    position: vec4<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    shadow_matrices: array<mat4x4<f32>, 6>,
    intensity: f32,
    radius: f32,
    shadow_tile_base: u32,
    _padding: f32,
};

struct ScatterLightUniform {
    num_lights: u32,
    sample_count: u32,
    frame_index: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    resolution: vec2<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_hdr: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_depth: texture_depth_2d;
@group(0) @binding(2) var s_linear: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read> point_lights: array<PointLight>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<uniform> sl_u: ScatterLightUniform;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn hash_u32(x: u32) -> u32 {
    var v = x;
    v = v ^ (v >> 16u);
    v = v * 0x7feb352du;
    v = v ^ (v >> 15u);
    v = v * 0x846ca68bu;
    v = v ^ (v >> 16u);
    return v;
}

fn evaluate_point_light(light: PointLight, world_pos: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let L = light.position.xyz - world_pos;
    let dist = length(L);
    if (dist > light.radius || dist < 1e-4) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    let atten = pow(max(1.0 - dist / light.radius, 0.0), 2.0);
    let NdotL = max(dot(normalize(L), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)), 0.0);
    return light.color.xyz * light.intensity * atten * NdotL;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let base = textureSample(t_hdr, s_linear, in.uv);
    let n = sl_u.num_lights;
    if (n == 0u) {
        return base;
    }

    let px = u32(in.uv.x * sl_u.resolution.x);
    let py = u32(in.uv.y * sl_u.resolution.y);
    let K = sl_u.sample_count;

    var accum = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    for (var k: u32 = 0u; k < K; k = k + 1u) {
        let seed = hash_u32(px + py * 73856093u + k * 19349663u + sl_u.frame_index);
        let idx = seed % n;
        let light = point_lights[idx];
        let stub_pos = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        accum = accum + evaluate_point_light(light, stub_pos);
    }
    accum = accum / f32(K);

    return vec4<f32>(base.rgb + accum, base.a);
}
```

### `shaders/sdf_shadow.wgsl` | **Строк:** 131

```wgsl
// SDF cone-traced shadows — GPU companion to the CPU reference
// `SdfShadowScene::trace_cone` in src/sdf/mod.rs.
//
// Bindings 26..28 match `pbr.wgsl`. Multi-brick page table lives in
// `SdfSceneGpu.pages` (up to 8 bricks packed into the 128³ atlas).
//
// Sign convention matches the CPU baker: NEGATIVE inside solids, positive
// outside, meters everywhere.

struct SdfBrickPageGpu {
    world_min: vec4<f32>,
    world_max: vec4<f32>,
    atlas_origin_res: vec4<f32>,
}

struct SdfSceneGpu {
    atlas_dims: vec4<u32>,
    world_bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    world_bounds_max_texel: vec4<f32>,
    pages: array<SdfBrickPageGpu, 8>,
};

@group(0) @binding(26) var<uniform> sdf_scene: SdfSceneGpu;
@group(0) @binding(27) var t_sdf_bricks: texture_3d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(28) var s_sdf_bricks: sampler;

const SDF_CONE_APERTURE: f32 = 0.3;
const MAX_CONE_STEPS: u32 = 128u;
const SDF_ATLAS_EXTENT: f32 = 128.0;

fn sdf_load_atlas(coord: vec3<i32>) -> f32 {
    let c = clamp(coord, vec3<i32>(0), vec3<i32>(i32(SDF_ATLAS_EXTENT) - 1));
    return textureLoad(t_sdf_bricks, c, 0).r;
}

fn sdf_sample_page(page: SdfBrickPageGpu, p: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let span = page.world_max.xyz - page.world_min.xyz;
    let local = (p - page.world_min.xyz) / max(span, vec3<f32>(1.0e-6));
    if (any(local < vec3<f32>(0.0)) || any(local > vec3<f32>(1.0))) {
        return 1.0e9;
    }
    let res = page.atlas_origin_res.w;
    let origin = page.atlas_origin_res.xyz;
    let grid = origin + local * res - vec3<f32>(0.5);
    let base = floor(grid);
    let f = grid - base;
    let b = vec3<i32>(base);
    var accum = 0.0;
    for (var z = 0; z < 2; z = z + 1) {
        for (var y = 0; y < 2; y = y + 1) {
            for (var x = 0; x < 2; x = x + 1) {
                let w = select(f.x, 1.0 - f.x, x == 0)
                    * select(f.y, 1.0 - f.y, y == 0)
                    * select(f.z, 1.0 - f.z, z == 0);
                accum = accum + sdf_load_atlas(b + vec3<i32>(x, y, z)) * w;
            }
        }
    }
    return accum;
}

fn sdf_aabb(p: vec3<f32>, bmin: vec3<f32>, bmax: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let c = (bmin + bmax) * 0.5;
    let h = (bmax - bmin) * 0.5;
    let q = abs(p - c) - h;
    return length(max(q, vec3<f32>(0.0))) + min(max(q.x, max(q.y, q.z)), 0.0);
}

fn sdf_sample_world(p: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let count = sdf_scene.atlas_dims.x;
    if (count == 0u) {
        return 1.0e9;
    }
    var best = 1.0e9;
    for (var i = 0u; i < count; i = i + 1u) {
        let page = sdf_scene.pages[i];
        let d_box = sdf_aabb(p, page.world_min.xyz, page.world_max.xyz);
        if (d_box <= 0.0) {
            best = min(best, sdf_sample_page(page, p));
        } else {
            best = min(best, d_box);
        }
    }
    return best;
}

fn sdf_trace_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    if (sdf_scene.atlas_dims.x == 0u) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let texel = sdf_scene.world_bounds_max_texel.w;
    let bias = 2.0 * texel;
    let origin = world_pos + normal * bias;
    let dir = normalize(light_dir);
    let max_dist = length(sdf_scene.world_bounds_max_texel.xyz - sdf_scene.world_bounds_min.xyz);
    let half_tan = tan(0.5 * SDF_CONE_APERTURE);
    let t_min = max(bias, 0.5 * texel);

    var visibility = 1.0;
    var t = t_min;

    for (var i = 0u; i < MAX_CONE_STEPS; i = i + 1u) {
        if (t >= max_dist || visibility < 1.0e-3) {
            break;
        }
        let p = origin + dir * t;
        let sd = sdf_sample_world(p);
        let r = half_tan * t;

        var occ: f32;
        if (r > 1.0e-6) {
            occ = clamp(1.0 - sd / r, 0.0, 1.0);
        } else {
            occ = select(0.0, 1.0, sd <= 0.0);
        }

        var dt: f32;
        if (sd <= 0.0) {
            dt = t_min;
        } else {
            dt = clamp(abs(sd), t_min, max(r, t_min));
        }
        let cov = min(1.0, dt / max(r, t_min));

        visibility = visibility * (1.0 - occ * cov);
        t = t + dt;
    }

    return clamp(visibility, 0.0, 1.0);
}
```

```wgsl
struct ShadowMatrix {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};
@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> shadow: ShadowMatrix;

struct Model {
    model: mat4x4<f32>,
    normal_matrix: mat3x3<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> models: array<Model>;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(
    @location(0) pos_q: vec4<f32>,
    @builtin(instance_index) instance_idx: u32,
) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let mdl = models[instance_idx];
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(pos_q, mdl.bounds_min.xyz, mdl.bounds_extent.xyz);
    out.clip_pos = shadow.view_proj * mdl.model * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
```

### `shaders/skybox.wgsl` | **Строк:** 56

```wgsl
// Skybox background pass.
//
// Draws a fullscreen triangle that samples the environment cubemap along the
// view ray reconstructed from the inverse camera matrices. Runs FIRST in the
// forward HDR pass (depth is still cleared to 1.0) and writes depth = 1.0 so
// every opaque fragment drawn afterwards wins the depth test.
//
// The Camera layout MUST match `CameraUniform` in src/camera.rs
// (7 mat4 + 1 vec4 = 464 bytes, uniform address alignment).

struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_env: texture_cube<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_env: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> camera: Camera;

struct SkyboxVertexOutput {
    // z = w so the fragment depth lands exactly on the far plane (1.0).
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) ndc: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) idx: u32) -> SkyboxVertexOutput {
    // Fullscreen triangle trick covering NDC [-1, 1].
    let x = f32((idx << 1u) & 2u) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(idx & 2u) * 2.0 - 1.0;

    var out: SkyboxVertexOutput;
    // z = w puts the fragment depth exactly on the far plane (1.0).
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 1.0, 1.0);
    out.ndc = vec2<f32>(x, y);
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: SkyboxVertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    // Unproject the far-plane point to view space, then rotate the direction
    // into world space (inv_view applied with w = 0 keeps it a direction).
    let far_view = camera.inv_proj * vec4<f32>(in.ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
    let dir_view = normalize(far_view.xyz / far_view.w);
    let dir_world = normalize((camera.inv_view * vec4<f32>(dir_view, 0.0)).xyz);

    // textureSampleLevel: no screen-space derivatives wanted on a cube lookup.
    let color = textureSampleLevel(t_env, s_env, dir_world, 0.0).rgb;
    return vec4<f32>(color, 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/smaa/blend_weights.wgsl` | **Строк:** 352

```wgsl
// SMAA Blend Weight Calculation (Pass 2) — PRESET_HIGH
// Port of iryoku SMAA.hlsl SMAABlendingWeightCalculationPS
//
// SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS      = 16
// SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG = 8
// SMAA_CORNER_ROUNDING       = 25
//
// Input:  edges texture (Rg8Unorm)
// Output: blend weights (Rgba8Unorm)

struct SmaaMetrics {
    rt_metrics: vec4<f32>, // (1/w, 1/h, w, h)
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_edges   : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_area    : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_search  : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var s_linear  : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(4) var s_point   : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(5) var<uniform> u : SmaaMetrics;

const SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS: i32 = 16;
const SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG: i32 = 8;
const SMAA_CORNER_ROUNDING_NORM: f32 = 0.25; // 25 / 100
const SMAA_AREATEX_MAX_DISTANCE: f32 = 16.0;
const SMAA_AREATEX_MAX_DISTANCE_DIAG: f32 = 20.0;
const SMAA_AREATEX_PIXEL_SIZE: vec2<f32> = vec2<f32>(1.0 / 160.0, 1.0 / 560.0);
const SMAA_AREATEX_SUBTEX_SIZE: f32 = 1.0 / 7.0;
const SMAA_SEARCHTEX_SIZE: vec2<f32> = vec2<f32>(66.0, 33.0);
const SMAA_SEARCHTEX_PACKED_SIZE: vec2<f32> = vec2<f32>(64.0, 16.0);

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) pixcoord: vec2<f32>,
    @location(2) offset0: vec4<f32>,
    @location(3) offset1: vec4<f32>,
    @location(4) offset2: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.uv = uv;

    let m = u.rt_metrics;
    out.pixcoord = uv * m.zw;

    out.offset0 = m.xyxy * vec4<f32>(-0.25, -0.125, 1.25, -0.125) + uv.xyxy;
    out.offset1 = m.xyxy * vec4<f32>(-0.125, -0.25, -0.125, 1.25) + uv.xyxy;
    out.offset2 = m.xxyy * vec4<f32>(-2.0, 2.0, -2.0, 2.0) * f32(SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS)
                  + vec4<f32>(out.offset0.x, out.offset0.z, out.offset1.y, out.offset1.w);
    return out;
}

// ─── Helper: sample edges using linear filtering ─────────────────────────────
fn sample_edges(coord: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    return textureSampleLevel(t_edges, s_linear, coord, 0.0).rg;
}

fn sample_edges_point(coord: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    return textureSampleLevel(t_edges, s_point, coord, 0.0).rg;
}

fn sample_edges_offset(coord: vec2<f32>, offset: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    return textureSampleLevel(t_edges, s_linear, coord + offset * u.rt_metrics.xy, 0.0).rg;
}

// ─── SearchTex lookup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn search_length(e: vec2<f32>, offset: f32) -> f32 {
    var scale = SMAA_SEARCHTEX_SIZE * vec2<f32>(0.5, -1.0);
    var bias  = SMAA_SEARCHTEX_SIZE * vec2<f32>(offset, 1.0);
    scale += vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0);
    bias  += vec2<f32>( 0.5, -0.5);
    scale *= 1.0 / SMAA_SEARCHTEX_PACKED_SIZE;
    bias  *= 1.0 / SMAA_SEARCHTEX_PACKED_SIZE;
    return textureSampleLevel(t_search, s_point, scale * e + bias, 0.0).r;
}

// ─── Horizontal/Vertical search ─────────────────────────────────────────────
fn search_x_left(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, end: f32) -> f32 {
    var tc = texcoord_in;
    var e = vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS; i++) {
        if (tc.x <= end || e.g <= 0.8281 || e.r != 0.0) { break; }
        e = sample_edges(tc).rg;
        tc -= vec2<f32>(2.0, 0.0) * u.rt_metrics.xy;
    }
    let offset = -(255.0 / 127.0) * search_length(e, 0.0) + 3.25;
    return u.rt_metrics.x * offset + tc.x;
}

fn search_x_right(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, end: f32) -> f32 {
    var tc = texcoord_in;
    var e = vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS; i++) {
        if (tc.x >= end || e.g <= 0.8281 || e.r != 0.0) { break; }
        e = sample_edges(tc).rg;
        tc += vec2<f32>(2.0, 0.0) * u.rt_metrics.xy;
    }
    let offset = -(255.0 / 127.0) * search_length(e, 0.5) + 3.25;
    return -u.rt_metrics.x * offset + tc.x;
}

fn search_y_up(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, end: f32) -> f32 {
    var tc = texcoord_in;
    var e = vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS; i++) {
        if (tc.y <= end || e.r <= 0.8281 || e.g != 0.0) { break; }
        e = sample_edges(tc).rg;
        tc -= vec2<f32>(0.0, 2.0) * u.rt_metrics.xy;
    }
    let offset = -(255.0 / 127.0) * search_length(e.gr, 0.0) + 3.25;
    return u.rt_metrics.y * offset + tc.y;
}

fn search_y_down(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, end: f32) -> f32 {
    var tc = texcoord_in;
    var e = vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS; i++) {
        if (tc.y >= end || e.r <= 0.8281 || e.g != 0.0) { break; }
        e = sample_edges(tc).rg;
        tc += vec2<f32>(0.0, 2.0) * u.rt_metrics.xy;
    }
    let offset = -(255.0 / 127.0) * search_length(e.gr, 0.5) + 3.25;
    return -u.rt_metrics.y * offset + tc.y;
}

// ─── Area texture lookup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn smaa_area(dist: vec2<f32>, e1: f32, e2: f32, offset: f32) -> vec2<f32> {
    var texcoord = SMAA_AREATEX_MAX_DISTANCE * round(4.0 * vec2<f32>(e1, e2)) + dist;
    texcoord = SMAA_AREATEX_PIXEL_SIZE * texcoord + 0.5 * SMAA_AREATEX_PIXEL_SIZE;
    texcoord.y = SMAA_AREATEX_SUBTEX_SIZE * offset + texcoord.y;
    return textureSampleLevel(t_area, s_linear, texcoord, 0.0).rg;
}

fn smaa_area_diag(dist: vec2<f32>, e: vec2<f32>, offset: f32) -> vec2<f32> {
    var texcoord = SMAA_AREATEX_MAX_DISTANCE_DIAG * e + dist;
    texcoord = SMAA_AREATEX_PIXEL_SIZE * texcoord + 0.5 * SMAA_AREATEX_PIXEL_SIZE;
    texcoord.x += 0.5;
    texcoord.y += SMAA_AREATEX_SUBTEX_SIZE * offset;
    return textureSampleLevel(t_area, s_linear, texcoord, 0.0).rg;
}

// ─── Diagonal search ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn decode_diag_bilinear_access(e_in: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    var e = e_in;
    e.x = e.x * abs(5.0 * e.x - 5.0 * 0.75);
    return round(e);
}

fn search_diag1(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, dir: vec2<f32>) -> vec4<f32> {
    // returns (d, end_e) packed as (z=steps, w=activity, then xy for end_e)
    var coord = vec4<f32>(texcoord_in, -1.0, 1.0);
    let t = vec3<f32>(u.rt_metrics.xy, 1.0);
    var e = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG - 1; i++) {
        if (coord.z >= f32(SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG - 1) || coord.w <= 0.9) { break; }
        coord = vec4<f32>(coord.xyz + t * vec3<f32>(dir, 1.0), coord.w);
        e = sample_edges(coord.xy).rg;
        coord.w = dot(e, vec2<f32>(0.5, 0.5));
    }
    return vec4<f32>(e, coord.zw);
}

fn search_diag2(texcoord_in: vec2<f32>, dir: vec2<f32>) -> vec4<f32> {
    var coord = vec4<f32>(texcoord_in.x + 0.25 * u.rt_metrics.x, texcoord_in.y, -1.0, 1.0);
    let t = vec3<f32>(u.rt_metrics.xy, 1.0);
    var e = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    for (var i = 0; i < SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG - 1; i++) {
        if (coord.z >= f32(SMAA_MAX_SEARCH_STEPS_DIAG - 1) || coord.w <= 0.9) { break; }
        coord = vec4<f32>(coord.xyz + t * vec3<f32>(dir, 1.0), coord.w);
        e = sample_edges(coord.xy).rg;
        e = decode_diag_bilinear_access(e);
        coord.w = dot(e, vec2<f32>(0.5, 0.5));
    }
    return vec4<f32>(e, coord.zw);
}

fn calculate_diag_weights(texcoord: vec2<f32>, e_in: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    var weights = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    var d: vec4<f32>;

    if (e_in.r > 0.0) {
        let r1 = search_diag1(texcoord, vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0));
        d.x = r1.z;
        d.z = r1.w;
        let end_e = r1.xy;
        d.x += select(0.0, 1.0, end_e.y > 0.9);
    } else {
        d.x = 0.0;
        d.z = 0.0;
    }
    let r2 = search_diag1(texcoord, vec2<f32>(1.0, -1.0));
    d.y = r2.z;
    d.w = r2.w;

    if (d.x + d.y > 2.0) {
        let coords = vec4<f32>(-d.x + 0.25, d.x, d.y, -d.y - 0.25) * u.rt_metrics.xyxy + texcoord.xyxy;
        var c: vec4<f32>;
        c.x = sample_edges_offset(coords.xy, vec2<f32>(-1.0, 0.0)).r;
        c.y = sample_edges_offset(coords.xy, vec2<f32>(-1.0, 0.0)).g;
        c.z = sample_edges_offset(coords.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).r;
        c.w = sample_edges_offset(coords.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).g;
        var c2 = vec4<f32>(c.y, c.x, c.w, c.z);
        c2 = vec4<f32>(decode_diag_bilinear_access(c2.xy), decode_diag_bilinear_access(c2.zw));
        let cc = 2.0 * vec2<f32>(c2.x, c2.z) + vec2<f32>(c2.y, c2.w);
        var cc2 = cc;
        if (d.z < 0.9) { cc2.x = 0.0; }
        if (d.w < 0.9) { cc2.y = 0.0; }
        weights += smaa_area_diag(d.xy, cc2, 0.0);
    }

    let r3 = search_diag2(texcoord, vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0));
    d.x = r3.z;
    d.z = r3.w;
    if (sample_edges_offset(texcoord, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).r > 0.0) {
        let r4 = search_diag2(texcoord, vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0));
        d.y = r4.z;
        d.w = r4.w;
        let end_e2 = r4.xy;
        d.y += select(0.0, 1.0, end_e2.y > 0.9);
    } else {
        d.y = 0.0;
        d.w = 0.0;
    }

    if (d.x + d.y > 2.0) {
        let coords = vec4<f32>(-d.x, -d.x, d.y, d.y) * u.rt_metrics.xyxy + texcoord.xyxy;
        var c: vec4<f32>;
        c.x = sample_edges_offset(coords.xy, vec2<f32>(-1.0, 0.0)).g;
        c.y = sample_edges_offset(coords.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0, -1.0)).r;
        c.z = sample_edges_offset(coords.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).g;
        c.w = sample_edges_offset(coords.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).r;
        let cc = 2.0 * vec2<f32>(c.x, c.z) + vec2<f32>(c.y, c.w);
        var cc2 = cc;
        if (d.z < 0.9) { cc2.x = 0.0; }
        if (d.w < 0.9) { cc2.y = 0.0; }
        weights += smaa_area_diag(d.xy, cc2, 0.0).gr;
    }

    return weights;
}

// ─── Corner detection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fn detect_horizontal_corner(weights_in: vec2<f32>, texcoord: vec4<f32>, d: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let left_right = step(d.xy, d.yx);
    var rounding = (1.0 - SMAA_CORNER_ROUNDING_NORM) * left_right;
    rounding /= left_right.x + left_right.y;

    var factor = vec2<f32>(1.0);
    factor.x -= rounding.x * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0)).r;
    factor.x -= rounding.y * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0)).r;
    factor.y -= rounding.x * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0, -2.0)).r;
    factor.y -= rounding.y * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, -2.0)).r;

    return weights_in * saturate(factor);
}

fn detect_vertical_corner(weights_in: vec2<f32>, texcoord: vec4<f32>, d: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let left_right = step(d.xy, d.yx);
    var rounding = (1.0 - SMAA_CORNER_ROUNDING_NORM) * left_right;
    rounding /= left_right.x + left_right.y;

    var factor = vec2<f32>(1.0);
    factor.x -= rounding.x * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.xy, vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).g;
    factor.x -= rounding.y * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.zw, vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0)).g;
    factor.y -= rounding.x * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.xy, vec2<f32>(-2.0, 0.0)).g;
    factor.y -= rounding.y * sample_edges_offset(texcoord.zw, vec2<f32>(-2.0, 1.0)).g;

    return weights_in * saturate(factor);
}

fn saturate(v: vec2<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    return clamp(v, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0));
}

// ─── Fragment shader ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    var weights = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    let e = sample_edges_point(in.uv);

    if (e.g > 0.0) {
        // Diagonal detection
        var diag_weights = calculate_diag_weights(in.uv, e);

        if (diag_weights.r <= 0.0 && diag_weights.g <= 0.0) {
            // Horizontal search
            var d: vec2<f32>;
            var coords: vec3<f32>;
            coords.x = search_x_left(in.offset0.xy, in.offset2.x);
            coords.y = in.offset1.y;
            d.x = coords.x;

            let e1 = sample_edges(coords.xy).r;

            coords.z = search_x_right(in.offset0.zw, in.offset2.y);
            d.y = coords.z;

            d = abs(round(u.rt_metrics.zz * d - in.pixcoord.xx));
            let sqrt_d = sqrt(d);

            let e2 = sample_edges_offset(vec2<f32>(coords.z, coords.y), vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)).r;

            weights.x = smaa_area(sqrt_d, e1, e2, 0.0).x;
            weights.y = smaa_area(sqrt_d, e1, e2, 0.0).y;

            let corner_tc = vec4<f32>(coords.x, in.uv.y, coords.z, in.uv.y);
            let w = detect_horizontal_corner(weights.xy, corner_tc, d);
            weights.x = w.x;
            weights.y = w.y;
        } else {
            weights.x = diag_weights.x;
            weights.y = diag_weights.y;
        }
    }

    if (e.r > 0.0) {
        // Vertical search
        var d: vec2<f32>;
        var coords: vec3<f32>;
        coords.y = search_y_up(in.offset1.xy, in.offset2.z);
        coords.x = in.offset0.x;
        d.x = coords.y;

        let e1 = sample_edges(coords.xy).g;

        coords.z = search_y_down(in.offset1.zw, in.offset2.w);
        d.y = coords.z;

        d = abs(round(u.rt_metrics.ww * d - in.pixcoord.yy));
        let sqrt_d = sqrt(d);

        let e2 = sample_edges_offset(vec2<f32>(coords.x, coords.z), vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0)).g;

        weights.z = smaa_area(sqrt_d, e1, e2, 0.0).x;
        weights.w = smaa_area(sqrt_d, e1, e2, 0.0).y;

        let corner_tc = vec4<f32>(in.uv.x, coords.y, in.uv.x, coords.z);
        let w = detect_vertical_corner(weights.zw, corner_tc, d);
        weights.z = w.x;
        weights.w = w.y;
    }

    return weights;
}
```

### `shaders/smaa/edge.wgsl` | **Строк:** 83

```wgsl
// SMAA Edge Detection (Pass 1) — Luma-based, PRESET_HIGH
// Port of iryoku SMAA.hlsl SMAALumaEdgeDetectionPS
//
// Input:  LDR color (post-ACES tonemapped, linear Rgba8Unorm)
// Output: Rg8Unorm edges texture (R = left edge, G = top edge)

struct SmaaMetrics {
    rt_metrics: vec4<f32>, // (1/w, 1/h, w, h)
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_color   : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_linear  : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> u : SmaaMetrics;

const SMAA_THRESHOLD: f32 = 0.05;
const SMAA_LOCAL_CONTRAST_ADAPTATION_FACTOR: f32 = 1.25;
const LUMA_WEIGHTS: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722);

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) offset0: vec4<f32>,
    @location(2) offset1: vec4<f32>,
    @location(3) offset2: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.uv = uv;

    let m = u.rt_metrics;
    out.offset0 = m.xyxy * vec4<f32>(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0, -1.0) + uv.xyxy;
    out.offset1 = m.xyxy * vec4<f32>( 1.0, 0.0, 0.0,  1.0) + uv.xyxy;
    out.offset2 = m.xyxy * vec4<f32>(-2.0, 0.0, 0.0, -2.0) + uv.xyxy;
    return out;
}

fn luma(coord: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return dot(textureSampleLevel(t_color, s_linear, coord, 0.0).rgb, LUMA_WEIGHTS);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec2<f32> {
    let threshold = vec2<f32>(SMAA_THRESHOLD);

    let L      = luma(in.uv);
    let Lleft  = luma(in.offset0.xy);
    let Ltop   = luma(in.offset0.zw);

    let delta_left = abs(L - Lleft);
    let delta_top  = abs(L - Ltop);
    let delta_xy = vec2<f32>(delta_left, delta_top);
    var edges = step(threshold, delta_xy);

    if (dot(edges, vec2<f32>(1.0)) == 0.0) {
        discard;
    }

    let Lright  = luma(in.offset1.xy);
    let Lbottom = luma(in.offset1.zw);
    let delta_right  = abs(L - Lright);
    let delta_bottom = abs(L - Lbottom);

    var maxDelta = max(delta_xy, vec2<f32>(delta_right, delta_bottom));

    let Lleftleft = luma(in.offset2.xy);
    let Ltoptop   = luma(in.offset2.zw);
    let delta_ll = abs(Lleft - Lleftleft);
    let delta_tt = abs(Ltop  - Ltoptop);

    maxDelta = max(maxDelta, vec2<f32>(delta_ll, delta_tt));
    let finalDelta = max(maxDelta.x, maxDelta.y);

    edges *= step(vec2<f32>(finalDelta), SMAA_LOCAL_CONTRAST_ADAPTATION_FACTOR * delta_xy);

    return edges;
}
```
