### `shaders/smaa/neighborhood.wgsl` | **Строк:** 70

```wgsl
// SMAA Neighborhood Blending (Pass 3)
// Port of iryoku SMAA.hlsl SMAANeighborhoodBlendingPS
//
// Input:  LDR color + blend weights texture
// Output: Anti-aliased LDR color (Rgba8Unorm)

struct SmaaMetrics {
    rt_metrics: vec4<f32>, // (1/w, 1/h, w, h)
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_color  : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_blend  : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var s_linear : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(3) var s_point  : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<uniform> u : SmaaMetrics;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
    @location(1) offset: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    out.uv = uv;
    out.offset = u.rt_metrics.xyxy * vec4<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) + uv.xyxy;
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    var a: vec4<f32>;
    a.x = textureSampleLevel(t_blend, s_point, in.offset.xy, 0.0).a; // Right
    a.y = textureSampleLevel(t_blend, s_point, in.offset.zw, 0.0).g; // Top
    let local = textureSampleLevel(t_blend, s_point, in.uv, 0.0);
    a.w = local.x; // Bottom (stored in .r => left for vertical pass? Actually .r = left weight from horiz)
    a.z = local.z; // Left

    if (dot(a, vec4<f32>(1.0)) < 1e-5) {
        return textureSampleLevel(t_color, s_linear, in.uv, 0.0);
    }

    let h = max(a.x, a.z) > max(a.y, a.w);

    var blending_offset: vec4<f32>;
    var blending_weight: vec2<f32>;

    if (h) {
        blending_offset = vec4<f32>(a.x, 0.0, a.z, 0.0);
        blending_weight = a.xz;
    } else {
        blending_offset = vec4<f32>(0.0, a.y, 0.0, a.w);
        blending_weight = a.yw;
    }

    blending_weight /= dot(blending_weight, vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0));

    let blending_coord = blending_offset * vec4<f32>(u.rt_metrics.xy, -u.rt_metrics.xy) + in.uv.xyxy;

    var color = blending_weight.x * textureSampleLevel(t_color, s_linear, blending_coord.xy, 0.0);
    color += blending_weight.y * textureSampleLevel(t_color, s_linear, blending_coord.zw, 0.0);

    return color;
}
```

### `shaders/ssao.wgsl` | **Строк:** 140

```wgsl
// View-space hemisphere SSAO.
//
// Normal buffer stores world normals + linear depth (|view_z| / FAR).
// Samples are offset in *view space*, then reprojected — never as raw UV
// offsets of world-space directions (that caused false AO / moiré on
// slanted flat faces).

struct Camera {
    // Must mirror rust CameraUniform exactly.
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_noise: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var s_ssao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<uniform> kernel: array<vec4<f32>, 32>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<uniform> camera: Camera;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const WORLD_RADIUS: f32 = 0.45;
const DEPTH_BIAS: f32 = 0.025;
const INTENSITY: f32 = 1.0;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let x = f32(i32(vertex_index) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vertex_index) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    // Top-left UV origin (matches wgpu framebuffer sampling).
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

/// Reconstruct RH view-space position from top-left UV + linear |view_z|/FAR.
fn view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let view_z = max(linear_depth * FAR, 1e-4);
    // uv.y=0 → top → ndc.y = +1
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0);
    // glam perspective_rh: clip.x = m00 * view.x, clip.y = m11 * view.y,
    // clip.w = -view.z. At the view plane view.z = -view_z.
    let inv_m00 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[0][0], 1e-6);
    let inv_m11 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[1][1], 1e-6);
    return vec3<f32>(
        ndc.x * inv_m00 * view_z,
        ndc.y * inv_m11 * view_z,
        -view_z,
    );
}

fn project_view_to_uv(view_pos: vec3<f32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    let clip = camera.proj * vec4<f32>(view_pos, 1.0);
    let w = max(abs(clip.w), 1e-5);
    let ndc = clip.xy / w;
    // Inverse of view_pos_from_uv_depth mapping.
    return vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) f32 {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let px = vec2<i32>(clamp(in.uv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
    let normal_depth = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, px, 0);
    let n_world = normalize(normal_depth.rgb);
    let depth = normal_depth.a;

    if (depth >= 0.999 || depth <= 1e-5) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let view_pos = view_pos_from_uv_depth(in.uv, depth);
    // World → view (direction only).
    let n_view = normalize((camera.view * vec4<f32>(n_world, 0.0)).xyz);

    // Tile 4×4 noise in output pixel space (half-res pass → clip_pos).
    let noise_px = vec2<i32>(
        i32(in.clip_pos.x) & 3,
        i32(in.clip_pos.y) & 3,
    );
    let random_vec = textureLoad(t_noise, noise_px, 0).xyz;
    // Orthonormal basis around the view-space normal.
    var tangent = normalize(random_vec - n_view * dot(random_vec, n_view));
    if (dot(tangent, tangent) < 1e-6) {
        let up = select(vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), abs(n_view.y) < 0.9);
        tangent = normalize(cross(up, n_view));
    }
    let bitangent = cross(n_view, tangent);
    let tbn = mat3x3<f32>(tangent, bitangent, n_view);

    var occlusion = 0.0;
    var valid_samples = 0.0;

    for (var i = 0u; i < 32u; i = i + 1u) {
        let sample_view = view_pos + tbn * kernel[i].xyz * WORLD_RADIUS;
        // Behind the near plane / camera.
        if (sample_view.z >= -1e-3) {
            continue;
        }

        let sample_uv = project_view_to_uv(sample_view);
        if (sample_uv.x < 0.0 || sample_uv.x > 1.0 || sample_uv.y < 0.0 || sample_uv.y > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }

        let sample_px = vec2<i32>(clamp(sample_uv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
        let sample_depth = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, sample_px, 0).a;
        if (sample_depth >= 0.999) {
            continue;
        }

        let occluder_z = sample_depth * FAR;          // positive |view_z|
        let expected_z = -sample_view.z;              // positive
        let z_diff = expected_z - occluder_z;         // >0 ⇒ occluder closer

        // Range check softens distant false hits (walls behind open space).
        let range_check = 1.0 - smoothstep(WORLD_RADIUS * 0.5, WORLD_RADIUS, abs(z_diff));
        if (z_diff > DEPTH_BIAS) {
            occlusion += range_check;
        }
        valid_samples += 1.0;
    }

    if (valid_samples < 1.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    return clamp(1.0 - (occlusion / valid_samples) * INTENSITY, 0.0, 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/ssao_blur.wgsl` | **Строк:** 75

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var t_ssao: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_ssao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
// Soft depth sigma in metres — wide enough to blur noise on flats.
const DEPTH_SIGMA: f32 = 0.35;
// Soft normal gate so triangulation diagonals don't leave a hard seam.
const NORMAL_POWER: f32 = 2.0;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let x = f32(i32(vertex_index) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vertex_index) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn bilateral_weight(center_nd: vec4<f32>, sample_nd: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    let depth_diff_m = abs(center_nd.a - sample_nd.a) * FAR;
    let depth_w = exp(-depth_diff_m / max(DEPTH_SIGMA, 1e-3));

    let n_dot = max(dot(normalize(center_nd.rgb), normalize(sample_nd.rgb)), 0.0);
    // Floor keeps some bleed across micro normal flips on flat quads.
    let normal_w = mix(0.15, 1.0, pow(n_dot, NORMAL_POWER));

    return depth_w * normal_w;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) f32 {
    let tex_size = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_ssao));
    let texel_size = 1.0 / tex_size;
    let nd_size = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));

    let center_nd = textureLoad(
        t_normal_depth,
        vec2<i32>(clamp(in.uv * nd_size, vec2<f32>(0.0), nd_size - 1.0)),
        0,
    );
    let center_ao = textureSample(t_ssao, s_ssao, in.uv).r;

    var accum = 0.0;
    var weight_sum = 0.0;

    // 7×7 bilateral — half-res SSAO needs a wider kernel to kill 4×4 noise.
    for (var y = -3; y <= 3; y++) {
        for (var x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel_size;
            let sample_uv = in.uv + offset;

            let sample_nd = textureLoad(
                t_normal_depth,
                vec2<i32>(clamp(sample_uv * nd_size, vec2<f32>(0.0), nd_size - 1.0)),
                0,
            );
            let sample_ao = textureSample(t_ssao, s_ssao, sample_uv).r;

            let spatial = exp(-0.15 * f32(x * x + y * y));
            let w = bilateral_weight(center_nd, sample_nd) * spatial;
            accum += sample_ao * w;
            weight_sum += w;
        }
    }

    return accum / max(weight_sum, 1e-5);
}
```

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var t_ssao_half: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_ssao: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const DEPTH_SIGMA: f32 = 0.25;
const NORMAL_POWER: f32 = 2.0;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let x = f32(i32(vertex_index) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vertex_index) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn bilateral_weight(center_nd: vec4<f32>, sample_nd: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    let depth_diff_m = abs(center_nd.a - sample_nd.a) * FAR;
    let depth_w = exp(-depth_diff_m / max(DEPTH_SIGMA, 1e-3));
    let n_dot = max(dot(normalize(center_nd.rgb), normalize(sample_nd.rgb)), 0.0);
    let normal_w = mix(0.15, 1.0, pow(n_dot, NORMAL_POWER));
    return depth_w * normal_w;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) f32 {
    let full_dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let center_nd = textureLoad(
        t_normal_depth,
        vec2<i32>(clamp(in.uv * full_dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), full_dims - 1.0)),
        0,
    );

    var accum = 0.0;
    var weight_sum = 0.0;

    // 3×3 guided upsample in full-res texel space.
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let full_px = vec2<i32>(in.uv * full_dims) + vec2<i32>(x, y);
            let sample_nd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, full_px, 0);

            let half_uv = (vec2<f32>(full_px) + 0.5) / full_dims;
            let sample_ao = textureSample(t_ssao_half, s_ssao, half_uv).r;

            let w = bilateral_weight(center_nd, sample_nd);
            accum += sample_ao * w;
            weight_sum += w;
        }
    }

    return accum / max(weight_sum, 1e-5);
}
```

### `shaders/taa.wgsl` | **Строк:** 275

```wgsl

struct TaaUniform {
    output_size : vec2<f32>,
    input_size  : vec2<f32>,
    blend_alpha : f32,
    reset       : u32,
    jitter_uv   : vec2<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_current    : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_velocity   : texture_2d<f32>; // xy = UV delta, z = depth
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_history    : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var s_linear     : sampler;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<uniform>     taa_u : TaaUniform;
@group(0) @binding(5) var t_reactive   : texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(6) var t_prev_depth : texture_depth_2d; // previous frame depth

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos : vec4<f32>,
    @location(0)       uv       : vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv       = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

fn rgb_to_ycocg(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let y  = 0.25 * c.r + 0.5 * c.g + 0.25 * c.b;
    let co = 0.5 * c.r - 0.5 * c.b;
    let cg = -0.25 * c.r + 0.5 * c.g - 0.25 * c.b;
    return vec3<f32>(y, co, cg);
}

fn ycocg_to_rgb(ycc: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let y  = ycc.x;
    let co = ycc.y;
    let cg = ycc.z;
    return max(vec3<f32>(y + co - cg, y + cg, y - co - cg), vec3<f32>(0.0));
}

fn tonemap(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let l = 0.25 * c.r + 0.5 * c.g + 0.25 * c.b;
    return c / (1.0 + max(l, 0.0));
}

fn inv_tonemap(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let l = 0.25 * c.r + 0.5 * c.g + 0.25 * c.b;
    return c / max(1.0 - min(l, 0.999), 1e-4);
}

fn finite_hdr(c: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
    return !(any(c != c) || any(abs(c) > vec3<f32>(65504.0)));
}

fn bh_weight(d: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return exp(-2.29 * dot(d, d));
}

fn sample_history_catmull_rom(uv: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let size = taa_u.output_size;
    let texel = 1.0 / size;
    let sample_pos = uv * size;
    let tc = floor(sample_pos - 0.5) + 0.5;
    let f = sample_pos - tc;
    let f2 = f * f;
    let f3 = f2 * f;

    let w0 = f2 - 0.5 * (f3 + f);
    let w1 = 1.5 * f3 - 2.5 * f2 + 1.0;
    let w3 = 0.5 * (f3 - f2);
    let w2 = 1.0 - w0 - w1 - w3;

    let w12 = w1 + w2;
    let tc12 = (tc + w2 / max(w12, vec2<f32>(1e-5))) * texel;
    let tc0 = (tc - 1.0) * texel;
    let tc3 = (tc + 2.0) * texel;

    var result = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var wsum = 0.0;

    let c_top = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, vec2<f32>(tc12.x, tc0.y), 0.0).rgb;
    let w_top = w12.x * w0.y;
    if (finite_hdr(c_top)) {
        result += c_top * w_top;
        wsum += w_top;
    }
    let c_left = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, vec2<f32>(tc0.x, tc12.y), 0.0).rgb;
    let w_left = w0.x * w12.y;
    if (finite_hdr(c_left)) {
        result += c_left * w_left;
        wsum += w_left;
    }
    let c_mid = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, vec2<f32>(tc12.x, tc12.y), 0.0).rgb;
    let w_mid = w12.x * w12.y;
    if (finite_hdr(c_mid)) {
        result += c_mid * w_mid;
        wsum += w_mid;
    }
    let c_right = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, vec2<f32>(tc3.x, tc12.y), 0.0).rgb;
    let w_right = w3.x * w12.y;
    if (finite_hdr(c_right)) {
        result += c_right * w_right;
        wsum += w_right;
    }
    let c_bot = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, vec2<f32>(tc12.x, tc3.y), 0.0).rgb;
    let w_bot = w12.x * w3.y;
    if (finite_hdr(c_bot)) {
        result += c_bot * w_bot;
        wsum += w_bot;
    }
    let filtered = result / max(wsum, 1e-5);

    let c00 = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, (tc + vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0)) * texel, 0.0).rgb;
    let c10 = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, (tc + vec2<f32>(1.0, 0.0)) * texel, 0.0).rgb;
    let c01 = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, (tc + vec2<f32>(0.0, 1.0)) * texel, 0.0).rgb;
    let c11 = textureSampleLevel(t_history, s_linear, (tc + vec2<f32>(1.0, 1.0)) * texel, 0.0).rgb;
    let mn = min(min(min(c00, c10), c01), c11);
    let mx = max(max(max(c00, c10), c01), c11);
    return clamp(filtered, mn, mx);
}

fn clip_aabb(mn: vec3<f32>, mx: vec3<f32>, p: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let center = 0.5 * (mx + mn);
    let extents = max(0.5 * (mx - mn), vec3<f32>(1e-4));
    let offset = p - center;
    let v_unit = offset / extents;
    let ma = max(abs(v_unit.x), max(abs(v_unit.y), abs(v_unit.z)));
    if (ma > 1.0) {
        return center + offset / ma;
    }
    return p;
}

// TAA-STAR hybrid: longest MV on motion, closest depth at silhouettes.
fn dilated_velocity(center_px: vec2<i32>, max_px: vec2<i32>) -> vec2<f32> {
    var best_d = 2.0;
    var closest_v = textureLoad(t_velocity, center_px, 0).xy;
    var longest_v = closest_v;
    var longest_len = dot(longest_v, longest_v);
    var depth_min = 2.0;
    var depth_max = 0.0;

    for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            let coord = clamp(center_px + vec2<i32>(dx, dy), vec2<i32>(0), max_px);
            let s = textureLoad(t_velocity, coord, 0);
            depth_min = min(depth_min, s.z);
            depth_max = max(depth_max, s.z);
            if (s.z < best_d) {
                best_d = s.z;
                closest_v = s.xy;
            }
            let len = dot(s.xy, s.xy);
            if (len > longest_len) {
                longest_len = len;
                longest_v = s.xy;
            }
        }
    }
    let depth_edge = depth_max - depth_min;
    if (depth_edge > 0.002 && longest_len > 1e-10) {
        return longest_v;
    }
    return closest_v;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let max_px = vec2<i32>(taa_u.input_size) - vec2<i32>(1);
    let px = vec2<i32>(clamp(
        in.uv * taa_u.input_size,
        vec2<f32>(0.0),
        taa_u.input_size - vec2<f32>(1.0),
    ));

    let jitter_px = taa_u.jitter_uv * taa_u.input_size;
    var m1 = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var m2 = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var cmc = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    var cur_sum = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var cur_wsum = 0.0;
    var center_w = 0.0;

    for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            let coord = clamp(px + vec2<i32>(dx, dy), vec2<i32>(0), max_px);
            let raw = textureLoad(t_current, coord, 0).rgb;
            let ycc = rgb_to_ycocg(tonemap(raw));
            m1 += ycc;
            m2 += ycc * ycc;
            if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) {
                cmc = ycc;
            }
            let d = vec2<f32>(f32(dx), f32(dy)) - jitter_px;
            let w = bh_weight(d);
            cur_sum += tonemap(raw) * w;
            cur_wsum += w;
            if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) {
                center_w = w;
            }
        }
    }

    let mu = m1 * (1.0 / 9.0);
    let sigma = sqrt(max(m2 * (1.0 / 9.0) - mu * mu, vec3<f32>(0.0)));

    let vel_conf = 1.0 - clamp(length(dilated_velocity(px, max_px) * taa_u.output_size) / 24.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let gamma = mix(0.85, 1.45, vel_conf * vel_conf);
    var cmin = mu - gamma * sigma;
    var cmax = mu + gamma * sigma;
    let chroma_extent = 0.125 * max(cmax.x - cmin.x, sigma.x);
    cmin = vec3<f32>(cmin.x, cmc.y - chroma_extent, cmc.z - chroma_extent);
    cmax = vec3<f32>(cmax.x, cmc.y + chroma_extent, cmc.z + chroma_extent);

    let raw_vel = dilated_velocity(px, max_px);
    let velocity = raw_vel - taa_u.jitter_uv;
    let reprojected_uv = in.uv - velocity;
    let in_bounds = all(reprojected_uv >= vec2<f32>(0.0)) && all(reprojected_uv <= vec2<f32>(1.0));

    let vel_len = length(velocity * taa_u.output_size);
    let still = 1.0 - clamp(vel_len / 1.25, 0.0, 1.0);

    let current_tm = cur_sum / max(cur_wsum, 1e-5);
    let current_ycc = rgb_to_ycocg(current_tm);

    var history_ycc = rgb_to_ycocg(tonemap(sample_history_catmull_rom(reprojected_uv)));

    let lum_diff = abs(current_ycc.x - history_ycc.x)
        / max(current_ycc.x, max(history_ycc.x, 0.2));
    let agree = 1.0 - clamp(lum_diff / 0.22, 0.0, 1.0);
    let is_edge = clamp(sigma.x / 0.05, 0.0, 1.0);
    let lock = still * still * is_edge * agree;
    let ghost = (1.0 - is_edge) * clamp(lum_diff / 0.10, 0.0, 1.0);

    let clipped = clip_aabb(cmin, cmax, history_ycc);
    history_ycc = mix(clipped, history_ycc, lock);
    let history_tm = ycocg_to_rgb(history_ycc);

    // Intel / TAA-STAR depth threshold disocclusion reject.
    let curr_depth = textureLoad(t_velocity, px, 0).z;
    let prev_px = vec2<i32>(reprojected_uv * vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_prev_depth)));
    let prev_depth = textureLoad(t_prev_depth, prev_px, 0);
    let depth_ok = step(curr_depth, prev_depth + 0.001);

    var k_move = mix(1.0 - taa_u.blend_alpha * 2.0, 1.0 - taa_u.blend_alpha, agree * agree);
    k_move *= 1.0 - clamp(vel_len / 12.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55;
    k_move *= 1.0 - ghost;
    // Cap history weight on static edges — 0.97 was too soft for MSAA+TAA hybrids.
    var k_feedback = mix(k_move, 0.80, lock);

    let phase_w = center_w / max(cur_wsum, 1e-5);
    k_feedback *= mix(0.85, 1.0, phase_w);

    if (!in_bounds || taa_u.reset != 0u || depth_ok < 0.5) {
        k_feedback = 0.0;
    }

    let reactive = textureLoad(
        t_reactive,
        vec2<i32>(in.uv * vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_reactive))),
        0,
    ).r;
    k_feedback *= 1.0 - reactive;

    let resolved_tm = mix(current_tm, history_tm, clamp(k_feedback, 0.0, 1.0));
    return vec4<f32>(inv_tonemap(resolved_tm), 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/tone_mapping.wgsl` | **Строк:** 172

```wgsl
struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(
    @builtin(vertex_index) in_vertex_index: u32,
) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let x = f32(i32((in_vertex_index << 1u) & 2u)) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(in_vertex_index & 2u)) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv = vec2<f32>((x + 1.0) * 0.5, (1.0 - y) * 0.5);
    out.clip_position = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_hdr: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var s_hdr: sampler;

struct TonemapUniform {
    exposure: f32,
    sharpen_enabled: u32,
    bloom_enabled: u32,
    rcas_sharpness: f32,
    output_size: vec2<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> tonemap_u: TonemapUniform;
@group(0) @binding(3) var t_bloom: texture_2d<f32>;

const RCAS_LIMIT: f32 = 0.25 - (1.0 / 16.0);
const BLOOM_INTENSITY: f32 = 0.4;

// ACES kept for reference but not used — AgX is now the display transform.
fn aces_filmic(x: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return clamp(
        (x * (2.51 * x + 0.03)) / (x * (2.43 * x + 0.59) + 0.14),
        vec3<f32>(0.0),
        vec3<f32>(1.0),
    );
}

// AgX — Filmic AgX (Blender / Troy Sobotka) approximation, punchier than ACES,
// keeps highlight hue (no cyan shift), used as the sole display tonemapper.
fn agx_tonemap(x: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    var c = max(x, vec3<f32>(0.0));
    c = pow(c, vec3<f32>(0.96)); // was 0.85 → пастель; 0.96 сохраняет saturation
    let a = c * (6.2 * c + 0.5);
    let b = c * (6.2 * c + 1.7) + 0.06;
    return clamp(a / max(b, vec3<f32>(1e-5)), vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0));
}

fn pgrain(uv: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    // Interleaved gradient noise — stable, no tiling, cheap.
    return fract(sin(dot(uv * 413.0, vec2<f32>(17.13, 81.73))) * 43758.5453);
}

fn apply_film_optics(c: vec3<f32>, uv: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    var out = c;
    // Subtle grain — 1% in midtones only, was 3% dusty.
    let g = pgrain(uv) - 0.5;
    let luma = dot(out, vec3<f32>(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
    let grain_w = 0.01 * clamp(1.0 - abs(luma - 0.5) * 1.7, 0.0, 1.0);
    out = out + g * grain_w;
    // Soft vignette 5% at corners, was 22% dark → пастель.
    let d2 = dot(uv - 0.5, uv - 0.5);
    let vign = pow(clamp(1.0 - d2 * 0.55, 0.0, 1.0), 2.0);
    let vign4 = vign * vign; // ≈ cos^4
    out = out * mix(0.95, 1.0, vign4);
    return clamp(out, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0));
}

fn prep_agx(hdr: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    var c = hdr;
    if (any(c != c) || any(abs(c) > vec3<f32>(65504.0))) {
        c = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    return agx_tonemap(c * tonemap_u.exposure);
}

fn prep_display(hdr: vec3<f32>, uv: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return apply_film_optics(prep_agx(hdr), uv);
}

fn rcas(b: vec3<f32>, d: vec3<f32>, e: vec3<f32>, f: vec3<f32>, h: vec3<f32>, sharpness_stops: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let bL = b.b * 0.5 + (b.r * 0.5 + b.g);
    let dL = d.b * 0.5 + (d.r * 0.5 + d.g);
    let eL = e.b * 0.5 + (e.r * 0.5 + e.g);
    let fL = f.b * 0.5 + (f.r * 0.5 + f.g);
    let hL = h.b * 0.5 + (h.r * 0.5 + h.g);

    let range = max(max(max(max(bL, dL), eL), fL), hL) - min(min(min(min(bL, dL), eL), fL), hL);
    var nz = 0.25 * bL + 0.25 * dL + 0.25 * fL + 0.25 * hL - eL;
    nz = clamp(abs(nz) / max(range, 1e-5), 0.0, 1.0);
    nz = 1.0 - 0.5 * nz;

    let mn4 = min(min(b, d), min(f, h));
    let mx4 = max(max(b, d), max(f, h));

    let hit_min = min(mn4, e) / max(mx4 * 4.0, vec3<f32>(1e-5));
    let hit_max = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - max(mx4, e)) / (mn4 * 4.0 - vec3<f32>(4.0));
    let lobe_rgb = max(-hit_min, hit_max);
    var lobe = max(lobe_rgb.x, max(lobe_rgb.y, lobe_rgb.z));
    lobe = max(-RCAS_LIMIT, min(lobe, 0.0)) * exp2(-sharpness_stops);
    lobe *= nz;

    let rcp_l = 1.0 / (4.0 * lobe + 1.0);
    return (lobe * (b + d + h + f) + e) * rcp_l;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let texel = 1.0 / max(tonemap_u.output_size, vec2<f32>(1.0));
    var hdr = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv).rgb;
    if (tonemap_u.bloom_enabled != 0u) {
        hdr += textureSample(t_bloom, s_hdr, in.uv).rgb * BLOOM_INTENSITY;
    }
    // AgX before RCAS, optics after — grain not sharpened.
    let e_agx = prep_agx(hdr);

    if (tonemap_u.sharpen_enabled == 0u) {
        return vec4<f32>(apply_film_optics(e_agx, in.uv), 1.0);
    }

    var hdr_b = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, -texel.y)).rgb;
    var hdr_h = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, texel.y)).rgb;
    var hdr_d = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-texel.x, 0.0)).rgb;
    var hdr_f = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(texel.x, 0.0)).rgb;
    if (tonemap_u.bloom_enabled != 0u) {
        let bloom_b = textureSample(t_bloom, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, -texel.y)).rgb * BLOOM_INTENSITY;
        let bloom_h = textureSample(t_bloom, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, texel.y)).rgb * BLOOM_INTENSITY;
        let bloom_d = textureSample(t_bloom, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-texel.x, 0.0)).rgb * BLOOM_INTENSITY;
        let bloom_f = textureSample(t_bloom, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(texel.x, 0.0)).rgb * BLOOM_INTENSITY;
        hdr_b += bloom_b;
        hdr_h += bloom_h;
        hdr_d += bloom_d;
        hdr_f += bloom_f;
    }
    let b = prep_agx(hdr_b);
    let h = prep_agx(hdr_h);
    let d = prep_agx(hdr_d);
    let f = prep_agx(hdr_f);
    let sharpened = clamp(rcas(b, d, e_agx, f, h, tonemap_u.rcas_sharpness), vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0));
    return vec4<f32>(apply_film_optics(sharpened, in.uv), 1.0);
}
// Display-referred RCAS-only pass: input is already tonemapped LDR.
// Adds grain+vignette after RCAS so Sharp AA path also gets film optics.
@fragment
fn fs_present_rcas(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let texel = 1.0 / max(tonemap_u.output_size, vec2<f32>(1.0));
    let e_raw = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv).rgb;
    let e = apply_film_optics(e_raw, in.uv);

    if (tonemap_u.sharpen_enabled == 0u) {
        return vec4<f32>(e, 1.0);
    }

    let b_raw = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, -texel.y)).rgb;
    let h_raw = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, texel.y)).rgb;
    let d_raw = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-texel.x, 0.0)).rgb;
    let f_raw = textureSample(t_hdr, s_hdr, in.uv + vec2<f32>(texel.x, 0.0)).rgb;
    let b = apply_film_optics(b_raw, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, -texel.y));
    let h = apply_film_optics(h_raw, in.uv + vec2<f32>(0.0, texel.y));
    let d = apply_film_optics(d_raw, in.uv + vec2<f32>(-texel.x, 0.0));
    let f = apply_film_optics(f_raw, in.uv + vec2<f32>(texel.x, 0.0));
    return vec4<f32>(
        clamp(rcas(b, d, e, f, h, tonemap_u.rcas_sharpness), vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0)),
        1.0,
    );
}
```

### `shaders/velocity.wgsl` | **Строк:** 54

```wgsl

struct VelocityUniform {
    inv_curr_vp : mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_vp     : mat4x4<f32>,
    screen_size : vec2<f32>,
    jitter_uv   : vec2<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_depth  : texture_depth_2d;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> vel_u : VelocityUniform;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos : vec4<f32>,
    @location(0)       uv       : vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var out: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    out.uv       = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    out.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let px    = vec2<i32>(i32(in.clip_pos.x), i32(in.clip_pos.y));
    let depth = textureLoad(t_depth, px, 0);

    // Sky/background: write the same jitter-induced UV delta as static geometry
    // so TAA's `vel - jitter_uv` cancels to 0. Returning 0 here made silhouettes
    // mix object (≈jitter) with sky (0) and crawl after the jitter subtract.
    if (depth >= 0.9999) {
        return vec4<f32>(vel_u.jitter_uv, depth, 1.0);
    }

    let ndc_x = in.uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let ndc_y = 1.0 - 2.0 * in.uv.y;

    let ndc_h    = vec4<f32>(ndc_x, ndc_y, depth, 1.0);
    let world_h  = vel_u.inv_curr_vp * ndc_h;
    let world_pos = world_h.xyz / world_h.w;

    let prev_clip = vel_u.prev_vp * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0);
    let prev_ndc  = prev_clip.xy / prev_clip.w;
    let prev_uv = vec2<f32>(prev_ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5,
                             0.5 - prev_ndc.y * 0.5);

    let vel = in.uv - prev_uv;
    return vec4<f32>(vel, depth, 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/vertex_compressed.wgsl` | **Строк:** 40

```wgsl
// Shared compressed-vertex decode (included before pass shaders).

struct CompressedVertIn {
    @location(0) pos_q: vec4<f32>,
    @location(1) normal_oct: vec2<f32>,
    @location(2) tangent_oct: vec2<f32>,
    @location(3) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

fn oct_decode(o: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    // VertexFormat::Snorm8x2 already expands to [-1, 1] in the VS input.
    var n = vec3<f32>(o.x, 1.0 - abs(o.x) - abs(o.y), o.y);
    let t = max(-n.y, 0.0);
    n.x += select(-t, t, o.x >= 0.0);
    n.z += select(-t, t, o.y >= 0.0);
    return normalize(n);
}

fn decode_local_position(pos_q: vec4<f32>, bounds_min: vec3<f32>, bounds_extent: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let t = pos_q.xyz * 0.5 + 0.5;
    return bounds_min + t * bounds_extent;
}

fn decode_tangent_sign(pos_q: vec4<f32>) -> f32 {
    return select(-1.0, 1.0, pos_q.w >= 0.0);
}

fn decode_compressed_attributes(
    in: CompressedVertIn,
    bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec3<f32>,
) -> vec4<f32> {
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, bounds_min, bounds_extent);
    let normal = oct_decode(in.normal_oct);
    let tangent = oct_decode(in.tangent_oct);
    let sign = decode_tangent_sign(in.pos_q);
    // Pack sign into tangent.w for downstream bitangent reconstruction.
    return vec4<f32>(local_pos, sign);
}
```

### `shaders/vg.wgsl` | **Строк:** 60

```wgsl
// ── Shared structures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct CameraUniform {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

struct VGInstance {
    transform: mat4x4<f32>,
    meshlet_offset: u32,
    meshlet_count: u32,
    flags: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

// ── Bindings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: CameraUniform;

@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> vg_instances: array<VGInstance>;

struct VertOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos:    vec4<f32>,
    @location(0)       world_pos:   vec3<f32>,
    @location(1)       world_norm:  vec3<f32>,
    @location(2)       uv:          vec2<f32>,
};

// ── Vertex shader ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@vertex
fn vs_main(
    in: CompressedVertIn,
    @builtin(instance_index) inst_idx: u32,
) -> VertOut {
    let inst = vg_instances[inst_idx];
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, inst.bounds_min.xyz, inst.bounds_extent.xyz);
    let world_pos  = inst.transform * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    let world_norm = normalize((inst.transform * vec4<f32>(oct_decode(in.normal_oct), 0.0)).xyz);

    var out: VertOut;
    out.clip_pos   = camera.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.world_pos  = world_pos.xyz;
    out.world_norm = world_norm;
    out.uv         = in.uv;
    return out;
}

// ── Fragment shader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let n_col = in.world_norm * 0.5 + vec3<f32>(0.5);
    let tint = vec3<f32>(0.2, 0.85, 0.9);
    let colour = mix(n_col, tint, 0.35);
    return vec4<f32>(colour, 1.0);
}
```

### `shaders/vg_cull.wgsl` | **Строк:** 207

```wgsl
// GPU meshlet culling (two-phase).
// Phase 1: frustum + cone + Hi-Z vs previous frame.
// Phase 2: re-test Hi-Z rejects against the freshly built pyramid (same frame).

struct CullParams {
    planes: array<vec4<f32>, 6>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    hiz_size: vec2<f32>,
    hiz_mip_count: u32,
    hiz_enabled: u32,
    cull_mode: u32, // 0 = phase 1, 1 = phase 2
    reject_capacity: u32,
    _pad: vec2<u32>,
};

struct Meshlet {
    vertex_offset: u32,
    vertex_count: u32,
    index_offset: u32,
    index_count: u32,
    sphere_center: vec3<f32>,
    sphere_radius: f32,
    cone_axis: vec3<f32>,
    cone_cutoff: f32,
    lod_error: f32,
    lod_level: u32,
    material_index: u32,
    _pad: u32,
};

struct VGInstance {
    transform: mat4x4<f32>,
    meshlet_offset: u32,
    meshlet_count: u32,
    flags: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

struct DrawIndexedIndirectCmd {
    index_count: u32,
    instance_count: u32,
    first_index: u32,
    base_vertex: i32,
    first_instance: u32,
};

struct RejectRecord {
    inst_idx: u32,
    meshlet_idx: u32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> cull_params: CullParams;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<storage, read> instances: array<VGInstance>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> meshlets: array<Meshlet>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> commands: array<DrawIndexedIndirectCmd>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var<storage, read_write> cmd_count: atomic<u32>;
@group(0) @binding(5) var t_hiz: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(6) var s_hiz: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(7) var<storage, read_write> rejects: array<RejectRecord>;
@group(0) @binding(8) var<storage, read_write> reject_count: atomic<u32>;

fn test_sphere(center: vec3<f32>, radius: f32) -> bool {
    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        let p = cull_params.planes[i];
        let d = dot(p.xyz, center) + p.w;
        if (d < -radius) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

fn max_scale(m: mat4x4<f32>) -> f32 {
    return max(length(m[0].xyz), max(length(m[1].xyz), length(m[2].xyz)));
}

fn hiz_mip_for_rect(rect_size: vec2<f32>, tex_size: vec2<f32>) -> u32 {
    let max_side = max(rect_size.x, rect_size.y);
    let level = ceil(log2(max(max_side, 1.0) / max(tex_size.x, 1.0)));
    return u32(clamp(level, 0.0, f32(cull_params.hiz_mip_count - 1u)));
}

fn test_hiz_occlusion(center: vec3<f32>, radius: f32, view_proj: mat4x4<f32>) -> bool {
    if (cull_params.hiz_enabled == 0u) {
        return true;
    }

    let clip = view_proj * vec4<f32>(center, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 0.0) {
        return false;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    if (abs(ndc.x) > 1.0 + radius || abs(ndc.y) > 1.0 + radius) {
        return false;
    }

    let uv = ndc.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
    let px_radius = radius * cull_params.hiz_size.y * 0.5 / clip.w;
    let rect_min = uv * cull_params.hiz_size - vec2<f32>(px_radius);
    let rect_max = uv * cull_params.hiz_size + vec2<f32>(px_radius);
    let rect_size = max(rect_max - rect_min, vec2<f32>(1.0));
    let mip = hiz_mip_for_rect(rect_size, cull_params.hiz_size);

    var max_hiz = 0.0;
    for (var sy = 0u; sy < 2u; sy++) {
        for (var sx = 0u; sx < 2u; sx++) {
            let su = (f32(sx) + 0.5) / 2.0;
            let sv = (f32(sy) + 0.5) / 2.0;
            let sample_uv = mix(rect_min, rect_max, vec2<f32>(su, sv)) / cull_params.hiz_size;
            max_hiz = max(max_hiz, textureSampleLevel(t_hiz, s_hiz, sample_uv, f32(mip)).x);
        }
    }

    let to_cam = normalize(cull_params.camera_pos.xyz - center);
    let nearest = center + to_cam * radius;
    let nearest_clip = view_proj * vec4<f32>(nearest, 1.0);
    let nearest_ndc_z = nearest_clip.z / nearest_clip.w;
    return nearest_ndc_z <= max_hiz + 0.002;
}

fn emit_draw(inst_idx: u32, meshlet: Meshlet) {
    let cap = arrayLength(&commands);
    let slot = atomicAdd(&cmd_count, 1u);
    if (slot >= cap) {
        return;
    }
    commands[slot].index_count = meshlet.index_count;
    commands[slot].instance_count = 1u;
    commands[slot].first_index = meshlet.index_offset;
    commands[slot].base_vertex = 0;
    commands[slot].first_instance = inst_idx;
}

fn push_reject(inst_idx: u32, meshlet_idx: u32) {
    let cap = cull_params.reject_capacity;
    let slot = atomicAdd(&reject_count, 1u);
    if (slot >= cap) {
        return;
    }
    rejects[slot].inst_idx = inst_idx;
    rejects[slot].meshlet_idx = meshlet_idx;
}

@compute @workgroup_size(64, 1, 1)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    if (cull_params.cull_mode == 1u) {
        let ri = gid.x;
        let n = atomicLoad(&reject_count);
        if (ri >= n) {
            return;
        }
        let rec = rejects[ri];
        let inst = instances[rec.inst_idx];
        let meshlet = meshlets[rec.meshlet_idx];
        let scale = max_scale(inst.transform);
        let wc = (inst.transform * vec4<f32>(meshlet.sphere_center, 1.0)).xyz;
        let wr = meshlet.sphere_radius * scale;
        if (test_hiz_occlusion(wc, wr, cull_params.view_proj)) {
            emit_draw(rec.inst_idx, meshlet);
        }
        return;
    }

    let inst_idx = gid.x;
    if (inst_idx >= arrayLength(&instances)) {
        return;
    }
    let inst = instances[inst_idx];
    if (inst.meshlet_count == 0u) {
        return;
    }

    let selected_lod = inst.flags;
    let scale = max_scale(inst.transform);
    let start = inst.meshlet_offset;
    let end = start + inst.meshlet_count;

    for (var mi = start; mi < end; mi++) {
        let meshlet = meshlets[mi];
        if (meshlet.lod_level != selected_lod) {
            continue;
        }
        let wc = (inst.transform * vec4<f32>(meshlet.sphere_center, 1.0)).xyz;
        let wr = meshlet.sphere_radius * scale;
        if (!test_sphere(wc, wr)) {
            continue;
        }
        let cone_axis = normalize(mat3x3<f32>(
            inst.transform[0].xyz,
            inst.transform[1].xyz,
            inst.transform[2].xyz,
        ) * meshlet.cone_axis);
        let to_cam = normalize(cull_params.camera_pos.xyz - wc);
        if (dot(cone_axis, to_cam) < meshlet.cone_cutoff) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!test_hiz_occlusion(wc, wr, cull_params.view_proj)) {
            push_reject(inst_idx, mi);
            continue;
        }
        emit_draw(inst_idx, meshlet);
    }
}

```

### `shaders/vg_resolve.wgsl` | **Строк:** 946

```wgsl
// ── Virtual Geometry: VISIBILITY BUFFER RESOLVE PASS ─────────────────────
//
// Fullscreen pass that shades the visibility buffer written by vg_vis.wgsl
// with the SAME Cook-Torrance + IBL + clustered-lights + shadow pipeline as
// pbr.wgsl (all of it copied verbatim — WGSL has no includes).
//
// Per pixel:
//   1. RT0 id != SENTINEL? else `discard` (background / occluded pixels keep
//      whatever the earlier passes wrote).
//   2. Reconstruct world position from the hardware depth buffer with
//      camera.inv_proj / camera.inv_view.
//   3. Normal from RT1 (world space), UV from RT2.
//   4. material = materials[meshlets[instances[inst].meshlet_offset]
//         .material_index]   (one material per VG asset — see build_vg_asset)
//      stored in a flat `array<Material>` built by
//      `VgResolvePass::build_material_storage` on the Rust side; layout is
//      byte-identical to the per-object `MaterialUniform` (48 bytes).
//
// MATERIAL TEXTURE LIMITATION: WGSL cannot index bind groups, so per-material
// texture binding is impossible without bindless. The resolve therefore shades
// with MATERIAL-LEVEL parameters only: albedo = base_color, normal = flat,
// metallic/roughness = scalar factors. Texture flags in `Material.flags` are
// intentionally ignored here.
//
// Bindings:
//   group(0) = PBR frame bind group (camera / IBL / shader debug)
//   group(1) = PBR scene bind group (lights / shadows / clusters / VSM)
//   group(2) = this pass' own attachments + VG storage buffers.

struct Camera {
    // Must mirror rust CameraUniform exactly (464 bytes).
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

struct LightUniform {
    dir_color:      vec4<f32>,
    dir_direction:  vec4<f32>,
    ambient:        vec4<f32>,
    shadow_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    point_lights_pos:   array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    point_lights_color: array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    num_point_lights:   u32,
    soft_shadows:       u32,
    point_light_path:   u32,
    vsm_screen_shadows: u32,
};

/// Storage-buffer variant of the forward Material uniform (112 bytes,
/// identical field layout to `material::MaterialUniform`).
struct Material {
    base_color: vec4<f32>,
    emissive:   vec4<f32>,
    metallic:   f32,
    roughness:  f32,
    flags:      u32,
    sheen:      f32,
    layer0_color: vec4<f32>,
    layer0_params: vec4<f32>,
    layer1_color: vec4<f32>,
    layer1_params: vec4<f32>,
};

/// Mirror of `virtual_geometry::meshlet::VGInstanceData` (112 bytes).
struct VGInstance {
    transform: mat4x4<f32>,
    meshlet_offset: u32,
    meshlet_count: u32,
    flags: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

/// Mirror of `virtual_geometry::meshlet::MeshletDescriptor` (64 bytes).
struct MeshletDescriptor {
    vertex_offset: u32,
    vertex_count: u32,
    index_offset: u32,
    index_count: u32,

    sphere_center: vec3<f32>,
    sphere_radius: f32,

    cone_axis: vec3<f32>,
    cone_cutoff: f32,

    lod_error: f32,
    lod_level: u32,
    material_index: u32,
    _pad: u32,
};

// Clustered Forward Rendering structures
struct PointLight {
    position: vec4<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    // Shadow view-projection matrices for point-light cube faces.
    // Face order: PosX, NegX, PosY, NegY, PosZ, NegZ (matches CPU).
    shadow_matrices: array<mat4x4<f32>, 6>,
    intensity: f32,
    radius: f32,
    // First atlas tile of this light's 6-tile run (NO_TILE = 0xFFFFFFFFu when
    // the light casts no shadow or the atlas saturated).
    shadow_tile_base: u32,
    _pad: f32,
};

struct ClusterMetadata {
    offset: u32,
    count: u32,
};

struct ClusterInfo {
    clusters_x: u32,
    clusters_y: u32,
    depth_slices: u32,
    screen_width: u32,
    screen_height: u32,
    near: f32,
    far: f32,
    depth_scale: f32,
    total_clusters: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
    _pad1: u32,
    _pad2: u32,
};

struct ShadowUniform {
    // 4 cascade matrices (4×4 each)
    csm_matrices: array<mat4x4<f32>, 4>,
    // Split depths in view space
    csm_splits: vec4<f32>,
    // Size of the shadow atlas (e.g. 4096.0)
    shadow_atlas_size: f32,
    soft_near: f32,
    soft_far: f32,
    _pad2: u32,
};

struct ShaderDebugUniform {
    debug_viz_mode: u32,
    frame_index: u32,
    ibl_enabled: u32,
    gtao_enabled: u32,
};

// ── group(0): frame / global (mirrors pbr.wgsl group 0) ─────────────────

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> shader_debug: ShaderDebugUniform;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_irradiance: texture_cube<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var t_prefiltered: texture_cube<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var t_brdf_lut: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(5) var s_ibl: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(6) var t_blue_noise: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(7) var s_blue_noise: sampler;

// ── group(1): pass / scene (mirrors pbr.wgsl group 1) ───────────────────

@group(1) @binding(0) var<uniform> light_u: LightUniform;
@group(1) @binding(1) var t_shadow: texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(2) var s_shadow: sampler_comparison;
@group(1) @binding(3) var t_ssao: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(4) var s_ssao: sampler;
@group(1) @binding(5) var<storage, read> point_lights: array<PointLight>;
@group(1) @binding(6) var<storage, read> cluster_metadata: array<ClusterMetadata>;
@group(1) @binding(7) var<storage, read> cluster_light_indices: array<u32>;
@group(1) @binding(8) var<uniform> cluster_info: ClusterInfo;
@group(1) @binding(9) var t_csm: texture_depth_2d_array;
@group(1) @binding(10) var s_csm: sampler_comparison;
@group(1) @binding(11) var t_local_shadow_atlas: texture_depth_2d;
@group(1) @binding(12) var<uniform> shadow_u: ShadowUniform;
@group(1) @binding(13) var t_vsm_pages: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(14) var s_vsm: sampler;
@group(1) @binding(15) var<storage, read> vsm_info: VsmGpuInfo;

struct DdgiGridGpu {
    origin: vec4<f32>,
    spacing: f32,
    dims_x: u32,
    dims_y: u32,
    dims_z: u32,
    enabled: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
    _pad1: u32,
    _pad2: u32,
}
struct DdgiProbeGpu {
    samples: array<vec4<f32>, 8>,
}
struct SdfBrickPageGpu {
    world_min: vec4<f32>,
    world_max: vec4<f32>,
    atlas_origin_res: vec4<f32>,
}
struct SdfSceneGpu {
    atlas_dims: vec4<u32>,
    world_bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    world_bounds_max_texel: vec4<f32>,
    pages: array<SdfBrickPageGpu, 8>,
}
@group(1) @binding(16) var<uniform> ddgi_grid: DdgiGridGpu;
@group(1) @binding(17) var<storage, read> ddgi_probes: array<DdgiProbeGpu>;
@group(1) @binding(18) var<uniform> sdf_scene: SdfSceneGpu;
@group(1) @binding(19) var t_sdf_bricks: texture_3d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(20) var s_sdf_bricks: sampler;
@group(1) @binding(21) var t_vsm_shadow: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(1) @binding(22) var s_vsm_shadow: sampler;

// ── group(2): vis-buffer attachments + VG storage ───────────────────────

@group(2) @binding(0) var t_vis_id:   texture_2d<u32>;        // RT0 r32uint
@group(2) @binding(1) var t_vis_nd:   texture_2d<f32>;        // RT1 rgba16float
@group(2) @binding(2) var t_vis_uv:   texture_2d<f32>;        // RT2 rg16float
@group(2) @binding(3) var t_depth:    texture_depth_2d;       // main depth
@group(2) @binding(4) var<storage, read> vg_instances: array<VGInstance>;
@group(2) @binding(5) var<storage, read> meshlets: array<MeshletDescriptor>;
@group(2) @binding(6) var<storage, read> vg_materials: array<Material>;

/// RT0 clear value written by the vis pass for "no VG geometry".
const SENTINEL: u32 = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

const PI: f32 = 3.14159265359;

fn sanitize_hdr(c: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    if (any(c != c) || any(abs(c) > vec3<f32>(65504.0))) {
        return vec3<f32>(0.0);
    }
    return clamp(c, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(64.0));
}

// ── BRDF helpers (verbatim from pbr.wgsl) ─────────────────────────────────

fn distribution_ggx(n: vec3<f32>, h: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let a = roughness * roughness;
    let a2 = a * a;
    let n_dot_h = max(dot(n, h), 0.0);
    let n_dot_h2 = n_dot_h * n_dot_h;
    let nom = a2;
    let denom = (n_dot_h2 * (a2 - 1.0) + 1.0);
    return nom / (PI * denom * denom);
}

fn geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_v: f32, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let r = (roughness + 1.0);
    let k = (r * r) / 8.0;
    return n_dot_v / (n_dot_v * (1.0 - k) + k);
}

fn geometry_smith(n: vec3<f32>, v: vec3<f32>, l: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 0.0);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
    let ggx2 = geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_v, roughness);
    let ggx1 = geometry_schlick_ggx(n_dot_l, roughness);
    return ggx1 * ggx2;
}

fn fresnel_schlick(cos_theta: f32, f0: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    return f0 + (1.0 - f0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - cos_theta, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
}

fn fresnel_schlick_roughness(cos_theta: f32, f0: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    return f0 + (max(vec3<f32>(1.0 - roughness), f0) - f0) * pow(clamp(1.0 - cos_theta, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0);
}

fn apply_geometric_specular_aa(normal: vec3<f32>, roughness: f32) -> f32 {
    let dndx = dpdx(normal);
    let dndy = dpdy(normal);
    let variance = 0.5 * (dot(dndx, dndx) + dot(dndy, dndy));
    let kernel_roughness = clamp(variance, 0.0, 0.25);
    return sqrt(roughness * roughness + kernel_roughness);
}

// Clustered Forward Rendering helper functions
fn linearize_depth(ndc_depth: f32, near: f32, far: f32) -> f32 {
    let z_ndc = ndc_depth * 2.0 - 1.0; // Convert from [0, 1] to [-1, 1]
    return (2.0 * near * far) / ((far + near) - z_ndc * (far - near));
}

fn get_depth_slice(linear_depth: f32, cluster_info: ClusterInfo) -> u32 {
    let z_norm = log(linear_depth / cluster_info.near) / cluster_info.depth_scale;
    return min(u32(max(z_norm, 0.0)), cluster_info.depth_slices - 1u);
}

fn cube_face_index(dir: vec3<f32>) -> u32 {
    let ad = abs(dir);
    if (ad.x >= ad.y && ad.x >= ad.z) {
        return select(1u, 0u, dir.x >= 0.0); // NegX : PosX
    }
    if (ad.y >= ad.x && ad.y >= ad.z) {
        return select(3u, 2u, dir.y >= 0.0); // NegY : PosY
    }
    return select(5u, 4u, dir.z >= 0.0);     // NegZ : PosZ
}

fn select_face_matrix(mats: array<mat4x4<f32>, 6>, face: u32) -> mat4x4<f32> {
    switch (face) {
        case 0u: { return mats[0]; }
        case 1u: { return mats[1]; }
        case 2u: { return mats[2]; }
        case 3u: { return mats[3]; }
        case 4u: { return mats[4]; }
        default: { return mats[5]; }
    }
}

fn get_point_light_shadow(light: PointLight, world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    if (light.shadow_tile_base == 0xFFFFFFFFu) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let dir = world_pos - light.position.xyz;
    let face = cube_face_index(dir);
    let shadow_matrix = select_face_matrix(light.shadow_matrices, face);

    let bias_world_pos = world_pos + normal * 0.02;
    let clip = shadow_matrix * vec4<f32>(bias_world_pos, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let local_uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);

    if (local_uv.x < 0.0 || local_uv.x > 1.0 || local_uv.y < 0.0 || local_uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let tpa = 16.0;
    let tile_index = light.shadow_tile_base + face;
    let col = f32(tile_index % 16u);
    let row = floor(f32(tile_index) / tpa);
    let inv_tpa = 1.0 / tpa;

    // 5×5 PCF — matches directional `csm_sample` look (monolithic, no grain).
    let texel_atlas = inv_tpa / 512.0; // TILE_PX = 512
    let tile_origin = vec2<f32>(col, row) * inv_tpa;
    var visibility = 0.0;
    for (var y = -2; y <= 2; y = y + 1) {
        for (var x = -2; x <= 2; x = x + 1) {
            var sample_uv = tile_origin + local_uv * inv_tpa
                + vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel_atlas;
            sample_uv = clamp(
                sample_uv,
                tile_origin + texel_atlas,
                tile_origin + inv_tpa - texel_atlas,
            );
            visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
                t_local_shadow_atlas, s_shadow,
                sample_uv,
                ndc.z - 0.002,
            );
        }
    }
    return visibility / 25.0;
}

fn get_cascade_index(view_z: f32) -> u32 {
    var idx: u32 = 3u;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 4u; i = i + 1u) {
        if (view_z < shadow_u.csm_splits[i]) {
            idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    return idx;
}

fn csm_sample(cascade_idx: u32, uv: vec2<f32>, depth: f32) -> f32 {
    var visibility = 0.0;
    let texel_size = 1.0 / shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size;
    for (var y = -2; y <= 2; y = y + 1) {
        for (var x = -2; x <= 2; x = x + 1) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel_size;
            visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
                t_csm, s_csm, uv + offset, i32(cascade_idx), depth,
            );
        }
    }
    return visibility / 25.0;
}

fn linearize_depth01(d: f32) -> f32 {
    let denom = shadow_u.soft_far - d * (shadow_u.soft_far - shadow_u.soft_near);
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-6) { return shadow_u.soft_far; }
    return shadow_u.soft_near * shadow_u.soft_far / denom;
}

fn shadow_sample_dither(clip_xy: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_blue_noise));
    let noise = textureSample(t_blue_noise, s_blue_noise, clip_xy / dims).r;
    return fract(noise + f32(shader_debug.frame_index % 16u) * 0.61803398875);
}

fn pcss_csm(world_pos: vec3<f32>, view_z: f32, normal: vec3<f32>, light_angle: f32, dither: f32) -> f32 {
    let cascade_idx = get_cascade_index(view_z);
    let mat = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx];
    let biased = world_pos + normal * 0.0004;
    let clip = mat * vec4<f32>(biased, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
    if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let texel = 1.0 / shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size;

    var blocker_sum = 0.0;
    var blocker_count = 0.0;
    let search_radius = texel * 4.0;
    let atlas_res = vec2<f32>(shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size);
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let offset = vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * search_radius;
            let coord = vec2<i32>((uv + offset) * atlas_res);
            let d = textureLoad(t_csm, coord, i32(cascade_idx), 0);
            if (d < ndc.z) {
                blocker_sum += d;
                blocker_count += 1.0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (blocker_count < 0.5) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let blocker_ndc = blocker_sum / blocker_count;

    let receiver_d = linearize_depth01(ndc.z);
    let blocker_d = linearize_depth01(blocker_ndc);
    let block_dist = max(receiver_d - blocker_d, 0.0);
    let penumbra_world = (block_dist * light_angle) / max(blocker_d, 1e-3);
    var filter_radius = penumbra_world * shadow_u.shadow_atlas_size * 0.02;
    filter_radius = clamp(filter_radius, texel, texel * 8.0);

    var visibility = 0.0;
    let golden = 2.39996323;
    let rot_angle = dither * 6.28318530718;
    for (var i = 0u; i < 16u; i = i + 1u) {
        let fi = f32(i);
        let angle = fi * golden + rot_angle;
        let r = sqrt(fi / 16.0) * filter_radius;
        let offset = vec2<f32>(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * r;
        visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
            t_csm, s_csm, uv + offset, i32(cascade_idx), ndc.z - 0.001,
        );
    }
    return visibility / 16.0;
}

fn get_csm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, view_z: f32, normal: vec3<f32>, dither: f32) -> f32 {
    let cascade_idx = get_cascade_index(view_z);

    let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
    let n_dot_l = max(dot(normal, l_dir), 0.0);
    let bias = 0.00025 + (1.0 - n_dot_l) * 0.0012;
    let shadow_pos = world_pos + normal * bias;

    let mat = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx];
    let clip = mat * vec4<f32>(shadow_pos, 1.0);
    if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
    let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);

    if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0 || ndc.z > 1.0 || ndc.z < 0.0) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    // VSM-only: never fall through to CSM.
    if (light_u.soft_shadows == 2u) {
        let lk = vsm_lookup(world_pos);
        if (lk.valid > 0.5) {
            return vsm_shadow(world_pos, normal, l_dir);
        }
        return 1.0;
    }
    var shadow: f32;
    if (light_u.soft_shadows == 1u) {
        shadow = pcss_csm(world_pos, view_z, normal, 0.016, dither);
    } else {
        shadow = csm_sample(cascade_idx, uv, ndc.z - 0.0002);
    }

    let idx_usize = i32(cascade_idx);
    if (cascade_idx + 1u < 4u && idx_usize >= 0) {
        let next_split = shadow_u.csm_splits[cascade_idx];
        let prev_split = select(0.0, shadow_u.csm_splits[cascade_idx - 1u], cascade_idx > 0u);
        let band = (next_split - prev_split) * 0.1;
        if (view_z > next_split - band) {
            let mat2 = shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx + 1u];
            let clip2 = mat2 * vec4<f32>(shadow_pos, 1.0);
            let ndc2 = clip2.xyz / clip2.w;
            let uv2 = vec2<f32>(ndc2.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc2.y * 0.5);
            if (!(uv2.x < 0.0 || uv2.x > 1.0 || uv2.y < 0.0 || uv2.y > 1.0 || ndc2.z > 1.0 || ndc2.z < 0.0)) {
                let s2 = csm_sample(cascade_idx + 1u, uv2, ndc2.z - 0.0005);
                let t = (view_z - (next_split - band)) / max(band, 1e-4);
                shadow = mix(shadow, s2, clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0));
            }
        }
    }
    return shadow;
}

// ── VSM_SMRT BLOCK (mirrored verbatim from pbr.wgsl — keep in sync) ──────

const VSM_PAGE_VALID: u32 = 0x80000000u;
const VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK: u32 = 0x3FFFFFFFu;

/// GPU mirror of one clipmap level (`shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmLevelGpu`).
struct VsmLevelGpu {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    world_half_extent: f32,
    page_table_offset: u32,
    pages_per_side: u32,
    texel_world: f32,
}

/// GPU mirror of `shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo`.
struct VsmGpuInfo {
    level_count: u32,
    page_px: u32,
    phys_page_count: u32,
    phys_pages_per_side: u32,
    ray_count: u32,
    samples_per_ray: u32,
    source_angle: f32,
    source_radius: f32,
    max_trace_dist: f32,
    _pad0: vec3<f32>,
    levels: array<VsmLevelGpu, 8>,
    page_tables: array<u32, 2048>,
}

fn vsm_ign(p: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2<f32>(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
}

struct VsmLookup {
    valid: f32,
    layer: i32,
    pixel: vec2<i32>,
    pixel_f: vec2<f32>,
    receiver_z: f32,
    z_world_per_ndc: f32,
    texel_world: f32,
}

fn vsm_lookup(pos: vec3<f32>) -> VsmLookup {
    var out: VsmLookup;
    out.valid = 0.0;
    out.layer = 0;
    out.pixel = vec2<i32>(0);
    out.pixel_f = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    out.receiver_z = 0.0;
    out.z_world_per_ndc = 1.0;
    out.texel_world = 1.0;

    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    for (var lv = 0u; lv < count; lv++) {
        let cm = vsm_info.levels[lv];
        let clip = cm.view_proj * vec4<f32>(pos, 1.0);
        if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) {
            continue;
        }
        let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
        if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }
        if (ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }

        let pps = f32(cm.pages_per_side);
        let page = min(vec2<u32>(uv * pps), vec2<u32>(cm.pages_per_side - 1u));
        let entry =
            vsm_info.page_tables[cm.page_table_offset + page.y * cm.pages_per_side + page.x];
        if ((entry & VSM_PAGE_VALID) == 0u) {
            continue;
        }

        let phys = entry & VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK;
        let page_uv = fract(uv * pps);
        let ppx = f32(vsm_info.page_px);
        let lo = 1.0;
        let hi = ppx - 2.0;
        let pf = lo + clamp(page_uv, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0)) * (hi - lo);

        out.valid = 1.0;
        out.layer = i32(phys);
        out.pixel_f = pf;
        out.pixel = vec2<i32>(i32(pf.x), i32(pf.y));
        out.receiver_z = ndc.z;
        out.z_world_per_ndc = cm.world_half_extent * 4.0;
        out.texel_world = (cm.world_half_extent * 2.0)
            / (pps * f32(vsm_info.page_px));
        return out;
    }
    return out;
}

fn vsm_tap_lit(lk: VsmLookup, pix: vec2<i32>, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let lo = 1;
    let hi = i32(vsm_info.page_px) - 2;
    if (pix.x < lo || pix.y < lo || pix.x > hi || pix.y > hi) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, pix, lk.layer, 0).r;
    if (stored > 0.999) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let occluded = stored < lk.receiver_z - bias_ndc
        && (lk.receiver_z - stored) > min_diff;
    return select(1.0, 0.0, occluded);
}

fn vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let f = lk.pixel_f;
    let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(f.x)), i32(floor(f.y)));
    let a = fract(f);
    let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    return mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y);
}

fn vsm_pcf_lit(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, spread: f32) -> f32 {
    let min_diff = (1.25 * lk.texel_world) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
    if (spread <= 1.5) {
        return vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    }
    if (spread <= 2.5) {
        var acc = vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(-1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, -1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        return acc / 5.0;
    }
    let sp = max(spread, 1.0);
    var acc = 0.0;
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            let w = f32(2 - abs(dx)) * f32(2 - abs(dy));
            let pf = lk.pixel_f + vec2<f32>(f32(dx), f32(dy)) * sp;
            let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(pf.x)), i32(floor(pf.y)));
            let a = fract(pf);
            let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            acc += mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y) * w;
            wsum += w;
        }
    }
    return acc / max(wsum, 1.0);
}

fn vsm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    if (count == 0u) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let f = normalize(light_dir);
    let up = select(vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), abs(f.y) < 0.99);
    let tangent = normalize(cross(up, f));
    let bitangent = cross(f, tangent);

    let ray_count = clamp(vsm_info.ray_count, 1u, 16u);
    let samples_per_ray = clamp(vsm_info.samples_per_ray, 1u, 16u);
    let tan_source = tan(max(vsm_info.source_angle, 1e-5));

    let jitter = vsm_ign(world_pos.xy + world_pos.zz * 7.31);

    let lk0 = vsm_lookup(world_pos);
    var origin = world_pos;
    if (lk0.valid > 0.5) {
        // Stronger receiver offset on surfaces facing the light (flat-top acne).
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
        let push = lk0.texel_world * mix(0.25, 0.85, n_dot_l);
        origin = world_pos + normalize(normal) * push;
    }

    var sum = 0.0;

    for (var r = 0u; r < ray_count; r++) {
        let u1 = (f32(r) + 0.5 + jitter * 0.5) / f32(ray_count);
        let theta = fract(u1 * 2.39996323 + jitter) * 6.28318530718;
        let radius = tan_source * sqrt(u1);
        let dir = normalize(
            f + (tangent * cos(theta) + bitangent * sin(theta)) * radius,
        );

        var transmittance = 1.0;
        for (var s = 1u; s <= samples_per_ray; s++) {
            if (transmittance < 0.01) {
                break;
            }
            let u = f32(s) / f32(samples_per_ray);
            // Quartic keeps sample 1 at ~1 texel so the umbra attaches to the
            // caster base. Quadratic+min-frac 0.03 started ~20 cm out.
            let dist = max(vsm_info.max_trace_dist * u * u * u * u, lk0.texel_world * 1.5);
            let sp = origin + dir * dist;

            let lk = vsm_lookup(sp);
            if (lk.valid < 0.5) {
                break;
            }

            let slope = sqrt(max(1.0 - abs(dot(normal, f)), 0.0));
            let contact = clamp(1.0 - dist / max(lk.texel_world * 16.0, 1e-4), 0.0, 1.0);
            // Extra bias for near-perpendicular receivers (flat faces → zebra acne).
            let face_on = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
            let bias_ndc = lk.texel_world * (0.35 + 0.55 * slope + 0.9 * face_on)
                * mix(1.0, 0.45, contact) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
            let spread = clamp(dist * tan_source / max(lk.texel_world, 1e-4), 1.0, 4.0);

            let lit = vsm_pcf_lit(lk, bias_ndc, spread);
            let occ = 1.0 - lit;
            if (occ > 0.01) {
                let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, lk.pixel, lk.layer, 0).r;
                let depth_diff = max((lk.receiver_z - stored) * lk.z_world_per_ndc, 0.0);
                let penumbra = max(vsm_info.source_angle * dist, lk.texel_world);
                let soft = clamp(1.0 - depth_diff / penumbra, 0.0, 1.0);
                transmittance *= mix(1.0, soft, occ);
            }
        }
        sum += transmittance;
    }
    return clamp(sum / f32(ray_count), 0.0, 1.0);
}

// ── End VSM block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Fullscreen triangle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct FsInput {
    @builtin(position) fb_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> FsInput {
    // Triangle covering the viewport: (-1,-1) (3,-1) (-1,3).
    var p = vec2<f32>(
        f32((vi << 1u) & 2u),
        f32(vi & 2u),
    ) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    var out: FsInput;
    out.fb_pos = vec4<f32>(p, 0.0, 1.0);
    return out;
}

// ── Resolve fragment ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: FsInput) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    let dims = vec2<i32>(textureDimensions(t_vis_id));
    let px = vec2<i32>(in.fb_pos.xy);

    // UV in sampling space (v=0 at bottom), matching how the forward pass
    // samples SSAO/IBL textures.
    let uv01 = vec2<f32>(in.fb_pos.xy) / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_depth));
    let sample_uv = vec2<f32>(uv01.x, 1.0 - uv01.y);

    let id = textureLoad(t_vis_id, px, 0).r;
    let depth_raw = textureLoad(t_depth, px, 0);

    if (id == SENTINEL || depth_raw >= 1.0) {
        discard; // background or never-rasterized pixel: keep prior color
    }

    let inst_idx = id >> 16u;
    if (inst_idx >= arrayLength(&vg_instances)) {
        discard; // defensive: stale ID buffer vs shrunk instance list
    }
    let inst = vg_instances[inst_idx];

    // One material per asset ⇒ every meshlet of the instance shares it.
    if (inst.meshlet_offset >= arrayLength(&meshlets)) {
        discard;
    }
    let m_idx = meshlets[inst.meshlet_offset].material_index;

    // Fallback material for out-of-range indices instead of nuking pixels.
    var mat: Material;
    mat.base_color = vec4<f32>(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.0);
    mat.emissive = vec4<f32>(0.0);
    mat.metallic = 0.0;
    mat.roughness = 1.0;
    mat.flags = 0u;
    if (m_idx < arrayLength(&vg_materials)) {
        mat = vg_materials[m_idx];
    }

    // Material-level shading only (see header note): no texture branches.
    let albedo = mat.base_color.rgb;
    var n = normalize(textureLoad(t_vis_nd, px, 0).xyz);

    var metallic = mat.metallic;
    var roughness = clamp(mat.roughness, 0.05, 1.0);
    let spec_roughness = apply_geometric_specular_aa(n, roughness);

    // ── World-position reconstruction ────────────────────────────────────
    let ndc = vec3<f32>(uv01.x * 2.0 - 1.0, (1.0 - uv01.y) * 2.0 - 1.0, depth_raw);
    let view_pos = camera.inv_proj * vec4<f32>(ndc, 1.0);
    if (abs(view_pos.w) < 1.0e-8) {
        return vec4<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, mat.base_color.a);
    }
    let world_pos = (camera.inv_view * vec4<f32>(view_pos.xyz / view_pos.w, 1.0)).xyz;

    let v = normalize(camera.camera_pos.xyz - world_pos);
    let n_dot_v = max(dot(n, v), 0.0001);
    let f0 = mix(vec3<f32>(0.04), albedo, metallic);

    // --- DEBUG VISUALIZATION OVERLAY (parity with forward pass) ---
    if (shader_debug.debug_viz_mode == 1u) {
        let cluster_x = u32(in.fb_pos.x / 16.0);
        let cluster_y = u32(in.fb_pos.y / 16.0);
        let view_pos_dbg = camera.view * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0);
        let view_z_dbg = max(-view_pos_dbg.z, cluster_info.near);
        let cluster_z = get_depth_slice(view_z_dbg, cluster_info);
        let cluster_idx_flat = cluster_x + cluster_y * cluster_info.clusters_x + cluster_z * cluster_info.clusters_x * cluster_info.clusters_y;
        let color_val = f32(cluster_idx_flat % 128u) / 127.0;
        return vec4<f32>(color_val, color_val * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
    } else if (shader_debug.debug_viz_mode == 2u) {
        let view_z = -(camera.view * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0)).z;
        let s = get_csm_shadow(world_pos, view_z, n, shadow_sample_dither(in.fb_pos.xy));
        return vec4<f32>(s, s, s, 1.0);
    }

    var shadow = 1.0;
    var lo = vec3<f32>(0.0);

    // --- Directional Light ---
    {
        let l = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);
        let vl = v + l;
        let vl_sq = dot(vl, vl);
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
        let view_z = -(camera.view * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0)).z;
        shadow = get_csm_shadow(world_pos, view_z, n, shadow_sample_dither(in.fb_pos.xy));
        if (vl_sq >= 1.0e-8 && n_dot_l > 0.0) {
            let h = vl * inverseSqrt(vl_sq);
            let ndf = distribution_ggx(n, h, spec_roughness);
            let g = geometry_smith(n, v, l, spec_roughness);
            let f = fresnel_schlick(max(dot(h, v), 0.0), f0);
            let specular = (ndf * g * f) / (4.0 * n_dot_v * n_dot_l + 0.0001);
            let radiance = light_u.dir_color.rgb * light_u.dir_color.w;
            let ks = f;
            let kd = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - ks) * (1.0 - metallic);
            lo += (kd * albedo / PI + specular) * radiance * n_dot_l * shadow;
        }
    }

    // --- Point Lights (Clustered Forward Rendering) ---
    let cluster_x = u32(in.fb_pos.x / 16.0);
    let cluster_y = u32(in.fb_pos.y / 16.0);

    let view_pos_cluster = camera.view * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0);
    let view_z_cluster = max(-view_pos_cluster.z, cluster_info.near);
    let cluster_z = get_depth_slice(view_z_cluster, cluster_info);

    if (cluster_x < cluster_info.clusters_x && cluster_y < cluster_info.clusters_y && cluster_z < cluster_info.depth_slices) {
        let cluster_idx = cluster_x + cluster_y * cluster_info.clusters_x + cluster_z * cluster_info.clusters_x * cluster_info.clusters_y;

        let cluster_meta = cluster_metadata[cluster_idx];
        let light_count = arrayLength(&point_lights);
        let index_count = arrayLength(&cluster_light_indices);
        let n_cluster = min(cluster_meta.count, 256u);

        for (var i = 0u; i < n_cluster; i = i + 1u) {
            let idx_pos = cluster_meta.offset + i;
            if (idx_pos >= index_count) { break; }
            let light_idx = cluster_light_indices[idx_pos];
            if (light_idx >= light_count) { continue; }
            let light = point_lights[light_idx];

            let p_pos = light.position.xyz;
            let p_color = light.color.rgb;
            let p_intensity = light.intensity;
            let p_radius = light.radius;

            let l = normalize(p_pos - world_pos);
            let vl = v + l;
            let vl_sq = dot(vl, vl);
            let dist = length(p_pos - world_pos);

            let attenuation = 1.0 / (dist * dist + 1.0) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, p_radius, dist));
            let radiance = p_color * p_intensity;

            let p_shadow = get_point_light_shadow(light, world_pos, n);
            let n_dot_l = max(dot(n, l), 0.0);
            if (vl_sq >= 1.0e-8 && n_dot_l > 0.0) {
                let h = vl * inverseSqrt(vl_sq);
                let ndf = distribution_ggx(n, h, roughness);
                let g = geometry_smith(n, v, l, roughness);
                let f = fresnel_schlick(max(dot(h, v), 0.0), f0);

                let numerator = ndf * g * f;
                let denominator = 4.0 * n_dot_v * n_dot_l + 0.0001;
                let specular = numerator / denominator;
                let ks = f;
                let kd = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - ks) * (1.0 - metallic);

                lo += (kd * albedo / PI + specular) * radiance * n_dot_l * attenuation * p_shadow;
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Ambient IBL ---
    let kS_ibl = fresnel_schlick_roughness(n_dot_v, f0, spec_roughness);
    let kD_ibl = (vec3<f32>(1.0) - kS_ibl) * (1.0 - metallic);

    var irradiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var prefiltered_color = vec3<f32>(0.0);
    var env_brdf = vec2<f32>(0.0, 0.0);
    let r = reflect(-v, n);
    if (shader_debug.ibl_enabled != 0u) {
        irradiance = textureSample(t_irradiance, s_ibl, n).rgb;
        prefiltered_color = textureSampleLevel(t_prefiltered, s_ibl, r, spec_roughness * 4.0).rgb;
        env_brdf = textureSample(t_brdf_lut, s_ibl, vec2<f32>(n_dot_v, spec_roughness)).rg;
    }
    let diffuse_ibl = irradiance * albedo;
    let specular_ibl = prefiltered_color * (kS_ibl * env_brdf.x + env_brdf.y);

    let ao = textureSample(t_ssao, s_ssao, sample_uv).r;

    let ambient_factor = light_u.ambient.w;

    let ambient = (kD_ibl * diffuse_ibl + specular_ibl) * ambient_factor * ao + light_u.ambient.xyz * albedo * ao;
    let color = ambient + lo + mat.emissive.rgb;
    return vec4<f32>(sanitize_hdr(color), mat.base_color.a);
}

```

```wgsl
// Depth-only VG shadow pass — meshlet indirect draws with per-instance transforms.

struct ShadowMatrix {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};
@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> shadow: ShadowMatrix;

struct VGInstance {
    transform: mat4x4<f32>,
    meshlet_offset: u32,
    meshlet_count: u32,
    flags: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> vg_instances: array<VGInstance>;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(in: CompressedVertIn, @builtin(instance_index) inst_idx: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let inst = vg_instances[inst_idx];
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, inst.bounds_min.xyz, inst.bounds_extent.xyz);
    let world_pos = inst.transform * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    out.clip_pos = shadow.view_proj * world_pos;
    return out;
}
```

### `shaders/vg_vis.wgsl` | **Строк:** 105

```wgsl
// ── Virtual Geometry: VISIBILITY BUFFER PASS ─────────────────────────────
//
// Rasterizes VG meshlets into three attachments that the deferred resolve
// pass (vg_resolve.wgsl) shades with the full PBR lighting stack:
//
//   RT0  r32uint   bitfield  = (instance_index << 16) | triangle_id
//                  triangle_id = @builtin(primitive_index) < 124 (meshlet
//                  triangle cap), instance_index < 4096 (MAX_VG_INSTANCES).
//                  Cleared to 0xFFFFFFFF (SENTINEL) = "no VG geometry".
//   RT1  rgba16float = world-space normal.xyz + NDC depth (w)
//   RT2  rg16float   = interpolated mesh UV
//
// NOTE ON THE ID PACKING: the draw commands produced by the CPU culling
// pass carry `first_instance = instance_index`, and `@builtin(instance_index)`
// starts at `firstInstance` — so the instance index is the only per-draw
// value that reaches this shader. Every meshlet of an asset shares one
// `material_index` (see `build_vg_asset`), so the resolve pass only needs
// the instance to recover the material: `meshlets[instances[i].meshlet_offset]`.
//
// Bindings:
//   group(0) = the PBR global bind group (only `camera` is read here;
//              unused entries in the layout are fine).
//   group(1) = VG per-instance storage (`VGInstanceData`), binding 0.

struct Camera {
    // Must mirror rust CameraUniform exactly (464 bytes).
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

/// Mirror of `virtual_geometry::meshlet::VGInstanceData` (80 bytes).
struct VGInstance {
    transform: mat4x4<f32>,
    meshlet_offset: u32,
    meshlet_count: u32,
    flags: u32,
    _pad: u32,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> vg_instances: array<VGInstance>;

/// RT0 value written for background pixels (also the clear value used by
/// the CPU when creating RT0).
const SENTINEL: u32 = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    /// Global VG instance index (flat — constant across the primitive).
    @location(0) @interpolate(flat) instance_id: u32,
    /// World-space normal (interpolated).
    @location(1) world_normal: vec3<f32>,
    /// Mesh UV (interpolated).
    @location(2) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(in: CompressedVertIn, @builtin(instance_index) inst_idx: u32) -> VertexOutput {
    let inst = vg_instances[inst_idx];

    var out: VertexOutput;
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(in.pos_q, inst.bounds_min.xyz, inst.bounds_extent.xyz);
    let world_pos = inst.transform * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    out.clip_pos = camera.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.world_normal = normalize(mat3x3<f32>(
        inst.transform[0].xyz,
        inst.transform[1].xyz,
        inst.transform[2].xyz,
    ) * oct_decode(in.normal_oct));
    out.uv = in.uv;
    out.instance_id = inst_idx;
    return out;
}

struct FragmentOutput {
    @location(0) vis_id:     u32,
    @location(1) normal_depth: vec4<f32>,
    @location(2) uv:         vec2<f32>,
};

@fragment
fn fs_main(
    in: VertexOutput,
    @builtin(primitive_index) primitive_idx: u32,
) -> FragmentOutput {
    var out: FragmentOutput;

    // Triangle ids fit 16 bits (meshlet cap = 124 triangles); instance ids
    // fit the upper 16 bits (MAX_VG_INSTANCES = 4096).
    out.vis_id = (in.instance_id << 16u) | (primitive_idx & 0xFFFFu);

    // NDC depth from the hardware-interpolated clip position.
    out.normal_depth = vec4<f32>(in.world_normal, in.clip_pos.z);

    out.uv = in.uv;
    return out;
}
```
