```wgsl
struct Model {
    model: mat4x4<f32>,
    normal_matrix: mat3x3<f32>,
    color: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_min: vec4<f32>,
    bounds_extent: vec4<f32>,
};

struct PageDrawInfo {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    atlas_offset_x: f32,
    atlas_offset_y: f32,
    page_size_px: f32,
    atlas_size_px: f32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read> models: array<Model>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> page_info: PageDrawInfo;

struct VertexOutput {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) depth: f32,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(
    @location(0) pos_q: vec4<f32>,
    @builtin(instance_index) instance_idx: u32,
) -> VertexOutput {
    var out: VertexOutput;
    let mdl = models[instance_idx];
    let local_pos = decode_local_position(pos_q, mdl.bounds_min.xyz, mdl.bounds_extent.xyz);
    let world_pos = mdl.model * vec4<f32>(local_pos, 1.0);
    out.clip_pos = page_info.view_proj * world_pos;
    out.depth = out.clip_pos.z / out.clip_pos.w;
    return out;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VertexOutput) -> @location(0) f32 {
    return in.depth;
}

### `shaders/vsm_shadow_temporal.wgsl` | **Строк:** 107

```wgsl
// Temporal accumulation for 1-spp VSM shadow trace.

struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

struct VsmTemporalUniform {
    blend_alpha: f32,
    reset: u32,
    _pad: vec2<f32>,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_raw: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var t_history: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(2) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(0) @binding(4) var s_linear: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(5) var<uniform> vsm_temp: VsmTemporalUniform;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var o: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    o.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    o.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
}

fn view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let view_z = max(linear_depth * FAR, 1e-4);
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0);
    let inv_m00 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[0][0], 1e-6);
    let inv_m11 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[1][1], 1e-6);
    return vec3<f32>(ndc.x * inv_m00 * view_z, ndc.y * inv_m11 * view_z, -view_z);
}

fn world_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    return (camera.inv_view * vec4<f32>(view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv, linear_depth), 1.0)).xyz;
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) f32 {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let px = vec2<i32>(clamp(in.uv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
    let nd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, px, 0);
    let curr = textureSample(t_raw, s_linear, in.uv).r;

    if (nd.a >= 0.999 || nd.a <= 1e-5 || vsm_temp.reset != 0u) {
        return curr;
    }

    let world_pos = world_pos_from_uv_depth(in.uv, nd.a);
    let prev_clip = camera.prev_view_proj * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0);
    if (prev_clip.w <= 1e-4) {
        return curr;
    }
    let prev_ndc = prev_clip.xy / prev_clip.w;
    let prev_uv = vec2<f32>(prev_ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - prev_ndc.y * 0.5);
    if (prev_uv.x < 0.0 || prev_uv.x > 1.0 || prev_uv.y < 0.0 || prev_uv.y > 1.0) {
        return curr;
    }

    // Depth disocclusion — reject stale history on motion / new geometry.
    // World-space threshold scaled with depth to keep far-field stable.
    let prev_px = vec2<i32>(clamp(prev_uv * dims, vec2<f32>(0.0), dims - 1.0));
    let prev_nd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, prev_px, 0);
    let depth_diff = abs(nd.a - prev_nd.a) * FAR;
    let depth_thresh = 0.15 + nd.a * 0.30;
    if (depth_diff > depth_thresh) {
        return curr;
    }

    let hist = textureSample(t_history, s_linear, prev_uv).r;

    // Neighborhood AABB clamp on history (reduces smear trails).
    // Variance clamp (mean ± 1.25 sigma) would be more permissive on edges
    // but AABB is sufficient for binary R16Float visibility.
    let texel = 1.0 / dims;
    var min_s = curr;
    var max_s = curr;
    for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++) {
            let s = textureSample(t_raw, s_linear, in.uv + vec2<f32>(f32(x), f32(y)) * texel).r;
            min_s = min(min_s, s);
            max_s = max(max_s, s);
        }
    }
    let clamped_hist = clamp(hist, min_s, max_s);

    let alpha = clamp(vsm_temp.blend_alpha, 0.05, 0.20);
    return mix(clamped_hist, curr, alpha);
}

### `shaders/vsm_shadow_trace.wgsl` | **Строк:** 239

```wgsl
// Screen-space VSM SMRT: 1 Vogel ray / pixel (temporal pass accumulates).

struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
    view: mat4x4<f32>,
    proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_view: mat4x4<f32>,
    inv_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    prev_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
};

struct LightUniform {
    dir_color: vec4<f32>,
    dir_direction: vec4<f32>,
    ambient: vec4<f32>,
    shadow_view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    point_lights_pos: array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    point_lights_color: array<vec4<f32>, 128>,
    num_point_lights: u32,
    soft_shadows: u32,
    point_light_path: u32,
    vsm_screen_shadows: u32,
};

struct VsmPassUniform {
    frame_index: u32,
    _pad0: u32,
    _pad1: u32,
    _pad2: u32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_normal_depth: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> camera: Camera;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> light_u: LightUniform;
@group(0) @binding(3) var t_vsm_pages: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(4) var s_vsm: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(5) var<storage, read> vsm_info: VsmGpuInfo;
@group(0) @binding(6) var t_blue_noise: texture_2d<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(7) var s_blue_noise: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(8) var<uniform> vsm_pass: VsmPassUniform;

const FAR: f32 = 1000.0;
const VSM_PAGE_VALID: u32 = 0x80000000u;
const VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK: u32 = 0x3FFFFFFFu;
const GOLDEN: f32 = 0.61803398875;

struct VsmLevelGpu {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    world_half_extent: f32,
    page_table_offset: u32,
    pages_per_side: u32,
    texel_world: f32,
}

struct VsmGpuInfo {
    level_count: u32,
    page_px: u32,
    phys_page_count: u32,
    phys_pages_per_side: u32,
    ray_count: u32,
    samples_per_ray: u32,
    source_angle: f32,
    source_radius: f32,
    max_trace_dist: f32,
    _pad0: vec3<f32>,
    levels: array<VsmLevelGpu, 8>,
    page_tables: array<u32, 2048>,
}

struct VsmLookup {
    valid: f32,
    layer: i32,
    pixel: vec2<i32>,
    pixel_f: vec2<f32>,
    receiver_z: f32,
    z_world_per_ndc: f32,
    texel_world: f32,
};

struct VsOut {
    @builtin(position) clip_pos: vec4<f32>,
    @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
};

@vertex
fn vs_main(@builtin(vertex_index) vi: u32) -> VsOut {
    var o: VsOut;
    let x = f32(i32(vi) / 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    let y = f32(i32(vi) % 2) * 4.0 - 1.0;
    o.uv = vec2<f32>(x * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0 - (y * 0.5 + 0.5));
    o.clip_pos = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
    return o;
}

fn view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let view_z = max(linear_depth * FAR, 1e-4);
    let ndc = vec2<f32>(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0);
    let inv_m00 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[0][0], 1e-6);
    let inv_m11 = 1.0 / max(camera.proj[1][1], 1e-6);
    return vec3<f32>(ndc.x * inv_m00 * view_z, ndc.y * inv_m11 * view_z, -view_z);
}

fn world_pos_from_uv_depth(uv: vec2<f32>, linear_depth: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
    let vp = view_pos_from_uv_depth(uv, linear_depth);
    return (camera.inv_view * vec4<f32>(vp, 1.0)).xyz;
}

fn vogel(i: u32, n: u32, phi: f32) -> vec2<f32> {
    let k = f32(i) + 0.5;
    let r = sqrt(k / f32(n));
    let t = k * 2.39996323 + phi;
    return vec2<f32>(cos(t), sin(t)) * r;
}

fn vsm_lookup(pos: vec3<f32>) -> VsmLookup {
    var out: VsmLookup;
    out.valid = 0.0;
    out.layer = 0;
    out.pixel = vec2<i32>(0);
    out.pixel_f = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    out.receiver_z = 0.0;
    out.z_world_per_ndc = 1.0;
    out.texel_world = 1.0;
    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    for (var lv = 0u; lv < count; lv++) {
        let cm = vsm_info.levels[lv];
        let clip = cm.view_proj * vec4<f32>(pos, 1.0);
        if (clip.w <= 1.0e-4) { continue; }
        let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
        if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0) { continue; }
        if (ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) { continue; }
        let pps = f32(cm.pages_per_side);
        let page = min(vec2<u32>(uv * pps), vec2<u32>(cm.pages_per_side - 1u));
        let entry = vsm_info.page_tables[cm.page_table_offset + page.y * cm.pages_per_side + page.x];
        if ((entry & VSM_PAGE_VALID) == 0u) { continue; }
        let phys = entry & VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK;
        let page_uv = fract(uv * pps);
        let ppx = f32(vsm_info.page_px);
        let pf = 1.0 + clamp(page_uv, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0)) * (ppx - 3.0);
        out.valid = 1.0;
        out.layer = i32(phys);
        out.pixel_f = pf;
        out.pixel = vec2<i32>(i32(pf.x), i32(pf.y));
        out.receiver_z = ndc.z;
        out.z_world_per_ndc = cm.world_half_extent * 4.0;
        out.texel_world = (cm.world_half_extent * 2.0) / (pps * ppx);
        return out;
    }
    return out;
}

fn vsm_tap_lit(lk: VsmLookup, pix: vec2<i32>, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let lo = 1;
    let hi = i32(vsm_info.page_px) - 2;
    if (pix.x < lo || pix.y < lo || pix.x > hi || pix.y > hi) { return 1.0; }
    let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, pix, lk.layer, 0).r;
    if (stored > 0.999) { return 1.0; }
    let occluded = stored < lk.receiver_z - bias_ndc && (lk.receiver_z - stored) > min_diff;
    return select(1.0, 0.0, occluded);
}

fn vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(lk.pixel_f.x)), i32(floor(lk.pixel_f.y)));
    let a = fract(lk.pixel_f);
    let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    return mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y);
}

fn vsm_trace_1ray(world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>, phi: f32) -> f32 {
    // Returns 1.0 (lit) when clipmap has no resident page — VSM-only policy:
    // outer regions are lit; SDF contact provides near shadowing.
    let f = normalize(light_dir);
    let lk0 = vsm_lookup(world_pos);
    if (lk0.valid < 0.5) { return 1.0; }
    let up = select(vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), abs(f.y) < 0.99);
    let tangent = normalize(cross(up, f));
    let bitangent = cross(f, tangent);
    let tan_source = tan(max(vsm_info.source_angle, 1e-5));
    let vog = vogel(0u, 1u, phi);
    let radius = tan_source * length(vog);
    let dir = normalize(f + tangent * vog.x * radius + bitangent * vog.y * radius);

    let n_dot_l = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
    let origin = world_pos + normalize(normal) * (lk0.texel_world * mix(0.25, 0.85, n_dot_l));
    let samples = clamp(vsm_info.samples_per_ray, 1u, 8u);
    var transmittance = 1.0;

    for (var s = 1u; s <= samples; s++) {
        if (transmittance < 0.01) { break; }
        let u = f32(s) / f32(samples);
        let dist = max(vsm_info.max_trace_dist * u * u * u * u, lk0.texel_world * 1.5);
        let sp = origin + dir * dist;
        let lk = vsm_lookup(sp);
        if (lk.valid < 0.5) { break; }
        let slope = sqrt(max(1.0 - abs(dot(normal, f)), 0.0));
        let contact = clamp(1.0 - dist / max(lk.texel_world * 16.0, 1e-4), 0.0, 1.0);
        let face_on = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
        let bias_ndc = lk.texel_world * (0.35 + 0.55 * slope + 0.9 * face_on)
            * mix(1.0, 0.45, contact) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
        let spread = clamp(dist * tan_source / max(lk.texel_world, 1e-4), 1.0, 4.0);
        let lit = vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, (1.25 * lk.texel_world) / lk.z_world_per_ndc);
        let occ = 1.0 - lit;
        if (occ > 0.01) {
            let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, lk.pixel, lk.layer, 0).r;
            let depth_diff = max((lk.receiver_z - stored) * lk.z_world_per_ndc, 0.0);
            let penumbra = max(vsm_info.source_angle * dist, lk.texel_world);
            let soft = clamp(1.0 - depth_diff / penumbra, 0.0, 1.0);
            transmittance *= mix(1.0, soft, occ);
        }
    }
    return clamp(transmittance, 0.0, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fs_main(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) f32 {
    let dims = vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_normal_depth));
    let nd = textureLoad(t_normal_depth, vec2<i32>(in.uv * dims), 0);
    if (nd.a >= 0.999 || nd.a <= 1e-5) { return 1.0; }
    if (light_u.soft_shadows != 2u) { return 1.0; }

    let world_pos = world_pos_from_uv_depth(in.uv, nd.a);
    let normal = normalize(nd.rgb);
    let l_dir = normalize(light_u.dir_direction.xyz);

    let bn = textureSample(
        t_blue_noise,
        s_blue_noise,
        in.clip_pos.xy / vec2<f32>(textureDimensions(t_blue_noise)),
    ).r;
    let phi = fract(bn + f32(vsm_pass.frame_index) * GOLDEN) * 6.28318530718;

    return vsm_trace_1ray(world_pos, normal, l_dir, phi);
}

### `shaders/vsm_smrt.wgsl` | **Строк:** 289

```wgsl
//! VSM clipmap lookup + SMRT (Shadow Map Ray Tracing) soft sampling.
//!
//! This file is the **canonical source** of the sampling helpers used by
//! `pbr.wgsl`'s `vsm_shadow()`. WGSL has no `#include`, so the block between
//! BEGIN/END markers below is duplicated verbatim at the end of `pbr.wgsl`;
//! keep the two copies in sync (a concat-based single source is possible
//! later via `shader::load`, which already joins strings).
//!
//! GPU resources (reserved bind group 25 in the PBR pipeline layout):
//! ```text
//! @group(0) @binding(19)  t_vsm_pages : texture_2d_array<f32>
//!      One LAYER per physical atlas page (128×128 R32Float each). Layer
//!      index == physical page index from the page table. NOTE: the device
//!      must support at least `pool_pages` array layers (default limit 2048;
//!      clamp VsmConfig::pool_pages accordingly when creating the texture).
//!      Texels hold NDC-z ([0,1]) of the owning clipmap level's ortho
//!      (matches shaders/vsm_depth.wgsl output).
//! @group(0) @binding(20)  s_vsm : sampler (linear)
//!      Reserved for future moment filtering; current sampling uses
//!      textureLoad because R32Float is not filterable without the
//!      FLOAT32_FILTERABLE feature.
//! @group(0) @binding(21)  vsm_info : storage read-only VsmGpuInfo
//!      Mirrored by Rust `shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo` — see the layout
//!      contract there before touching any field order.
//! ```
//!
//! The function stays dead code (and its bindings unused, hence unvalidated
//! against the pipeline layout) until the renderer binds group 25 and calls
//! it from the shadow-mode branch.

// ── BEGIN VSM_SMRT BLOCK (mirrored into pbr.wgsl verbatim) ──────────────

/// Page-table VALID bit (mirror of `shadow::page_table::PAGE_VALID_BIT`).
const VSM_PAGE_VALID: u32 = 0x80000000u;
/// Page-table physical-index mask (mirror of `PAGE_PHYS_MASK`).
const VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK: u32 = 0x3FFFFFFFu;

/// GPU mirror of one clipmap level (`shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmLevelGpu`).
struct VsmLevelGpu {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    world_half_extent: f32,
    page_table_offset: u32,
    pages_per_side: u32,
    texel_world: f32,
}

/// GPU mirror of `shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo`.
struct VsmGpuInfo {
    level_count: u32,
    page_px: u32,
    phys_page_count: u32,
    phys_pages_per_side: u32,
    // SMRT params (mirror of SmrtUniform / shadow::smrt::SmrtConfig).
    ray_count: u32,
    samples_per_ray: u32,
    source_angle: f32,
    source_radius: f32,
    max_trace_dist: f32,
    _pad0: vec3<f32>,
    levels: array<VsmLevelGpu, 8>,
    /// Concatenated page tables: `level * 256 + y * 16 + x`.
    page_tables: array<u32, 2048>,
}

@group(0) @binding(19) var t_vsm_pages: texture_2d_array<f32>;
@group(0) @binding(20) var s_vsm: sampler;
@group(0) @binding(21) var<storage, read> vsm_info: VsmGpuInfo;

/// Interleaved gradient noise (Jimenez 2014) for per-pixel ray rotation.
fn vsm_ign(p: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
    return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2<f32>(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
}

/// Result of resolving a world position against the clipmap page tables.
struct VsmLookup {
    /// 1.0 when a valid page was found covering the position.
    valid: f32,
    /// Physical page index (== texture array layer).
    layer: i32,
    /// Pixel inside the 128² page.
    pixel: vec2<i32>,
    pixel_f: vec2<f32>,
    /// NDC depth of the query point in the owning level.
    receiver_z: f32,
    /// World units per unit of NDC depth at this level ((far − near)).
    z_world_per_ndc: f32,
    /// World units per shadow texel at this level.
    texel_world: f32,
};

/// Finds the finest clipmap level whose window covers `pos` AND whose page
/// table entry is valid. Coarser levels are tried in order.
fn vsm_lookup(pos: vec3<f32>) -> VsmLookup {
    var out: VsmLookup;
    out.valid = 0.0;
    out.layer = 0;
    out.pixel = vec2<i32>(0);
    out.pixel_f = vec2<f32>(0.0);
    out.receiver_z = 0.0;
    out.z_world_per_ndc = 1.0;
    out.texel_world = 1.0;

    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    for (var lv = 0u; lv < count; lv++) {
        let cm = vsm_info.levels[lv];
        let clip = cm.view_proj * vec4<f32>(pos, 1.0);
        let ndc = clip.xyz / clip.w;
        let uv = vec2<f32>(ndc.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - ndc.y * 0.5);
        if (uv.x < 0.0 || uv.x > 1.0 || uv.y < 0.0 || uv.y > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }
        if (ndc.z < 0.0 || ndc.z > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }

        let pps = f32(cm.pages_per_side);
        let page = min(vec2<u32>(uv * pps), vec2<u32>(cm.pages_per_side - 1u));
        let entry =
            vsm_info.page_tables[cm.page_table_offset + page.y * cm.pages_per_side + page.x];
        if ((entry & VSM_PAGE_VALID) == 0u) {
            continue; // page not resident; try the coarser level
        }

        let phys = entry & VSM_PAGE_PHYS_MASK;
        let page_uv = fract(uv * pps);
        let ppx = f32(vsm_info.page_px);
        let lo = 1.0;
        let hi = ppx - 2.0;
        let pf = lo + clamp(page_uv, vec2<f32>(0.0), vec2<f32>(1.0)) * (hi - lo);

        out.valid = 1.0;
        out.layer = i32(phys);
        out.pixel_f = pf;
        out.pixel = vec2<i32>(i32(pf.x), i32(pf.y));
        out.receiver_z = ndc.z;
        // Level ortho spans near=−2h .. far=+2h ⇒ NDC depth unit = 4h world.
        out.z_world_per_ndc = cm.world_half_extent * 4.0;
        out.texel_world = (cm.world_half_extent * 2.0)
            / (pps * f32(vsm_info.page_px));
        return out;
    }
    return out;
}

fn vsm_tap_lit(lk: VsmLookup, pix: vec2<i32>, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let lo = 1;
    let hi = i32(vsm_info.page_px) - 2;
    if (pix.x < lo || pix.y < lo || pix.x > hi || pix.y > hi) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, pix, lk.layer, 0).r;
    if (stored > 0.999) {
        return 1.0;
    }
    let occluded = stored < lk.receiver_z - bias_ndc
        && (lk.receiver_z - stored) > min_diff;
    return select(1.0, 0.0, occluded);
}

fn vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, min_diff: f32) -> f32 {
    let f = lk.pixel_f;
    let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(f.x)), i32(floor(f.y)));
    let a = fract(f);
    let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
    return mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y);
}

fn vsm_pcf_lit(lk: VsmLookup, bias_ndc: f32, spread: f32) -> f32 {
    let min_diff = (1.25 * lk.texel_world) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
    if (spread <= 1.5) {
        return vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
    }
    if (spread <= 2.5) {
        var acc = vsm_pcf_bilinear(lk, bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(-1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, -1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        acc += vsm_tap_lit(lk, vec2<i32>(i32(lk.pixel_f.x), i32(lk.pixel_f.y)) + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
        return acc / 5.0;
    }
    let sp = max(spread, 1.0);
    var acc = 0.0;
    var wsum = 0.0;
    for (var dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (var dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
            let w = f32(2 - abs(dx)) * f32(2 - abs(dy));
            let pf = lk.pixel_f + vec2<f32>(f32(dx), f32(dy)) * sp;
            let i0 = vec2<i32>(i32(floor(pf.x)), i32(floor(pf.y)));
            let a = fract(pf);
            let s00 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0, bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s10 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 0), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s01 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(0, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            let s11 = vsm_tap_lit(lk, i0 + vec2<i32>(1, 1), bias_ndc, min_diff);
            acc += mix(mix(s00, s10, a.x), mix(s01, s11, a.x), a.y) * w;
            wsum += w;
        }
    }
    return acc / max(wsum, 1.0);
}

/// SMRT-style soft shadow for the directional light.
///
/// Traces `ray_count` rays from the shading point toward the light disc
/// (angular radius `source_angle`), marching `samples_per_ray` steps each.
/// Steps use a cubic distance curve so the first samples sit centimetres
/// from the receiver (contact at caster bases). Each step is 3×3 PCF'd.
///
/// Returns visibility in [0, 1]. Positions not covered by any resident page
/// return 1.0 (lit) so the virtualized area acts purely as an optimization.
fn vsm_shadow(world_pos: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>, light_dir: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    let count = min(vsm_info.level_count, 8u);
    if (count == 0u) {
        return 1.0;
    }

    let f = normalize(light_dir); // direction toward the light
    let up = select(vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), abs(f.y) < 0.99);
    let tangent = normalize(cross(up, f));
    let bitangent = cross(f, tangent);

    let ray_count = clamp(vsm_info.ray_count, 1u, 16u);
    let samples_per_ray = clamp(vsm_info.samples_per_ray, 1u, 16u);
    let tan_source = tan(max(vsm_info.source_angle, 1e-5));

    let jitter = vsm_ign(world_pos.xy + world_pos.zz * 7.31);

    let lk0 = vsm_lookup(world_pos);
    var origin = world_pos;
    if (lk0.valid > 0.5) {
        let n_dot_l = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
        let push = lk0.texel_world * mix(0.6, 1.5, n_dot_l);
        origin = world_pos + normalize(normal) * push;
    }

    var sum = 0.0;

    for (var r = 0u; r < ray_count; r++) {
        let u1 = (f32(r) + 0.5 + jitter * 0.5) / f32(ray_count);
        let theta = fract(u1 * 2.39996323 + jitter) * 6.28318530718;
        let radius = tan_source * sqrt(u1);
        let dir = normalize(
            f + (tangent * cos(theta) + bitangent * sin(theta)) * radius,
        );

        var transmittance = 1.0;
        for (var s = 1u; s <= samples_per_ray; s++) {
            if (transmittance < 0.01) {
                break;
            }
            let u = f32(s) / f32(samples_per_ray);
            let dist = max(vsm_info.max_trace_dist * u * u * u * u, lk0.texel_world * 1.5);
            let sp = origin + dir * dist;

            let lk = vsm_lookup(sp);
            if (lk.valid < 0.5) {
                break;
            }

            let slope = sqrt(max(1.0 - abs(dot(normal, f)), 0.0));
            let contact = clamp(1.0 - dist / max(lk.texel_world * 16.0, 1e-4), 0.0, 1.0);
            let face_on = max(dot(normalize(normal), f), 0.0);
            let bias_ndc = lk.texel_world * (0.45 + 0.60 * slope + 1.0 * face_on)
                * mix(1.0, 0.45, contact) / lk.z_world_per_ndc;
            let spread = clamp(dist * tan_source / max(lk.texel_world, 1e-4), 1.0, 8.0);
            let lit = vsm_pcf_lit(lk, bias_ndc, spread);
            let occ = 1.0 - lit;
            if (occ > 0.01) {
                let stored = textureLoad(t_vsm_pages, lk.pixel, lk.layer, 0).r;
                let depth_diff = max((lk.receiver_z - stored) * lk.z_world_per_ndc, 0.0);
                let penumbra = max(vsm_info.source_angle * dist, lk.texel_world);
                let soft = clamp(1.0 - depth_diff / penumbra, 0.0, 1.0);
                transmittance *= mix(1.0, soft, occ);
            }
        }
        sum += transmittance;
    }
    return clamp(sum / f32(ray_count), 0.0, 1.0);

// ── END VSM_SMRT BLOCK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Standalone validation entry point (unused; lets tools parse this file
// independently of pbr.wgsl).
fn _vsm_smrt_validate(pos: vec3<f32>, n: vec3<f32>, l: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
    return vsm_shadow(pos, n, l);
}

```wgsl
struct Camera {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    camera_pos: vec4<f32>,
};

struct ClipmapLevel {
    view_proj: mat4x4<f32>,
    world_half_extent: f32,
    page_table_offset: u32,
    pages_per_side: u32,
    _pad: u32,
};

struct VsmVisInfo {
    inv_vp: mat4x4<f32>,
    num_clipmap_levels: u32,
    screen_width: u32,
    screen_height: u32,
    _pad: u32,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var t_depth: texture_depth_2d;
@group(0) @binding(1) var<uniform> vis_info: VsmVisInfo;
@group(0) @binding(2) var<storage, read> clipmap_levels: array<ClipmapLevel>;
@group(0) @binding(3) var<storage, read_write> requested_pages: array<atomic<u32>>;

fn reconstruct_world_pos(uv: vec2<f32>, depth: f32, inv_vp: mat4x4<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
    let ndc = vec4<f32>(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0, depth, 1.0);
    let world_h = inv_vp * ndc;
    return world_h.xyz / world_h.w;
}

@compute @workgroup_size(8, 8, 1)
fn cs_visibility(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid: vec3<u32>) {
    if (gid.x >= vis_info.screen_width || gid.y >= vis_info.screen_height) {
        return;
    }

    let depth = textureLoad(t_depth, vec2<i32>(gid.xy), 0);
    if (depth >= 0.9999) { return; }

    let uv = (vec2<f32>(gid.xy) + 0.5) / vec2<f32>(f32(vis_info.screen_width), f32(vis_info.screen_height));
    let world_pos = reconstruct_world_pos(uv, depth, vis_info.inv_vp);

    for (var level = 0u; level < vis_info.num_clipmap_levels; level++) {
        let cm = clipmap_levels[level];
        let light_clip = cm.view_proj * vec4<f32>(world_pos, 1.0);
        let ndc = light_clip.xyz / light_clip.w;
        let lsuv = ndc.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;

        if (lsuv.x < 0.0 || lsuv.x > 1.0 || lsuv.y < 0.0 || lsuv.y > 1.0) {
            continue;
        }

        let page_x = u32(lsuv.x * f32(cm.pages_per_side));
        let page_y = u32(lsuv.y * f32(cm.pages_per_side));
        let flat_idx = cm.page_table_offset + page_y * cm.pages_per_side + page_x;

        let word_idx = flat_idx / 32u;
        let bit_idx = flat_idx % 32u;
        atomicOr(&requested_pages[word_idx], 1u << bit_idx);
    }
}

//! Asset data types used with [`redox_asset`] for render resources.
//!
//! These types are stored in the asset manager; when loaded (or inserted),
//! the render context creates GPU resources and maps handles to indices.

use redox_asset::Handle;
use redox_math::Vec3;

use crate::mesh::Mesh;

/// CPU-side mesh data. Stored in the asset manager; uploaded to GPU when synced.
pub type MeshData = Mesh;

/// Image data for textures. Produced by [`redox_asset::ImageLoader`].
pub type TextureData = image::DynamicImage;

/// Substrate-style material layer (clear coat, secondary BRDF lobe, etc.).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct MaterialLayer {
    pub base_color: Vec3,
    pub metallic: f32,
    pub roughness: f32,
    pub weight: f32,
}

impl Default for MaterialLayer {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            base_color: Vec3::ONE,
            metallic: 0.0,
            roughness: 0.5,
            weight: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

/// How a material's surface is composited into the frame.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BlendMode {
    /// Fully opaque surface (default): rendered in the main forward pass.
    #[default]
    Opaque,
    /// Alpha-blended surface: rendered after all opaque geometry, sorted
    /// back-to-front, without writing depth.
    Alpha,
}

/// Material descriptor (no GPU indices). Stored in the asset manager.
///
/// Texture slots reference other assets by handle; when creating the GPU material,
/// the render context resolves these to texture indices.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MaterialData {
    pub base_color: Vec3,
    pub metallic: f32,
    pub roughness: f32,
    pub emissive: Vec3,
    pub albedo_handle: Option<Handle<TextureData>>,
    pub normal_handle: Option<Handle<TextureData>>,
    pub mr_handle: Option<Handle<TextureData>>,
    /// How the surface is blended into the frame (default [`BlendMode::Opaque`]).
    pub blend: BlendMode,
    /// Optional Substrate-style layers (up to two). `None` = single-lobe material.
    pub layers: Option<[MaterialLayer; 2]>,
    /// Sheen lobe weight for fabric-like surfaces (0 = disabled).
    pub sheen: f32,
}

impl MaterialData {
    pub fn solid(color: Vec3) -> Self {
        Self {
            base_color: color,
            metallic: 0.0,
            roughness: 0.5,
            emissive: Vec3::ZERO,
            albedo_handle: None,
            normal_handle: None,
            mr_handle: None,
            blend: BlendMode::Opaque,
            layers: None,
            sheen: 0.0,
        }
    }

    /// Sets the blend mode (builder style).
    pub fn blend(mut self, blend: BlendMode) -> Self {
        self.blend = blend;
        self
    }

    pub fn metallic(mut self, metallic: f32) -> Self {
        self.metallic = metallic;
        self
    }

    pub fn roughness(mut self, roughness: f32) -> Self {
        self.roughness = roughness;
        self
    }

    pub fn emissive(mut self, color: Vec3) -> Self {
        self.emissive = color;
        self
    }

    pub fn with_albedo(mut self, handle: Handle<TextureData>) -> Self {
        self.albedo_handle = Some(handle);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_normal(mut self, handle: Handle<TextureData>) -> Self {
        self.normal_handle = Some(handle);
        self
    }

    pub fn with_mr(mut self, handle: Handle<TextureData>) -> Self {
        self.mr_handle = Some(handle);
        self
    }

    /// Enables Substrate-style dual layers (builder style).
    pub fn with_layers(mut self, layers: [MaterialLayer; 2]) -> Self {
        self.layers = Some(layers);
        self
    }

    /// Sets sheen weight (builder style).
    pub fn sheen(mut self, sheen: f32) -> Self {
        self.sheen = sheen;
        self
    }
}

```rust
//! Camera component and GPU uniform.
//!
//! [`CameraUniform`] carries **separate** view / projection matrices plus their
//! inverses — this is what lets shadow passes (CSM) build correct cascade
//! frustums from the real camera instead of a hardcoded guess.
//!
//! When TAA is enabled the renderer injects a subpixel jitter into the
//! projection matrix every frame (see [`crate::pass::taa`]). The unjittered
//! matrices are stored so the velocity pass can compute correct motion vectors.
//!
//! # GPU layout note
//! `view_proj` + `camera_pos` stay at offsets 0..80 for compatibility with
//! shaders compiled before the split; new fields are appended after them.

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};
use redox_ecs::Entity;
use redox_math::{Mat4, Quat, Vec3, look_at, perspective};

/// ECS component describing a perspective camera.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Camera {
    /// Vertical field-of-view in **radians**.
    pub fov_y: f32,
    /// Near clipping plane distance.
    pub near: f32,
    /// Far clipping plane distance.
    pub far: f32,
    /// Aspect ratio (width / height). Updated on window resize.
    pub aspect_ratio: f32,
}

impl Camera {
    /// Creates a new camera with the given parameters.
    ///
    /// * `fov_y` — vertical field of view **in radians**.
    /// * `aspect_ratio` — width / height of the viewport.
    /// * `near` / `far` — clipping plane distances.
    pub fn new(fov_y: f32, aspect_ratio: f32, near: f32, far: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            fov_y,
            aspect_ratio,
            near,
            far,
        }
    }

    /// Builds the projection matrix for this camera.
    #[inline]
    pub fn projection_matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        perspective(self.fov_y, self.aspect_ratio, self.near, self.far)
    }

    /// Builds a view matrix given the camera's world-space position and rotation.
    ///
    /// The camera looks along its local −Z axis (right-handed convention).
    #[inline]
    pub fn view_matrix(position: Vec3, rotation: Quat) -> Mat4 {
        let forward = rotation * Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
        let target = position + forward;
        look_at(position, target, Vec3::Y)
    }

    /// Convenience: builds a combined view-projection matrix.
    pub fn view_proj_matrix(&self, position: Vec3, rotation: Quat) -> Mat4 {
        self.projection_matrix() * Self::view_matrix(position, rotation)
    }
}

/// ECS resource that identifies which entity is the active (main) camera.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct ActiveCamera(pub Entity);

/// GPU-friendly camera uniform with separated matrices.
///
/// Uploaded to a uniform buffer; bound by every pass that needs camera data
/// (PBR, shadow, velocity, TAA, skybox).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct CameraUniform {
    /// Combined view-projection matrix (column-major). Kept first for
    /// byte-compatibility with pre-split shaders.
    pub view_proj: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Camera world-space position (padded to 16 bytes).
    pub camera_pos: [f32; 4],
    /// World→view matrix.
    pub view: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// View→clip matrix.
    pub proj: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Inverse view matrix (clip-independent ray reconstruction).
    pub inv_view: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Inverse projection matrix.
    pub inv_proj: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Previous frame's **unjittered** view-projection (motion vectors).
    pub prev_view_proj: [[f32; 4]; 4],
}

impl CameraUniform {
    /// Creates a zeroed uniform (identity-like placeholder).
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            view_proj: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
            camera_pos: [0.0; 4],
            view: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
            proj: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
            inv_view: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
            inv_proj: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
            prev_view_proj: Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d(),
        }
    }

    /// Updates all matrices from camera parameters and transform.
    ///
    /// `prev_view_proj` keeps its previous value (call
    /// [`snapshot_prev_view_proj`](Self::snapshot_prev_view_proj) at frame end).
    pub fn update(&mut self, camera: &Camera, position: Vec3, rotation: Quat) {
        let view = Camera::view_matrix(position, rotation);
        let proj = camera.projection_matrix();
        self.view = view.to_cols_array_2d();
        self.proj = proj.to_cols_array_2d();
        self.inv_view = view.inverse().to_cols_array_2d();
        self.inv_proj = proj.inverse().to_cols_array_2d();
        self.view_proj = (proj * view).to_cols_array_2d();
        self.camera_pos = [position.x, position.y, position.z, 1.0];
    }

    /// Copies the current combined VP into `prev_view_proj`.
    ///
    /// Call once at the end of each rendered frame (after velocity consumed
    /// the previous value).
    pub fn snapshot_prev_view_proj(&mut self) {
        self.prev_view_proj = self.view_proj;
    }

    /// Applies a subpixel NDC jitter to the projection and refreshes the
    /// combined `view_proj`. Used by TAA/TAAU before uploading the uniform.
    pub fn apply_jitter_ndc(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
        let mut proj = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.proj);
        // Same derivation as the legacy combined-matrix path: shifting the
        // z-axis x/y components translates NDC xy.
        proj.z_axis.x -= dx;
        proj.z_axis.y -= dy;
        self.proj = proj.to_cols_array_2d();
        let view = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.view);
        self.view_proj = (proj * view).to_cols_array_2d();
    }

    /// Returns the current combined view-projection as a glam matrix.
    pub fn view_proj_matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.view_proj)
    }

    /// Returns the previous (unjittered) view-projection as a glam matrix.
    pub fn prev_view_proj_matrix(&self) -> Mat4 {
        Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.prev_view_proj)
    }

    /// Returns the unjittered combined view-projection (recomputed from the
    /// stored view/proj pair, immune to per-frame jitter writes).
    pub fn unjittered_view_proj(&self, jitter_dx: f32, jitter_dy: f32) -> Mat4 {
        let mut proj = Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.proj);
        proj.z_axis.x += jitter_dx;
        proj.z_axis.y += jitter_dy;
        proj * Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.view)
    }
}

impl Default for CameraUniform {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

// ── ECS resource for TAA camera history ──────────────────────────────────────

/// ECS resource that stores the previous frame's **unjittered** VP matrix.
///
/// [`RenderContext`](crate::RenderContext) writes this every frame so the
/// velocity pass can compute per-pixel motion vectors. Applications never need
/// to touch this directly. Prefer `CameraUniform::prev_view_proj` for new code.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct PreviousViewProj {
    /// Column-major 4×4 unjittered VP matrix from the last rendered frame.
    pub matrix: Mat4,
}

impl Default for PreviousViewProj {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            matrix: Mat4::IDENTITY,
        }
    }
}

//! GPU compute pass for clustered forward light assignment.

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};

use crate::clustering::cluster_config;
use crate::shader::{CLUSTER_CULL_LIGHTS_WGSL, create_shader_module};

/// Per-frame parameters for the cluster light cull compute shader.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct ClusterCullParams {
    pub cam_pos: [f32; 4],
    pub view_proj: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    pub num_lights: u32,
    pub max_lights_per_cluster: u32,
    pub indices_capacity: u32,
    pub _pad: u32,
}

/// GPU pipeline that assigns point lights to screen-space clusters.
pub struct ClusterGpuCull {
    pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    params_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    counter_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
}

impl ClusterGpuCull {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                uniform_entry(0),
                uniform_entry(1),
                storage_read_entry(2),
                storage_read_entry(3),
                storage_rw_entry(4),
                storage_rw_entry(5),
                storage_rw_entry(6),
            ],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "cluster_cull_lights_shader", CLUSTER_CULL_LIGHTS_WGSL);
        let pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "main",
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        });

        let params_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_params"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<ClusterCullParams>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let counter_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_global_offset"),
            size: 4,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bgl,
            params_buffer,
            counter_buffer,
        }
    }

    /// Clears the global light-index counter and records the cull dispatch.
    pub fn record_dispatch(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        params: &ClusterCullParams,
        cluster_info_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        bounds_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        point_lights_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        metadata_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        light_indices_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        total_clusters: u32,
    ) {
        // Atomic offset into the compacted per-cluster light index list.
        queue.write_buffer(&self.counter_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&0u32));
        queue.write_buffer(&self.params_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(params));

        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_cull_bg"),
            layout: &self.bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: cluster_info_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: self.params_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: bounds_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: point_lights_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: metadata_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    resource: light_indices_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 6,
                    resource: self.counter_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        let workgroups = (total_clusters + 63) / 64;
        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_cull_lights"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &bind_group, &[]);
            pass.dispatch_workgroups(workgroups.max(1), 1, 1);
        }
    }
}

impl Default for ClusterCullParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            cam_pos: [0.0; 4],
            view_proj: [[0.0; 4]; 4],
            num_lights: 0,
            max_lights_per_cluster: cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER,
            indices_capacity: 0,
            _pad: 0,
        }
    }
}

fn uniform_entry(binding: u32) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

fn storage_read_entry(binding: u32) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

fn storage_rw_entry(binding: u32) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: false },
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

```rust
//! GPU cluster management and light assignment updates.

use crate::cluster_gpu_cull::{ClusterCullParams, ClusterGpuCull};
use crate::clustering::{self, ClusterInfo, ClusterLightAssignment};
use crate::light::{PointLight, PointLightGpu};
use wgpu::{Buffer, CommandEncoder, Device, Queue};

/// Manages cluster data and GPU buffers for clustered forward rendering.
pub struct ClusterManager {
    /// Current cluster information.
    pub cluster_info: ClusterInfo,
    /// Point lights storage buffer.
    pub point_lights_buffer: Buffer,
    /// Metadata buffer: (offset, count) for each cluster.
    pub metadata_buffer: Buffer,
    /// Light index buffer: flat array of light indices.
    pub light_indices_buffer: Buffer,
    /// Cluster bounds buffer (min_depth, max_depth for each cluster).
    pub bounds_buffer: Buffer,
    /// Cluster info uniform buffer.
    pub info_buffer: Buffer,
    /// Current light assignment (cached for debugging).
    current_assignment: Option<ClusterLightAssignment>,
    /// Cached cluster depth bounds (rebuilt only when camera range / resolution changes).
    cached_cluster_bounds: Vec<clustering::ClusterBounds>,
    bounds_cache_near: f32,
    bounds_cache_far: f32,
    bounds_cache_width: u32,
    bounds_cache_height: u32,
    /// When true, light→cluster assignment runs on GPU compute; CPU builds AABBs only.
    pub gpu_cull: bool,
    gpu_cull_pass: ClusterGpuCull,
    pending_gpu_lights: u32,
    pending_cam_pos: redox_math::Vec3,
    pending_view_proj: redox_math::Mat4,
}

/// Maximum number of light indices in the flat buffer (cap to avoid huge allocations).
const MAX_INDICES_CAP: u64 = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

impl ClusterManager {
    /// Creates a new cluster manager with initial screen and camera parameters.
    pub fn new(
        screen_width: u32,
        screen_height: u32,
        camera: &crate::camera::Camera,
        device: &Device,
        queue: &Queue,
    ) -> Self {
        let cluster_info = ClusterInfo::new(screen_width, screen_height, camera);
        let num_clusters = cluster_info.total_clusters();

        // Initialize point lights buffer
        let point_lights_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_point_lights_buffer"),
            size: (clustering::cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS as u64)
                * std::mem::size_of::<PointLightGpu>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        // Initialize buffers with default sizes
        let metadata_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_metadata_buffer"),
            size: (num_clusters as u64) * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterMetadata>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        // Flat array of light indices per cluster; worst case num_clusters * MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER.
        let indices_capacity = (num_clusters as u64) * (clustering::cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER as u64);
        let light_indices_buffer_size = (indices_capacity.min(MAX_INDICES_CAP)) * std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64;
        let light_indices_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_light_indices_buffer"),
            size: light_indices_buffer_size,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let bounds_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_bounds_buffer"),
            size: (num_clusters as u64) * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterBounds>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let info_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("cluster_info_buffer"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<ClusterInfo>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        // Write initial cluster info
        let info_bytes = bytemuck::bytes_of(&cluster_info);
        queue.write_buffer(&info_buffer, 0, info_bytes);

        Self {
            cluster_info,
            point_lights_buffer,
            metadata_buffer,
            light_indices_buffer,
            bounds_buffer,
            info_buffer,
            current_assignment: None,
            cached_cluster_bounds: Vec::new(),
            bounds_cache_near: f32::NAN,
            bounds_cache_far: f32::NAN,
            bounds_cache_width: 0,
            bounds_cache_height: 0,
            gpu_cull: true,
            gpu_cull_pass: ClusterGpuCull::new(device),
            pending_gpu_lights: 0,
            pending_cam_pos: redox_math::Vec3::ZERO,
            pending_view_proj: redox_math::Mat4::IDENTITY,
        }
    }

    fn invalidate_bounds_cache(&mut self) {
        self.cached_cluster_bounds.clear();
        self.bounds_cache_near = f32::NAN;
        self.bounds_cache_far = f32::NAN;
        self.bounds_cache_width = 0;
        self.bounds_cache_height = 0;
    }

    fn ensure_cluster_bounds(&mut self, camera: &crate::camera::Camera) {
        let w = self.cluster_info.screen_width;
        let h = self.cluster_info.screen_height;
        if self.cached_cluster_bounds.is_empty()
            || self.bounds_cache_near != camera.near
            || self.bounds_cache_far != camera.far
            || self.bounds_cache_width != w
            || self.bounds_cache_height != h
        {
            self.cached_cluster_bounds =
                clustering::build_clusters(camera, w, h);
            self.bounds_cache_near = camera.near;
            self.bounds_cache_far = camera.far;
            self.bounds_cache_width = w;
            self.bounds_cache_height = h;
        }
    }

    /// Rebuilds cluster buffers for a new screen resolution without requiring
    /// a full `Camera` struct (reuses the existing near/far values).
    pub fn resize_for_screen(
        &mut self,
        screen_width: u32,
        screen_height: u32,
        device: &Device,
        queue: &Queue,
    ) {
        use clustering::cluster_config;
        let new_clusters_x =
            (screen_width + cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_X - 1) / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_X;
        let new_clusters_y =
            (screen_height + cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_Y - 1) / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_Y;

        let old_total = self.cluster_info.total_clusters();

        self.cluster_info.clusters_x = new_clusters_x;
        self.cluster_info.clusters_y = new_clusters_y;
        self.cluster_info.screen_width = screen_width;
        self.cluster_info.screen_height = screen_height;
        self.cluster_info.total_clusters =
            new_clusters_x * new_clusters_y * self.cluster_info.depth_slices;

        let new_total = self.cluster_info.total_clusters();

        if new_total > old_total {
            self.metadata_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_metadata_buffer"),
                size: (new_total as u64)
                    * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterMetadata>() as u64,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });

            self.bounds_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_bounds_buffer"),
                size: (new_total as u64)
                    * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterBounds>() as u64,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });

            let indices_cap = (new_total as u64)
                * (clustering::cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER as u64);
            let indices_size =
                (indices_cap.min(MAX_INDICES_CAP)) * std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64;
            self.light_indices_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_light_indices_buffer"),
                size: indices_size,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });
        }

        queue.write_buffer(&self.info_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&self.cluster_info));
        self.current_assignment = None;
        self.invalidate_bounds_cache();
    }
    /// Rebuilds screen dimensions (e.g., on window resize).
    pub fn rebuild_for_resolution(
        &mut self,
        screen_width: u32,
        screen_height: u32,
        camera: &crate::camera::Camera,
        device: &Device,
        queue: &Queue,
    ) {
        let new_info = ClusterInfo::new(screen_width, screen_height, camera);
        let old_total = self.cluster_info.total_clusters();
        let new_total = new_info.total_clusters();

        // Recreate buffers if size changed
        if new_total != old_total {
            self.metadata_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_metadata_buffer"),
                size: (new_total as u64)
                    * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterMetadata>() as u64,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });

            self.bounds_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_bounds_buffer"),
                size: (new_total as u64) * std::mem::size_of::<clustering::ClusterBounds>() as u64,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });

            let indices_cap = (new_total as u64) * (clustering::cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER as u64);
            let indices_size = (indices_cap.min(MAX_INDICES_CAP)) * std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64;
            self.light_indices_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("cluster_light_indices_buffer"),
                size: indices_size,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });
        }

        self.cluster_info = new_info;
        
        // Write updated cluster info
        let info_bytes = bytemuck::bytes_of(&self.cluster_info);
        queue.write_buffer(&self.info_buffer, 0, info_bytes);

        self.current_assignment = None;
        self.invalidate_bounds_cache();
    }

    /// Updates cluster light assignments based on current lights.
    ///
    /// `cam_pos` must be the camera's world-space position (same value written into
    /// `camera_uniform.camera_pos`) so the CPU depth test matches the WGSL shader.
    pub fn update_clusters(
        &mut self,
        lights: &[PointLight],
        camera: &crate::camera::Camera,
        cam_pos: redox_math::Vec3,
        view_proj: redox_math::Mat4,
        _device: &Device,
        queue: &Queue,
    ) {
        // Convert PointLight to PointLightGpu and serialize to GPU
        let gpu_lights: Vec<PointLightGpu> = lights
            .iter()
            .map(PointLightGpu::from_point_light)
            .collect();
        
        if !gpu_lights.is_empty() {
            let lights_bytes = bytemuck::cast_slice::<PointLightGpu, u8>(&gpu_lights);
            queue.write_buffer(&self.point_lights_buffer, 0, lights_bytes);
        }

        self.ensure_cluster_bounds(camera);

        let bounds_bytes =
            bytemuck::cast_slice::<clustering::ClusterBounds, u8>(&self.cached_cluster_bounds);
        queue.write_buffer(&self.bounds_buffer, 0, bounds_bytes);

        if self.gpu_cull {
            self.pending_gpu_lights = gpu_lights.len() as u32;
            self.pending_cam_pos = cam_pos;
            self.pending_view_proj = view_proj;
            self.current_assignment = None;
            return;
        }

        let assignment = clustering::assign_lights_to_clusters(
            lights,
            &self.cluster_info,
            &self.cached_cluster_bounds,
            cam_pos,
            view_proj,
        );

        let metadata_bytes =
            bytemuck::cast_slice::<clustering::ClusterMetadata, u8>(&assignment.cluster_metadata);
        queue.write_buffer(&self.metadata_buffer, 0, metadata_bytes);

        let indices_bytes = bytemuck::cast_slice::<u32, u8>(&assignment.light_indices);
        queue.write_buffer(&self.light_indices_buffer, 0, indices_bytes);

        self.current_assignment = Some(assignment);
    }

    /// Records the GPU cluster light cull into `encoder` (no-op when [`Self::gpu_cull`] is false).
    pub fn record_gpu_cull(
        &self,
        device: &Device,
        encoder: &mut CommandEncoder,
        queue: &Queue,
    ) {
        if !self.gpu_cull {
            return;
        }

        let indices_capacity = (self.light_indices_buffer.size()
            / std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u64)
            .min(u32::MAX as u64) as u32;

        let params = ClusterCullParams {
            cam_pos: [
                self.pending_cam_pos.x,
                self.pending_cam_pos.y,
                self.pending_cam_pos.z,
                1.0,
            ],
            view_proj: self.pending_view_proj.to_cols_array_2d(),
            num_lights: self.pending_gpu_lights,
            max_lights_per_cluster: clustering::cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER,
            indices_capacity,
            _pad: 0,
        };

        self.gpu_cull_pass.record_dispatch(
            device,
            encoder,
            queue,
            &params,
            &self.info_buffer,
            &self.bounds_buffer,
            &self.point_lights_buffer,
            &self.metadata_buffer,
            &self.light_indices_buffer,
            self.cluster_info.total_clusters as u32,
        );
    }

    /// Returns the current cluster info.
    pub fn info(&self) -> &ClusterInfo {
        &self.cluster_info
    }

    /// Returns statistics about the current light assignment (for debugging).
    pub fn assignment_stats(&self) -> Option<ClusterAssignmentStats> {
        self.current_assignment.as_ref().map(|assignment| {
            let total_lights_refs = assignment.light_indices.len() as u32;
            let total_clusters = assignment.cluster_count;
            let avg_lights_per_cluster = if total_clusters > 0 {
                total_lights_refs as f32 / total_clusters as f32
            } else {
                0.0
            };

            let max_lights = assignment
                .cluster_metadata
                .iter()
                .map(|m| m.count)
                .max()
                .unwrap_or(0);

            ClusterAssignmentStats {
                total_lights_in_scene: assignment.cluster_metadata.iter().map(|m| m.count).sum(),
                total_light_references: total_lights_refs,
                total_clusters,
                avg_lights_per_cluster,
                max_lights_in_cluster: max_lights,
            }
        })
    }
}

/// Statistics about the current light-to-cluster assignment.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ClusterAssignmentStats {
    /// Number of unique lights in the scene.
    pub total_lights_in_scene: u32,
    /// Total number of light references across all clusters (sum of all counts).
    pub total_light_references: u32,
    /// Total number of clusters.
    pub total_clusters: u32,
    /// Average lights per cluster.
    pub avg_lights_per_cluster: f32,
    /// Maximum lights in any single cluster.
    pub max_lights_in_cluster: u32,
}

```rust
//! Clustered forward rendering: spatial partitioning of lights into screen-space clusters.
//!
//! This module implements a 3D grid of clusters in screen space and depth, allowing efficient
//! light culling. Each cluster stores which lights affect it, reducing the per-fragment light loop.

use crate::camera::Camera;
use crate::light::PointLight;
use redox_math::Vec3;

/// Constants for cluster grid configuration.
pub mod cluster_config {
    /// Size of each cluster in screen-space X (pixels).
    pub const CLUSTER_SIZE_X: u32 = 16;
    /// Size of each cluster in screen-space Y (pixels).
    pub const CLUSTER_SIZE_Y: u32 = 16;
    /// Number of depth slices in the cluster grid.
    pub const CLUSTER_DEPTH: u32 = 24;
    /// Maximum number of lights per cluster.
    pub const MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER: u32 = 256;
    /// Maximum total lights in the scene.
    pub const MAX_LIGHTS: u32 = 512;
}

/// Stores depth bounds for a single cluster.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct ClusterBounds {
    /// Minimum depth in camera space (linear, typically near_plane).
    pub min_depth: f32,
    /// Maximum depth in camera space (linear).
    pub max_depth: f32,
}

/// Metadata for a cluster's light list: offset and count.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct ClusterMetadata {
    /// Offset into the global light index array.
    pub offset: u32,
    /// Number of lights in this cluster.
    pub count: u32,
}

/// Clustered light assignment result.
pub struct ClusterLightAssignment {
    /// Flat array of light indices.
    pub light_indices: Vec<u32>,
    /// Metadata (offset and count) for each cluster.
    pub cluster_metadata: Vec<ClusterMetadata>,
    /// Cluster bounds (min/max depth) for each cluster.
    pub cluster_bounds: Vec<ClusterBounds>,
    /// Actual number of clusters used.
    pub cluster_count: u32,
    /// Actual number of depth slices used (may be less than CLUSTER_DEPTH).
    pub depth_slices: u32,
}

/// Information about the cluster grid (for GPU).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct ClusterInfo {
    /// Number of clusters in X (width / CLUSTER_SIZE_X).
    pub clusters_x: u32,
    /// Number of clusters in Y (height / CLUSTER_SIZE_Y).
    pub clusters_y: u32,
    /// Number of depth slices.
    pub depth_slices: u32,
    /// Screen width in pixels.
    pub screen_width: u32,
    /// Screen height in pixels.
    pub screen_height: u32,
    /// Camera near plane.
    pub near: f32,
    /// Camera far plane.
    pub far: f32,
    /// Log-based depth scaling factor (for logarithmic depth distribution).
    pub depth_scale: f32,
    /// Total number of clusters in the 3D grid (clusters_x * clusters_y * depth_slices).
    pub total_clusters: u32,
    /// WGSL uniform structs round size to 16 bytes.
    pub _pad: [u32; 3],
}

impl ClusterInfo {
    /// Builds cluster info from screen and camera parameters.
    pub fn new(screen_width: u32, screen_height: u32, camera: &Camera) -> Self {
        let clusters_x = (screen_width + cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_X - 1) / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_X;
        let clusters_y = (screen_height + cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_Y - 1) / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_Y;
        let depth_slices = cluster_config::CLUSTER_DEPTH;
        let total_clusters = clusters_x * clusters_y * depth_slices;

        // Logarithmic depth scaling: z_slice = near * (far/near)^(i/(num_slices-1))
        // This allows better precision near the camera.
        let depth_scale = (camera.far / camera.near).ln() / (depth_slices - 1) as f32;

        Self {
            clusters_x,
            clusters_y,
            depth_slices,
            screen_width,
            screen_height,
            near: camera.near,
            far: camera.far,
            depth_scale,
            total_clusters,
            _pad: [0; 3],
        }
    }

    /// Total number of clusters (convenience for usize-based code).
    pub fn total_clusters(&self) -> usize {
        // Derive from dimensions to avoid stale cached values after resize.
        (self.clusters_x as usize) * (self.clusters_y as usize) * (self.depth_slices as usize)
    }
}

/// Builds the cluster bounds for the given camera and screen dimensions.
pub fn build_clusters(camera: &Camera, screen_width: u32, screen_height: u32) -> Vec<ClusterBounds> {
    let cluster_info = ClusterInfo::new(screen_width, screen_height, camera);
    let mut bounds = Vec::with_capacity(cluster_info.total_clusters());

    let near = camera.near;
    let far = camera.far;

    for z in 0..cluster_info.depth_slices {
        // Logarithmic depth distribution: z_i = near * (far/near)^(i / (num_slices - 1))
        // This gives better precision near the camera.
        let z_norm = z as f32 / (cluster_info.depth_slices - 1) as f32;
        let min_depth = near * (far / near).powf(z_norm);
        let max_depth = if z == cluster_info.depth_slices - 1 {
            far
        } else {
            let z_norm_next = (z as f32 + 1.0) / (cluster_info.depth_slices - 1) as f32;
            near * (far / near).powf(z_norm_next)
        };

        for _y in 0..cluster_info.clusters_y {
            for _x in 0..cluster_info.clusters_x {
                bounds.push(ClusterBounds {
                    min_depth,
                    max_depth,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    bounds
}

/// Computes the cluster index from screen coordinates and depth.
///
/// Returns (cluster_x, cluster_y, cluster_z) or None if out of bounds.
pub fn get_cluster_indices(
    screen_x: f32,
    screen_y: f32,
    linear_depth: f32,
    cluster_info: &ClusterInfo,
) -> Option<(u32, u32, u32)> {
    let cluster_x = (screen_x / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_X as f32) as u32;
    let cluster_y = (screen_y / cluster_config::CLUSTER_SIZE_Y as f32) as u32;

    if cluster_x >= cluster_info.clusters_x || cluster_y >= cluster_info.clusters_y {
        return None;
    }

    // Logarithmic depth indexing
    let z_norm = ((linear_depth / cluster_info.near).ln() / cluster_info.depth_scale).max(0.0);
    let cluster_z = (z_norm as u32).min(cluster_info.depth_slices - 1);

    Some((cluster_x, cluster_y, cluster_z))
}

/// Linearizes a hardware depth value (NDC z, **[0, 1]** range as produced by
/// [`redox_math::perspective`] on wgpu) into positive view-space distance.
pub fn linearize_depth(depth_ndc: f32, near: f32, far: f32) -> f32 {
    // Zero-to-one perspective: d = (-f/(f-n) * z - n*f/(f-n)) / z
    // solved for |z|:
    //   z = n*f / (f - d*(f-n))
    let denom = far - depth_ndc * (far - near);
    if denom.abs() < 1e-6 {
        return far;
    }
    near * far / denom
}

/// Converts linear depth to a depth slice index.
pub fn get_depth_slice(linear_depth: f32, cluster_info: &ClusterInfo) -> u32 {
    let near = cluster_info.near;
    let _depth_scale = cluster_info.depth_scale;
    
    // z_slice = ln(depth / near) / depth_scale
    let z_norm = ((linear_depth / near).max(1.0).ln() / _depth_scale).max(0.0);
    (z_norm as u32).min(cluster_info.depth_slices - 1)
}
/// Returns true if a point light sphere could illuminate any fragment in the given cluster.
///
/// Two-stage conservative test:
/// 1. **Depth** — the light's near/far extent along the camera→light ray must
///    overlap the cluster's logarithmic depth band (matches the WGSL metric).
/// 2. **Screen-space XY** — project the light center to NDC and test a
///    conservatively enlarged sphere footprint against the cluster's screen
///    rectangle. Lights outside the frustum (or behind the camera) are only
///    rejected when provably off-screen; borderline cases pass.
fn sphere_intersects_cluster(
    light_pos: Vec3,
    light_radius: f32,
    cluster_x: u32,
    cluster_y: u32,
    cluster_z: u32,
    cluster_info: &ClusterInfo,
    cluster_bounds: &[ClusterBounds],
    _cam_pos: Vec3,
    view_proj: redox_math::Mat4,
) -> bool {
    let cluster_idx = (cluster_z as usize)
        * (cluster_info.clusters_x as usize)
        * (cluster_info.clusters_y as usize)
        + (cluster_y as usize) * (cluster_info.clusters_x as usize)
        + (cluster_x as usize);

    if cluster_idx >= cluster_bounds.len() {
        return false;
    }

    let bounds = &cluster_bounds[cluster_idx];

    // ── 1. Depth overlap — view-space Z from clip.w (planar, matches shaders) ──
    let clip_depth = view_proj * light_pos.extend(1.0);
    let light_view_z = clip_depth.w;
    if light_view_z <= 0.0 && light_view_z + light_radius <= 0.0 {
        return false;
    }
    let sphere_near = (light_view_z - light_radius).max(0.0);
    let sphere_far = light_view_z + light_radius;
    if !(sphere_near <= bounds.max_depth && sphere_far >= bounds.min_depth) {
        return false;
    }

    // ── 2. Screen-space XY overlap against THIS cluster's tile ──
    let clip = clip_depth;
    let w = clip.w;
    if w <= 0.0 {
        return false;
    }
    let ndc = clip.truncate() / w;

    let tile_min_x = (cluster_x as f32 / cluster_info.clusters_x as f32) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let tile_max_x = ((cluster_x + 1) as f32 / cluster_info.clusters_x as f32) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    let tile_max_y = 1.0 - (cluster_y as f32 / cluster_info.clusters_y as f32) * 2.0;
    let tile_min_y = 1.0 - ((cluster_y + 1) as f32 / cluster_info.clusters_y as f32) * 2.0;

    let m = view_proj.to_cols_array_2d();
    let scale_x = m[0][0].abs().max(m[1][0].abs()).max(m[2][0].abs());
    let scale_y = m[0][1].abs().max(m[1][1].abs()).max(m[2][1].abs());
    let r_ndc_x = light_radius * scale_x / w;
    let r_ndc_y = light_radius * scale_y / w;
    if ndc.x + r_ndc_x < tile_min_x || ndc.x - r_ndc_x > tile_max_x {
        return false;
    }
    if ndc.y + r_ndc_y < tile_min_y || ndc.y - r_ndc_y > tile_max_y {
        return false;
    }

    true
}

/// Assigns lights to clusters based on spatial intersection.
///
/// `cam_pos` is the camera's world-space position; it must match what
/// `camera_uniform.camera_pos` contains so the depth metric aligns with the shader.
///
/// Returns indices into the lights array for each cluster, along with metadata.
pub fn assign_lights_to_clusters(
    lights: &[PointLight],
    cluster_info: &ClusterInfo,
    cluster_bounds: &[ClusterBounds],
    cam_pos: Vec3,
    view_proj: redox_math::Mat4,
) -> ClusterLightAssignment {
    // Derive this from dimensions directly to avoid any mismatch with the cached
    // `total_clusters` field (and to stay safe across resizes).
    let num_clusters = (cluster_info.clusters_x as usize)
        * (cluster_info.clusters_y as usize)
        * (cluster_info.depth_slices as usize);
    let mut cluster_metadata: Vec<ClusterMetadata> = vec![
        ClusterMetadata {
            offset: 0,
            count: 0,
        };
        num_clusters
    ];
    let mut light_indices = Vec::new();

    // For each cluster, collect intersecting lights
    let mut current_offset = 0u32;
    for cluster_z in 0..cluster_info.depth_slices {
        for cluster_y in 0..cluster_info.clusters_y {
            for cluster_x in 0..cluster_info.clusters_x {
                let cluster_idx = (cluster_z as usize) * (cluster_info.clusters_x as usize)
                    * (cluster_info.clusters_y as usize)
                    + (cluster_y as usize) * (cluster_info.clusters_x as usize)
                    + (cluster_x as usize);
                if cluster_idx >= cluster_metadata.len() {
                    // Defensive guard: should never happen, but avoids a hard crash.
                    continue;
                }

                let mut light_count = 0u32;
                for (light_idx, light) in lights.iter().enumerate() {
                    if sphere_intersects_cluster(
                        light.position,
                        light.radius,
                        cluster_x,
                        cluster_y,
                        cluster_z,
                        cluster_info,
                        cluster_bounds,
                        cam_pos,
                        view_proj,
                    ) {
                        light_indices.push(light_idx as u32);
                        light_count += 1;

                        // Cap lights per cluster to prevent excessive computation
                        if light_count >= cluster_config::MAX_LIGHTS_PER_CLUSTER {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                cluster_metadata[cluster_idx] = ClusterMetadata {
                    offset: current_offset,
                    count: light_count,
                };
                current_offset += light_count;
            }
        }
    }

    ClusterLightAssignment {
        light_indices,
        cluster_metadata,
        cluster_bounds: cluster_bounds.to_vec(),
        cluster_count: num_clusters as u32,
        depth_slices: cluster_info.depth_slices,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_cluster_info_computation() {
        let camera = Camera::new(std::f32::consts::PI / 4.0, 16.0 / 9.0, 0.1, 1000.0);
        let info = ClusterInfo::new(1920, 1080, &camera);

        assert_eq!(info.clusters_x, (1920 + 15) / 16);
        assert_eq!(info.clusters_y, (1080 + 15) / 16);
        assert_eq!(info.depth_slices, cluster_config::CLUSTER_DEPTH);
        assert_eq!(info.screen_width, 1920);
        assert_eq!(info.screen_height, 1080);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_get_cluster_indices() {
        let camera = Camera::new(std::f32::consts::PI / 4.0, 16.0 / 9.0, 0.1, 1000.0);
        let info = ClusterInfo::new(1920, 1080, &camera);

        // Test valid cluster
        let (cx, cy, cz) = get_cluster_indices(100.0, 200.0, 5.0, &info).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cx, 100 / 16);
        assert_eq!(cy, 200 / 16);
        assert!(cz < info.depth_slices);

        // Test out of bounds
        let result = get_cluster_indices(2000.0, 200.0, 5.0, &info);
        assert!(result.is_none());
    }
}

//! Thin facade over [`crate::renderer::Renderer`] for backward-compatible examples.

use std::ops::{Deref, DerefMut};
use std::sync::Arc;

use winit::window::Window;

pub use crate::renderer::ShaderDebugVizMode;

use crate::renderer::Renderer;

use crate::virtual_geometry::runtime::VGConfig;

/// Backward-compatible rendering facade. Delegates to [`Renderer`].
pub struct RenderContext(Renderer);

impl Deref for RenderContext {
    type Target = Renderer;
    fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl DerefMut for RenderContext {
    fn deref_mut(&mut self) -> &mut Self::Target {
        &mut self.0
    }
}

impl RenderContext {
    pub async fn new(window: Arc<Window>, present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode) -> Self {
        Self(Renderer::new(window, present_mode).await)

    }

    /// Legacy single-call render (acquires surface texture internally).

        self.0.render_frame(objects)
    }

    pub fn init_virtual_geometry(&mut self, config: VGConfig) {
        self.0.init_virtual_geometry(config);
    }
}

//! Per-frame render inputs assembled by the game / app layer.

use crate::camera::Camera;
use crate::light::LightScene;
use crate::resource::ibl::IBLResource;
use crate::systems::RenderObject;

/// Everything the renderer needs to draw one frame besides GPU state.
///
/// Pass order is fixed inside [`crate::renderer::Renderer::render_frame`]:
/// shadows → normals → SSAO → skybox → opaque PBR → transparent → VG → TAA → tonemap.
pub struct FrameView<'a> {
    pub camera: &'a Camera,
    pub objects: &'a [RenderObject],
    pub lights: &'a LightScene,
    pub environment: Option<&'a IBLResource>,
}

impl<'a> FrameView<'a> {
    pub fn new(
        camera: &'a Camera,
        objects: &'a [RenderObject],
        lights: &'a LightScene,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            camera,
            objects,
            lights,
            environment: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_environment(mut self, env: &'a IBLResource) -> Self {
        self.environment = Some(env);
        self
    }
}
