```rust
//! Normal and Depth pre-pass.
//!
//! Renders world-space normals and linear depth to an RGBA16 texture.
//! This data is used by SSAO and other post-processing effects.

use crate::mesh::CompressedVertex;
use crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT;
use crate::shader::{NORMAL_WGSL, create_shader_with_vertex_decode};

pub struct NormalPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl NormalPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("normal_pass_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                // Global (Camera)
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX | wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                // Models (Storage)
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX | wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("normal_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_with_vertex_decode(device, "normal_shader", NORMAL_WGSL);

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("normal_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[CompressedVertex::buffer_layout()],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
                cull_mode: Some(wgpu::Face::Back),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: true,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::Less,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! GPU particle billboards: compute compaction + indirect instanced draw.
//!
//! CPU simulation lives in `redox_vfx`; this module uploads [`GpuParticle`]
//! slices and draws camera-facing quads. An optional compute pass can re-sim
//! on GPU when [`ParticleGpuSystem::gpu_sim_enabled`] is true.

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};
use redox_vfx::{GpuParticle, ParticleSimUniforms, ParticleSystem};

use crate::camera::CameraUniform;
use crate::pass::shared_layouts::DEPTH_FORMAT;
use crate::shader::{PARTICLE_BILLBOARD_WGSL, PARTICLE_SIM_WGSL};

/// Matches WGSL `DrawIndirect` (instance_count may be atomic in sim shader).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct ParticleDrawIndirect {
    pub vertex_count: u32,
    pub instance_count: u32,
    pub first_vertex: u32,
    pub first_instance: u32,
}

/// GPU resources for particle simulation and billboard drawing.
pub struct ParticleGpuSystem {
    pub capacity: u32,
    pub gpu_sim_enabled: bool,
    /// Alive count after last upload / sim (for CPU-side queries).
    pub last_alive_count: u32,

    particle_buffer_a: wgpu::Buffer,
    particle_buffer_b: wgpu::Buffer,
    /// When true, the draw pass reads `particle_buffer_a`.
    draw_from_a: bool,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    alive_counter: wgpu::Buffer,
    indirect_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    sim_uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,

    reset_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    sim_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    finalize_pipeline: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    sim_bind_group_a: wgpu::BindGroup,
    sim_bind_group_b: wgpu::BindGroup,

    draw_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    draw_pipeline_reactive: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    draw_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    camera_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,

    ping: bool,
}

impl ParticleGpuSystem {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, capacity: u32, hdr_format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let capacity = capacity.max(1);
        let particle_bytes = (capacity as u64) * GpuParticle::STRIDE as u64;

        let particle_buffer_a = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_storage_a"),
            size: particle_bytes,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_SRC,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let particle_buffer_b = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_storage_b"),
            size: particle_bytes,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_SRC,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let alive_counter = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_alive_counter"),
            size: 4,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let indirect_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_indirect"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<ParticleDrawIndirect>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::INDIRECT
                | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let sim_uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_sim_uniforms"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<ParticleSimUniforms>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let camera_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_camera"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<CameraUniform>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        let sim_shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_sim_shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(PARTICLE_SIM_WGSL.into()),
        });
        let draw_shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_billboard_shader"),
            source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(PARTICLE_BILLBOARD_WGSL.into()),
        });

        let sim_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_sim_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                uniform_entry(0, wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE),
                storage_entry(1, true),
                storage_entry(2, false),
                storage_entry(3, false),
                storage_entry(4, false),
            ],
        });

        let sim_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_sim_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&sim_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let reset_pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_reset_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&sim_layout),
            module: &sim_shader,
            entry_point: "cs_reset",
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        });
        let sim_pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_sim_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&sim_layout),
            module: &sim_shader,
            entry_point: "cs_main",
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        });
        let finalize_pipeline = device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_finalize_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&sim_layout),
            module: &sim_shader,
            entry_point: "cs_finalize",
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        });

        let make_sim_bg = |read: &wgpu::Buffer, write: &wgpu::Buffer| {
            device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                label: Some("particle_sim_bg"),
                layout: &sim_bgl,
                entries: &[
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        resource: sim_uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        resource: read.as_entire_binding(),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 2,
                        resource: write.as_entire_binding(),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 3,
                        resource: alive_counter.as_entire_binding(),
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 4,
                        resource: indirect_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                    },
                ],
            })
        };

        let sim_bind_group_a = make_sim_bg(&particle_buffer_a, &particle_buffer_b);
        let sim_bind_group_b = make_sim_bg(&particle_buffer_b, &particle_buffer_a);

        let draw_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_draw_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                uniform_entry(0, wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX),
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let draw_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_draw_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&draw_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let blend = wgpu::BlendState {
            color: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::SrcAlpha,
                dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::OneMinusSrcAlpha,
                operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
            },
            alpha: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::OneMinusSrcAlpha,
                operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
            },
        };

        let draw_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_draw_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&draw_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &draw_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &draw_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: Some(blend),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: false,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let draw_pipeline_reactive = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_draw_pipeline_reactive"),
            layout: Some(&draw_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &draw_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &draw_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[
                    Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: hdr_format,
                        blend: Some(blend),
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    }),
                    Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
                        blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::RED,
                    }),
                ],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleStrip,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: false,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let draw_bind_group = Self::make_draw_bind_group(
            device,
            &draw_bgl,
            &camera_buffer,
            &particle_buffer_a,
        );

        Self {
            capacity,
            gpu_sim_enabled: true,
            last_alive_count: 0,
            particle_buffer_a,
            particle_buffer_b,
            draw_from_a: true,
            alive_counter,
            indirect_buffer,
            sim_uniform_buffer,
            reset_pipeline,
            sim_pipeline,
            finalize_pipeline,
            sim_bind_group_a,
            sim_bind_group_b,
            draw_pipeline,
            draw_pipeline_reactive,
            draw_bind_group,
            camera_buffer,
            ping: false,
        }
    }

    /// Upload CPU-simulated particles from [`ParticleSystem`].
    pub fn upload_from_vfx(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        system: &ParticleSystem,
        camera: &CameraUniform,
    ) {
        self.upload_slice(
            device,
            queue,
            system.buffer().raw(),
            system.alive_count(),
            camera,
        );
    }

    /// Upload a raw particle slice (typically alive prefix of a VFX buffer).
    pub fn upload_slice(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        particles: &[GpuParticle],
        alive_count: usize,
        camera: &CameraUniform,
    ) {
        let alive = alive_count.min(particles.len()).min(self.capacity as usize);
        self.last_alive_count = alive as u32;

        queue.write_buffer(
            &self.particle_buffer_a,
            0,
            bytemuck::cast_slice(&particles[..alive.min(particles.len())]),
        );
        self.draw_from_a = true;
        self.refresh_draw_bind_group(device);

        let args = ParticleDrawIndirect {
            vertex_count: 4,
            instance_count: alive as u32,
            first_vertex: 0,
            first_instance: 0,
        };
        queue.write_buffer(&self.indirect_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&args));
        queue.write_buffer(&self.camera_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(camera));
    }

    fn draw_buffer(&self) -> &wgpu::Buffer {
        if self.draw_from_a {
            &self.particle_buffer_a
        } else {
            &self.particle_buffer_b
        }
    }

    fn refresh_draw_bind_group(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device) {
        let draw_bgl = self.draw_pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0);
        self.draw_bind_group = Self::make_draw_bind_group(
            device,
            &draw_bgl,
            &self.camera_buffer,
            self.draw_buffer(),
        );
    }

    fn make_draw_bind_group(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        particle_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_draw_bg"),
            layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: particle_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    /// Optional GPU re-simulation (integrate + compact + indirect args).
    pub fn record_gpu_sim(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        uniforms: &ParticleSimUniforms,
    ) {
        if !self.gpu_sim_enabled {
            return;
        }

        queue.write_buffer(&self.sim_uniform_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(uniforms));

        let use_b = self.ping;
        self.ping = !self.ping;
        self.draw_from_a = use_b;
        self.refresh_draw_bind_group(device);

        let sim_bg = if use_b {
            &self.sim_bind_group_b
        } else {
            &self.sim_bind_group_a
        };

        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("particle_sim_reset"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.reset_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, sim_bg, &[]);
            pass.dispatch_workgroups(1, 1, 1);
        }
        {
            let groups = (self.capacity + 255) / 256;
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("particle_sim_integrate"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.sim_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, sim_bg, &[]);
            pass.dispatch_workgroups(groups, 1, 1);
        }
        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("particle_sim_finalize"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.finalize_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, sim_bg, &[]);
            pass.dispatch_workgroups(1, 1, 1);
        }
    }

    /// Draw billboards after opaque geometry; optionally marks reactive mask.
    pub fn record_draw<'a>(
        &'a self,
        render_pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>,
        reactive_view: Option<&'a wgpu::TextureView>,
    ) {
        if self.last_alive_count == 0 && !self.gpu_sim_enabled {
            return;
        }
        let pipeline = if reactive_view.is_some() {
            &self.draw_pipeline_reactive
        } else {
            &self.draw_pipeline
        };
        render_pass.set_pipeline(pipeline);
        render_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.draw_bind_group, &[]);
        render_pass.draw_indirect(&self.indirect_buffer, 0);
    }

    /// Begin a particle render pass (HDR + optional reactive R8).
    pub fn begin_draw_pass<'a>(
        &'a self,
        encoder: &'a mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        hdr_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
        depth_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
        reactive_view: Option<&'a wgpu::TextureView>,
    ) -> wgpu::RenderPass<'a> {
        let color_attachments: &[Option<wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment>] =
            if let Some(reactive) = reactive_view {
                &[
                    Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: hdr_view,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    }),
                    Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: reactive,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    }),
                ]
            } else {
                &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: hdr_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })]
            };

        encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("particle_pass"),
            color_attachments,
            depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                view: depth_view,
                depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                }),
                stencil_ops: None,
            }),
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
        })
    }
}

fn uniform_entry(binding: u32, visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

fn storage_entry(binding: u32, read_only: bool) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::COMPUTE,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only },
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}
```

### `src/pass/pbr.rs` | **Строк:** 689

```rust
//! Physically-based rendering (PBR) pass.
//!
//! `PbrPass` owns the PBR render pipeline and bind-group layouts.
//! It uses the Cook-Torrance BRDF model for realistic shading.
//!
//! Bind groups (Phase 2.2):
//!   0 — Frame/global (camera, IBL, blue noise)
//!   1 — Pass/scene (lights, shadows, clusters, DDGI, SDF)
//!   2 — Materials
//!   3 — Instances (model storage)

use crate::mesh::CompressedVertex;
use crate::pass::shared_layouts::{DEPTH_FORMAT, multisample_state};
use crate::shader::{PBR_WGSL, create_shader_with_vertex_decode};

/// The main PBR render pass.
pub struct PbrPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,

    // Bind-group layouts
    pub frame_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub scene_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub material_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub model_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl PbrPass {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        surface_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        sample_count: u32,
    ) -> Self {
```

```rust
//! ScatterLight fullscreen pass — stochastic K-sample point-light accumulation.
//!
//! RedOx alternative to clustered forward for many dynamic point lights.

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};

use crate::shader::{SCATTER_LIGHT_WGSL, create_shader_module};

/// Default stochastic samples per pixel (K).
pub const SCATTER_LIGHT_SAMPLE_COUNT: u32 = 8;

/// GPU uniform for the ScatterLight pass (binding 4).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct ScatterLightUniform {
    pub num_lights: u32,
    pub sample_count: u32,
    pub frame_index: u32,
    pub _pad: u32,
    pub resolution: [f32; 2],
}

impl Default for ScatterLightUniform {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            num_lights: 0,
            sample_count: SCATTER_LIGHT_SAMPLE_COUNT,
            frame_index: 0,
            _pad: 0,
            resolution: [1.0, 1.0],
        }
    }
}

/// Fullscreen ScatterLight compositing pass.
pub struct ScatterLightPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
}

impl ScatterLightPass {

            entries: &[

                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,

                    count: None,

                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("scatter_light_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("scatter_light_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState::default(),
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("scatter_light_uniform"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<ScatterLightUniform>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            uniform_buffer,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        hdr_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        depth_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
        point_lights_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("scatter_light_bg"),
            layout: &self.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(hdr_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: point_lights_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    pub fn draw<'a>(&'a self, pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>, bind_group: &'a wgpu::BindGroup) {
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, bind_group, &[]);
        pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Shadow mapping pass.
//!
//! Renders the scene from the light's perspective into a depth texture.

use crate::shader::{SHADOW_WGSL, create_shader_with_vertex_decode};

pub const SHADOW_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float;
pub const SHADOW_SIZE: u32 = 2048;

/// Pass for rendering shadow maps.
pub struct ShadowPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub model_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl ShadowPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let model_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_model_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout, &model_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_with_vertex_decode(device, "shadow_shader", SHADOW_WGSL);

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[crate::mesh::compress::compressed_position_layout()],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: None, // No fragment shader for classic shadow pass (writes to depth texture)
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
                cull_mode: None, // dual-face: thin casters / silhouettes stay solid
                unclipped_depth: false,
                polygon_mode: wgpu::PolygonMode::Fill,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: SHADOW_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: true,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                // Bias kept minimal: large constant/slope on Depth32Float was
                // pushing caster depth past receivers → cast shadows vanished.
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState {
                    constant: 0,
                    slope_scale: 0.0,
                    clamp: 0.0,
                },
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            model_bgl,
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Shared bind-group layouts and depth helpers used across render passes.
//!
//! Replaces the legacy `ForwardPass` name — the forward shading pipeline is
//! unused; PBR owns the main draw path. This module only exposes BGL factories
//! and [`ModelUniform`] shared by shadow, PBR, and debug passes.
//!
//! ## PBR bind-group split (Phase 2.2) — wired
//!
//! | Group | Role            | Bindings                                                        |
//! |-------|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
//! | **0** | Frame / global  | Camera, shader debug, IBL textures, BRDF LUT, blue noise       |
//! | **1** | Pass / scene    | Lights, shadows, clusters, VSM, DDGI, SDF atlas                |
//! | **2** | Materials       | Material uniform + albedo/normal/MR textures                   |
//! | **3** | Instances       | Model storage buffer                                           |

use crate::resource::texture::Texture;

/// Depth texture format used by opaque passes.
pub const DEPTH_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float;

/// Multisample state for HDR geometry passes (color-only MSAA; depth stays 1×).
pub fn multisample_state(count: u32) -> wgpu::MultisampleState {
    wgpu::MultisampleState {
        count: count.max(1),
        mask: !0,
        alpha_to_coverage_enabled: false,
    }
}

/// Shared bind-group layouts for camera, light, model, and texture bindings.
pub struct SharedLayouts {
    pub camera_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub light_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub model_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub texture_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

/// Per-instance model data in the storage buffer.
///
/// Layout matches WGSL `Model`: mat4 (64B) + mat3x3 (48B) + vec4 color +
/// vec4 bounds_min + vec4 bounds_extent = 160 bytes.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
pub struct ModelUniform {
    pub model: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    pub normal_matrix: [[f32; 4]; 3],
    pub color: [f32; 4],
    pub bounds_min: [f32; 4],
    pub bounds_extent: [f32; 4],
}

impl SharedLayouts {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let camera_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("camera_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX | wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let light_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("light_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let model_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("model_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let texture_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("texture_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        multisampled: false,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        Self {
            camera_bgl,
            light_bgl,
            model_bgl,
            texture_bgl,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_camera_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("camera_bg"),
            layout: &self.camera_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_light_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("light_bg"),
            layout: &self.light_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_model_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("model_bg"),
            layout: &self.model_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_texture_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        texture: &Texture,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("texture_bg"),
            layout: &self.texture_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&texture.view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&texture.sampler),
                },
            ],
        })
    }
}

/// Creates a depth texture matching the given surface dimensions.
pub fn create_depth_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let size = wgpu::Extent3d {
        width: width.max(1),
        height: height.max(1),
        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
    };
    let tex = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("depth_texture"),
        size,
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_SRC,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = tex.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (tex, view)
}

/// Backward-compatible alias used during migration.
pub type ForwardPass = SharedLayouts;

/// Factory for the planned frame-level bind group (camera + shared samplers).
pub struct PbrFrameLayouts {
    pub camera_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub sampler_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl PbrFrameLayouts {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let camera_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("pbr_frame_camera_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX | wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });
        let sampler_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("pbr_frame_samplers_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Comparison),
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });
        Self {
            camera_bgl,
            sampler_bgl,
        }
    }
}

/// Factory for the planned scene/shadow bind group (CSM, clusters, VSM, SDF).
pub struct PbrSceneLayouts {
    pub light_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub shadow_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl PbrSceneLayouts {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        let light_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("pbr_scene_light_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {

                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {

        let shadow_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {

                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });
        Self {
            light_bgl,
            shadow_bgl,
        }
    }
}

/// Documents the four-group PBR layout (wired in `pbr.wgsl` / `PbrPass`).
pub struct PbrBindGroupPlan;
```

### `src/pass/skybox.rs` | **Строк:** 188

```rust
//! Skybox background pass.
//!
//! Draws a fullscreen triangle into the HDR buffer **before** opaque
//! geometry, sampling the environment cubemap along the per-pixel view ray.
//! The pipeline writes depth `1.0` with `LessEqual` compare, so it passes
//! against freshly cleared depth and is then overdrawn by all scene geometry.

use crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT;
use crate::pass::shared_layouts::multisample_state;
use crate::shader::{SKYBOX_WGSL, create_shader_module};

/// Skybox background pass: env cubemap + camera uniform in one bind group.
pub struct SkyboxPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    /// Layout for group 0: (0) env cubemap view, (1) filtering sampler,
    /// (2) camera uniform matching [`crate::camera::CameraUniform`].
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    /// Bind group over the environment view, sampler, and camera buffer.
    /// Refresh via [`Self::refresh_bind_group`] when the environment changes.
    pub bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
}

impl SkyboxPass {
    /// Builds the skybox pipeline, bind-group layout, and initial bind group.
    ///
    /// `camera_buffer` must hold a [`crate::camera::CameraUniform`]
    /// (`queue.write_buffer` updates stay visible through the bind group).
    /// `env_view` is a cube-dimension view of the environment map and
    /// `env_sampler` any filtering sampler.
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        env_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        env_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
        hdr_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        sample_count: u32,
    ) -> Self {
        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "skybox_shader", SKYBOX_WGSL);

        let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("skybox_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                // 0: environment cubemap
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                // 1: environment sampler
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
                // 2: camera uniform
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX | wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("skybox_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("skybox_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            // Fullscreen triangle; culling disabled so winding never bites.
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                cull_mode: None,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            // Writes far-plane depth first so every later opaque fragment wins.
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: true,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: multisample_state(sample_count),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let bind_group = Self::build_bind_group(
            device,
            &bind_group_layout,
            camera_buffer,
            env_view,
            env_sampler,
        );

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            bind_group,
        }
    }

    /// Recreates the group-0 bind group for a (possibly new) environment view.
    ///
    /// Call whenever the environment changes, e.g. after
    /// [`crate::RenderContext::set_environment`].
    pub fn refresh_bind_group(
        &mut self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        env_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        env_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) {
        self.bind_group = Self::build_bind_group(
            device,
            &self.bind_group_layout,
            camera_buffer,
            env_view,
            env_sampler,
        );
    }

    fn build_bind_group(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        env_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        env_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("skybox_bind_group"),
            layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(env_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(env_sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    /// Records one fullscreen-triangle draw. Call right after the depth clear,
    /// before opaque draws, inside the forward HDR render pass.
    pub fn draw<'a>(&'a self, render_pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>) {
        render_pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
        render_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.bind_group, &[]);
        render_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
    }
}
```

### `src/pass/smaa.rs` | **Строк:** 558

```rust
//! SMAA 1× anti-aliasing pass (Subpixel Morphological Anti-Aliasing).
//!
//! Three-pass fullscreen post-process ported from iryoku's SMAA with
//! PRESET_HIGH configuration:
//! - threshold = 0.05
//! - max_search_steps = 16
//! - max_search_steps_diag = 8
//! - corner_rounding = 25
//!
//! ## Pipeline
//! 1. **Edge detection** (luma): LDR input → `edges_tex` (Rg8Unorm)
//! 2. **Blend weight calculation**: edges + area/search LUTs → `blend_tex` (Rgba8Unorm)
//! 3. **Neighborhood blending**: LDR input + blend weights → anti-aliased output

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};
use crate::shader::{
    SMAA_EDGE_WGSL, SMAA_BLEND_WGSL, SMAA_NEIGHBORHOOD_WGSL, create_shader_module,
};

// ─── Precomputed lookup textures (embedded at compile time) ──────────────────

const AREA_TEX_BYTES: &[u8] =
    include_bytes!("../../assets/smaa/AreaTexDX10.bin");
const SEARCH_TEX_BYTES: &[u8] =
    include_bytes!("../../assets/smaa/SearchTex.bin");

const AREA_TEX_WIDTH: u32 = 160;
const AREA_TEX_HEIGHT: u32 = 560;
const SEARCH_TEX_WIDTH: u32 = 64;
const SEARCH_TEX_HEIGHT: u32 = 16;

// ─── Uniform ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
struct SmaaMetrics {
    rt_metrics: [f32; 4], // (1/w, 1/h, w, h)
}

// ─── Pass struct ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub struct SmaaPass {
    edge_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    edge_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    blend_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    blend_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    neighborhood_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    neighborhood_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,

    sampler_linear: wgpu::Sampler,
    sampler_point: wgpu::Sampler,
    uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,

    area_tex_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    search_tex_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    _area_tex: wgpu::Texture,
    _search_tex: wgpu::Texture,

    edges_tex: wgpu::Texture,
    edges_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    blend_tex: wgpu::Texture,
    blend_view: wgpu::TextureView,

    width: u32,
    height: u32,
}

impl SmaaPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue) -> Self {
        // ── Upload area + search textures ────────────────────────────────────
        let (area_tex, area_tex_view) = upload_lut(
            device,
            queue,
            "smaa_area_tex",
            AREA_TEX_WIDTH,
            AREA_TEX_HEIGHT,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm,
            AREA_TEX_BYTES,
            2,
        );
        let (search_tex, search_tex_view) = upload_lut(
            device,
            queue,
            "smaa_search_tex",
            SEARCH_TEX_WIDTH,
            SEARCH_TEX_HEIGHT,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
            SEARCH_TEX_BYTES,
            1,
        );

        // ── Samplers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let sampler_linear = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_linear_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let sampler_point = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_point_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        // ── Uniform buffer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_uniform"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<SmaaMetrics>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        // ── Pass 1: Edge detection ───────────────────────────────────────────
        let edge_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_edge_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                tex_entry(0, true),       // t_color (filterable)
                sampler_entry(1, true),   // s_linear
                uniform_entry(2),         // uniform
            ],
        });
        let edge_pipeline = create_fullscreen_pipeline(
            device,
            "smaa_edge",
            SMAA_EDGE_WGSL,
            &edge_bgl,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm,
        );

        // ── Pass 2: Blend weight calculation ─────────────────────────────────
        let blend_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_blend_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                tex_entry(0, true),       // t_edges
                tex_entry(1, true),       // t_area
                tex_entry(2, true),       // t_search
                sampler_entry(3, true),   // s_linear
                sampler_entry(4, false),  // s_point
                uniform_entry(5),         // uniform
            ],
        });
        let blend_pipeline = create_fullscreen_pipeline(
            device,
            "smaa_blend",
            SMAA_BLEND_WGSL,
            &blend_bgl,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
        );

        // ── Pass 3: Neighborhood blending ────────────────────────────────────
        let neighborhood_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_neighborhood_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                tex_entry(0, true),       // t_color
                tex_entry(1, true),       // t_blend
                sampler_entry(2, true),   // s_linear
                sampler_entry(3, false),  // s_point
                uniform_entry(4),         // uniform
            ],
        });
        let neighborhood_pipeline = create_fullscreen_pipeline(
            device,
            "smaa_neighborhood",
            SMAA_NEIGHBORHOOD_WGSL,
            &neighborhood_bgl,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
        );

        // ── Intermediate textures (1×1 placeholder, resized on first use) ───
        let (edges_tex, edges_view) = create_intermediate(
            device,
            "smaa_edges",
            1,
            1,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm,
        );
        let (blend_tex, blend_view) = create_intermediate(
            device,
            "smaa_blend",
            1,
            1,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
        );

        Self {
            edge_pipeline,
            edge_bgl,
            blend_pipeline,
            blend_bgl,
            neighborhood_pipeline,
            neighborhood_bgl,
            sampler_linear,
            sampler_point,
            uniform_buffer,
            area_tex_view,
            search_tex_view,
            _area_tex: area_tex,
            _search_tex: search_tex,
            edges_tex,
            edges_view,
            blend_tex,
            blend_view,
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
        }
    }

    /// Recreate intermediate textures and update the uniform with new dimensions.
    pub fn resize(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, width: u32, height: u32) {
        if self.width == width && self.height == height {
            return;
        }
        self.width = width;
        self.height = height;

        let (edges_tex, edges_view) = create_intermediate(
            device,
            "smaa_edges",
            width,
            height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg8Unorm,
        );
        self.edges_tex = edges_tex;
        self.edges_view = edges_view;

        let (blend_tex, blend_view) = create_intermediate(
            device,
            "smaa_blend",
            width,
            height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
        );
        self.blend_tex = blend_tex;
        self.blend_view = blend_view;
    }

    /// Record the full 3-pass SMAA pipeline.
    ///
    /// - `color_view`: LDR input texture (post-ACES, Rgba8Unorm).
    /// - `out_view`: destination for the anti-aliased result (same format).
    pub fn record(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
        color_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        out_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) {
        // Upload uniform
        let metrics = SmaaMetrics {
            rt_metrics: [
                1.0 / self.width as f32,
                1.0 / self.height as f32,
                self.width as f32,
                self.height as f32,
            ],
        };
        queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform_buffer, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&metrics));

        // ── Pass 1: Edge detection ───────────────────────────────────────────
        let edge_bg = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_edge_bg"),
            layout: &self.edge_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(color_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler_linear),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("smaa_edge_pass"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &self.edges_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                ..Default::default()
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.edge_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &edge_bg, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        }

        // ── Pass 2: Blend weight calculation ─────────────────────────────────
        let blend_bg = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_blend_bg"),
            layout: &self.blend_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.edges_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.area_tex_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.search_tex_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler_linear),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler_point),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("smaa_blend_pass"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &self.blend_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                ..Default::default()
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.blend_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &blend_bg, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        }

        // ── Pass 3: Neighborhood blending ────────────────────────────────────
        let neighborhood_bg = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("smaa_neighborhood_bg"),
            layout: &self.neighborhood_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(color_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&self.blend_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler_linear),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler_point),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        {
            let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("smaa_neighborhood_pass"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: out_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                ..Default::default()
            });
            pass.set_pipeline(&self.neighborhood_pipeline);
            pass.set_bind_group(0, &neighborhood_bg, &[]);
            pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        }
    }
}

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn upload_lut(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
    label: &str,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    data: &[u8],
    bytes_per_pixel: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width,
            height,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
            texture: &texture,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        data,
        wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(bytes_per_pixel * width),
            rows_per_image: Some(height),
        },
        wgpu::Extent3d {
            width,
            height,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
    );
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

fn create_intermediate(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    label: &str,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

fn create_fullscreen_pipeline(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    label: &str,
    shader_source: &str,
    bgl: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    target_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
    let shader = create_shader_module(device, &format!("{label}_shader"), shader_source);
    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some(&format!("{label}_layout")),
        bind_group_layouts: &[bgl],
        push_constant_ranges: &[],
    });
    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "vs_main",
            buffers: &[],
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "fs_main",
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format: target_format,
                blend: None,
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
            compilation_options: Default::default(),
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
        multiview: None,
    })
}

fn tex_entry(binding: u32, filterable: bool) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable },
            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
            multisampled: false,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}

fn sampler_entry(binding: u32, filtering: bool) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(if filtering {
            wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering
        } else {
            wgpu::SamplerBindingType::NonFiltering
        }),
        count: None,
    }
}

fn uniform_entry(binding: u32) -> wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
        binding,
        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX_FRAGMENT,
        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
            has_dynamic_offset: false,
            min_binding_size: None,
        },
        count: None,
    }
}
```
