```rust
//! Temporal Anti-Aliasing (TAA) render pass.
//!
//! Blends the current jittered HDR frame with an accumulated history buffer
//! to produce a stable, alias-reduced output.  Two `Rgba16Float` textures are
//! kept in a ping-pong arrangement — one is read as history, the other is
//! written as the new accumulated result.
//!
//! ## Algorithm overview
//! 1. Sample the current HDR frame at the current UV.
//! 2. Build a 3×3 neighbourhood colour-AABB for ghosting rejection.
//! 3. Fetch the motion vector from the velocity buffer, compute reprojected UV.
//! 4. Sample history at the reprojected UV (bilinear).
//! 5. Clamp history to the colour AABB.
//! 6. Lerp: `result = mix(clamped_history, current, alpha)` (alpha ≈ 0.1).
//! 7. On the first frame (or resize) set `reset = 1` to skip history blending.
//!
//! ## Bind group (group 0)
//! | binding | resource          | format / type       |
//! |---------|-------------------|---------------------|
//! | 0       | current HDR       | `texture_2d<f32>`   |
//! | 1       | velocity texture  | `texture_2d<f32>`   |
//! | 2       | history texture   | `texture_2d<f32>`   |
//! | 3       | linear sampler    | `sampler`           |
//! | 4       | `TaaUniform`      | uniform buffer      |
//! | 5       | reactive mask     | `texture_2d` R8     |

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};

use crate::resource::buffer::create_uniform_buffer;
use crate::shader::{TAA_WGSL, create_shader_module};

// ── Halton low-discrepancy sequence ─────────────────────────────────────────

/// Evaluates the Halton sequence at `index` for the given `base`.
///
/// Returns a value in (0, 1].  Using bases 2 and 3 gives excellent 2-D
/// coverage for subpixel jitter (the same bases as Unreal Engine TAA).
pub fn halton(mut index: u64, base: u64) -> f32 {
    let mut f = 1.0f32;
    let mut r = 0.0f32;
    while index > 0 {
        f /= base as f32;
        r += f * (index % base) as f32;
        index /= base;
    }
    r
}

/// Computes the subpixel jitter for `frame_index` in **NDC units** such that
/// `proj.z_axis.x -= jitter.x` and `proj.z_axis.y -= jitter.y` produce a
/// constant screen-space shift of ±0.5 pixels, independent of depth.
///
/// The returned delta is already sign-adjusted for the column-2 insertion
/// (see `apply_jitter_to_projection`).
pub fn halton_jitter_ndc(frame_index: u64, width: u32, height: u32) -> [f32; 2] {
    // Period-16 Halton cycle (matches Unreal/AMD TSR jitter sequence).
    let i = frame_index % 16;
    let px = halton(i + 1, 2) - 0.5; // base-2
    let py = halton(i + 1, 3) - 0.5; // base-3
    // Convert pixel offset to NDC offset
    let nx = px * 2.0 / width as f32;
    let ny = py * 2.0 / height as f32;
    [nx, ny]
}

/// Applies a subpixel jitter to a projection matrix (glam column-major).
///
/// Modifies `proj.z_axis.{x,y}` (column 2, rows 0 and 1) so that the
/// resulting NDC position is shifted by `(jitter_ndc[0], jitter_ndc[1])`.
///
/// Derivation (perspective_rh, clip_w = -view_z):
/// ```text
/// NDC_x = (f/aspect * view_x  +  z_axis.x * view_z) / (-view_z)
///       = NDC_x_orig  -  z_axis.x
/// ```
/// Therefore `z_axis.x -= jitter_ndc_x` shifts NDC_x by +jitter_ndc_x, independent
/// of depth. Must be applied to **projection** `P`, never to combined `P*V`.
pub fn apply_jitter_to_projection(
    proj: redox_math::Mat4,
    jitter_ndc: [f32; 2],
) -> redox_math::Mat4 {
    let mut p = proj;
    p.z_axis.x -= jitter_ndc[0];
    p.z_axis.y -= jitter_ndc[1];
    p
}

// ── Uniform ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Parameters uploaded to the TAA shader every frame.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct TaaUniform {
    /// Output (present) resolution in pixels.
    pub output_size: [f32; 2],
    /// Input (internal render) resolution in pixels.
    pub input_size: [f32; 2],
    /// Fraction of the *current* frame blended in (typical: 0.05–0.10).
    /// Lower → more stable but slower to clear ghosting.
    pub blend_alpha: f32,
    /// Set to `1` on the first frame after creation/resize; `0` otherwise.
    /// When non-zero the shader skips history blending (avoids stale history).
    pub reset: u32,
    /// Current frame Halton jitter in UV (`ndc * 0.5` with Y flipped).
    pub jitter_uv: [f32; 2],
}

impl Default for TaaUniform {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            output_size: [1920.0, 1080.0],
            input_size: [1920.0, 1080.0],
            blend_alpha: 0.1,
            reset: 1,
            jitter_uv: [0.0, 0.0],
        }
    }
}

// ── Pass struct ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// The TAA render pass.
///
/// Owns the pipeline, sampler, and the uniform buffer.
/// The **ping-pong history textures** are owned by [`RenderContext`] so they
/// can be shared with the tone-mapping pass.
pub struct TaaPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    /// Bilinear clamp sampler used for all TAA texture samples.
    pub sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
    /// Uniform buffer (`TaaUniform`), updated each frame.
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    /// 1×1 black fallback reactive mask (0 = no reactive boost).
    pub reactive_fallback_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    _reactive_fallback_texture: wgpu::Texture,
    /// 1×1 far-depth fallback (1.0) for first-frame disocclusion.
    pub prev_depth_fallback_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    _prev_depth_fallback_texture: wgpu::Texture,
}

impl TaaPass {
    /// Creates the TAA pass.
    ///
    /// `hdr_format` should match the HDR and history texture format
    /// (`Rgba16Float` in standard RedOx setup).
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        hdr_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Self {
        // ── Bind group layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        let bind_group_layout =
            device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("taa_bgl"),
                entries: &[
                    // 0 : current HDR frame
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float {
                                filterable: true,
                            },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 1 : velocity texture (motion vectors)
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float {
                                filterable: true,
                            },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 2 : history texture (previous TAA output)
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 2,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float {
                                filterable: true,
                            },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 3 : bilinear sampler
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 3,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 4 : TaaUniform
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 4,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                            has_dynamic_offset: false,
                            min_binding_size: None,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 5 : reactive mask (R8, non-filterable — sampled via textureLoad)
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 5,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float {
                                filterable: false,
                            },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // 6 : previous frame depth (Depth32Float)
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 6,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                ],
            });

        // ── Shader & pipeline ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "taa_shader", TAA_WGSL);

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("taa_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("taa_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        // ── Sampler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("taa_linear_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        // ── Uniform buffer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let uniform_buffer = create_uniform_buffer(
            device,
            "taa_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&TaaUniform::default()),
        );

        let (reactive_fallback_texture, reactive_fallback_view) =
            create_reactive_fallback_texture(device, queue);
        let (prev_depth_fallback_texture, prev_depth_fallback_view) =
            create_prev_depth_fallback_texture(device, queue);

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            sampler,
            uniform_buffer,
            reactive_fallback_view,
            _reactive_fallback_texture: reactive_fallback_texture,
            prev_depth_fallback_view,
            _prev_depth_fallback_texture: prev_depth_fallback_texture,
        }
    }

    /// Creates the bind group for one TAA invocation.
    ///
    /// Pass [`Self::reactive_fallback_view`] until a real reactive mask is wired.
    pub fn create_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        current_hdr_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        velocity_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        history_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        reactive_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        prev_depth_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("taa_bg"),
            layout: &self.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(current_hdr_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(velocity_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(history_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(reactive_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 6,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(prev_depth_view),
                },
            ],
        })
    }
}

/// 1×1 black R8Unorm reactive fallback (0 = TAA uses normal blend alpha).
fn create_reactive_fallback_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("taa_reactive_fallback"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
            texture: &texture,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        &[0u8],
        wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(1),
            rows_per_image: Some(1),
        },
        wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
    );
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// 1×1 Depth32Float fallback (far plane).
fn create_prev_depth_fallback_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    _queue: &wgpu::Queue,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("taa_prev_depth_fallback"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

// ── Helper: create one ping-pong history texture ──────────────────────────────

/// Creates one of the two ping-pong TAA history textures.
///
/// Format: `Rgba16Float`.  Usages: `RENDER_ATTACHMENT | TEXTURE_BINDING`.
pub fn create_history_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    label: &str,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// Creates the velocity (motion-vector) texture.
///
/// Format: `Rgba16Float` (xy = UV delta, zw unused).
/// Usages: `RENDER_ATTACHMENT | TEXTURE_BINDING`.
pub fn create_velocity_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("velocity_texture"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::apply_jitter_to_projection;
    use redox_math::{perspective, Mat4, Vec3, Vec4};

    fn ndc_xy(vp: Mat4, p: Vec3) -> [f32; 2] {
        let c = vp * Vec4::new(p.x, p.y, p.z, 1.0);
        [c.x / c.w, c.y / c.w]
    }

    #[test]
    fn proj_jitter_is_constant_ndc_shift() {
        let view = Mat4::look_at_rh(Vec3::new(4.0, 3.0, 12.0), Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::Y);
        let proj = perspective(0.9, 16.0 / 9.0, 0.1, 200.0);
        let jitter = [0.004, -0.003];
        let vp0 = proj * view;
        let vp1 = apply_jitter_to_projection(proj, jitter) * view;

        for p in [
            Vec3::new(0.0, 0.5, 0.0),
            Vec3::new(8.0, 1.0, -6.0),
            Vec3::new(-3.0, 2.0, 15.0),
        ] {
            let a = ndc_xy(vp0, p);
            let b = ndc_xy(vp1, p);
            assert!(
                (b[0] - a[0] - jitter[0]).abs() < 1e-4,
                "x shift at {p:?}"
            );
            assert!(
                (b[1] - a[1] - jitter[1]).abs() < 1e-4,
                "y shift at {p:?}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn combined_vp_column_jitter_depends_on_world_z() {
        let view = Mat4::look_at_rh(Vec3::new(4.0, 3.0, 12.0), Vec3::ZERO, Vec3::Y);
        let proj = perspective(0.9, 16.0 / 9.0, 0.1, 200.0);
        let jitter = [0.004, 0.0];
        let vp0 = proj * view;
        let mut wrong = vp0;
        wrong.z_axis.x -= jitter[0];

        let p0 = Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
        let p1 = Vec3::new(2.0, 0.0, 5.0);
        let d0 = ndc_xy(wrong, p0)[0] - ndc_xy(vp0, p0)[0];
        let d1 = ndc_xy(wrong, p1)[0] - ndc_xy(vp0, p1)[0];
        assert!(
            (d0 - d1).abs() > 1e-3,
            "wrong-path shifts should differ with world Z ({d0} vs {d1})"
        );
    }
}

```rust
//! Transparent (alpha-blended) geometry pass.
//!
//! Reuses the full PBR shader and bind-group layouts but renders with
//! alpha blending on the colour target and **depth write disabled** so
//! transparent surfaces never occlude each other or later draws. Objects are
//! drawn back-to-front by distance from the camera (sorted in
//! [`crate::RenderContext`], which owns the object list).

use crate::mesh::CompressedVertex;
use crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT;
use crate::pass::shared_layouts::multisample_state;
use crate::pass::pbr::PbrPass;
use crate::shader::{PBR_WGSL, create_shader_with_vertex_decode};

/// Alpha-blended variant of the PBR pipeline.
pub struct TransparentPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
}

impl TransparentPass {
    /// Builds a pipeline with the PBR shader, bind-group layouts, vertex
    /// layout, and raster state of `pbr_pass`, but with `ALPHA_BLENDING`
    /// colour output and depth-write off (`LessEqual` test kept so hidden
    /// fragments behind opaque geometry are skipped).
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        pbr_pass: &PbrPass,
        hdr_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        sample_count: u32,
    ) -> Self {
        let shader = create_shader_with_vertex_decode(device, "pbr_transparent_shader", PBR_WGSL);

        let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("pbr_transparent_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[
                &pbr_pass.frame_bgl,
                &pbr_pass.scene_bgl,
                &pbr_pass.material_bgl,
                &pbr_pass.model_bgl,
            ],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("pbr_transparent_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[CompressedVertex::buffer_layout()],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
                cull_mode: Some(wgpu::Face::Back),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            // Depth is tested against the opaque pass results but never
            // written: transparent objects must not occlude one another.
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: DEPTH_FORMAT,
                depth_write_enabled: false,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: multisample_state(sample_count),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self { pipeline }
    }
}

### `src/pass/velocity.rs` | **Строк:** 169

```rust
//! Velocity (motion-vector) render pass.
//!
//! Produces an `Rgba16Float` texture containing per-pixel screen-space motion
//! vectors (xy = UV delta from previous frame to current, z = depth, w = 1).
//!
//! ## Bind group (group 0)
//! - binding 0 : `texture_depth_2d`  (current depth buffer)
//! - binding 1 : `VelocityUniform`   (inverse current jittered VP, previous VP, screen size)
//!
//! The pass runs as a fullscreen triangle (`draw(0..3, 0..1)`) directly after
//! the main forward pass (depth buffer is fully populated at that point).

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};
use redox_math::Mat4;

use crate::resource::buffer::create_uniform_buffer;
use crate::shader::{VELOCITY_WGSL, create_shader_module};

/// GPU-side uniform for the velocity pass.
///
/// Updated every frame before the pass executes.
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct VelocityUniform {
    /// Inverse of the current frame's **jittered** view-projection matrix.
    /// Used to reconstruct world-space position from NDC + depth.
    pub inv_curr_vp: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Previous frame's **unjittered** view-projection matrix.
    /// Used to find where each world point was on screen last frame.
    pub prev_vp: [[f32; 4]; 4],
    /// Viewport dimensions (width, height) in pixels.
    pub screen_size: [f32; 2],
    /// Current Halton jitter in UV (same conversion as `TaaUniform.jitter_uv`).
    /// Written into sky pixels so TAA's jitter subtract cancels for the background.
    pub jitter_uv: [f32; 2],
}

impl Default for VelocityUniform {
    fn default() -> Self {
        let id = Mat4::IDENTITY.to_cols_array_2d();
        Self {
            inv_curr_vp: id,
            prev_vp: id,
            screen_size: [1920.0, 1080.0],
            jitter_uv: [0.0; 2],
        }
    }
}

/// The velocity buffer render pass.
pub struct VelocityPass {
    /// Render pipeline (fullscreen triangle, depth → motion vectors).
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    /// Layout for the single bind group (depth + uniform).
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    /// Persistent uniform buffer, updated each frame via `queue.write_buffer`.
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
}

impl VelocityPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        // ── Bind group layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        let bind_group_layout =
            device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("velocity_bgl"),
                entries: &[
                    // binding 0 : depth texture (sampled without comparison)
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    // binding 1 : velocity uniform
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                            ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                            has_dynamic_offset: false,
                            min_binding_size: None,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                ],
            });

        // ── Pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "velocity_shader", VELOCITY_WGSL);

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("velocity_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("velocity_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    // Rgba16Float — xy = velocity UV, zw unused but safe on all backends
                    format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        // ── Uniform buffer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let uniform_buffer = create_uniform_buffer(
            device,
            "velocity_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&VelocityUniform::default()),
        );

        Self {
            pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            uniform_buffer,
        }
    }

    /// Creates a bind group for this pass.
    ///
    /// Call once per frame (after updating `uniform_buffer`) because
    /// `depth_view` changes on resize.
    pub fn create_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        depth_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("velocity_bg"),
            layout: &self.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: self.uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        })
    }
}

//! Visibility-buffer shading for Virtual Geometry (Phase 3).
//!
//! Two cooperating passes replace the flat-shaded debug VG path with the full
//! PBR lighting stack (IBL + clustered lights + shadows):
//!
//! 1. [`VgVisPass`] — rasterizes VG meshlets into a *visibility buffer*.
//! 2. [`VgResolvePass`] — fullscreen resolve that shades via the PBR global BG.

use crate::pass::shared_layouts::multisample_state;
use crate::material::{Material, MaterialUniform};
use crate::mesh::CompressedVertex;
use crate::virtual_geometry::indirect::IndirectDrawBuffer;
use crate::shader::{VG_RESOLVE_WGSL, VG_VIS_WGSL, create_shader_module, create_shader_with_vertex_decode};
use crate::virtual_geometry::meshlet::{MeshletDescriptor, VGInstanceData};

/// RT0: packed `(instance_index << 16) | triangle_id`.
pub const VIS_ID_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::R32Uint;
/// RT1: world-space normal.xyz + NDC depth.
pub const VIS_NORMAL_DEPTH_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float;
/// RT2: interpolated mesh UV.
pub const VIS_UV_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rg16Float;

/// RT0 clear value meaning "no VG geometry at this pixel".
pub const VIS_ID_SENTINEL: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;

/// Rasterizes VG meshlets into the visibility buffer.
pub struct VgVisPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    /// group(1): `array<VGInstanceData>` storage (binding 0, vertex stage).
    pub vis_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl VgVisPass {
    /// Creates the visibility pass pipeline.
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        frame_bgl: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        depth_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    ) -> Self {
        let vis_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_vis_instances_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_vis_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[frame_bgl, &vis_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_with_vertex_decode(device, "vg_vis_shader", VG_VIS_WGSL);

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_vis_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[CompressedVertex::buffer_layout()],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[
                    Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: VIS_ID_FORMAT,
                        blend: None,
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    }),
                    Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: VIS_NORMAL_DEPTH_FORMAT,
                        blend: None,
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    }),
                    Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format: VIS_UV_FORMAT,
                        blend: None,
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    }),
                ],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
                cull_mode: Some(wgpu::Face::Back),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: depth_format,
                depth_write_enabled: true,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState::default(),
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self { pipeline, vis_bgl }
    }

    pub fn create_instances_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        instance_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_vis_instances_bg"),
            layout: &self.vis_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: instance_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        })
    }
}

/// Sets pipeline, bind groups, and VG vertex/index buffers on an active pass.
pub fn bind_vis_draw_state<'a>(
    pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>,
    vis: &'a VgVisPass,
    frame_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    instances_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    vertex_buffer: &'a wgpu::Buffer,
    index_buffer: &'a wgpu::Buffer,
) {
    pass.set_pipeline(&vis.pipeline);
    pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_bg, &[]);
    pass.set_bind_group(1, instances_bg, &[]);
    pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, vertex_buffer.slice(..));
    pass.set_index_buffer(index_buffer.slice(..), wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32);
}

/// Fullscreen resolve shading the visibility buffer with full PBR lighting.
pub struct VgResolvePass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    resolve_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl VgResolvePass {
    pub fn new(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        hdr_format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
        frame_bgl: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        scene_bgl: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
        sample_count: u32,
    ) -> Self {
        let resolve_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_resolve_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Uint,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Depth,
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 6,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_resolve_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[frame_bgl, scene_bgl, &resolve_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "vg_resolve_shader", VG_RESOLVE_WGSL);

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_resolve_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: hdr_format,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState::default(),
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: multisample_state(sample_count),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self { pipeline, resolve_bgl }
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn create_resolve_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        rt0_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        rt1_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        rt2_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        depth_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        instances_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        meshlets_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        materials_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_resolve_bg"),
            layout: &self.resolve_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(rt0_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(rt1_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(rt2_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(depth_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 4,
                    resource: instances_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 5,
                    resource: meshlets_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 6,
                    resource: materials_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    pub fn draw<'a>(
        &'a self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>,
        frame_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
        scene_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
        resolve_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    ) {
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_bg, &[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(1, scene_bg, &[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(2, resolve_bg, &[]);
        pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
    }
}

pub fn build_material_storage(
    materials: &[Material],
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    let uniforms: Vec<MaterialUniform> =
        materials.iter().map(|m| m.to_uniform(device)).collect();
    let buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some("vg_material_storage"),
        size: (uniforms.len() * std::mem::size_of::<MaterialUniform>()).max(16) as u64,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
    });
    if !uniforms.is_empty() {
        queue.write_buffer(&buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&uniforms));
    }
    buffer
}

pub fn build_meshlet_storage(
    meshlets: &[MeshletDescriptor],
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    let bytes: &[u8] = bytemuck::cast_slice(meshlets);
    let buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
        label: Some("vg_meshlet_storage"),
        size: bytes.len().max(16) as u64,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
        mapped_at_creation: false,
    });
    if !bytes.is_empty() {
        queue.write_buffer(&buffer, 0, bytes);
    }
    buffer
}

const _: () = {
    use std::mem::size_of;
    assert!(size_of::<MeshletDescriptor>() == 64);
    assert!(size_of::<VGInstanceData>() == 112);
    assert!(size_of::<MaterialUniform>() == 112);
};

// ── Visibility-buffer render targets ──────────────────────────────────────────

/// GPU textures for the VG visibility pass (RT0–RT2).
pub struct VgVisTargets {
    pub id_texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub id_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub normal_depth_texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub normal_depth_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub uv_texture: wgpu::Texture,
    pub uv_view: wgpu::TextureView,
}

/// Allocates visibility-buffer attachments at internal resolution.
pub fn create_vg_vis_targets(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> VgVisTargets {
    let make = |format: wgpu::TextureFormat, label: &str| {
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some(label),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: width.max(1),
                height: height.max(1),
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
        (texture, view)
    };

    let (id_texture, id_view) = make(VIS_ID_FORMAT, "vg_vis_id");
    let (normal_depth_texture, normal_depth_view) =
        make(VIS_NORMAL_DEPTH_FORMAT, "vg_vis_normal_depth");
    let (uv_texture, uv_view) = make(VIS_UV_FORMAT, "vg_vis_uv");

    VgVisTargets {
        id_texture,
        id_view,
        normal_depth_texture,
        normal_depth_view,
        uv_texture,
        uv_view,
    }
}

// ── VG shadow depth pass ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Depth-only meshlet draws for CSM / point-light shadow atlases.
pub struct VgShadowPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub instances_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl VgShadowPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, depth_format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let shadow_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_shadow_matrix_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let instances_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_shadow_instances_bgl"),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                binding: 0,
                visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::VERTEX,
                ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                    ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Storage { read_only: true },
                    has_dynamic_offset: false,
                    min_binding_size: None,
                },
                count: None,
            }],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_shadow_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&shadow_bgl, &instances_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let shader = create_shader_with_vertex_decode(device, "vg_shadow_shader", crate::shader::VG_SHADOW_WGSL);

        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_shadow_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[CompressedVertex::buffer_layout()],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: None,
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
                cull_mode: Some(wgpu::Face::Back),
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
                format: depth_format,
                depth_write_enabled: true,
                depth_compare: wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual,
                stencil: wgpu::StencilState::default(),
                bias: wgpu::DepthBiasState {
                    constant: 2,
                    slope_scale: 2.0,
                    clamp: 0.0,
                },
            }),
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            instances_bgl,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_instances_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        instance_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vg_shadow_instances_bg"),
            layout: &self.instances_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: instance_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        })
    }

    pub fn draw<'a>(
        &'a self,
        pass: &mut wgpu::RenderPass<'a>,
        shadow_matrix_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
        instances_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
        vertex_buffer: &'a wgpu::Buffer,
        index_buffer: &'a wgpu::Buffer,
        indirect: &'a IndirectDrawBuffer,
    ) {
        if indirect.count == 0 {
            return;
        }
        pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
        pass.set_bind_group(0, shadow_matrix_bg, &[]);
        pass.set_bind_group(1, instances_bg, &[]);
        pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, vertex_buffer.slice(..));
        pass.set_index_buffer(index_buffer.slice(..), wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32);
        indirect.issue_draws(pass);
    }
}

//! Dual-filter bloom post-process pass (6-mip downsample / upsample chain).

use crate::shader::{create_shader_module, BLOOM_WGSL};

const BLOOM_COMPOSITE_WGSL: &str = include_str!("../../shaders/bloom_composite.wgsl");

/// Number of bloom mip levels (½ … ¹⁄₆₄ of the internal HDR resolution).
pub const BLOOM_MIP_COUNT: usize = 6;

/// Bloom extraction, 6-mip blur, and HDR composite.
pub struct BloomPass {
    pub downsample_threshold_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub downsample_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub upsample_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub composite_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub composite_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
}

impl BloomPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "bloom_shader", BLOOM_WGSL);

        let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });

        let make_pipeline = |label: &str, entry: &str, blend: Option<wgpu::BlendState>| {
            device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some(label),
                layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
                vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: "vs_main",
                    buffers: &[],
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                },
                fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                    module: &shader,
                    entry_point: entry,
                    targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                        format,
                        blend,
                        write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                    })],
                    compilation_options: Default::default(),
                }),
                primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState::default(),
                depth_stencil: None,
                multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
                multiview: None,
            })
        };

        let composite_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "bloom_composite_shader", BLOOM_COMPOSITE_WGSL);
        let composite_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_composite_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });
        let composite_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_composite_pipeline_layout"),
            bind_group_layouts: &[&composite_bgl],
            push_constant_ranges: &[],
        });
        let composite_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_composite_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(&composite_layout),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &composite_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &composite_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState::default(),
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        // Upsample blends ADD into the already-downsampled finer mip.
        let upsample_blend = Some(wgpu::BlendState {
            color: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
            },
            alpha: wgpu::BlendComponent {
                src_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                dst_factor: wgpu::BlendFactor::One,
                operation: wgpu::BlendOperation::Add,
            },
        });

        Self {
            downsample_threshold_pipeline: make_pipeline(
                "bloom_downsample_threshold",
                "fs_downsample_threshold",
                None,
            ),
            downsample_pipeline: make_pipeline("bloom_downsample", "fs_downsample", None),
            upsample_pipeline: make_pipeline("bloom_upsample", "fs_upsample", upsample_blend),
            composite_pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            composite_bgl,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        source: &wgpu::TextureView,
        sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_bg"),
            layout: &self.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(source),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_composite_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        base: &wgpu::TextureView,
        bloom: &wgpu::TextureView,
        sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("bloom_composite_bg"),
            layout: &self.composite_bgl,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(base),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(bloom),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
                },
            ],
        })
    }
}

use crate::shader::{GTAO_BLUR_WGSL, GTAO_UPSAMPLE_WGSL, GTAO_WGSL, create_shader_module};
use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};

pub struct SSAOPass {
    pub pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub blur_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub upsample_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub blur_bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub upsample_bind_group_layout: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub noise_texture: crate::resource::texture::Texture,
}

impl SSAOPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue) -> Self {
        let mut noise_data = Vec::new();
        for i in 0..16 {
            let a = (i as f32 * 0.61803398875).fract() * 6.28318530718;
            noise_data.extend_from_slice(&[a.cos(), a.sin(), 0.0f32, 0.0f32]);
        }
        let noise_texture = Self::create_noise_texture(device, queue, &noise_data);

        let bind_group_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::NonFiltering),
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

        let blur_bind_group_layout =
            device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("gtao_blur_bgl"),
                entries: &[
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                        count: None,
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 2,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                ],
            });

        let upsample_bind_group_layout =
            device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
                label: Some("gtao_upsample_bgl"),
                entries: &[
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 1,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                        count: None,
                    },
                    wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                        binding: 2,
                        visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                        ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                            sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: false },
                            view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                            multisampled: false,
                        },
                        count: None,
                    },
                ],
            });

        let gtao_fmt = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float;
        let shader = create_shader_module(device, "gtao_shader", GTAO_WGSL);
        let pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(
                &device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                    label: Some("gtao_pipeline_layout"),
                    bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
                    push_constant_ranges: &[],
                }),
            ),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: gtao_fmt,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let blur_shader = create_shader_module(device, "gtao_blur_shader", GTAO_BLUR_WGSL);
        let blur_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_blur_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(
                &device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                    label: Some("gtao_blur_pipeline_layout"),
                    bind_group_layouts: &[&blur_bind_group_layout],
                    push_constant_ranges: &[],
                }),
            ),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &blur_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &blur_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: gtao_fmt,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let upsample_shader = create_shader_module(device, "gtao_upsample_shader", GTAO_UPSAMPLE_WGSL);
        let upsample_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_upsample_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(
                &device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                    label: Some("gtao_upsample_pipeline_layout"),
                    bind_group_layouts: &[&upsample_bind_group_layout],
                    push_constant_ranges: &[],
                }),
            ),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &upsample_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &upsample_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: gtao_fmt,
                    blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        Self {
            pipeline,
            blur_pipeline,
            upsample_pipeline,
            bind_group_layout,
            blur_bind_group_layout,
            upsample_bind_group_layout,
            noise_texture,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_blur_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        raw_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
        normal_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_blur_bg"),
            layout: &self.blur_bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(raw_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(normal_view),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_upsample_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        half_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
        normal_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_upsample_bg"),
            layout: &self.upsample_bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(half_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(normal_view),
                },
            ],
        })
    }

    fn create_noise_texture(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        noise_data: &[f32],
    ) -> crate::resource::texture::Texture {
        let size = wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: 4,
            height: 4,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        };
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_noise"),
            size,
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba32Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        queue.write_texture(
            wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
                texture: &texture,
                mip_level: 0,
                origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
                aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
            },
            bytemuck::cast_slice(noise_data),
            wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
                offset: 0,
                bytes_per_row: Some(4 * 16),
                rows_per_image: Some(4),
            },
            size,
        );
        let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        crate::resource::texture::Texture {
            texture,
            view,
            sampler,
            width: 4,
            height: 4,
            mip_levels: 1,
        }
    }
}
