pub struct VsmShadowPass {
    pub trace_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub temporal_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    pub trace_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub temporal_bgl: wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
    pub pass_uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub temporal_uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
}

impl VsmShadowPass {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        use crate::shader::{VSM_SHADOW_TEMPORAL_WGSL, VSM_SHADOW_TRACE_WGSL};

        let trace_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_trace_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                tex_ro(0),
                uniform(1),
                uniform(2),
                tex_array_ro(3),
                sampler_nf(4),
                storage_ro(5),
                tex_ro(6),
                sampler_nf(7),
                uniform(8),
            ],
        });

        let temporal_bgl = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_temporal_bgl"),
            entries: &[
                tex_filt(0),
                tex_filt(1),
                tex_ro(2),
                uniform(3),
                sampler_f(4),
                uniform(5),
            ],
        });

        let trace_shader = create_shader_module(device, "vsm_shadow_trace", VSM_SHADOW_TRACE_WGSL);
        let trace_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_trace_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(
                &device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                    label: Some("vsm_shadow_trace_pl"),
                    bind_group_layouts: &[&trace_bgl],
                    push_constant_ranges: &[],
                }),
            ),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &trace_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &trace_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let temporal_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "vsm_shadow_temporal", VSM_SHADOW_TEMPORAL_WGSL);
        let temporal_pipeline = device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_temporal_pipeline"),
            layout: Some(
                &device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
                    label: Some("vsm_shadow_temporal_pl"),
                    bind_group_layouts: &[&temporal_bgl],
                    push_constant_ranges: &[],
                }),
            ),
            vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
                module: &temporal_shader,
                entry_point: "vs_main",
                buffers: &[],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            },
            fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
                module: &temporal_shader,
                entry_point: "fs_main",
                targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                    format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
                    blend: None,
                    write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
                })],
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            }),
            primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
                topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            depth_stencil: None,
            multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
            multiview: None,
        });

        let pass_uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pass_uniform"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<VsmPassUniform>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let temporal_uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_temporal_uniform"),
            size: std::mem::size_of::<VsmTemporalUniform>() as u64,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        Self {
            trace_pipeline,
            temporal_pipeline,
            trace_bgl,
            temporal_bgl,
            pass_uniform_buffer,
            temporal_uniform_buffer,
        }
    }

    pub fn create_trace_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        normal_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        light_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        vsm_pages: &wgpu::TextureView,
        vsm_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
        vsm_info_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        blue_noise_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        blue_noise_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_trace_bg"),
            layout: &self.trace_bgl,
            entries: &[
                bind_tex(0, normal_view),
                bind_buf(1, camera_buffer),
                bind_buf(2, light_buffer),
                bind_tex(3, vsm_pages),
                bind_samp(4, vsm_sampler),
                bind_storage(5, vsm_info_buffer),
                bind_tex(6, blue_noise_view),
                bind_samp(7, blue_noise_sampler),
                bind_buf(8, &self.pass_uniform_buffer),
            ],
        })
    }

    pub fn create_temporal_bind_group(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        raw_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        history_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        normal_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
        camera_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
        linear_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    ) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
        device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_temporal_bg"),
            layout: &self.temporal_bgl,
            entries: &[
                bind_tex(0, raw_view),
                bind_tex(1, history_view),
                bind_tex(2, normal_view),
                bind_buf(3, camera_buffer),
                bind_samp(4, linear_sampler),
                bind_buf(5, &self.temporal_uniform_buffer),
            ],
        })
    }
}

//! Tone mapping and gamma correction post-processing pass.

use bytemuck::{Pod, Zeroable};

use crate::shader::{TONE_MAPPING_WGSL, create_shader_module};

/// GPU uniform for the tone-mapping pass (binding 2).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Pod, Zeroable)]
pub struct TonemapUniform {
    pub exposure: f32,
    pub sharpen_enabled: u32,
    pub bloom_enabled: u32,
    /// RCAS sharpness in stops (0 = max, ~0.5 = mild).
    pub rcas_sharpness: f32,
    pub output_size: [f32; 2],
}

impl Default for TonemapUniform {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            exposure: 1.0,
            sharpen_enabled: 0,
            bloom_enabled: 0,
            rcas_sharpness: 0.5,
            output_size: [1.0, 1.0],
        }
    }
}

                    binding: 0,

                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("tone_mapping_pipeline_layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
        push_constant_ranges: &[],
    });

    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("tone_mapping_pipeline"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "vs_main",
            buffers: &[],
            compilation_options: wgpu::PipelineCompilationOptions::default(),
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "fs_main",
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format: output_format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
            compilation_options: wgpu::PipelineCompilationOptions::default(),
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            ..Default::default()

        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
        multiview: None,
    })
}

                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {
                        ty: wgpu::BufferBindingType::Uniform,
                        has_dynamic_offset: false,
                        min_binding_size: None,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
                    ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
                        sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
                        view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
                        multisampled: false,
                    },
                    count: None,
                },
            ],
        });

    let layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
        label: Some("rcas_present_pipeline_layout"),
        bind_group_layouts: &[&bind_group_layout],
        push_constant_ranges: &[],
    });

    device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
        label: Some("rcas_present_pipeline"),
        layout: Some(&layout),
        vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "vs_main",
            buffers: &[],
            compilation_options: wgpu::PipelineCompilationOptions::default(),
        },
        fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
            module: &shader,
            entry_point: "fs_present_rcas",
            targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
                format: output_format,
                blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::REPLACE),
                write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
            })],
            compilation_options: wgpu::PipelineCompilationOptions::default(),
        }),
        primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
            topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        depth_stencil: None,
        multisample: wgpu::MultisampleState::default(),
        multiview: None,
    })
}

pub fn create_tonemap_bind_group(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    pipeline: &wgpu::RenderPipeline,
    hdr_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    bloom_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    hdr_sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
    uniform_buffer: &wgpu::Buffer,
) -> wgpu::BindGroup {
    device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
        label: Some("tone_mapping_bind_group"),
        layout: &pipeline.get_bind_group_layout(0),
        entries: &[
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(hdr_view),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 1,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(hdr_sampler),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 2,
                resource: uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            },
            wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 3,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(bloom_view),
            },
        ],
    })
}

//! GPU resource registry with slot reuse.
//!
//! Replaces the append-only `Vec<GpuMesh> / Vec<Material> / Vec<Texture>`
//! storage that leaked by design. Slots are recycled through a free list, and
//! `AssetId` handles map to slot indices so removal is O(1).

use std::collections::HashMap;

use redox_asset::AssetId;

use crate::asset_types::{MaterialData};
use crate::material::Material;
use crate::resource::texture::Texture;

/// A GPU mesh (vertex + index buffers).
pub struct GpuMesh {
    pub vertex_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub index_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub index_count: u32,
    /// Mesh-local AABB (from CPU vertices) used for frustum culling.
    pub local_bounds: redox_math::Aabb,
}

/// Everything owned by the GPU for one uploaded material.
pub struct MaterialSlot {
    /// CPU-side material parameters mirrored for rebuilds.
    pub data: MaterialData,
    pub uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
    pub bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
}

/// Everything owned by the GPU for one uploaded texture.
pub struct TextureSlot {
    pub texture: Texture,
    /// Bind group sampling this texture (created at upload time).
    pub bind_group: Option<wgpu::BindGroup>,
}

/// Generic dense slot storage with free-list recycling.
struct Pool<T> {
    slots: Vec<Option<T>>,
    free: Vec<usize>,
}

impl<T> Pool<T> {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            slots: Vec::new(),
            free: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, value: T) -> usize {
        match self.free.pop() {
            Some(idx) => {
                self.slots[idx] = Some(value);
                idx
            }
            None => {
                self.slots.push(Some(value));
                self.slots.len() - 1
            }
        }
    }

    fn remove(&mut self, idx: usize) -> Option<T> {
        if idx >= self.slots.len() {
            return None;
        }
        let taken = self.slots[idx].take();
        if taken.is_some() {
            self.free.push(idx);
        }
        taken
    }

    fn get(&self, idx: usize) -> Option<&T> {
        self.slots.get(idx).and_then(|s| s.as_ref())
    }

    fn get_mut(&mut self, idx: usize) -> Option<&mut T> {
        self.slots.get_mut(idx).and_then(|s| s.as_mut())
    }

    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.slots.len() - self.free.len()
    }

}

impl<T> Default for Pool<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// Registry of all GPU-side meshes, materials, textures and their handle maps.
///
/// Access pattern mirrors the previous `RenderContext` fields (`meshes`,
/// `handle_to_mesh_index`, …) but adds removal. `RenderContext` delegates to it.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct GpuRegistry {
    meshes: Pool<GpuMesh>,
    handle_to_mesh: HashMap<AssetId, usize>,

    materials: Pool<MaterialSlot>,
    handle_to_material: HashMap<AssetId, usize>,
    /// Legacy index-based material storage used while examples still pass raw
    /// indices; removed when callers migrate to handles.
    pub legacy_materials: Vec<Material>,
    pub legacy_material_bind_groups: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup>,
    pub legacy_material_uniform_buffers: Vec<wgpu::Buffer>,

    textures: Pool<TextureSlot>,
    handle_to_texture: HashMap<AssetId, usize>,
    pub legacy_textures: Vec<Texture>,
    pub legacy_texture_bind_groups: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup>,

    pub fallback_texture_bg: Option<wgpu::BindGroup>,
}

impl GpuRegistry {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    // ── Meshes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// Inserts a GPU mesh and records the handle mapping.
    pub fn insert_mesh(&mut self, handle: AssetId, mesh: GpuMesh) -> usize {
        let slot = self.meshes.insert(mesh);
        self.handle_to_mesh.insert(handle, slot);
        slot
    }

    /// Removes a mesh, freeing its slot and dropping the GPU buffers.
    pub fn remove_mesh(&mut self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<GpuMesh> {
        let slot = self.handle_to_mesh.remove(&handle)?;
        self.meshes.remove(slot)
    }

    pub fn mesh_by_handle(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<&GpuMesh> {
        self.handle_to_mesh.get(&handle).and_then(|&i| self.meshes.get(i))
    }

    pub fn mesh_by_slot(&self, slot: usize) -> Option<&GpuMesh> {
        self.meshes.get(slot)
    }

    pub fn link_material_index(&mut self, handle: AssetId, idx: usize) {
        self.handle_to_material.insert(handle, idx);
    }

    pub fn mesh_index_for(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<usize> {
        self.handle_to_mesh.get(&handle).copied()
    }

    pub fn texture_index_for(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<usize> {
        self.handle_to_texture.get(&handle).copied()
    }

    pub fn material_index_for(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<usize> {
        self.handle_to_material.get(&handle).copied()
    }

    pub fn has_mesh(&self, handle: AssetId) -> bool {
        self.handle_to_mesh.contains_key(&handle)
    }

    pub fn has_texture(&self, handle: AssetId) -> bool {
        self.handle_to_texture.contains_key(&handle)
    }

    pub fn has_material(&self, handle: AssetId) -> bool {
        self.handle_to_material.contains_key(&handle)
    }

    /// Inserts a mesh without an asset handle (examples / procedural geometry).
    pub fn insert_mesh_slot(&mut self, mesh: GpuMesh) -> usize {
        self.meshes.insert(mesh)
    }

    pub fn legacy_material(&self, idx: usize) -> Option<&Material> {
        self.legacy_materials.get(idx)
    }

    pub fn legacy_material_bind_group(&self, idx: usize) -> Option<&wgpu::BindGroup> {
        self.legacy_material_bind_groups.get(idx)
    }

    pub fn legacy_texture(&self, idx: usize) -> Option<&Texture> {
        self.legacy_textures.get(idx)
    }

    pub fn legacy_texture_bind_group(&self, idx: usize) -> Option<&wgpu::BindGroup> {
        self.legacy_texture_bind_groups.get(idx)
    }

    pub fn push_legacy_material(
        &mut self,
        material: Material,
        uniform_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
        bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    ) -> usize {
        let idx = self.legacy_materials.len();
        self.legacy_materials.push(material);
        self.legacy_material_uniform_buffers.push(uniform_buffer);
        self.legacy_material_bind_groups.push(bind_group);
        idx
    }

    pub fn push_legacy_texture(
        &mut self,
        texture: Texture,
        bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
    ) -> usize {
        let idx = self.legacy_textures.len();
        self.legacy_textures.push(texture);
        self.legacy_texture_bind_groups.push(bind_group);
        idx
    }

    pub fn legacy_materials(&self) -> &[Material] {
        &self.legacy_materials
    }

    pub fn legacy_material_bind_groups(&self) -> &[wgpu::BindGroup] {
        &self.legacy_material_bind_groups
    }

    /// Number of live mesh slots (for stats/debug UI).
    pub fn mesh_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.meshes.len()
    }

    // ── Materials ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub fn insert_material(&mut self, handle: AssetId, slot: MaterialSlot) -> usize {
        let idx = self.materials.insert(slot);
        self.handle_to_material.insert(handle, idx);
        idx
    }

    pub fn remove_material(&mut self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<MaterialSlot> {
        let idx = self.handle_to_material.remove(&handle)?;
        self.materials.remove(idx)
    }

    pub fn material_by_handle(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<&MaterialSlot> {
        self.handle_to_material.get(&handle).and_then(|&i| self.materials.get(i))
    }

    // ── Textures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub fn insert_texture(&mut self, handle: AssetId, slot: TextureSlot) -> usize {
        let idx = self.textures.insert(slot);
        self.handle_to_texture.insert(handle, idx);
        idx
    }

    pub fn remove_texture(&mut self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<TextureSlot> {
        let idx = self.handle_to_texture.remove(&handle)?;
        self.textures.remove(idx)
    }

    pub fn texture_by_handle(&self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<&TextureSlot> {
        self.handle_to_texture.get(&handle).and_then(|&i| self.textures.get(i))
    }

    pub fn texture_slot_mut(&mut self, handle: AssetId) -> Option<&mut TextureSlot> {
        let idx = *self.handle_to_texture.get(&handle)?;
        self.textures.get_mut(idx)
    }
}

//! Lightweight pass contexts for multi-threaded command-buffer recording.

use bytemuck;
use redox_math::{Aabb, Mat4, Vec3};

use crate::pass::normal::NormalPass;
use crate::pass::shadow::ShadowPass;
use crate::pass::vg_resolve::VgShadowPass;
use crate::registry::GpuRegistry;
use crate::shadow::csm::ShadowUniform;
use crate::systems::RenderObject;
use crate::virtual_geometry::runtime::VGSystem;

/// Clone-friendly handles for CSM shadow depth recording.
pub struct ShadowContext<'a> {
    pub device: &'a wgpu::Device,
    pub queue: &'a wgpu::Queue,
    pub shadow_pass: &'a ShadowPass,
    pub shadow_model_bind_group: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub cascade_matrix_buffers: &'a [wgpu::Buffer],
    pub cascade_matrix_bgs: &'a [wgpu::BindGroup],
    pub csm_layer_views: &'a [wgpu::TextureView],
    pub vg_shadow_pass: &'a VgShadowPass,
    pub vg_shadow_instances_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub registry: &'a GpuRegistry,
}

/// Records directional CSM cascade depth passes into a fresh command buffer.
pub fn record_csm_shadow_depth(
    ctx: &ShadowContext<'_>,
    shadow_u: &ShadowUniform,
    cascade_vis: &[Vec<bool>],
    objects: &[RenderObject],
    vg_system: Option<&VGSystem>,
    render_csm: bool,
) -> wgpu::CommandBuffer {
    let mut encoder = ctx
        .device
        .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_csm_encoder"),
        });

    if !render_csm {
        return encoder.finish();
    }

    let cascade_count = shadow_u
        .csm_matrices
        .iter()
        .take(4)
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(i, _)| *i < cascade_vis.len())
        .count()
        .min(ctx.csm_layer_views.len());

    for cascade_idx in 0..cascade_count {
        ctx.queue.write_buffer(
            &ctx.cascade_matrix_buffers[cascade_idx],
            0,
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&shadow_u.csm_matrices[cascade_idx]),
        );

        let shadow_matrix_bg = &ctx.cascade_matrix_bgs[cascade_idx];
        let csm_layer_view = &ctx.csm_layer_views[cascade_idx];

        let mut shadow_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_pass_csm_parallel"),
            color_attachments: &[],
            depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                view: csm_layer_view,
                depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                }),
                stencil_ops: None,
            }),
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
        });

        shadow_pass.set_pipeline(&ctx.shadow_pass.pipeline);
        shadow_pass.set_bind_group(0, shadow_matrix_bg, &[]);
        shadow_pass.set_bind_group(1, ctx.shadow_model_bind_group, &[]);

        for (i, obj) in objects.iter().enumerate() {
            if cascade_idx >= cascade_vis.len() || !cascade_vis[cascade_idx][i] {
                continue;
            }
            let ext = obj.bounds.max - obj.bounds.min;
            if ext.y < 0.6 && ext.x > 8.0 && ext.z > 8.0 {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(gpu_mesh) = ctx.registry.mesh_by_slot(obj.mesh_index) {
                shadow_pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, gpu_mesh.vertex_buffer.slice(..));
                shadow_pass.set_index_buffer(
                    gpu_mesh.index_buffer.slice(..),
                    wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32,
                );
                shadow_pass.draw_indexed(
                    0..gpu_mesh.index_count,
                    0,
                    (i as u32)..(i as u32 + 1),
                );
            }
        }

        if let Some(vg) = vg_system {
            if vg.has_content() {
                vg.draw_shadow_indirect(
                    &mut shadow_pass,
                    &ctx.vg_shadow_pass,
                    shadow_matrix_bg,
                    ctx.vg_shadow_instances_bg,
                );
            }
        }
    }

    encoder.finish()
}

/// Clone-friendly handles for the depth/normal prepass.
pub struct PrepassContext<'a> {
    pub device: &'a wgpu::Device,
    pub normal_pass: &'a NormalPass,
    pub normal_bind_group: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub normal_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub depth_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub registry: &'a GpuRegistry,
}

/// Records the normal + depth prepass into a fresh command buffer.
pub fn record_normal_prepass(
    ctx: &PrepassContext<'_>,
    objects: &[RenderObject],
    vis: &[bool],
) -> wgpu::CommandBuffer {
    let mut encoder = ctx
        .device
        .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("prepass_encoder"),
        });

    let mut normal_render_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
        label: Some("normal_pass_parallel"),
        color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
            view: &ctx.normal_view,
            resolve_target: None,
            ops: wgpu::Operations {
                load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                    r: 0.0,
                    g: 0.0,
                    b: 0.0,
                    a: 1.0,
                }),
                store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
            },
        })],
        depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
            view: &ctx.depth_view,
            depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
                store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
            }),
            stencil_ops: None,
        }),
        timestamp_writes: None,
        occlusion_query_set: None,
    });

    normal_render_pass.set_pipeline(&ctx.normal_pass.pipeline);
    normal_render_pass.set_bind_group(0, ctx.normal_bind_group, &[]);
    for (i, obj) in objects.iter().enumerate() {
        if i >= vis.len() || !vis[i] {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(gpu_mesh) = ctx.registry.mesh_by_slot(obj.mesh_index) {
            normal_render_pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, gpu_mesh.vertex_buffer.slice(..));
            normal_render_pass.set_index_buffer(
                gpu_mesh.index_buffer.slice(..),
                wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32,
            );
            normal_render_pass.draw_indexed(
                0..gpu_mesh.index_count,
                0,
                (i as u32)..(i as u32 + 1),
            );
        }
    }
    drop(normal_render_pass);

    encoder.finish()
}

/// Frustum visibility scratch helper (shared by prepass scheduling).
pub fn compute_main_visibility(
    view_proj: &[[f32; 4]; 4],
    objects: &[RenderObject],
    out: &mut Vec<bool>,
) {
    let frustum = redox_math::Frustum::from_view_projection(Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(view_proj));
    out.clear();
    out.reserve(objects.len());
    for o in objects {
        out.push(frustum.intersects_aabb(&o.bounds));
    }
}

/// Conservative AABB vs clip test (shadow cascade culling).
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub fn aabb_overlaps_clip(bounds: Aabb, view_proj: Mat4) -> bool {
    let corners = [
        Vec3::new(bounds.min.x, bounds.min.y, bounds.min.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.max.x, bounds.min.y, bounds.min.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.min.x, bounds.max.y, bounds.min.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.max.x, bounds.max.y, bounds.min.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.min.x, bounds.min.y, bounds.max.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.max.x, bounds.min.y, bounds.max.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.min.x, bounds.max.y, bounds.max.z),
        Vec3::new(bounds.max.x, bounds.max.y, bounds.max.z),
    ];
    let mut min_ndc = Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY);
    let mut max_ndc = Vec3::splat(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
    for c in corners {
        let clip = view_proj * c.extend(1.0);
        if clip.w <= 0.0 {
            return true;
        }
        let ndc = clip.truncate() / clip.w;
        min_ndc = min_ndc.min(ndc);
        max_ndc = max_ndc.max(ndc);
    }
    min_ndc.x <= 1.0
        && max_ndc.x >= -1.0
        && min_ndc.y <= 1.0
        && max_ndc.y >= -1.0
        && min_ndc.z <= 1.0
        && max_ndc.z >= 0.0
}

/// One point-light caster's atlas job (matrices already uploaded).
pub struct AtlasCasterJob {
    pub face_base: usize,
    pub tile_base: u32,
    pub face_vis: [Vec<bool>; 6],
}

pub struct AtlasContext<'a> {
    pub device: &'a wgpu::Device,
    pub shadow_pass: &'a ShadowPass,
    pub shadow_model_bind_group: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub face_matrix_bgs: &'a [wgpu::BindGroup],
    pub atlas_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
    pub vg_shadow_pass: &'a VgShadowPass,
    pub vg_shadow_instances_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub registry: &'a GpuRegistry,
}

pub fn record_point_atlas_shadows(
    ctx: &AtlasContext<'_>,
    jobs: &[AtlasCasterJob],
    objects: &[RenderObject],
    vg_system: Option<&VGSystem>,
) -> wgpu::CommandBuffer {
    use crate::shadow::atlas_allocator::TILE_PX;

    let mut encoder = ctx
        .device
        .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_atlas_encoder"),
        });
    if jobs.is_empty() {
        return encoder.finish();
    }

    let mut first = true;
    for job in jobs {
        let load_op = if first {
            first = false;
            wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0)
        } else {
            wgpu::LoadOp::Load
        };
        let mut shadow_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("local_shadow_pass_point_cube"),
            color_attachments: &[],
            depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                view: ctx.atlas_view,
                depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                    load: load_op,
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                }),
                stencil_ops: None,
            }),
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
        });
        shadow_pass.set_pipeline(&ctx.shadow_pass.pipeline);
        shadow_pass.set_bind_group(1, ctx.shadow_model_bind_group, &[]);

        for face_i in 0..6usize {
            let (col, row) =
                crate::shadow::atlas_allocator::tile_grid(job.tile_base + face_i as u32);
            let x = col * TILE_PX;
            let y = row * TILE_PX;
            shadow_pass.set_bind_group(0, &ctx.face_matrix_bgs[job.face_base + face_i], &[]);
            shadow_pass.set_viewport(x as f32, y as f32, TILE_PX as f32, TILE_PX as f32, 0.0, 1.0);
            shadow_pass.set_scissor_rect(x, y, TILE_PX, TILE_PX);
            for (i, obj) in objects.iter().enumerate() {
                if !job.face_vis[face_i][i] {
                    continue;
                }
                if let Some(gpu_mesh) = ctx.registry.mesh_by_slot(obj.mesh_index) {
                    shadow_pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, gpu_mesh.vertex_buffer.slice(..));
                    shadow_pass.set_index_buffer(
                        gpu_mesh.index_buffer.slice(..),
                        wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32,
                    );
                    shadow_pass.draw_indexed(
                        0..gpu_mesh.index_count,
                        0,
                        (i as u32)..(i as u32 + 1),
                    );
                }
            }
            if let Some(vg) = vg_system {
                if vg.has_content() {
                    vg.draw_shadow_indirect(
                        &mut shadow_pass,
                        ctx.vg_shadow_pass,
                        &ctx.face_matrix_bgs[job.face_base + face_i],
                        ctx.vg_shadow_instances_bg,
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
    encoder.finish()
}

pub struct VsmContext<'a> {
    pub device: &'a wgpu::Device,
    pub vsm_depth_pass: &'a crate::shadow::depth_pass::VsmDepthPass,
    pub vsm_pageinfo_bg: &'a wgpu::BindGroup,
    pub vsm_pages_views: &'a [wgpu::TextureView],
    pub registry: &'a GpuRegistry,
}

pub fn record_vsm_pages(
    ctx: &VsmContext<'_>,
    dirty: &[(u32, u32, u32, u16)],
    objects: &[RenderObject],
) -> wgpu::CommandBuffer {
    let mut encoder = ctx
        .device
        .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pages_encoder"),
        });
    for (page_ord, &(_level, _px, _py, phys)) in dirty.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut page_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_page_depth"),
            color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                view: &ctx.vsm_pages_views[phys as usize],
                resolve_target: None,
                ops: wgpu::Operations {
                    load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::WHITE),
                    store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                },
            })],
            depth_stencil_attachment: None,
            timestamp_writes: None,
            occlusion_query_set: None,
        });
        page_pass.set_pipeline(&ctx.vsm_depth_pass.pipeline);
        page_pass.set_bind_group(0, ctx.vsm_pageinfo_bg, &[(page_ord as u32) * 256]);
        for (i, obj) in objects.iter().enumerate() {
            if let Some(gpu_mesh) = ctx.registry.mesh_by_slot(obj.mesh_index) {
                page_pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, gpu_mesh.vertex_buffer.slice(..));
                page_pass.set_index_buffer(
                    gpu_mesh.index_buffer.slice(..),
                    wgpu::IndexFormat::Uint32,
                );
                page_pass.draw_indexed(0..gpu_mesh.index_count, 0, (i as u32)..(i as u32 + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    encoder.finish()
}

impl Renderer {
    /// Initialises the entire rendering context.
    ///
    /// This is an `async` function because `wgpu` adapter and device requests
    /// are asynchronous. Wrap with `pollster::block_on` when calling from
    /// synchronous code.
    pub async fn new(window: Arc<Window>, present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode) -> Self {
        let size = window.inner_size();

        // --- Instance ---
        let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor {
            backends: wgpu::Backends::all(),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        // --- Surface ---
        let surface = instance
            .create_surface(window)
            .expect("Failed to create surface");

        // --- Adapter ---
        let adapter = instance
            .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
                power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::HighPerformance,
                compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
                force_fallback_adapter: false,
            })
            .await
            .expect("Failed to find a suitable GPU adapter");

        log::info!("Using adapter: {:?}", adapter.get_info().name);

        // --- Device & Queue ---
        let mut required_features = wgpu::Features::empty();
        if adapter.features().contains(wgpu::Features::SHADER_PRIMITIVE_INDEX) {
            required_features |= wgpu::Features::SHADER_PRIMITIVE_INDEX;
        }
        // Rgba16Float MSAA×2 needs adapter-specific format features (WebGPU baseline is ×1/×4 only).
        if adapter
            .features()
            .contains(wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_ADAPTER_SPECIFIC_FORMAT_FEATURES)
        {
            required_features |= wgpu::Features::TEXTURE_ADAPTER_SPECIFIC_FORMAT_FEATURES;
        }
        let (device, queue) = adapter
            .request_device(
                &wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
                    label: Some("redox_device"),
                    required_features,
                    required_limits: wgpu::Limits::default(),
                },
                None,
            )
            .await
            .expect("Failed to create device");

        // --- Surface configuration ---
        let surface_caps = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
        let surface_format = surface_caps
            .formats
            .iter()
            .find(|f| f.is_srgb())
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or(surface_caps.formats[0]);

        let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
            format: surface_format,
            width: size.width.max(1),
            height: size.height.max(1),
            present_mode,
            alpha_mode: surface_caps.alpha_modes[0],
            view_formats: vec![],
            desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
        };

        Self::from_shared_device(device, queue, &adapter, Some(surface), config)
    }

    /// Build a full engine [`Renderer`] on an existing device/queue (editor SharedGpu).
    ///
    /// Pass `surface: None` for offscreen hosts that only call [`Self::render_frame_into`].
    /// `config.format` must match the `surface_view` passed to that method (editor RTT =
    /// [`wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm`]).
    pub fn from_shared_device(
        device: wgpu::Device,
        queue: wgpu::Queue,
        adapter: &wgpu::Adapter,
        surface: Option<wgpu::Surface<'static>>,
        config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
    ) -> Self {
        let staging_ring = crate::resource::StagingRing::new(
            &device,
            crate::resource::DEFAULT_RING_CAPACITY,
        );

        if let Some(ref surface) = surface {
            surface.configure(&device, &config);
        }

        let surface_format = config.format;
        let hdr_format = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float;

        // --- Internal resolution for TAAU ---
        // Default quality: render above output resolution, then TAA resolve.
        // This behaves like SSAA/temporal supersampling and reduces stair-steps without adding blur.
        let render_scale = 1.0_f32;
        let internal_width = ((config.width as f32) * render_scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
        let internal_height = ((config.height as f32) * render_scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
        // Weight of the current frame in TAA (higher = sharper, lower = smoother).
        let taa_blend_alpha = 0.08_f32;
        let taa_enabled = false;
        let aa_sharp = true;
        let hdr_msaa_target_count = pick_hdr_msaa_sample_count(&adapter, hdr_format, aa_sharp || taa_enabled);
        let msaa_sample_count = hdr_msaa_target_count;
        log::info!("HDR MSAA sample count: {msaa_sample_count} (TAA enabled: {taa_enabled})");

        // --- Render passes ---
        let shared_layouts = SharedLayouts::new(&device);
        let pbr_frame_layouts = PbrFrameLayouts::new(&device);
        let pbr_pass = PbrPass::new(&device, hdr_format, msaa_sample_count);
        let transparent_pass =
            TransparentPass::new(&device, &pbr_pass, hdr_format, msaa_sample_count);
        let shadow_pass = ShadowPass::new(&device);
        let normal_pass = NormalPass::new(&device, wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float);
        let ssao_pass = SSAOPass::new(&device, &queue);
        let vsm_shadow_pass = VsmShadowPass::new(&device);
        let scatter_light_pass = ScatterLightPass::new(&device, hdr_format);
        let bloom_pass = BloomPass::new(&device, hdr_format);
        let debug_lines_pass =
            DebugLinesPass::new(&device, &shared_layouts.camera_bgl, msaa_sample_count);

        // --- Camera uniform ---
        let camera_uniform = CameraUniform::default();
        let camera_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "camera_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&camera_uniform),
        );
        let camera_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("camera_bind_group"),
            layout: &shared_layouts.camera_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        });

        // --- Shadow Map / CSM depth array ---
        let shadow_texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_texture"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: SHADOW_SIZE,
                height: SHADOW_SIZE,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: SHADOW_FORMAT,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let shadow_view = shadow_texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());

        let shadow_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_comparison_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        // CSM texture array (4 cascades).
        let csm_texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("csm_texture_array"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: SHADOW_SIZE,
                height: SHADOW_SIZE,
                depth_or_array_layers: 4,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: SHADOW_FORMAT,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let csm_view = csm_texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            label: Some("csm_texture_array_view"),
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let csm_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("csm_comparison_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        // Local lights static shadow atlas.
        let local_shadow_atlas = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("local_shadow_atlas"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: 8192,
                height: 8192,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: SHADOW_FORMAT,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let local_shadow_atlas_view =
            local_shadow_atlas.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());

        let shadow_uniform = ShadowUniform::default();
        let shadow_uniform_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "shadow_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&shadow_uniform),
        );

        // --- Light uniform ---
        let light_uniform = LightUniform::default();
        let light_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "light_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&light_uniform),
        );

        let shader_debug_uniform = ShaderDebugUniform::default();
        let shader_debug_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "shader_debug_uniform",
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&shader_debug_uniform),
        );

        // --- Depth (internal) ---
        let (depth_texture, depth_view) =
            create_depth_texture(&device, internal_width, internal_height);
        let (prev_depth_texture, prev_depth_view) =
            create_prev_depth_texture(&device, &queue, internal_width, internal_height);

        // --- HDR Texture (internal) ---
        let hdr_texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("hdr_texture"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: internal_width,
                height: internal_height,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: hdr_format,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
                | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
                | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let hdr_view = hdr_texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());

        let (hdr_msaa_texture, hdr_msaa_view) = create_hdr_msaa_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            msaa_sample_count,
        );
        let (depth_msaa_texture, depth_msaa_view) = create_depth_msaa_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            msaa_sample_count,
        );

        let hdr_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("hdr_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let (bloom_mip_textures, bloom_mip_views) =
            create_bloom_mip_chain(&device, internal_width, internal_height, hdr_format);
        let (bloom_scratch_texture, bloom_scratch_view) = create_bloom_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            hdr_format,
            "bloom_scratch",
        );
        let bloom_down_bgs = create_bloom_downsample_bgs(
            &bloom_pass,
            &device,
            &hdr_view,
            &bloom_mip_views,
            &hdr_sampler,
        );
        let bloom_up_bgs =
            create_bloom_upsample_bgs(&bloom_pass, &device, &bloom_mip_views, &hdr_sampler);
        let bloom_composite_bg = bloom_pass.create_composite_bind_group(
            &device,
            &hdr_view,
            &bloom_mip_views[0],
            &hdr_sampler,
        );

        let tone_mapping_pipeline = create_tone_mapping_pipeline(&device, surface_format);
        // Tone-mapping uniform (exposure / sharpen toggle / output size).
        // The buffer is size-independent: `output_size` is written per frame.
        let tonemap_uniform_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "tonemap_uniform",
            &[0u8; std::mem::size_of::<TonemapUniform>()],
        );
        let tone_mapping_bind_group = create_tonemap_bind_group(
            &device,
            &tone_mapping_pipeline,
            &hdr_view,
            &bloom_mip_views[0],
            &hdr_sampler,
            &tonemap_uniform_buffer,
        );

        // --- Sharp AA resources ---
        let msaa_resolve_pass = MsaaResolvePass::new(&device, hdr_format);
        msaa_resolve_pass.set_sample_count(&queue, msaa_sample_count);
        let msaa_resolve_bg = msaa_resolve_pass.create_bind_group(&device, &hdr_msaa_view);

        let mut smaa_pass = SmaaPass::new(&device, &queue);
        smaa_pass.resize(&device, config.width, config.height);

        let (ldr_texture, ldr_view) = create_sharp_intermediate(
            &device, config.width, config.height, "sharp_ldr",
        );
        let (smaa_out_texture, smaa_out_view) = create_sharp_intermediate(
            &device, config.width, config.height, "sharp_smaa_out",
        );

        let tone_mapping_ldr_pipeline =
            create_tone_mapping_pipeline(&device, wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm);
        let tone_mapping_ldr_bg = create_tonemap_bind_group(
            &device,
            &tone_mapping_ldr_pipeline,
            &hdr_view,
            &bloom_mip_views[0],
            &hdr_sampler,
            &tonemap_uniform_buffer,
        );
        let rcas_present_pipeline = create_rcas_present_pipeline(&device, surface_format);
        let tonemap_rcas_uniform_buffer = buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
            &device,
            "tonemap_rcas_uniform",
            &[0u8; std::mem::size_of::<TonemapUniform>()],
        );
        let tone_mapping_rcas_bg = create_tonemap_bind_group(
            &device,
            &rcas_present_pipeline,
            &smaa_out_view,
            &bloom_mip_views[0],
            &hdr_sampler,
            &tonemap_rcas_uniform_buffer,
        );

        // --- Fallback textures ---
        let fallback_tex = Texture::white_1x1(&device, &queue);
        let fallback_texture_bg = shared_layouts.create_texture_bind_group(&device, &fallback_tex);

        let fallback_normal = Texture::normal_1x1(&device, &queue);
        let fallback_mr = Texture::mr_1x1(&device, &queue);
        let common_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("common_material_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let mut registry = GpuRegistry::new();
        registry.push_legacy_texture(fallback_tex, fallback_texture_bg);
        let fallback_texture_bg = shared_layouts.create_texture_bind_group(
            &device,
            registry.legacy_texture(0).expect("fallback texture"),
        );

        // --- Per-object model buffer (Storage) ---
        let model_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("model_storage_buffer"),
            size: (std::mem::size_of::<ModelUniform>() * 10000) as u64, // Support up to 10,000 objects
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let model_bind_group = shared_layouts.create_model_bind_group(&device, &model_buffer);
        let shadow_model_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("shadow_model_bg"),
            layout: &shadow_pass.model_bgl,
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: model_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
            }],
        });

        let half_width = (internal_width / 2).max(1);
        let half_height = (internal_height / 2).max(1);

        // --- Normal + GTAO textures (internal) ---
        let gtao_fmt = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float;
        let (normal_texture, normal_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            "normal",
        );
        let (ssao_raw_texture, ssao_raw_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            half_width,
            half_height,
            gtao_fmt,
            "gtao_raw",
        );
        let (ssao_half_blurred_texture, ssao_half_blurred_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            half_width,
            half_height,
            gtao_fmt,
            "gtao_half_blurred",
        );
        let (ssao_blurred_texture, ssao_blurred_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            gtao_fmt,
            "gtao_blurred",
        );

        let (vsm_shadow_raw_texture, vsm_shadow_raw_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
            "vsm_shadow_raw",
        );
        let (vsm_shadow_filtered_texture, vsm_shadow_filtered_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
            "vsm_shadow_filtered",
        );
        let (vsm_shadow_history_texture, vsm_shadow_history_view) = create_normal_ssao_texture(
            &device,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            wgpu::TextureFormat::R16Float,
            "vsm_shadow_history",
        );

        let ssao_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("ssao_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let ssao_pbr_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_pbr_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let vsm_shadow_pbr_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_shadow_pbr_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let normal_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("normal_bind_group"),
            layout: &normal_pass.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: model_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        let ssao_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("gtao_bind_group"),
            layout: &ssao_pass.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&normal_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&ssao_pass.noise_texture.view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&ssao_sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 3,
                    resource: camera_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
            ],
        });

        let ssao_blur_bind_group = ssao_pass.create_blur_bind_group(
            &device,
            &ssao_raw_view,
            &common_sampler,
            &normal_view,
        );
        let ssao_upsample_bind_group = ssao_pass.create_upsample_bind_group(
            &device,
            &ssao_half_blurred_view,
            &common_sampler,
            &normal_view,
        );

        // --- TAA infrastructure ---
        let taa_pass = TaaPass::new(&device, &queue, hdr_format);
        let velocity_pass = VelocityPass::new(&device);

        let (taa_history_tex0, taa_history_view0) =
            create_history_texture(&device, config.width, config.height, "taa_history_0");
        let (taa_history_tex1, taa_history_view1) =
            create_history_texture(&device, config.width, config.height, "taa_history_1");
        let (taa_velocity_tex, taa_velocity_view) =
            create_velocity_texture(&device, internal_width, internal_height);

        // Cached per-frame bind groups (rebuilt only on resize, not per frame).
        let velocity_bg = velocity_pass.create_bind_group(&device, &depth_view);
        let taa_history_bgs: [wgpu::BindGroup; 2] = [
            taa_pass.create_bind_group(
                &device,
                &hdr_view,
                &taa_velocity_view,
                &taa_history_view0,
                &taa_pass.reactive_fallback_view,
                &prev_depth_view,
            ),
            taa_pass.create_bind_group(
                &device,
                &hdr_view,
                &taa_velocity_view,
                &taa_history_view1,
                &taa_pass.reactive_fallback_view,
                &prev_depth_view,
            ),
        ];
        let make_tone_bg = |view: &wgpu::TextureView| {
            create_tonemap_bind_group(
                &device,
                &tone_mapping_pipeline,
                view,
                &bloom_mip_views[0],
                &hdr_sampler,
                &tonemap_uniform_buffer,
            )
        };
        let taa_tone_bgs: [wgpu::BindGroup; 2] =
            [make_tone_bg(&taa_history_view0), make_tone_bg(&taa_history_view1)];

        // --- IBL ---
        let ibl_processor = IBLProcessor::new(&device);
        let ibl_resource = IBLResource::dummy(&device, &queue);

        // --- Clustered Forward Rendering ---
        let dummy_camera = Camera::new(std::f32::consts::PI / 4.0, 16.0 / 9.0, 0.1, 1000.0);
        let cluster_manager = ClusterManager::new(internal_width, internal_height, &dummy_camera, &device, &queue);

        let scatter_light_bind_group = scatter_light_pass.create_bind_group(
            &device,
            &hdr_view,
            &depth_view,
            &hdr_sampler,
            &cluster_manager.point_lights_buffer,
        );

        let csm_state = CsmState::new(CsmConfig {
            cascade_count: 4,
            shadow_map_resolution: SHADOW_SIZE,
            near: 0.1,
            far: 200.0,
        });

        // ── VSM resources (directional; activated via `set_shadow_mode`) ──
        let vsm_config = crate::shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmConfig {
            // 256² pages × 512 layers ≈ 128 MB (same budget as 128²×2048).
            pool_pages: 512.min(device.limits().max_texture_array_layers),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let page_px = vsm_config.page_px;
        let layer_count = vsm_config.pool_pages;
        let vsm_pages_tex = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pages"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: page_px,
                height: page_px,
                depth_or_array_layers: layer_count,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: crate::shadow::shadow_atlas::VSM_ATLAS_FORMAT,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });
        let vsm_pages_views: Vec<wgpu::TextureView> = (0..layer_count)
            .map(|l| {
                vsm_pages_tex.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
                    label: Some(&format!("vsm_page{l}")),
                    base_array_layer: l,
                    array_layer_count: Some(1),
                    dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2),
                    ..Default::default()
                })
            })
            .collect();
        let vsm_sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_sampler"),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        let vsm_clipmap =
            crate::shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmClipmap::new(crate::shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmConfig {
                pool_pages: 512.min(device.limits().max_texture_array_layers),
                ..Default::default()
            });
        let info_size = std::mem::size_of::<crate::shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo>() as u64;
        let vsm_info_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_gpu_info"),
            size: info_size.max(16),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });

        // Phase 5: DDGI probe grid. SDF atlas starts empty — demo bricks must NOT
        // be uploaded globally (they multiply into directional shadows and look like
        // painted sliding blobs that don't match the real scene casters).
        let ddgi_gpu = crate::gi::DdgiGpu::new_default(&device);
        let sdf_gpu = crate::sdf::SdfGpuAtlas::new(&device, &queue);
        let (blue_noise_texture, blue_noise_view, blue_noise_sampler) =
            crate::resource::blue_noise::create_blue_noise_texture(&device, &queue);
        let hiz = HiZPyramid::new(&device, internal_width, internal_height);

        let vsm_pages_array_view = vsm_pages_tex.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pages_whole"),
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let vsm_shadow_trace_bind_group = vsm_shadow_pass.create_trace_bind_group(
            &device,
            &normal_view,
            &camera_buffer,
            &light_buffer,
            &vsm_pages_array_view,
            &vsm_sampler,
            &vsm_info_buffer,
            &blue_noise_view,
            &blue_noise_sampler,
        );
        let vsm_shadow_temporal_bind_group = vsm_shadow_pass.create_temporal_bind_group(
            &device,
            &vsm_shadow_raw_view,
            &vsm_shadow_history_view,
            &normal_view,
            &camera_buffer,
            &common_sampler,
        );

        let frame_bind_group = pbr_pass.create_frame_bind_group(
            &device,
            &camera_buffer,
            &shader_debug_buffer,
            &ibl_resource.irradiance_view,
            &ibl_resource.prefiltered_view,
            &ibl_resource.brdf_lut_view,
            &ibl_processor.sampler,
            &blue_noise_view,
            &blue_noise_sampler,
        );
        let scene_bind_group = pbr_pass.create_scene_bind_group(
            &device,
            &light_buffer,
            &shadow_view,
            &shadow_sampler,
            &ssao_blurred_view,
            &ssao_pbr_sampler,
            &cluster_manager.point_lights_buffer,
            &cluster_manager.metadata_buffer,
            &cluster_manager.light_indices_buffer,
            &cluster_manager.info_buffer,
            &csm_view,
            &csm_sampler,
            &local_shadow_atlas_view,
            &shadow_uniform_buffer,
            &vsm_pages_array_view,
            &vsm_sampler,
            &vsm_info_buffer,
            &ddgi_gpu.grid_buffer,
            &ddgi_gpu.probe_buffer,
            &sdf_gpu.scene_buffer,
            &sdf_gpu.view,
            &sdf_gpu.sampler,
            &vsm_shadow_history_view,
            &vsm_shadow_pbr_sampler,
        );

        let vg_system = Some(VGSystem::new(
            &device,
            VGConfig::default(),
            &camera_buffer,
            hdr_format,
            crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT,
        ));

        let depth_fmt = crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT;
        let vg_vis_pass = VgVisPass::new(&device, &pbr_pass.frame_bgl, depth_fmt);
        let vg_resolve_pass = VgResolvePass::new(
            &device,
            hdr_format,
            &pbr_pass.frame_bgl,
            &pbr_pass.scene_bgl,
            msaa_sample_count,
        );
        let vg_shadow_pass = VgShadowPass::new(&device, SHADOW_FORMAT);
        let vg_vis_targets = create_vg_vis_targets(&device, internal_width, internal_height);
        let vg_material_buffer = build_material_storage(&[], &device, &queue);
        let vg_instance_buf = vg_system
            .as_ref()
            .map(|v| v.instance_buffer())
            .expect("vg_system");
        let vg_meshlet_buf = vg_system
            .as_ref()
            .map(|v| v.meshlet_buffer())
            .expect("vg_system");
        let vg_resolve_bind_group = vg_resolve_pass.create_resolve_bind_group(
            &device,
            &vg_vis_targets.id_view,
            &vg_vis_targets.normal_depth_view,
            &vg_vis_targets.uv_view,
            &depth_view,
            vg_instance_buf,
            vg_meshlet_buf,
            &vg_material_buffer,
        );
        let vg_shadow_instances_bg =
            vg_shadow_pass.create_instances_bind_group(&device, vg_instance_buf);

        // Pooled per-frame shadow resources: allocated once here, written via
        // queue.write_buffer each frame (removes per-frame buffer/BG churn).
        let cascade_matrix_buffers: Vec<wgpu::Buffer> = (0..4)
            .map(|i| {
                buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
                    &device,
                    &format!("cascade_matrix_buf{i}"),
                    &[0u8; 64],
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let cascade_matrix_bgs: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup> = cascade_matrix_buffers
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, buf)| {
                device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                    label: Some(&format!("cascade_matrix_bg{i}")),
                    layout: &shadow_pass.bind_group_layout,
                    entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        resource: buf.as_entire_binding(),
                    }],
                })
            })
            .collect();
        let csm_layer_views: Vec<wgpu::TextureView> = (0..4)
            .map(|i| {
                csm_texture
                    .create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
                        label: Some(&format!("csm_layer{i}_view")),
                        base_array_layer: i,
                        array_layer_count: Some(1),
                        dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2),
                        ..Default::default()
                    })
            })
            .collect();
        use crate::shadow::atlas_allocator::MAX_CASTERS;
        // One uniform + bind group per cube face per caster. Sharing 6 buffers
        // across casters races: Queue::write_buffer batches before the encoder,
        // so every face pass would sample the LAST caster's matrices.
        let face_slots = (MAX_CASTERS as usize) * 6;
        let face_matrix_buffers: Vec<wgpu::Buffer> = (0..face_slots)
            .map(|i| {
                buffer::create_uniform_buffer(
                    &device,
                    &format!("face_matrix_buf{i}"),
                    &[0u8; 64],
                )
            })
            .collect();
        let face_matrix_bgs: Vec<wgpu::BindGroup> = face_matrix_buffers
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, buf)| {
                device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                    label: Some(&format!("face_matrix_bg{i}")),
                    layout: &shadow_pass.bind_group_layout,
                    entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                        binding: 0,
                        resource: buf.as_entire_binding(),
                    }],
                })
            })
            .collect();

        // ── VSM resources (directional; activated via `set_shadow_mode`) ──
        let vsm_depth_pass = crate::shadow::depth_pass::VsmDepthPass::new(&device);

        let info_size = std::mem::size_of::<crate::shadow::vsm_clipmap::VsmGpuInfo>() as u64;
        let vsm_info_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_gpu_info"),
            size: info_size.max(16),
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let vsm_pageinfo_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pageinfo_dyn"),
            // One 256-byte dynamic-offset slot per dirty page. Clipmap is
            // 8×16×16 = 2048 virtual pages; we only dirty those covering
            // scene AABBs, but size for a full invalidate just in case.
            size: 2048 * 256,
            usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
            mapped_at_creation: false,
        });
        let vsm_pageinfo_bg = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("vsm_pageinfo_bg_dyn"),
            layout: &vsm_depth_pass.bind_group_layout,
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: model_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Buffer(wgpu::BufferBinding {
                        buffer: &vsm_pageinfo_buffer,
                        offset: 0,
                        size: wgpu::BufferSize::new(256),
                    }),
                },
            ],
        });

        Self {
            device,
            queue,
            surface,
            config,
            render_scale,
            internal_width,
            internal_height,
            shared_layouts,
            pbr_frame_layouts,
            pbr_pass,
            shadow_pass,
            normal_pass,
            ssao_pass,
            camera_buffer,
            camera_uniform,
            camera_near: 0.1,
            camera_far: 200.0,
            light_uniform,
            light_buffer,
            shader_debug_buffer,
            frame_bind_group,
            scene_bind_group,
            msaa_sample_count,
            hdr_msaa_target_count,
            hdr_texture,
            hdr_view,
            hdr_msaa_texture,
            hdr_msaa_view,
            tone_mapping_pipeline,
            tone_mapping_bind_group,
            tonemap_uniform_buffer,
            exposure: 1.0,
            rcas_sharpness: 0.35,
            hdr_sampler,
            normal_texture,
            normal_view,
            normal_bind_group,
            ssao_raw_texture,
            ssao_raw_view,
            ssao_half_blurred_texture,
            ssao_half_blurred_view,
            ssao_blurred_texture,
            ssao_blurred_view,
            ssao_bind_group,
            ssao_blur_bind_group,
            ssao_upsample_bind_group,
            ssao_pbr_sampler,
            ssao_enabled: true,
            vsm_shadow_pass,
            vsm_shadow_raw_texture,
            vsm_shadow_raw_view,
            vsm_shadow_filtered_texture,
            vsm_shadow_filtered_view,
            vsm_shadow_history_texture,
            vsm_shadow_history_view,
            vsm_shadow_trace_bind_group,
            vsm_shadow_temporal_bind_group,
            vsm_shadow_pbr_sampler,
            depth_texture,
            depth_view,
            depth_msaa_texture,
            depth_msaa_view,
            prev_depth_texture,
            prev_depth_view,
            shadow_view,
            shadow_sampler,
            csm_texture,
            csm_view,
            csm_sampler,
            local_shadow_atlas,
            local_shadow_atlas_view,
            shadow_uniform,
            shadow_uniform_buffer,
            registry,
            fallback_texture_bg,
            fallback_normal_view: fallback_normal.view,
            fallback_mr_view: fallback_mr.view,
            common_sampler,
            material_blend_flags: Vec::new(),
            model_buffer,
            model_bind_group,
            shadow_model_bind_group,
            cluster_manager,
            lighting_mode: LightingMode::default(),
            scatter_light_pass,
            scatter_light_bind_group,
            aa_sharp,
            msaa_resolve_pass,
            msaa_resolve_bg,
            smaa_pass,
            ldr_texture,
            ldr_view,
            smaa_out_texture,
            smaa_out_view,
            tone_mapping_ldr_pipeline,
            tone_mapping_ldr_bg,
            rcas_present_pipeline,
            tone_mapping_rcas_bg,
            tonemap_rcas_uniform_buffer,
            bloom_pass,
            bloom_enabled: true,
            bloom_mip_textures,
            bloom_mip_views,
            bloom_scratch_texture,
            bloom_scratch_view,
            bloom_down_bgs,
            bloom_up_bgs,
            bloom_composite_bg,
            ddgi_gpu,
            sdf_gpu,
            blue_noise_texture,
            blue_noise_view,
            blue_noise_sampler,
            hiz,
            use_compressed_vertices: true,
            ibl_processor,
            ibl_resource,
            skybox_pass: None,
            transparent_pass,
            debug_lines_pass,
            current_debug_lines: Vec::new(),
            camera_bind_group,
            taa_enabled: true,
            taa_frame_count: 0,
            taa_prev_vp_unjittered: Mat4::IDENTITY,
            taa_pass,
            velocity_pass,
            taa_history_tex: [taa_history_tex0, taa_history_tex1],
            taa_history_view: [taa_history_view0, taa_history_view1],
            taa_blend_alpha,
            velocity_bg,
            taa_history_bgs,
            taa_tone_bgs,
            taa_velocity_tex,
            taa_velocity_view,
            taa_history_read_idx: 0,
            csm_state,
            // Virtual Geometry is initialised by default so the Nanite-like pipeline
            // is available without extra setup. It remains a no-op unless the scene
            // spawns entities with `VirtualMesh`.
            vg_system,
            vg_vis_pass,
            vg_resolve_pass,
            vg_shadow_pass,
            vg_vis_targets,
            vg_material_buffer,
            vg_resolve_bind_group,
            vg_shadow_instances_bg,
            vg_use_vis_path: true,
            current_point_lights: Vec::new(),
            vsm_depth_pass,
            vsm_clipmap,
            vsm_pages_tex,
            vsm_pages_views,
            vsm_pageinfo_buffer,
            vsm_pageinfo_bg,
            vsm_info_buffer,
            vsm_sampler,
            vsm_enabled: true,
            vsm_screen_shadows: true,
            vsm_dirty_pages_last_frame: 0,
            smrt_config: crate::shadow::smrt::SmrtQuality::Quality.config(),
            vsm_shadow_frame_count: 0,
            vsm_shadow_temporal_alpha: 0.08,
            vsm_warm: false,
            vsm_pages_array_view,
            vg_bind_groups_dirty: true,
            cascade_matrix_buffers,
            cascade_matrix_bgs,
            csm_layer_views,
            face_matrix_buffers,
            face_matrix_bgs,
            particle_system: None,
            particle_sim_uniforms: ParticleSimUniforms::default(),
            reactive_texture: None,
            reactive_view: None,
            mt_command_recording: true,
            model_uniform_scratch: Vec::new(),
            main_vis_scratch: Vec::new(),
            vg_sync_scratch: Vec::new(),
            staging_ring,
        }
    }

    // ── MSAA helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// Which HDR geometry pass performs the MSAA resolve (when `msaa_sample_count > 1`).
    fn hdr_geometry_resolve_pass(
        &self,
        objects: &[RenderObject],
        visibility: &[bool],
    ) -> HdrGeometryResolvePass {
        if self.aa_sharp && self.msaa_sample_count > 1 {
            return HdrGeometryResolvePass::SmartResolve;
        }
        if self.has_alpha_objects(objects, visibility) {
            HdrGeometryResolvePass::Transparent
        } else if self.vg_use_vis_path
            && self
                .vg_system
                .as_ref()
                .map(|v| v.has_content())
                .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            HdrGeometryResolvePass::VgResolve
        } else if self
            .vg_system
            .as_ref()
            .map(|v| v.has_content())
            .unwrap_or(false)
        {
            HdrGeometryResolvePass::VgDebug
        } else {
            HdrGeometryResolvePass::Forward
        }
    }

    fn geometry_depth_view(&self) -> &wgpu::TextureView {
        if self.msaa_sample_count > 1 {
            &self.depth_msaa_view
        } else {
            &self.depth_view
        }
    }

    fn geometry_depth_attachment<'a>(
        &'a self,
        load: wgpu::LoadOp<f32>,
    ) -> wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment<'a> {
        wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
            view: self.geometry_depth_view(),
            depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                load,
                store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
            }),
            stencil_ops: None,
        }
    }

    fn hdr_color_attachment<'a>(
        hdr_view: &'a wgpu::TextureView,
