```rust
                &self.vsm_shadow_pass.pass_uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&VsmPassUniform {
                    frame_index: self.vsm_shadow_frame_count as u32,
                    _pad: [0; 3],
                }),
            );
            self.queue.write_buffer(
                &self.vsm_shadow_pass.temporal_uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&VsmTemporalUniform {
                    blend_alpha: self.vsm_shadow_temporal_alpha,
                    reset: u32::from(self.vsm_shadow_frame_count == 0),
                    _pad: [0.0; 2],
                }),
            );

            let mut trace_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("vsm_shadow_trace"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &self.vsm_shadow_raw_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::WHITE),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            trace_pass.set_pipeline(&self.vsm_shadow_pass.trace_pipeline);
            trace_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.vsm_shadow_trace_bind_group, &[]);
            trace_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            drop(trace_pass);

            let mut temporal_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("vsm_shadow_temporal"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &self.vsm_shadow_filtered_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::WHITE),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            temporal_pass.set_pipeline(&self.vsm_shadow_pass.temporal_pipeline);
            temporal_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.vsm_shadow_temporal_bind_group, &[]);
            temporal_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            drop(temporal_pass);

            // Ping-pong: output buffer becomes next frame's history (no GPU copy).
            std::mem::swap(&mut self.vsm_shadow_filtered_texture, &mut self.vsm_shadow_history_texture);
            std::mem::swap(&mut self.vsm_shadow_filtered_view, &mut self.vsm_shadow_history_view);
            self.vsm_shadow_temporal_bind_group = self.vsm_shadow_pass.create_temporal_bind_group(
                &self.device,
                &self.vsm_shadow_raw_view,
                &self.vsm_shadow_history_view,
                &self.normal_view,
                &self.camera_buffer,
                &self.common_sampler,
            );
            self.update_global_bind_group();
        } else {
            let _ = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("vsm_shadow_disabled_clear"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &self.vsm_shadow_filtered_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::WHITE),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
        }

        // 5. Forward pass into HDR. Always clear + draw regular meshes.
        // VG vis/resolve composites on top; skipping this left HDR uninitialized
        // (full-screen white) as soon as any VG instance existed.
        let hdr_resolve_pass =
            self.hdr_geometry_resolve_pass(objects, &self.main_vis_scratch);
        let msaa_sample_count = self.msaa_sample_count;
        let debug_lines = std::mem::take(&mut self.current_debug_lines);
        if !debug_lines.is_empty() {
            self.debug_lines_pass
                .upload_lines(&self.queue, &debug_lines);
        }
        {
            let mut render_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("forward_pass_hdr"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(Self::hdr_color_attachment(
                    &self.hdr_view,
                    &self.hdr_msaa_view,
                    msaa_sample_count,
                    wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                        r: 0.05,
                        g: 0.05,
                        b: 0.08,
                        a: 1.0,
                    }),
                    hdr_resolve_pass,
                    HdrGeometryResolvePass::Forward,
                ))],
                depth_stencil_attachment: Some(self.geometry_depth_attachment(wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0))),
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });

            // Skybox background:
            // opaque fragment overwrites it. Skipped while the dummy (black)
            // IBL placeholder is active.
            if let Some(sb) = &self.skybox_pass {
                if !self.ibl_resource.is_dummy() {
                    sb.draw(&mut render_pass);
                }
            }

            self.record_draw(&mut render_pass, objects, &self.main_vis_scratch);
            if !debug_lines.is_empty() {
                self.debug_lines_pass
                    .draw(&self.camera_bind_group, &mut render_pass);
            }
        }

        // ── 5a. VG visibility buffer + PBR resolve ───────────────────────────
        if self.vg_use_vis_path {
            let vg_has_content = self
                .vg_system
                .as_ref()
                .map(|v| v.has_content())
                .unwrap_or(false);
            if vg_has_content {
                if self.vg_bind_groups_dirty {
                    self.rebuild_vg_bind_groups();
                }
                if let Some(vg) = &self.vg_system {
                    {
                        let mut vis_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                            label: Some("vg_vis_pass"),
                            color_attachments: &[
                                Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                                    view: &self.vg_vis_targets.id_view,
                                    resolve_target: None,
                                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                                        // R32Uint clear: do NOT use f32::from_bits(0xFFFF_FFFF)
                                        // (that is NaN; many drivers clear uint as 0). wgpu casts
                                        // Color.r as u32, and VIS_ID_SENTINEL as f64 is exact.
                                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                                            r: VIS_ID_SENTINEL as f64,
                                            g: 0.0,
                                            b: 0.0,
                                            a: 1.0,
                                        }),
                                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                                    },
                                }),
                                Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                                    view: &self.vg_vis_targets.normal_depth_view,
                                    resolve_target: None,
                                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                                    },
                                }),
                                Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                                    view: &self.vg_vis_targets.uv_view,
                                    resolve_target: None,
                                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::TRANSPARENT),
                                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                                    },
                                }),
                            ],
                            depth_stencil_attachment: Some(
                                wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
                                    view: &self.depth_view,
                                    depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
                                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                                    }),
                                    stencil_ops: None,
                                },
                            ),
                            timestamp_writes: None,
                            occlusion_query_set: None,
                        });
                        vg.draw_vis_indirect(
                            &mut vis_pass,
                            &self.vg_vis_pass,
                            &self.frame_bind_group,
                        );
                    }

                    {
                        let mut resolve_pass =
                            encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                                label: Some("vg_resolve_pass"),
                                color_attachments: &[Some(Self::hdr_color_attachment(
                                    &self.hdr_view,
                                    &self.hdr_msaa_view,
                                    msaa_sample_count,
                                    wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                                    hdr_resolve_pass,
                                    HdrGeometryResolvePass::VgResolve,
                                ))],
                                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                                timestamp_writes: None,
                                occlusion_query_set: None,
                            });
                        self.vg_resolve_pass.draw(
                            &mut resolve_pass,
                            &self.frame_bind_group,
                            &self.scene_bind_group,
                            &self.vg_resolve_bind_group,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if let Some(vg) = &self.vg_system {
            // Debug forward path (teal normals).
            let mut render_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("vg_debug_forward"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(Self::hdr_color_attachment(
                    &self.hdr_view,
                    &self.hdr_msaa_view,
                        msaa_sample_count,
                        wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                    hdr_resolve_pass,
                    HdrGeometryResolvePass::VgDebug,
                ))],
                depth_stencil_attachment: Some(self.geometry_depth_attachment(wgpu::LoadOp::Load)),
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            if vg.has_content() {
                vg.render(&mut render_pass);
            }
        }
        // ── 5b. Transparent pass:
        // Same HDR target and depth buffer as the forward pass, but with
        // depth writes disabled (read-only depth) so transparent surfaces
        // never occlude each other.
        if self.has_alpha_objects(objects, &self.main_vis_scratch) {
            let mut transparent_render_pass =
                encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("transparent_pass"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(Self::hdr_color_attachment(
                        &self.hdr_view,
                        &self.hdr_msaa_view,
                    msaa_sample_count,
                    wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                    hdr_resolve_pass,
                    HdrGeometryResolvePass::Transparent,
                    ))],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: Some(self.geometry_depth_attachment(wgpu::LoadOp::Load)),
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
            self.record_draw_transparent(&mut transparent_render_pass, objects, &self.main_vis_scratch);
        }

        // ── 5c. Smart Resolve (Sharp AA): luma-weighted MSAA resolve → hdr_view ─
        if self.aa_sharp && self.msaa_sample_count > 1 {
            self.msaa_resolve_pass.record(
                &mut encoder,
                &self.msaa_resolve_bg,
                &self.hdr_view,
            );
        }

        // ── 5d. GPU particles (billboards + reactive mask) ─────────────────
        if self.reactive_view.is_some() {
            if let Some(reactive) = &self.reactive_view {
                let _ = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("reactive_clear"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: reactive,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
            }
        }
        if let Some(ps) = &self.particle_system {
            if ps.last_alive_count > 0 || ps.gpu_sim_enabled {
                let reactive = self.reactive_view.as_ref();
                let mut particle_pass =
                    ps.begin_draw_pass(&mut encoder, &self.hdr_view, &self.depth_view, reactive);
                ps.record_draw(&mut particle_pass, reactive);
            }
        }

        // ── ScatterLight (HDR, pre-TAA) ─────────────────────────────────────
        self.record_scatter_light_pass(&mut encoder);

        // ── Tone-mapping uniform (shared by both call sites below) ─────────
        self.queue.write_buffer(
            &self.tonemap_uniform_buffer,
            0,
            bytemuck::bytes_of(&TonemapUniform {
                exposure: self.exposure,
                sharpen_enabled: if self.taa_enabled { 1 } else { 0 },
                bloom_enabled: if self.bloom_enabled { 1 } else { 0 },
                rcas_sharpness: if self.taa_enabled {
                    self.rcas_sharpness
                } else {
                    0.0
                },
                output_size: [self.config.width as f32, self.config.height as f32],
            }),
        );

        // ── TAA: velocity + accumulation passes ─────────────────────────────
        if self.taa_enabled {
            // --- 6a. Update velocity uniform (same P'*V as rasterization) ---
            let inv_jittered_vp = jittered_vp.inverse();

            let jitter = halton_jitter_ndc(
                self.taa_frame_count,
                self.internal_width,
                self.internal_height,
            );
            let vel_uniform = VelocityUniform {
                inv_curr_vp: inv_jittered_vp.to_cols_array_2d(),
                prev_vp: self.taa_prev_vp_unjittered.to_cols_array_2d(),
                screen_size: [self.internal_width as f32, self.internal_height as f32],
                jitter_uv: [jitter[0] * 0.5, -jitter[1] * 0.5],
            };
            self.queue.write_buffer(
                &self.velocity_pass.uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&vel_uniform),
            );


            // --- 6b. Velocity pass ---
            {
                let mut vel_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("velocity_pass"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: &self.taa_velocity_view,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
                                r: 0.0,
                                g: 0.0,
                                b: 0.0,
                                a: 1.0,
                            }),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
                vel_pass.set_pipeline(&self.velocity_pass.pipeline);
                vel_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.velocity_bg, &[]);
                vel_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }

            // --- 6c. Update TAA uniform ---
            let is_first_frame = self.taa_frame_count == 0;
            let jitter = halton_jitter_ndc(
                self.taa_frame_count,
                self.internal_width,
                self.internal_height,
            );
            let taa_uniform = TaaUniform {
                output_size: [self.config.width as f32, self.config.height as f32],
                input_size: [self.internal_width as f32, self.internal_height as f32],
                blend_alpha: self.taa_blend_alpha,
                reset: if is_first_frame { 1 } else { 0 },
                jitter_uv: [jitter[0] * 0.5, -jitter[1] * 0.5],
            };
            self.queue.write_buffer(
                &self.taa_pass.uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&taa_uniform),
            );

            // Ping-pong: read from history_read_idx, write to the other.
            let history_read_idx = self.taa_history_read_idx;
            let history_write_idx = 1 - history_read_idx;
            // Bind groups are prebuilt per history slot and rebuilt on resize.
            let taa_bg = &self.taa_history_bgs[history_read_idx];

            // --- 6d. TAA accumulation pass → write history ---
            {
                let mut taa_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("taa_pass"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: &self.taa_history_view[history_write_idx],
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
                taa_pass.set_pipeline(&self.taa_pass.pipeline);
                taa_pass.set_bind_group(0, &taa_bg, &[]);
                taa_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }

            // --- 6e. Bloom from stabilized TAA output, then tone map ---
            let taa_out_view = &self.taa_history_view[history_write_idx];
            self.record_bloom_chain(&mut encoder, taa_out_view);

            // Prebuilt bind group over the freshly written history slot.
            let taa_tone_bg = &self.taa_tone_bgs[history_write_idx];
            {
                let mut post_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("tone_mapping_pass"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: &surface_view,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
                post_pass.set_pipeline(&self.tone_mapping_pipeline);
                post_pass.set_bind_group(0, &taa_tone_bg, &[]);
                post_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }

            // --- 6f. Advance ping-pong and frame counter ---
            self.taa_history_read_idx = history_write_idx;
            self.taa_prev_vp_unjittered = unjittered_vp;
            self.taa_frame_count += 1;
        } else if self.aa_sharp {
            // ── Sharp AA path: ACES→LDR → SMAA → RCAS→surface ────────────
            self.record_bloom_chain(&mut encoder, &self.hdr_view);

            // 1) ACES tonemap HDR+bloom → ldr_view (Rgba8Unorm, no RCAS)
            self.queue.write_buffer(
                &self.tonemap_uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&TonemapUniform {
                    exposure: self.exposure,
                    sharpen_enabled: 0,
                    bloom_enabled: if self.bloom_enabled { 1 } else { 0 },
                    rcas_sharpness: 0.0,
                    output_size: [self.config.width as f32, self.config.height as f32],
                }),
            );
            {
                let mut ldr_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("sharp_tonemap_ldr"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: &self.ldr_view,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
                ldr_pass.set_pipeline(&self.tone_mapping_ldr_pipeline);
                ldr_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.tone_mapping_ldr_bg, &[]);
                ldr_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }

            // 2) SMAA 1× on LDR
            self.smaa_pass.record(
                &self.device,
                &self.queue,
                &mut encoder,
                &self.ldr_view,
                &self.smaa_out_view,
            );

            // 3) RCAS sharpen → surface (fs_present_rcas: no ACES, just RCAS)
            self.queue.write_buffer(
                &self.tonemap_rcas_uniform_buffer,
                0,
                bytemuck::bytes_of(&TonemapUniform {
                    exposure: 1.0,
                    sharpen_enabled: 1,
                    bloom_enabled: 0,
                    rcas_sharpness: self.rcas_sharpness,
                    output_size: [self.config.width as f32, self.config.height as f32],
                }),
            );
            {
                let mut rcas_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                    label: Some("sharp_rcas_present"),
                    color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                        view: &surface_view,
                        resolve_target: None,
                        ops: wgpu::Operations {
                            load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                            store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                        },
                    })],
                    depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                    occlusion_query_set: None,
                });
                rcas_pass.set_pipeline(&self.rcas_present_pipeline);
                rcas_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.tone_mapping_rcas_bg, &[]);
                rcas_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
            }
        } else {
            // ── Standard path (no TAA, no Sharp): bloom then tone map from HDR
            self.record_bloom_chain(&mut encoder, &self.hdr_view);
            let mut post_pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
                label: Some("tone_mapping_pass"),
                color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
                    view: &surface_view,
                    resolve_target: None,
                    ops: wgpu::Operations {
                        load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
                        store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
                    },
                })],
                depth_stencil_attachment: None,
                timestamp_writes: None,
                occlusion_query_set: None,
            });
            post_pass.set_pipeline(&self.tone_mapping_pipeline);
            post_pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.tone_mapping_bind_group, &[]);
            post_pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
        }

        // Copy current depth → prev depth for next frame's TAA disocclusion test.
        if self.taa_enabled {
            encoder.copy_texture_to_texture(
                wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
                    texture: &self.depth_texture,
                    mip_level: 0,
                    origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
                    aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::DepthOnly,
                },
                wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
                    texture: &self.prev_depth_texture,
                    mip_level: 0,
                    origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
                    aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::DepthOnly,
                },
                wgpu::Extent3d {
                    width: self.internal_width,
                    height: self.internal_height,
                    depth_or_array_layers: 1,
                },
            );
        }

        if let Some(vg) = self.vg_system.as_mut() {
            if vg.config.gpu_cull {
                vg.schedule_gpu_cull_readback(&mut encoder);
            }
        }

        // Feed next frame's motion reprojection (VSM temporal, future TAA-adjacent passes).
        self.camera_uniform.snapshot_prev_view_proj();
        if self.vsm_enabled {
            self.vsm_shadow_frame_count = self.vsm_shadow_frame_count.saturating_add(1);
        }

        self.queue.submit(
            mt_cmd_buffers
                .into_iter()
                .chain(std::iter::once(encoder.finish())),
        );
        self.staging_ring.end_frame();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Convenience wrapper: acquires a surface texture, renders into it, then
    /// presents it. Use `render_frame_into` + manual `present()` when you need
    /// to add additional passes (e.g. egui) before presentation.
    /// Render one frame from an explicit [`FrameView`] (preferred API).
    pub fn render_frame_view(
        &mut self,
        fv: &FrameView<'_>,
        surface_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> Result<(), wgpu::SurfaceError> {
        self.camera_near = fv.camera.near;
        self.camera_far = fv.camera.far;
        let light_u = fv.lights.to_legacy_uniform();
        self.update_light_buffer(&light_u);
        self.current_point_lights = fv.lights.points.clone();
        self.update_cluster_lights(&fv.lights.points, fv.camera);
        self.render_frame_into(fv.objects, surface_view)
    }

    pub fn render_frame(&mut self, objects: &[RenderObject]) -> Result<(), wgpu::SurfaceError> {
        let output = self
            .surface
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or(wgpu::SurfaceError::Lost)?
            .get_current_texture()?;
        let surface_view = output
            .texture
            .create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
        self.render_frame_into(objects, &surface_view)?;
        output.present();
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Writes the current camera uniform to the GPU.
    pub fn update_camera_buffer(&mut self) {
        let bytes = bytemuck::bytes_of(&self.camera_uniform).to_vec();
        self.staging_ring.write_immediate(
            &self.queue,
            &self.camera_buffer,
            0,
            &bytes,
            false,
        );
    }

    /// Returns the current light uniform.
    pub fn pbr_pass_light_uniform(&self) -> LightUniform {
        self.light_uniform
    }

    /// Writes a new light uniform to the GPU.
    ///
    /// When [`Self::vsm_enabled`] is true, forces `soft_shadows = 2` (VSM path)
    /// so the PBR shader never falls through to classic CSM.
    pub fn update_light_buffer(&mut self, light: &LightUniform) {
        let mut light = *light;
        if self.vsm_enabled {
            light.soft_shadows = 2;
        }
        self.light_uniform = light;
        let bytes = bytemuck::bytes_of(&light).to_vec();
        self.staging_ring.write_immediate(
            &self.queue,
            &self.light_buffer,
            0,
            &bytes,
            false,
        );
    }

    /// Writes the shader debug uniform (debug_viz_mode) to the GPU.
    pub fn update_shader_debug_buffer(&mut self, mode: ShaderDebugVizMode) {
        let mut u = ShaderDebugUniform::default();
        u.debug_viz_mode = mode as u32;
        u.frame_index = self.taa_frame_count as u32;
        u.ibl_enabled = u32::from(!self.ibl_resource.is_dummy());
        u.gtao_enabled = u32::from(self.ssao_enabled);
        let bytes = bytemuck::bytes_of(&u).to_vec();
        self.staging_ring.write_immediate(
            &self.queue,
            &self.shader_debug_buffer,
            0,
            &bytes,
            false,
        );
    }

    pub fn update_model_buffer(&mut self, objects: &[RenderObject]) {
        self.model_uniform_scratch.clear();
        self.model_uniform_scratch.reserve(objects.len());
        for obj in objects {
            let m3 = Mat3::from_cols(
                obj.model_matrix.x_axis.truncate(),
                obj.model_matrix.y_axis.truncate(),
                obj.model_matrix.z_axis.truncate(),
            );
            let nt = m3.inverse().transpose();
            let (bounds_min, bounds_extent) = self
                .registry
                .mesh_by_slot(obj.mesh_index)
                .map(|m| bounds_vectors(&m.local_bounds))
                .unwrap_or(([0.0; 4], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0]));
            self.model_uniform_scratch.push(ModelUniform {
                model: obj.model_matrix.to_cols_array_2d(),
                normal_matrix: [
                    nt.x_axis.extend(0.0).to_array(),
                    nt.y_axis.extend(0.0).to_array(),
                    nt.z_axis.extend(0.0).to_array(),
                ],
                color: obj.color,
                bounds_min,
                bounds_extent,
            });
        }
        let bytes = bytemuck::cast_slice(&self.model_uniform_scratch).to_vec();
        self.staging_ring.write_immediate(
            &self.queue,
            &self.model_buffer,
            0,
            &bytes,
            false,
        );
    }

    /// Updates cluster light assignments. Call this when lights change or camera is updated.
    ///
    /// Must be called **after** `update_camera_buffer()` so that `camera_uniform.camera_pos`
    /// already holds the correct world-space camera position for this frame.
    pub fn update_cluster_lights(&mut self, lights: &[crate::light::PointLight], camera: &Camera) {
        self.current_point_lights = lights.to_vec();
        let cp = self.camera_uniform.camera_pos;
        let cam_pos = redox_math::Vec3::new(cp[0], cp[1], cp[2]);
        self.cluster_manager.update_clusters(
            lights,
            camera,
            cam_pos,
            Mat4::from_cols_array_2d(&self.camera_uniform.view_proj),
            &self.device,
            &self.queue,
        );
    }

    /// Returns cluster manager for GPU cluster buffer bindings (if needed).
    pub fn cluster_manager(&self) -> &ClusterManager {
        &self.cluster_manager
    }

    // ── Virtual Geometry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// Initialise the Virtual Geometry subsystem with the given config.
    ///
    /// Call once after [`RenderContext::new`].  After this, `vg_system` is
    /// `Some` and VG assets / instances can be registered.
    pub fn init_virtual_geometry(&mut self, config: VGConfig) {
        // Use HDR format since VG objects are rendered into the HDR buffer in the forward pass
        let hdr_fmt = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float;
        let depth_fmt = crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT;
        let vg = VGSystem::new(&self.device, config, &self.camera_buffer, hdr_fmt, depth_fmt);
        self.vg_system = Some(vg);
        self.rebuild_vg_bind_groups();
    }

    /// Register a mesh as a VG asset, returning its [`VGAssetId`].
    ///
    /// Requires [`init_virtual_geometry`] to have been called first.
    pub fn register_vg_mesh(
        &mut self,
        mesh: &crate::mesh::Mesh,
        material_index: u32,
    ) -> Option<VGAssetId> {
        self.vg_system.as_mut()?.register_mesh(mesh, material_index, &self.queue)
    }

    /// Prepare the VG system for this frame and synchronise transforms from ECS.
    ///
    /// Must be called each frame before [`render_frame`].
    pub fn prepare_vg_frame(&mut self, world: &mut redox_ecs::world::World) {
        let vg = match self.vg_system.as_mut() {
            Some(v) => v,
            None => return,
        };

        // Phase 1: collect VG entities via query (not all_entities scan).
        type Entity = redox_ecs::Entity;
        self.vg_sync_scratch.clear();
        for (entity, vm, transform) in world
            .query::<(Entity, &VirtualMesh, &Transform)>()
            .iter(world)
        {
            self.vg_sync_scratch.push((
                entity,
                transform.matrix().to_cols_array_2d(),
                vm.instance_handle,
                vm.asset_id,
            ));
        }

        // Phase 2: apply updates and spawn new instances, then write back handles
        let mut new_handles: Vec<(Entity, crate::virtual_geometry::VGInstanceHandle)> = Vec::new();
        for (entity, mat, handle_opt, asset_id) in &self.vg_sync_scratch {
            if let Some(handle) = *handle_opt {
                vg.update_instance_transform(handle, *mat);
            } else if let Some(handle) = vg.spawn_instance(*asset_id, *mat) {
                new_handles.push((*entity, handle));
            }
        }
        // Phase 3: write back newly assigned instance handles
        for (entity, handle) in new_handles {
            if let Some(vm_mut) = world.get_component_mut::<VirtualMesh>(entity) {
                vm_mut.instance_handle = Some(handle);
            }
        }

        // Run CPU culling and upload draw commands
        let vp = self.camera_uniform.view_proj;
        let cam_pos = redox_math::Vec3::from_array([
            self.camera_uniform.camera_pos[0],
            self.camera_uniform.camera_pos[1],
            self.camera_uniform.camera_pos[2],
        ]);
        // Recover vertical FOV from projection matrix (perspective RH [0,1]).
        let fov_y = 2.0 * (1.0 / self.camera_uniform.proj[1][1]).atan();
        vg.prepare_frame(&self.queue, &vp, cam_pos, fov_y);
    }
}

/// Helper to create a render target texture for normal or GTAO pass.
fn create_normal_ssao_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    label: &str,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width,
            height,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// Pick the best HDR MSAA sample count supported by the adapter (prefer ×4, then ×2).
///
/// Used by [`crate::Renderer`] and editor offscreen hosts that share the Sharp AA path.
pub fn pick_hdr_msaa_sample_count(
    adapter: &wgpu::Adapter,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    want_msaa: bool,
) -> u32 {
    if !want_msaa {
        return 1;
    }
    let flags = adapter.get_texture_format_features(format).flags;
    for count in [4u32, 2] {
        if flags.sample_count_supported(count) {
            return count;
        }
    }
    1
}

/// Rgba8Unorm intermediate for Sharp AA (LDR tonemap output or SMAA result).
fn create_sharp_intermediate(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    label: &str,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// Previous-frame depth buffer for TAA disocclusion (Depth32Float copy).
fn create_prev_depth_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    _queue: &wgpu::Queue,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("prev_depth_texture"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// Helper to create HDR texture, view and sampler.
fn create_hdr_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView, wgpu::Sampler) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("hdr_texture"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width,
            height,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
        label: Some("hdr_sampler"),
        address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
        mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
        min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
        mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
        ..Default::default()
    });
    (texture, view, sampler)
}

/// Multisampled HDR colour target for geometry passes (TXAA-style MSAA input).
/// Includes TEXTURE_BINDING so the Smart Resolve pass can read individual samples.
fn create_hdr_msaa_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    sample_count: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("hdr_msaa_texture"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width,
            height,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

/// Multisampled depth target matching HDR MSAA sample count.
fn create_depth_msaa_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    sample_count: u32,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("depth_msaa_texture"),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: crate::pass::forward::DEPTH_FORMAT,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    (texture, view)
}

fn create_bloom_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
    label: &str,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        size: wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: width.max(1),
            height: height.max(1),
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_SRC
            | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
    (texture, view)
}

fn create_bloom_mip_chain(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
) -> (
    [wgpu::Texture; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT],
    [wgpu::TextureView; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT],
) {
    use crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT;
    let mut textures = Vec::with_capacity(BLOOM_MIP_COUNT);
    let mut views = Vec::with_capacity(BLOOM_MIP_COUNT);
    let mut w = width;
    let mut h = height;
    for i in 0..BLOOM_MIP_COUNT {
        w = (w / 2).max(1);
        h = (h / 2).max(1);
        let (tex, view) = create_bloom_texture(device, w, h, format, &format!("bloom_mip{i}"));
        textures.push(tex);
        views.push(view);
    }
    (
        textures.try_into().unwrap(),
        views.try_into().unwrap(),
    )
}

fn create_bloom_downsample_bgs(
    bloom_pass: &crate::post::bloom::BloomPass,
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    hdr_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    mip_views: &[wgpu::TextureView; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT],
    sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
) -> [wgpu::BindGroup; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT] {
    use crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT;
    let mut bgs = Vec::with_capacity(BLOOM_MIP_COUNT);
    for i in 0..BLOOM_MIP_COUNT {
        let src = if i == 0 { hdr_view } else { &mip_views[i - 1] };
        bgs.push(bloom_pass.create_bind_group(device, src, sampler));
    }
    bgs.try_into().unwrap()
}

fn create_bloom_upsample_bgs(
    bloom_pass: &crate::post::bloom::BloomPass,
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    mip_views: &[wgpu::TextureView; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT],
    sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
) -> [wgpu::BindGroup; crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT - 1] {
    use crate::post::bloom::BLOOM_MIP_COUNT;
    let mut bgs = Vec::with_capacity(BLOOM_MIP_COUNT - 1);
    for i in 0..BLOOM_MIP_COUNT - 1 {
        // Upsample reads the coarser mip (i+1) into mip i.
        bgs.push(bloom_pass.create_bind_group(device, &mip_views[i + 1], sampler));
    }
    bgs.try_into().unwrap()
}

/// Conservative overlap test: world AABB vs ortho clip cube `[-1,1]×[-1,1]×[0,1]`.
fn aabb_overlaps_clip(bounds: Aabb, view_proj: Mat4) -> bool {
    let b = bounds;
    let corners = [
        Vec3::new(b.min.x, b.min.y, b.min.z),
        Vec3::new(b.max.x, b.min.y, b.min.z),
        Vec3::new(b.min.x, b.max.y, b.min.z),
        Vec3::new(b.max.x, b.max.y, b.min.z),
        Vec3::new(b.min.x, b.min.y, b.max.z),
        Vec3::new(b.max.x, b.min.y, b.max.z),
        Vec3::new(b.min.x, b.max.y, b.max.z),
        Vec3::new(b.max.x, b.max.y, b.max.z),
    ];
    let mut min_c = Vec3::splat(f32::INFINITY);
    let mut max_c = Vec3::splat(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
    for c in corners {
        let p = view_proj.transform_point3(c);
        min_c = min_c.min(p);
        max_c = max_c.max(p);
    }
    !(max_c.x < -1.0
        || min_c.x > 1.0
        || max_c.y < -1.0
        || min_c.y > 1.0
        || max_c.z < 0.0
        || min_c.z > 1.0)
}
```

```rust
//! Procedural 64×64 blue-noise R8 texture for stochastic alpha testing.

/// Generate a 64×64 R8 blue-noise tile (4096 bytes).
pub fn generate_blue_noise_64() -> Vec<u8> {
    let size = 64usize;
    let mut data = vec![0u8; size * size];
    for y in 0..size {
        for x in 0..size {
            let h = hash2d(x as u32, y as u32, 0xB10C_u32);
            data[y * size + x] = (h & 0xFF) as u8;
        }
    }
    data
}

fn hash2d(x: u32, y: u32, seed: u32) -> u32 {
    let mut h = x.wrapping_mul(73856093) ^ y.wrapping_mul(19349663) ^ seed;
    h ^= h >> 16;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(0x7feb352d);
    h ^= h >> 15;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(0x846ca68b);
    h ^= h >> 16;
    h
}

/// Upload blue-noise texture to the GPU.
pub fn create_blue_noise_texture(
    device: &wgpu::Device,
    queue: &wgpu::Queue,
) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView, wgpu::Sampler) {
    let data = generate_blue_noise_64();
    let size = wgpu::Extent3d {
        width: 64,
        height: 64,
        depth_or_array_layers: 1,
    };
    let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
        label: Some("blue_noise_64"),
        size,
        mip_level_count: 1,
        sample_count: 1,
        dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
        format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
        usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
        view_formats: &[],
    });
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
            texture: &texture,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        &data,
        wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(64),
            rows_per_image: Some(64),
        },
        size,
    );
    let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());
    let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
        label: Some("blue_noise_sampler"),
        address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
        address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::Repeat,
        mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
        min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
        ..Default::default()
    });
    (texture, view, sampler)
}
```

```rust
//! Helpers for creating `wgpu` buffers.

use wgpu::util::DeviceExt;

/// Creates a vertex buffer initialised with `data`.
pub fn create_vertex_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, data: &[u8]) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        contents: data,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX,
    })
}

/// Creates an index buffer initialised with `data`.
pub fn create_index_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, data: &[u8]) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        contents: data,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::INDEX,
    })
}

/// Creates a uniform buffer initialised with `data`.
///
/// The buffer is created with both `UNIFORM` and `COPY_DST` usages so that
/// it can be updated each frame via `Queue::write_buffer`.
pub fn create_uniform_buffer(device: &wgpu::Device, label: &str, data: &[u8]) -> wgpu::Buffer {
    device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
        label: Some(label),
        contents: data,
        usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
    })
}
```

```rust
use crate::resource::texture::Texture;

/// Holds the pre-processed textures for IBL.
pub struct IBLResource {
    pub irradiance_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub prefiltered_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub brdf_lut_view: wgpu::TextureView,
    pub environment_view: wgpu::TextureView, // Original cubemap
    /// Whether a real environment was loaded (`from_equirect`).
    /// `dummy()` leaves this false so consumers (e.g. the skybox pass) can
    /// skip drawing the all-black placeholder.
    env_loaded: bool,
    /// Dummy maps must stay alive: dropping them leaves the views pointing at
    /// freed GPU memory (view-dependent white/cyan flashes).
    _owned: Vec<wgpu::Texture>,
}

/// Represents a Skybox (environment map).
pub struct Skybox {
    pub cubemap: wgpu::Texture,
    pub view: wgpu::TextureView,
}

/// Processor to generate IBL maps using compute shaders.
pub struct IBLProcessor {
    pub pipeline_equirect_to_cube: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    pub pipeline_irradiance: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    pub pipeline_prefilter: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    pub pipeline_brdf_lut: wgpu::ComputePipeline,
    pub sampler: wgpu::Sampler,
}

impl IBLProcessor {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device) -> Self {
        use crate::shader::{
            BRDF_LUT_WGSL, EQUIRECT_TO_CUBE_WGSL, IRRADIANCE_CONVOLUTION_WGSL,
            PREFILTER_CONVOLUTION_WGSL, create_shader_module,
        };

        // Each entry point lives in its own shader module so that naga never
        // sees two variables at the same @group/@binding with different types.
        let equirect_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "equirect_to_cube_shader", EQUIRECT_TO_CUBE_WGSL);
        let irradiance_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "irradiance_convolution_shader", IRRADIANCE_CONVOLUTION_WGSL);
        let prefilter_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "prefilter_convolution_shader", PREFILTER_CONVOLUTION_WGSL);
        let brdf_lut_shader =
            create_shader_module(device, "brdf_lut_shader", BRDF_LUT_WGSL);

        // Linear filtering with clamping and trilinear mip blending.
        let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_sampler"),
            address_mode_u: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_v: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            address_mode_w: wgpu::AddressMode::ClampToEdge,
            mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            mipmap_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Linear,
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let pipeline_equirect_to_cube =
            device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("equirect_to_cube_pipeline"),
                layout: None,
                module: &equirect_shader,
                entry_point: "equirect_to_cubemap",
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            });

        let pipeline_irradiance =
            device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("irradiance_pipeline"),
                layout: None,
                module: &irradiance_shader,
                entry_point: "irradiance_convolution",
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            });

        let pipeline_prefilter =
            device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("prefilter_pipeline"),
                layout: None,
                module: &prefilter_shader,
                entry_point: "prefilter_convolution",
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            });

        let pipeline_brdf_lut =
            device.create_compute_pipeline(&wgpu::ComputePipelineDescriptor {
                label: Some("brdf_lut_pipeline"),
                layout: None,
                module: &brdf_lut_shader,
                entry_point: "brdf_lut",
                compilation_options: Default::default(),
            });

        Self {
            pipeline_equirect_to_cube,
            pipeline_irradiance,
            pipeline_prefilter,
            pipeline_brdf_lut,
            sampler,
        }
    }

    /// Converts an equirectangular HDR texture to a cubemap.
    pub fn generate_cubemap(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        equirect: &Texture,
        size: u32,
    ) -> Skybox {
        let cubemap = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_cubemap"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size,
                height: size,
                depth_or_array_layers: 6,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let view = cubemap.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_cubemap_view"),
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let storage_view = cubemap.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_cubemap_storage_view"),
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("equirect_to_cube_bind_group"),
            layout: &self.pipeline_equirect_to_cube.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&equirect.view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 2,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&storage_view),
                },
            ],
        });

        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_generator_encoder"),
        });
        {
            let mut compute_pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("equirect_to_cube_pass"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            compute_pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline_equirect_to_cube);
            compute_pass.set_bind_group(0, &bind_group, &[]);
            compute_pass.dispatch_workgroups((size + 7) / 8, (size + 7) / 8, 6);
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));

        Skybox { cubemap, view }
    }

    /// Generates the BRDF LUT 2D texture.
    pub fn generate_brdf_lut(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
    ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
        let size = 512;
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_brdf_lut"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size,
                height: size,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default());

        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("brdf_lut_bind_group"),
            layout: &self.pipeline_brdf_lut.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&view),
            }],
        });

        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_brdf_lut_encoder"),
        });
        {
            let mut compute_pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("brdf_lut_pass"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            compute_pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline_brdf_lut);
            compute_pass.set_bind_group(0, &bind_group, &[]);
            compute_pass.dispatch_workgroups(size / 8, size / 8, 1);
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));

        (texture, view)
    }

    /// Generates the irradiance map from an environmental cubemap.
    pub fn generate_irradiance_map(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        skybox_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
        let size = 32; // Irradiance maps are low resolution
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_irradiance_map"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size,
                height: size,
                depth_or_array_layers: 6,
            },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let storage_view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
            ..Default::default()
        });

        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("irradiance_bind_group"),
            layout: &self.pipeline_irradiance.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(skybox_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                },
            ],
        });

        // Wait, I need a separate bind group for the output if I used @group(1) in shader
        let output_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("irradiance_output_bind_group"),
            layout: &self.pipeline_irradiance.get_bind_group_layout(1),
            entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                binding: 0,
                resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&storage_view),
            }],
        });

        let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_irradiance_encoder"),
        });
        {
            let mut compute_pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                label: Some("irradiance_pass"),
                timestamp_writes: None,
            });
            compute_pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline_irradiance);
            compute_pass.set_bind_group(0, &bind_group, &[]);
            compute_pass.set_bind_group(1, &output_bind_group, &[]);
            compute_pass.dispatch_workgroups(size / 8, size / 8, 6);
        }
        queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));

        let cube = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        (texture, cube)
    }

    /// Generates the pre-filtered environment map (Specular IBL).
    pub fn generate_prefiltered_map(
        &self,
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        skybox_view: &wgpu::TextureView,
    ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
        let size = 128;
        let mip_levels = 5;
        let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_prefiltered_map"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: size,
                height: size,
                depth_or_array_layers: 6,
            },
            mip_level_count: mip_levels,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba16Float,
            usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::STORAGE_BINDING,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
            label: Some("prefilter_bind_group"),
            layout: &self.pipeline_prefilter.get_bind_group_layout(0),
            entries: &[
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(skybox_view),
                },
                wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 1,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&self.sampler),
                },
            ],
        });

        for mip in 0..mip_levels {
            let mip_size = size >> mip;
            let roughness = mip as f32 / (mip_levels - 1) as f32;

            let storage_view = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
                label: Some(&format!("prefilter_mip_{mip}_storage_view")),
                dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2Array),
                base_mip_level: mip,
                mip_level_count: Some(1),
                ..Default::default()
            });

            let output_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                label: Some(&format!("prefilter_mip_{mip}_output_bind_group")),
                layout: &self.pipeline_prefilter.get_bind_group_layout(1),
                entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&storage_view),
                }],
            });

            let roughness_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
                label: Some("prefilter_roughness_buffer"),
                size: 4,
                usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
                mapped_at_creation: false,
            });
            queue.write_buffer(&roughness_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&[roughness]));

            let uniform_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
                label: Some("prefilter_uniform_bind_group"),
                layout: &self.pipeline_prefilter.get_bind_group_layout(2),
                entries: &[wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
                    binding: 0,
                    resource: roughness_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
                }],
            });

            let mut encoder = device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
                label: Some("ibl_prefilter_encoder"),
            });
            {
                let mut compute_pass = encoder.begin_compute_pass(&wgpu::ComputePassDescriptor {
                    label: Some(&format!("prefilter_mip_{mip}_pass")),
                    timestamp_writes: None,
                });
                compute_pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline_prefilter);
                compute_pass.set_bind_group(0, &bind_group, &[]);
                compute_pass.set_bind_group(1, &output_bind_group, &[]);
                compute_pass.set_bind_group(2, &uniform_bind_group, &[]);
                compute_pass.dispatch_workgroups((mip_size + 7) / 8, (mip_size + 7) / 8, 6);
            }
            queue.submit(Some(encoder.finish()));
        }

        let cube = texture.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            label: Some("ibl_prefiltered_view"),
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        (texture, cube)
    }
}

impl IBLResource {
    /// Generates a full IBL resource from an equirectangular HDR texture.
    pub fn from_equirect(
        device: &wgpu::Device,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        processor: &IBLProcessor,
        equirect: &Texture,
    ) -> Self {
        let skybox = processor.generate_cubemap(device, queue, equirect, 1024);
        let (irradiance_tex, irradiance) =
            processor.generate_irradiance_map(device, queue, &skybox.view);
        let (prefiltered_tex, prefiltered) =
            processor.generate_prefiltered_map(device, queue, &skybox.view);
        let (brdf_tex, brdf_lut) = processor.generate_brdf_lut(device, queue);

        Self {
            irradiance_view: irradiance,
            prefiltered_view: prefiltered,
            brdf_lut_view: brdf_lut,
            environment_view: skybox.view,
            env_loaded: true,
            _owned: vec![skybox.cubemap, irradiance_tex, prefiltered_tex, brdf_tex],
        }
    }

    /// Returns true while no real environment has been loaded
    /// (i.e. [`Self::dummy`] is in place and the env cubemap is black).
    pub fn is_dummy(&self) -> bool {
        !self.env_loaded
    }

    /// Creates a dummy (all-black) IBL resource used before any environment is set.
    ///
    /// Textures stay alive and are cleared to zero. Uninitialized cubemap faces
    /// flash the whole scene white/cyan as the camera samples different directions.
    pub fn dummy(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue) -> Self {
        let tex_usage = wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST;
        let dummy_lut = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("dummy_ibl_brdf_lut"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d { width: 1, height: 1, depth_or_array_layers: 1 },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
            usage: tex_usage,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let dummy_irradiance_cube = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("dummy_ibl_irradiance"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d { width: 1, height: 1, depth_or_array_layers: 6 },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
            usage: tex_usage,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let dummy_prefiltered_cube = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("dummy_ibl_prefiltered"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d { width: 1, height: 1, depth_or_array_layers: 6 },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
            usage: tex_usage,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        let dummy_env_cube = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
            label: Some("dummy_ibl_env"),
            size: wgpu::Extent3d { width: 1, height: 1, depth_or_array_layers: 6 },
            mip_level_count: 1,
            sample_count: 1,
            dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
            format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
            usage: tex_usage,
            view_formats: &[],
        });

        write_black_2d(queue, &dummy_lut);
        write_black_cube(queue, &dummy_irradiance_cube);
        write_black_cube(queue, &dummy_prefiltered_cube);
        write_black_cube(queue, &dummy_env_cube);

        let cube_view_desc = wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor {
            dimension: Some(wgpu::TextureViewDimension::Cube),
            ..Default::default()
        };

        Self {
            irradiance_view: dummy_irradiance_cube.create_view(&cube_view_desc),
            prefiltered_view: dummy_prefiltered_cube.create_view(&cube_view_desc),
            brdf_lut_view: dummy_lut.create_view(&wgpu::TextureViewDescriptor::default()),
            environment_view: dummy_env_cube.create_view(&cube_view_desc),
            env_loaded: false,
            _owned: vec![
                dummy_lut,
                dummy_irradiance_cube,
                dummy_prefiltered_cube,
                dummy_env_cube,
            ],
        }
    }
}

fn write_black_2d(queue: &wgpu::Queue, tex: &wgpu::Texture) {
    let row = vec![0u8; wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT as usize];
    queue.write_texture(
        wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
            texture: tex,
            mip_level: 0,
            origin: wgpu::Origin3d::ZERO,
            aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
        },
        &row,
        wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
            offset: 0,
            bytes_per_row: Some(wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT),
            rows_per_image: Some(1),
        },
        wgpu::Extent3d {
            width: 1,
            height: 1,
            depth_or_array_layers: 1,
        },
    );
}

fn write_black_cube(queue: &wgpu::Queue, tex: &wgpu::Texture) {
    let row = vec![0u8; wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT as usize];
    for layer in 0..6u32 {
        queue.write_texture(
            wgpu::ImageCopyTexture {
                texture: tex,
                mip_level: 0,
                origin: wgpu::Origin3d {
                    x: 0,
                    y: 0,
                    z: layer,
                },
                aspect: wgpu::TextureAspect::All,
            },
            &row,
            wgpu::ImageDataLayout {
                offset: 0,
                bytes_per_row: Some(wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT),
                rows_per_image: Some(1),
            },
            wgpu::Extent3d {
                width: 1,
                height: 1,
                depth_or_array_layers: 1,
            },
        );
    }
}
```

### `src/resource/staging_ring.rs` | **Строк:** 179

```rust
//! Ring-buffered staging allocator for per-frame GPU uploads.
//!
//! Writes are staged into an aligned CPU scratch, then flushed with
//! `queue.write_buffer` (wgpu 0.20 `Buffer` is not `Clone`, so a GPU-side
//! staging copy chain stores destinations at flush via caller-provided refs).
//! Dynamic UBO/SSBO bind offsets must respect WebGPU alignment (default 256).

use std::collections::VecDeque;

/// Number of virtual frames the ring keeps alive before reclaiming space.
pub const FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT: usize = 2;

/// Default ring capacity (64 MiB).
pub const DEFAULT_RING_CAPACITY: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

/// A pending host→device upload recorded against the CPU scratch.
struct PendingWrite {
    src_offset: u64,
    size: u64,
    /// Index into the flush-time destination table supplied by the caller.
    dst_index: u32,
    dst_offset: u64,
}

/// Allocation result: byte range inside the staging buffer.
pub struct StagingAlloc<'a> {
    pub offset: u64,
    pub data: &'a mut [u8],
}

/// Ring staging buffer with per-frame watermarks.
pub struct StagingRing {
    capacity: u64,
    /// Next write cursor (bytes).
    head: u64,
    /// Alignments snapped from device limits (portable default 256).
    pub uniform_align: u64,
    pub storage_align: u64,
    /// Watermark at end of each completed frame (for reclaim).
    frame_ends: VecDeque<u64>,
    pending: Vec<PendingWrite>,
    /// CPU-side scratch for the current frame's uploads.
    cpu_scratch: Vec<u8>,
    scratch_used: usize,
}

impl StagingRing {
    pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, capacity: u64) -> Self {
        let limits = device.limits();
        let uniform_align = limits.min_uniform_buffer_offset_alignment as u64;
        let storage_align = limits.min_storage_buffer_offset_alignment as u64;
        Self {
            capacity,
            head: 0,
            uniform_align,
            storage_align,
            frame_ends: VecDeque::with_capacity(FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT),
            pending: Vec::with_capacity(64),
            cpu_scratch: vec![0u8; capacity as usize],
            scratch_used: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Align required for dynamic uniform / storage bind offsets.
    pub fn dynamic_align(&self) -> u64 {
        self.uniform_align.max(self.storage_align).max(256)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn align_up(value: u64, align: u64) -> u64 {
        debug_assert!(align.is_power_of_two());
        (value + align - 1) & !(align - 1)
    }

    fn alloc_offset(&mut self, size: u64, align: u64, dynamic: bool) -> Option<u64> {
        let align = if dynamic {
            align.max(self.dynamic_align())
        } else {
            align.max(4)
        };
        let offset = Self::align_up(self.head, align);
        let end = offset.checked_add(size)?;
        if end > self.capacity {
            self.head = 0;
            let offset = Self::align_up(0, align);
            let end = offset.checked_add(size)?;
            if end > self.capacity {
                return None;
            }
            self.head = end;
            return Some(offset);
        }
        self.head = end;
        Some(offset)
    }

    /// Reserve `size` bytes. Returns a mutable slice into the CPU scratch.
    pub fn alloc(&mut self, size: u64, align: u64, dynamic: bool) -> Option<StagingAlloc<'_>> {
        let offset = self.alloc_offset(size, align, dynamic)?;
        let start = offset as usize;
        let end = start + size as usize;
        self.scratch_used = self.scratch_used.max(end);
        Some(StagingAlloc {
            offset,
            data: &mut self.cpu_scratch[start..end],
        })
    }

    /// Copy `bytes` into the scratch and record a write to destination slot
    /// `dst_index` (index into the slice passed to [`Self::flush`]).
    pub fn write_slot(
        &mut self,
        dst_index: u32,
        dst_offset: u64,
        bytes: &[u8],
        dynamic: bool,
    ) -> bool {
        let size = bytes.len() as u64;
        let align = if dynamic { self.dynamic_align() } else { 4 };
        let Some(offset) = self.alloc_offset(size, align, dynamic) else {
            return false;
        };
        let start = offset as usize;
        let end = start + bytes.len();
        self.cpu_scratch[start..end].copy_from_slice(bytes);
        self.scratch_used = self.scratch_used.max(end);
        self.pending.push(PendingWrite {
            src_offset: offset,
            size,
            dst_index,
            dst_offset,
        });
        true
    }

    /// Flush all pending writes into `dests[dst_index]` via `queue.write_buffer`.
    pub fn flush(&mut self, queue: &wgpu::Queue, dests: &[&wgpu::Buffer]) {
        for w in self.pending.drain(..) {
            let Some(dst) = dests.get(w.dst_index as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            let start = w.src_offset as usize;
            let end = start + w.size as usize;
            queue.write_buffer(dst, w.dst_offset, &self.cpu_scratch[start..end]);
        }
        self.scratch_used = 0;
    }

    /// Immediate upload (bypass pending queue) with ring alignment accounting.
    pub fn write_immediate(
        &mut self,
        queue: &wgpu::Queue,
        dst: &wgpu::Buffer,
        dst_offset: u64,
        bytes: &[u8],
        dynamic: bool,
    ) -> bool {
        let size = bytes.len() as u64;
        let align = if dynamic { self.dynamic_align() } else { 4 };
        if self.alloc_offset(size, align, dynamic).is_none() {
            // Ring full — still write directly so callers never fail silently.
            queue.write_buffer(dst, dst_offset, bytes);
            return true;
        }
        queue.write_buffer(dst, dst_offset, bytes);
        true
    }

    /// Mark end of frame; after `FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT` frames, reclaim prefix.
    pub fn end_frame(&mut self) {
        self.frame_ends.push_back(self.head);
        while self.frame_ends.len() > FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT {
            let _ = self.frame_ends.pop_front();
        }
        self.scratch_used = 0;
        self.pending.clear();
    }
}
```
